**הַחֶרֶס שֶׁאֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לַעֲמֹד.** כְּגוֹן חֶרֶס הַפּוֹרֵשׁ מִן הֶחָבִית וּמִן הַקְּדֵרָה בִּמְקוֹם הָאֹזֶן, וְאֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לַעֲמֹד בְּלֹא סְמִיכָה מִפְּנֵי כֹבֶד הָאֹזֶן שֶׁמַּכְבִּיד וּמַכְרִיעוֹ, אוֹ מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהָיָה בּוֹ חִדּוּד שֶׁהוּא חַד בְּתַחְתִּיתוֹ וְאֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לָשֶׁבֶת שֶׁלֹּא מְסֻמָּךְ:


החרס שאינו יכול לעמוד – such as a shard that separates from the jug or from the pot in the place of the ear/handle, and it is not able to stand without support because of the weight of the ear/handle that makes it heavy and outweighs it, or because it had in it a pointed knob which is sharp at its bottom and it cannot sit [straight] without being supported.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:1:2)


**נִטְּלָה הָאֹזֶן טָהוֹר.** דִּכְלִי חֶרֶס כֵּיוָן שֶׁטָּהַר שָׁעָה אַחַת שׁוּב אֵין לוֹ טֻמְאָה לְעוֹלָם:


נטלה האוזן טהור – for an earthenware vessel that is pure for one hour, it furthermore will not ever have defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:1:3)


**וְרַבִּי יְהוּדָה מְטַמֵּא.** דְּלֵית לֵיהּ הַךְ סְבָרָא:


ור' יהודה מטמא – for he doesn’t hold this reasoning.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:1:4)


**אוֹ שֶׁנֶּחְלְקָה.** לְאָרְכָּהּ כְּמִין שְׁתֵּי עֲרֵבוֹת, וְאֵינָהּ יְכוֹלָה לֵישֵׁב עַל תַּחְתֶּיהָ אֶלָּא עַל דָּפְנוֹתֶיהָ:


או שנחלקה –[or that was split] lengthwise like two troughs, and is unable to sit on its bottom other than on its sides.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:1:5)


**רַבִּי יְהוּדָה מְטַהֵר.** דְּסָבַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה דְהָא דִתְנַן הַדַּקִּים שֶׁבִּכְלֵי חֶרֶס יוֹשְׁבִים שֶׁלֹּא מְסֻמָּכִים שֶׁהֵן טְמֵאִים, הַיְנוּ מִן הַשּׁוּלַיִם וְלֹא מִן הַדְּפָנוֹת, שֶׁצָּרִיךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה שֶׁבֶר הַכְּלִי יוֹשֵׁב עַל שׁוּלָיו כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁיּוֹשֵׁב כְּשֶׁהוּא שָׁלֵם:


רבי יהודה מטהר – for Rabbi Yehuda holds that as it is taught in the Mishnah (Tractate Kelim, Chapter 2, Mishnah 2): “The smallest/thinnest of earthenware vessels that sits without supports are impure, that is from the rims and not from the sides, that there needs to be a shard of the of the vessel sitting on its rim in the manner that it sits when it is whole.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:1:6)


**וַחֲכָמִים מְטַמְּאִין.** דְּסָבְרֵי כֵלִים עֲשׂוּיִין לְהוֹשִׁיבָן עַל דָּפְנוֹתֵיהֶן לִפְרָקִים:


וחכמים מטמאין – for they hold that vessels that are made to set them on their sides periodically.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:2:1)


**וְאֵינָהּ יְכוֹלָה לְהִטַּלְטֵל בַּחֲצִי קַב גְּרוֹגָרוֹת.** מִתּוֹךְ שֶׁהִיא רְעוּעָה וְהַגְּרוֹגָרוֹת מַכְבִּידִים נִשְׁבֶּרֶת לְגַמְרֵי בְטִלְטוּלָהּ. וּלְכָךְ שִׁעֲרוּ בַחֲצִי קַב, דְּהוּא שִׁעוּר סְעוּדָה אַחַת. דְּקַב גְּרוֹגָרוֹת הוּא שִׁעוּר שְׁתֵּי סְעוּדוֹת, כִּדְמוּכָח בְּסוֹף מַסֶּכֶת פֵּאָה גַבֵּי אֵין פּוֹחֲתִין לֶעָנִי בַגֹּרֶן מִקַּב גְּרוֹגָרוֹת. וְכָל דְּלֹא חַזְיָא לְטַלְטֵל בָּהּ שִׁעוּר סְעוּדָה אַחַת, כִּשְׁבוּרָה דָּמְיָא:


ואינה יכולה להטלטל בחצי קב גרוגרות – because it is cracked/broken, and the dried figs weigh down upon the broken parts completely while being carried. And therefore, its measure is one-half-of-a-Kab, which is the measure of one meal. For a Kab of dried figs is the measure for two meals as it is proven at the end of the Tractate Peah (Chapter 8, Mishnah 5): “[When dispensing poor man’s tithe], they may give to the por at the threshing floor no less than…one Kab of dried figs.” But everything that is not worthy to carry in it the measure of one meal is like something that is broken.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:2:2)


**גִּסְטְרָא.** כְּלִי חֶרֶס שֶׁנֶּחְלַק לִשְׁנַיִם, וְנַעֲשָׂה גִיסֵי תְּרֵי:


גיסטרא (see Tractate Kelim, Chapter 2, Mishnah 6 – something defective/broken) – an earthenware vessel that is split into two, and it becomes two sides.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:2:3)


**שֶׁאֵין שְׁיָרִים לִשְׁיָרִים.** כְּלִי שָׁלֵם חָסִים עָלָיו וּמִשּׁוּם סֶדֶק פּוּרְתָּא לֹא שָׁדוּ לֵיהּ, וּמְבִיאִין שְׁיָרִים שֶׁל כְּלִי דְהַיְנוּ שֶׁבֶר כְּלִי וּמְשִׂימִין תַּחְתָּיו, אֲבָל שֶׁבֶר כְּלִי מִכִּי נִסְדַּק בְּמוֹצִיא מַשְׁקֶה מִשְׁדָא שָׁדוּ לֵיהּ, שֶׁאֵין אוֹמְרִים הָבֵא שֶׁבֶר כְּלִי אַחֵר לְהָנִיחַ תַּחַת שֶׁבֶר כְּלִי זֶה:


שאין שיריים לשיריים – we have compassion upon a complete vessel and because of a small crack, we don’t pour into it [liquids] and we bring the remnants of the vessel, that is the shards of a vessel and place them underneath it. But the shards of a vessel when it is cracked it releases liquid we throw it out, for we don’t say: bring a shard of one vessel to place underneath the shard of this vessel.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:1)


**כֹּל שֶׁנִּטְּלוּ אָזְנֶיהָ.** חֲשׁוּבָה גִסְטְרָא, וַאֲפִלּוּ הִיא שְׁלֵמָה, הוֹאִיל וְאֵין לָהּ אָזְנַיִם לְטַלְטְלָהּ מִמָּקוֹם לְמָקוֹם. וְאִם נִתְרוֹעֲעָה, שִׁעוּרָהּ כְּמוֹצִיא מַשְׁקֶה:


כל שנטלו אזניה – [when its handles have been removed] – it is considered defective/broken, fo since it lacks handles to carry it from place to place, and if it was cracked, its measure is like as it releases liquid.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:2)


**הָיוּ בָהּ חִדּוּדִים.** סְתָם חֶרֶס שֶׁנִּשְׁבָּר יוֹצְאִין מִמֶּנּוּ חִדּוּדִים. כְּמוֹ [אִיּוֹב מא] חַדּוּדֵי חָרֶס:


היו בה חדודים (if there were prongs projecting from the bottom of the misshaped vessel) – a mere earthenware [vessel] that was broken, there projects from [its bottom] prongs, as [it states in] (Job 41:22): “His underpart is jagged shards; [It spreads a threshing sledge on the mud].”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:3)


**כֹּל הַמְקַבֵּל עִמָּהּ בְּזֵיתִים.** אִם אֵין כַּזַּיִת יוֹצֵא בֵּין חִדּוּד לְחִדּוּד, חֲשׁוּב תּוֹךְ כְּמוֹ הַגִּסְטְרָא עַצְמָהּ וּמִטַּמֵּא אֲפִלּוּ בַאֲוִיר. אֲבָל אִם יוֹצֵא זַיִת מִבֵּינְתַיִם, אֵינוֹ מִטַּמֵּא בַאֲוִיר. אֲבָל מִטַּמֵּא בְמַגָּע מִטַּעַם יָד:


כל המקבל עמה בזיתים – if an olive does not protrude between each prong, it is considered as “inside” like the גיסטרא/defective receptacle itself and defiles even the airspace, but if the olive does not protrude from between them, it does not defile airspace, but it does defile through contact by reason of the hand.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:4)


**הָיְתָה מֻטָּה עַל צִדָּהּ.** שֶׁנֶּחְלְקָה לְאָרְכָּהּ כְּמִין עֲרֵבָה וְאֵינָהּ יוֹשֶׁבֶת אֶלָּא עַל דָּפְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיֵשׁ לָהּ חִדּוּדִים:


היתה מוטה על צדה – that it was split by length like a kind of trough and doesn’t sit other than upon its sides/walls and it has prongs projecting.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:5)


**כֹּל הַמְקַבֵּל עִמָּהּ בְּזֵיתִים.** כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁמִּטַּמְּאָה כְשֶׁיּוֹשֶׁבֶת עַל שׁוּלֶיהָ כָּךְ מִטַּמְּאָה יוֹשֶׁבֶת עַל צִדָּהּ. וּסְתָם מַתְנִיתִין כַּחֲכָמִים דִּלְעֵיל דִּמְטַמְּאִין בֶּחָבִית שֶׁנֶּחְלְקָה כְמִין שְׁנֵי עֲרֵבוֹת:


כל המקבל עמה בזיתים – in the manner that it defiles when it is sitting on its rim, so also it defiles while sitting on its side. But our anonymous Mishnah is according to the Sages of above (see Tractate Kelim, Chapter 4, Mishnah 1) that defiles regarding a jar that was split like two troughs.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:6)


**קַתֶּדְרָא.** כִּסֵּא שֶׁל נָשִׁים הַהֹלְכוֹת עַל הָעֲגָלָה:


קתדרא – a seat of women that walk on the wagon (see Tractate Kelim, Chapter 24, Mishnah 2).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:3:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:7)


**קוֹרְפִיּוֹת.** עַל שֵׁם מְקוֹמָן. וְהֵן כֵּלִים חַדִּים שֶׁאֵין יוֹשְׁבִים שֶׁלֹּא מְסֻמָּכִין:


קורפיות – on account of their place. But they are sharp vessels that they do not sit upon without support.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:3:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:8)


**וְקוֹסִים.** לְשׁוֹן קְשׂוֹת הַנָּסֶךְ [בְּמִדְבָּר ה], וּבְסַנְהֶדְרִין הַגּוֹנֵב אֶת הַקַּסְוָא, וְהוּא שֵׁם לִכְלִי שָׁרֵת. וְקוֹסִין הֵן מִינֵי כֵלִים שֶׁשּׁוּלֵיהֶן חַדִּין וּכְשֶׁמְּבַשְּׁלִים בָּהֶן מַנִּיחִין אוֹתָן עַל כְּלִי בַרְזֶל שֶׁקּוֹרִין טריפיד"י בְּלַעַ"ז, וּכְשֶׁמּוֹרִידִים אוֹתָן סוֹמְכִין אוֹתָן בְּאֵפֶר הַכִּירָה:


וקוסימן – the language of )Numbers 4:7): “[Over the table of display they shall spread a blue cloth; they shall place upon it the bowls, the ladles, the jars,] and the libation jugs.” But in [Tractate] Sanhedrin [Chapter 9, Mishnah 8] “a person who steals the vessel for libation,” and this is the name for the sacred vessels, and קוסים/rough-edged cups are kinds of vessels that their bottoms are sharp and when they cook in them, they place them on an iron vessel that they call TRIPIDI in the foreign language, and when hey lower them, they support them in he ashes of the portable stove on feet.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:3:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:3:9)


**הַצִּידוֹנִין.** שֶׁנַּעֲשִׂים בְּצִידוֹן:


הצידונין – that are made in Sidon.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:4:1)


**שְׂפָיוֹת.** מִלְּשׁוֹן שָׂפָה. שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ שָׁלֹשׁ שְׂפָתוֹת לְפִיו, וַאֲוִיר בֵּינְתַיִם בֵּין שָׂפָה לְשָׂפָה:


שפאיות – from the language of שפה/rim, border. That it has three rims for its mouth and airspace in-between them. Between each rim.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:4:2)


**הַפְּנִימִית עוֹדֶפֶת הַכֹּל טָהוֹר.** כָּל מַה שֶּׁהוּא חוּץ מִמֶּנָּה נֶחְשָׁב כְּגַבּוֹ שֶׁל כְּלִי וְאֵין כְּלִי חֶרֶס מִטַּמֵּא מִגַּבּוֹ. אֲבָל מַה שֶּׁבְּתוֹךְ הַפְּנִימִית טָמֵא:


הפנימית עודפת הכל טהור (if the inner one is largest – in height) – everything that is outside from it is considered like the back of the utensil/vessel and an earthenware vessel cannot be made impure from its outside. But what is within on the inside is impure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:4:3)


**הַחִיצוֹנָה עוֹדֶפֶת הַכֹּל טָמֵא.** דַּהֲוֵי חוּצָה לָהּ כְּגַבּוֹ שֶׁל כְּלִי וְלִפְנִים מִמֶּנָּה חֲשׁוּב תּוֹךְ. וְכֵן אִם אֶמְצָעִית גְּבוֹהָה, מִמֶּנָּה וְלַחוּץ חֲשׁוּב גַּב וְלִפְנִים חֲשׁוּב תּוֹךְ, שֶׁהַכְּלִי מִתְמַלֵּא עַד הַגְּבוֹהָה:


החיצונה עודפת הכל אמא – for that which is outside it is like on the back of the utensil/vessel, and what is in front of it is considered the inside. And similarly, if the middle [rim] is highest, from it and outward is considered on top of and what is inward is considered inside, for the vessel is filled until is highest part.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:4:4)


**הָיוּ שָׁווֹת.** שֶׁאֵין אַחַת מִן הַשְּׂפָתוֹת עוֹדֶפֶת עַל חֲבֶרְתָּהּ:


היו שוות – that none of the rims is larger than its neighbor.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:4:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:4:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:4:5)


**וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים הַכֹּל טָהוֹר.** הַשָּׂפָה שֶׁנָּפְלָה הַטֻּמְאָה בַאֲוִירָהּ בִּלְבַד הִיא טְמֵאָה, וְהַשְּׁאָר הַכֹּל טָהוֹר. וְכֵן הֲלָכָה:


וחכמים אומרים הכל טהור – the rim that the defilement fell upon in its airspace alone is impure, but the remainder is all pure. And this is the Halakha.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:4:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:4:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:4:6)


**מִשֶּׁיִּצְרְפֵם בַּכִּבְשָׁן.** וְקֹדֶם צֵרוּף הֵן כְּלֵי אֲדָמָה וְאֵין מִטַּמְּאִין:


משיצרפם בכבשן – but prior to smelting it is a vessel of earth and does not become defiled.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 4:4:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:4:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/4:4:7)


**וְהוּא גְמָר מְלַאכְתָּן.** וְאַף עַל גַּב דִּלְאַחַר צֵרוּף הַכִּבְשָׁן צְרִיכִין תִּקּוּן לְמָרְחָן לְהַחְלִיקָן וּלְהַשְׁווֹת שְׂפָתָן, אַף עַל פִּי כֵן מִשֶּׁיְּצָרְפֵם בַּכִּבְשָׁן חֲשִׁיב נִגְמְרָה מְלַאכְתָּן וּמִטַּמְּאִין:


והוא גמר מלאכה – but even though that after smelting the furnace, it requires repair for washing, to smooth them and to even out their borders, nevertheless, from when they are fired in the furnace, it is considered that their manufacture has been completed and they can become defiled.



## Chapter 5


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:1)


**תַּנּוּר תְּחִלָּתוֹ אַרְבָּעָה.** סְתָם תַּנּוּר עָשׂוּי כְּמִין קְדֵרָה גְדוֹלָה שֶׁאֵין לָהּ שׁוּלַיִם, וּמְחַבְּרִים אוֹתוֹ בְטִיט עַל גַּבֵּי קַרְקַע, וְרִצְפַּת הַקַּרְקַע הִיא תַחְתִּיתוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר. וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמֵּעַצְמוֹ אֵין לוֹ בֵית קִבּוּל, אַף עַל פִּי כֵן טָמֵא, דִּבְתוֹכוֹ תָלָה רַחֲמָנָא וַהֲרֵי יֵשׁ לוֹ תוֹךְ:


תנור תחלתו ארבע – an undefined oven is made like a larger pot which lacks a rim at the bottom of the vessel, and they fasten it with plaster on the ground, and the floor of the ground is the bottom of the oven. But even though that of itself it lacks a receptacle, it is nevertheless impure, for the All-Merciful assigned it by its insides, and behold it has an inside.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:2)


**תְּחִלָּתוֹ אַרְבָּעָה.** אֵין גָּבְהוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר פָּחוֹת מֵאַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים:


תחלתו ארבעה – the height of the oven is not less than four handbreadths.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:3)


**וּשְׁיָרָיו.** אִם הָיָה גָדוֹל וְנִטְמָא וְאַחַר כָּךְ נִשְׁבַּר, לֹא טָהֵר עַד שֶׁלֹּא יִהְיֶה בִשְׁבָרָיו אַרְבָּעָה:


ושייריו – if it was large and it became defiled and afterwards was broken, it would not be purified until there would not be in its remnants four [handbreadths].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:4)


**בַּמֶּה דְבָרִים אֲמוּרִים.** דִּתְחִלָּתוֹ וּשְׁיָרָיו אַרְבָּעָה:


במה דברים אמורים – that its beginning and its remnants would be four [handbreadths].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:5)


**בְּגָדוֹל.** הֶעָשׂוּי לֶאֱפוֹת וְלִצְלוֹת בּוֹ כְדֶרֶךְ הַתַּנּוּרִים:


בגדול – that is made to bake and to roast with it in the manner of overs.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:6)


**אֲבָל בְּקָטָן.** הֶעָשׂוּי לְתִינוֹקוֹת לְצַחֵק בּוֹ:


אבל בקטן – that is made for young children to play in.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:7)


**תְּחִלָּתוֹ כָּל שֶׁהוּא.** וְלָאו דַּוְקָא כָל שֶׁהוּא, דִּבְצִיר מִטֶּפַח לֹא הָוֵי:


תחלתו כל שהוא – but not exactly any small amount, for less than a handbreadth is not anything (see Talmud Hullin 124a).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:8)


**וּשְׁיָרָיו בְּרֻבּוֹ.** בַּגְּמָרָא בְּפֶרֶק הָעוֹר וְהָרֹטֶב [חֻלִּין דַּף קכד] מַקְשֶׁה עַל מַתְנִיתִין דְּהָכָא, וּבְצִיר מִטֶּפַח לְמַאי חֲזִי. וּמְשָׁנֵי, הַאי וּשְׁיָרָיו בְּרֻבּוֹ אַגָּדוֹל קָאֵי, וְלֹא אַתַּנּוּר קָטָן. וּמוֹתְבִינַן, בְּגָדוֹל, הָא קָאָמַר וּשְׁיָרָיו אַרְבָּעָה, דְּהָא קָתָנֵי בַּמֶּה דְבָרִים אֲמוּרִים בְּגָדוֹל מַשְׁמַע דְּלֹא פְלִיגֵי חֲכָמִים עַל תַּנָּא קַמָּא בְגָדוֹל כְּלָל. וּמְשָׁנֵי, הָא בְתַנּוּר בַּר שִׁבְעָה הָא בְתַנּוּר בַּר תִּשְׁעָה, כְּלוֹמַר בַּר שִׁבְעָה שְׁיָרָיו בְּרֻבּוֹ, וְאַף עַל פִּי דְלָא הָווּ אַרְבָּעָה וְאֵין תַּנּוּר פָּחוֹת מֵאַרְבָּעָה, הוֹאִיל וּמִתְּחִלָּתוֹ הָיָה כְלִי חָשׁוּב מִשְׁתַּמְּשִׁין בִּשְׁיָרָיו אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵינָן רְאוּיִין כָּל כָּךְ. וּבְתַנּוּר שֶׁל תִּשְׁעָה דְרֻבּוֹ הָוֵי שִׁעוּר גָּדוֹל, מְטַמֵּא בִּשְׁיָרָיו בְּאַרְבָּעָה, כִּתְחִלָּתוֹ:


ושייריו ברובו – In the Gemara in the chapter: “The Hide and the Grease”/העור והרוטב [Chapter 9 of Tractate Hullin 124a] it raises a question on our Mishnah that is here, that less than a handbreadth, of what is it worth? And it (i.e., the Gemara) answers, that the “remnant” that is referred to is the majority of the large [oven], and it is not about the small over. And We raise the objection, that with a large [oven]. And we raise the objection, regarding a large [oven], surely it states “and its remnants” are four [handbreadths], for it surely teaches: “Under what circumstances?” with a large [oven], implying that the Sages did not dispute with the first Tanna/teacher (i.e., Rabbi Meir) regarding a large [oven] at all. And it answers: This one is speaking about an oven of seven [handbreadths] and that one is [speaking of] an oven of nine [handbreadths], that is to say, something of seven [handbreadths] whose remnants are the majority/larger part, and even though there aren’t four [handbreadths] and there is no oven with less than four [handbreadths], for since, from its outset, it was an important vessel which used its remnants, even though they were not so worthy, and with an oven of nine [handbreadths] where its majority/larger part is a large measure, it defiles with its remnants with four [handbreadths] at its outset.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:1:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:9)


**מִשֶּׁתִּגָּמֵר מְלַאכְתּוֹ.** אַתְּחִלַּת תַּנּוּר קָאֵי. מֵאֵימָתַי הַתַּנּוּר מִטַּמֵּא, מִשֶּׁתִּגָּמֵר מְלַאכְתּוֹ:


משתגמר מלאכתו – it refers to the beginning of the oven. From when does the oven become defiled? From when its manufacture is complete.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:1:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:10)


**מִשֶּׁיַּסִּיקֶנּוּ.** אַף עַל גַּב דִּשְׁאָר כְּלֵי חֶרֶס סַגִּי לְהוּ בְצֵרוּף כִּבְשָׁן, תַּנּוּר דְּבָעֵי לְדַבֵּק בּוֹ טִיט לְעַבּוֹתוֹ לְהַחֲזִיק חֻמּוֹ לֹא נִגְמְרָה מְלַאכְתּוֹ עַד שֶׁיַּסִּיקֶנּוּ. וּמִיהוּ לֹא בָעֵי הֶסֵּק גָּדוֹל כְּדֵי לֶאֱפוֹת בּוֹ פַת, אֶלָּא כְדֵי לֶאֱפוֹת בּוֹ סֻפְגָּנִים, פַּת שֶׁבְּלִילָתָהּ רַכָּה הָעֲשׂוּיָה כִסְפוֹג, דִּבְהֶסֵּק מֻעָט סַגִּי לַהּ:


משיסיקנו (from when he will heat it – sufficiently] – even though that with the rest of earthenware vessels, it is sufficient for them with the smelting of the kiln (as seen at the conclusion of Chapter 4, Mishnah 4 of Tractate Kelim) an oven that requires to attach/glue it with plaster to be interwoven in order to contain its heat, its manufacture is not complete until it can heat sufficiently. But however, it doesn’t require large heating in order to bake bread in it, but rather in order to bake cakes made of spongy dough, dough that its mixture is soft that is made like a sponge and only a small amount of heating is sufficient for it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:1:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:1:11)


**מִשֶּׁיַּסִּיק אֶת הֶחָדָשׁ כְּדֵי לֶאֱפוֹת בַּיָּשָׁן.** דְּחָדָשׁ כְּדֵי לֶאֱפוֹת בּוֹ סֻפְגָּנִים בָּעֵי הֶסֵּק מְרֻבֶּה מִן הַיָּשָׁן. וְאִם הֻסַּק הֶחָדָשׁ הֶסֵּק מֻעָט דִּבְהֶסֵּק כָּזֶה הָיָה יָשָׁן רָאוּי לֶאֱפוֹת בּוֹ סֻפְגָּנִים, הַיְנוּ גְמַר מְלַאכְתּוֹ. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


משיסיק את החדש כדי לאפות בישן – that the new [oven] in order to bae in it cakes made of spongy dough requires greater heating from the old [oven]. But if the new [oven] was heated with a lesser/smaller heating, that with a heating like this, the old [oven] would be appropriate to bake in it the cakes made of spongy dough, that is when its manufacture is complete. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehuda.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:1)


**כִּירָה.** מְקוֹם שְׁפִיתַת שְׁתֵּי קְדֵרוֹת. וּפְעָמִים שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים הַקְּדֵרוֹת לְבַשֵּׁל בְּתוֹכָהּ וּפְעָמִים עַל גַּבָּהּ:


כירה (a portable stove on feet with caves for two pots) – a place of placing over the fire two pots. But sometimes they place the pots to cook within it and sometimes on top of it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:2)


**תְּחִלָּתָהּ שָׁלֹשׁ.** גָּבְהָהּ אֵין פָּחוֹת מִשָּׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת:


תחלתה שלש – its height is no less than three fingers-breadth.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:3)


**מִשֶּׁתִּגָּמֵר מְלַאכְתָּהּ.** מֵאֵימָתַי מִטַּמְּאָה תְחִלָּתָהּ, מִשֶּׁתִּגָּמֵר מְלַאכְתָּה:


משתיגמר מלאכתה- from when it become defiled initially, from when its manufacture is complete.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:4)


**בֵּיצָה קַלָּה.** בֵּיצַת תַּרְנְגֹלֶת. וְאַמַּאי קָרֵי לַהּ בֵּיצָה קַלָּה, שֶׁהִיא קַלָּה לְבַשֵּׁל יוֹתֵר מִכָּל הַבֵּיצִים:


ביצה קלה – the egg of a chicken. But why do they call it a light (easily boiling) egg? That this is easier to cook more than all the eggs.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:5)


**טְרוּפָה.** כְּשֶׁהִיא טְרוּפָה וּשְׁבוּרָה בַקְּעָרָה:


טרופה – that it is beaten and broken in a bowl (i.e., scrambled).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:6)


**וּנְתוּנָה בְאִלְפָּס.** שֶׁהוּחַם כְּבָר, שֶׁהִיא מְמַהֶרֶת לְהִתְבַּשֵּׁל:


ונתונה באלפס (and placed in a tightly-covered pot) – that was already warmed, for it is boiled quickly.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:7)


**הַכֻּפָּח.** שִׁעוּר שְׁפִיתַת קְדֵרָה אַחַת. וְחֻמּוֹ רַב מֵחֹם הַכִּירָה. וּפְעָמִים שֶׁאוֹפִין בּוֹ פַת:


הכופח – the measurement of the placing over the fire of one pot, and its heat is greater than the heat of the portable stove with caves for two pots, and sometimes they bake bread in it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:2:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:8)


**שִׁעוּרוֹ כַּתַּנּוּר.** כְּדֵי לֶאֱפוֹת סֻפְגָּנִים:


שיעורו כתנור – in order to bake cakes made of spongy dough (i.e., four handbreadths).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:2:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:9)


**שִׁעוּרוֹ כַּכִּירָה.** לְבַשֵּׁל בּוֹ בֵיצָה קַלָּה:


שיעורו ככירה – to make a light boiled egg.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:2:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:10)


**הָאֶבֶן הַיּוֹצֵא.** רְגִילִים לְחַבֵּר אֶבֶן בַּתַּנּוּר שֶׁבּוֹלֶטֶת מִמֶּנּוּ לַחוּץ כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לוֹ לְבֵית אֲחִיזָה, וּכְתַנּוּר דַּמְיָא. וְאִם נִטְמָא הַתַּנּוּר נִטְמֵאת הָאֶבֶן, וְנִטְמָא הַפַּת שֶׁנָּגַע בָּהּ, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא יָד לַתַּנּוּר, וּכְתִיב (ויקרא יא) תַּנּוּר וְכִירַיִם יֻתָּץ וְגוֹ'‏ טְמֵאִים יִהְיוּ לָכֶם, לְכָל שֶׁבְּצָרְכֵיכֶם, לְרַבּוֹת אֶת הַיָּדוֹת שֶׁהֵן צֹרֶךְ לַכְּלִי:


האבן היוצא – they are used to attaching a stone to the oven that projects outward from it in order that it will be for it a handle, and it is compared to an oven. But if the oven is defiled, the stone is [also] defiled, and the bread that came in contact with it is defiled because it is a handle for the oven, as it is written (Leviticus 11:35): “[Everything on which the carcass of any of them falls shall be impure:] an oven or stove shall be smashed. They are impure and impure they shall remain for you,” for everything that is in your needs, to include the handles which are needed for the vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:2:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:11)


**לֹא אָמְרוּ.** דְּיוֹתֵר מִטֶּפַח בַּתַּנּוּר וּמִשָּׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת בַּכִּירָה לֹא הָוֵי חִבּוּר, אֶלָּא כְשֶׁהָאֶבֶן בֵּין הַתַּנּוּר וְלַכֹּתֶל, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁמְּעַכֶּבֶת שֶׁאֵין יְכוֹלִין לְקָרֵב הַתַּנּוּר לַכֹּתֶל וְדוֹחֵק אֶת הַבַּיִת, הִלְכָּךְ יוֹתֵר מִטֶּפַח עוֹמֶדֶת לִנָּטֵל הִיא. אֲבָל לְצַד הַבַּיִת, אֲפִלּוּ גְדוֹלָה הַרְבֵּה, יָד הִיא לַתַּנּוּר. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


לא אמרו – that more than a handbreadth for an oven and from three fingers-breadth for a portable stove on feet with caves for two pots is not considered an attachment, other than when the stone is between the stove and the wall. Because it hinders it for one cannot bring the oven near to the wall and it presses the house, therefore, more than a handbreadth stands to be taken. But at the side of the house, even larger than the handle is to the oven. But the Halakah is not according to Rabbi Yehuda.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:2:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:2:12)


**וְהַשְּׁאָר טָהוֹר.** דְּתַנְיָא בְתוֹרַת כֹּהֲנִים, יָכוֹל שֶׁאֲנִי מְרַבֶּה יוֹתֵר מִכַּשִּׁעוּר, תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר טְמֵאִים הֵם:


והשאר טהור – as it is taught in the Sifra/Torat Kohanim (i.e., the Halakhic Midrash on the Book of Leviticus), it is possible that I earn more than that of its measure, as the inference teaches us, “they are impure” (Leviticus 11:35).



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:1)


**עֲטֶרֶת כִּירָה.** בִּנְיָן עָגֹל עָשׂוּי עַל רֹאשׁ הַכִּירָה כְדֵי לִשְׁמֹר חֻמָּהּ:


עטרת כירה – round building made on the top of the portable stove on feet with caves for two pots/כירה in order to preserve its heat.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:2)


**טְהוֹרָה.** וְאִם נִטְמֵאת הַכִּירָה לֹא נִטְמֵאת הָעֲטֶרֶת, דְּלָא חֲשִׁיבָא עֲטֶרֶת חִבּוּר לַכִּירָה:


טהורה – but if the portable stone on feet with caves for two pots became impure, the crown did not become impure, for the crown is not considered as attached to the portable stove with caves for two pots.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:3)


**טִירַת הַתַּנּוּר.** חֲצַר הַתַּנּוּר, לְשׁוֹן בַּחֲצֵרֵיהֶם וּבְטִירוֹתָם. מָקוֹם לִפְנֵי הַתַּנּוּר מֻקָּף מְחִצּוֹת שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים בּוֹ הַלֶּחֶם כְּשֶׁרוֹדִין אוֹתוֹ מִן הַתַּנּוּר:


טירת התנור (the surrounding of an oven/brick-work/fender) – the courtyard of the oven, it is the language of (Genesis 25:16): “[These are the sons of Ishmael and these are their names] by their villages and their encampments: [twelve chieftains of as many tribes].” It is ap lace in front of the oven that is surrounded by partitions where they place in it the bread when they detach/ shovel out bread from [where it sticks to] the oven.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:4)


**בִּזְמַן שֶׁהִיא גְבוֹהָה אַרְבָּעָה.** כְּשִׁעוּר גָּבְהוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר שֶׁתְּחִלָּתוֹ אַרְבָּעָה:


בזמן שהוא גבוהה ארבעה – as the measure of the height of the oven (which is four handbreadths) at its outset.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:5)


**אֲפִלּוּ עַל שָׁלֹשׁ אֲבָנִים.** שֶׁלֹּא הָיְתָה מְחֻבֶּרֶת חִבּוּר יָפֶה אֶלָּא מֻנַּחַת עַל שָׁלֹשׁ אֲבָנִים בִּלְבַד וּדְבֻקָּה לַתַּנּוּר, חֲשִׁיבָא חִבּוּר:


אפילו על שלש אבנים – that its attachment/connection was not done well but rather, it is lying only on three stones and is glued the oven, it is considered an attachment.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:6)


**בֵּית הַפַּךְ.** מָקוֹם עָשׂוּי בְּצִדֵּי הַכִּירָה שֶׁמַּנִּיחִין בּוֹ פַּךְ שֶׁמֶן לְהַפְשִׁיר:


בית הפך (socket/cruse) – a place that is made on the sides of the portable stove on feet with caves for two pots that they place upon it a cruse of oil to make tepid/cool.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:3:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:7)


**בֵּית הַתְּבָלִין.** מָקוֹם שֶׁמַּנִּיחִין בּוֹ אֶת הַתְּבָלִין:


בית תבלין – a place where they place in it the spices.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:3:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:8)


**בֵּית הַנֵּר.** מָקוֹם שֶׁמַּנִּיחִין בּוֹ הַנֵּר:


בית הנר – a place where they place in it the lamp.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:3:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:9)


**מִטַּמְּאִין בְּמַגָּע.** אִם נָגַע שֶׁרֶץ בְּתוֹךְ הַכִּירָה נִטְמְאוּ הַמְּקוֹמוֹת הַלָּלוּ בְטֻמְאַת הַכִּירָה. וְכֵן אִם נִטְמָא אֶחָד מִן הַמְּקוֹמוֹת הַלָּלוּ בְמַגַּע שֶׁרֶץ נִטְמֵאת הַכִּירָה עִמָּהֶם, דַּחֲשִׁיבֵי כְכִירָה וְהֵם דָּבָר אֶחָד לְעִנְיַן טֻמְאַת מַגָּע:


מיטמאין במגע – if an unclean reptile came in contact within the portable stove on feet with caves for two pots, these places became unclean through the defilement of the portable stove on feet with caves for two pots. And similarly, if one of these places became defiled through contact with the unclean reptile, the portable stove on feet with caves for two pots became impure with them, for they are considered like the portable stove on feet with caves for two pots and they are one thing regarding the matter of defilement through physical contact.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:3:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:10)


**וְאֵין מִטַּמְּאִין בַּאֲוִיר.** אִם נִתְלָה שֶׁרֶץ בַּאֲוִיר כִּירָה וְלֹא נָגַע בָּהּ, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהִיא טְמֵאָה, דִכְלִי חֶרֶס מִטַּמֵּא בַאֲוִיר, הֵן טְהוֹרִין, שֶׁאֵינָם חִבּוּר לָהּ אֶלָּא לְעִנְיַן מַגָּע. מִשּׁוּם דְּמִן הַתּוֹרָה אֵינָם חִבּוּר לָהּ, וְרַבָּנָן הוּא דְגַזּוּר עֲלַיְהוּ טֻמְאָה, וַעֲבַדוּ רַבָּנָן הֶכֵּרָא דְלָא לִטַּמְּאוּ בַאֲוִיר, כִּי הֵיכִי דְלָא לִשְּׂרְפוּ עֲלַיְהוּ תְרוּמָה וְקָדָשִׁים:


ואין מיטמאין באויר – if an unclean reptile was suspended in the airspace of the portable stove on feet with caves for two pots but did not come in contact with it, even though it is defiled, for an earthenware vessel becomes defiled through airspace, they are [ritually] pure, for they are not attached to it other than through the matter of physical contact. Because from the Torah, they are not attached to it, but the Rabbis decreed upon them defilement, as the Rabbis made an indication/sign not to defile it by airspace, in order that they not burn upon them heave-offering and Holy Things.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:3:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:3:11)


**וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן מְטַהֵר.** אֲפִלּוּ בְמַגָּע, כָּל מָקוֹם שֶׁלֹּא נָגְעָה בוֹ טֻמְאָה, דְּכָל חַד וְחַד כְּלִי בְאַנְפֵּי נַפְשֵׁיהּ הוּא. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי מֵאִיר:


ור' שמעון מטהר – [Rabb Shimon declares it pure] even through physical contact. Every place where defilement did not come in contact with it for each and every vessel is separate/independent. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Meir.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:4:1)


**תַּנּוּר שֶׁהֻסַּק מֵאֲחוֹרָיו.** שֶׁאֵין הַתַּנּוּר מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה עַד שֶׁיַּסִּיקֶנּוּ, וְאִם לֹא הֻסַּק מִבִּפְנִים אֶלָּא מִבַּחוּץ, חֲשִׁיב הֶסֵּק:


תנור שהוסק מאחוריו – that the oven does not become susceptible to receive defilement until it is heated, and if it is not heated from the inside, but rather from the outside, it is considered heating.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:4:2)


**אוֹ שֶׁהֻסַּק שֶׁלֹּא לְדַעְתּוֹ.** [אֲפִלּוּ מִבִּפְנִים]:


או הוסק שלא לדעתו – [even from the inside].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:4:3)


**אוֹ שֶׁהֻסַּק בְּבֵית הָאֻמָּן.** קֹדֶם שֶׁנִּגְמַר מְלֶאכֶת עֲשִׂיָּתוֹ:


או שהוסק בבית האומן – prior to the completion of the manufacture of its being made.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:4:4)


**טָמֵא.** גָּרְסִינַן. וְיֵשׁ סְפָרִים שֶׁגּוֹרְסִין טָהוֹר, וְשִׁבּוּשׁ הוּא:


טמא – we have the reading. But there are books that we have the reading, that it is pure, and this is a blunder/confusion.



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:5:1)


**מוּסַף הַתַּנּוּר.** תּוֹסַפְתּוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר שֶׁמּוֹסִיפִין בְּגָבְהוֹ כְדֵי לִשְׁמֹר חֻמּוֹ:


מוסף התנור (chimney-piece of the oven) – the addition of the oven that they at its top in order to preserve its heat.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:5:2)


**מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא סוֹמֵךְ עָלָיו אֶת הַשַּׁפּוּד.** שֶׁל בָּשָׂר, שֶׁרְגִילִים לִצְלוֹת בּוֹ בָשָׂר, וְהָוֵי דְבַר צֹרֶךְ לַתַּנּוּר. וְרַחֲמָנָא אָמַר וּטְמֵאִים יִהְיוּ לָכֶם, לְכָל שֶׁבְּצָרְכֵיכֶם, כִּדְדָרְשִׁינַן לְעֵיל [בְּמִשְׁנָה ב]:


מפני שהוא סומך עליו את השפוד (because it supports the roasting-spit on it) – of meat, for they regularly roast meat on it, and it is a thing that is necessary for the oven. And the All-Merciful states (Leviticus 11:35): “and unclean they shall remain for you,” to everything that are your needs, as we expounded above [in Mishnah 2 of Chapter 5 of Tractate Kelim].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:5:3)


**מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא אוֹפֶה בוֹ כְּשֶׁהוּא נִדְחָק.** כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ אֻכְלוּסִין מְרֻבִּין וְצָרִיךְ לְפַת מְרֻבָּה. וְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן לֹא סַגִּי לֵיהּ בְּטַעֲמָא דְתַנָּא קַמָּא מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא סוֹמֵךְ עָלָיו אֶת הַשַּׁפּוּד, דִּסְבִירָא לֵיהּ דְּבָעִינַן שֶׁיְּהֵא תַשְׁמִישׁ הַתּוֹסֶפֶת כְּעֵין תַּשְׁמִישׁ גּוּפוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר:


מפני שהוא אופה בו כשהוא נדחק – when he has many forced laborers and he the need for a great deal of bread. But for Rabbi Yohanan [HaSandlar], the reason of the first Tanna/teacher is not sufficient for him because he rests the roasting-spin upon it, and he holds that we require that the additional usage would like the usage of the body of the oven.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:5:4)


**מוּסַף הַיּוֹרָה שֶׁל שׁוֹלְקֵי זֵיתִים.** דֶּרֶךְ שׁוֹלְקֵי זֵיתִים וְצַבָּעִים שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶם יוֹרוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת וְעוֹשִׂים לָהֶם תּוֹסֶפֶת טִיט עַל שְׂפָתָם שֶׁיַּעֲלוּ בָהּ הַמַּיִם בְּעֵת רְתִיחָתָם. וְשֶׁל שׁוֹלְקֵי זֵיתִים טָמֵא, לְפִי שֶׁאוֹתָהּ תּוֹסֶפֶת צְרִיכָה לַכְּלִי וּמִשְׁתַּמְּשִׁים בָּהּ:


מוסף היורה של שולקי זיתים (rim around a boiler in the ground of olive seethers) – it is the manner of those who seethe/thoroughly boil olives and dyers that have large boilers and they make for them a rim of plaster on the border that water will rise upon it at the time of their foaming. But the seething of olives is unclean/impure, because addition/rim Is needed for the vessel and we use it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:5:5)


**וְשֶׁל צַבָּעִים טָהוֹר.** דְּלֹא מִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בֵּיהּ כִּי הֵיכִי דְלָא לִפְסִיד צִבְעֵיהּ. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן הַסַּנְדְּלָר:


ושל צבעים טהור – for they don’t use it in order that they don’t use its dye. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yohanan HaSandlar.



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:6:1)


**מֵעָפָר וּלְמַטָּן מִטַּמֵּא בְמַגָּע.** אִם נָגַע שֶׁרֶץ בַּתַּנּוּר מִתּוֹכוֹ לְמַעְלָה מִן הֶעָפָר נִטְמָא מַה שֶּׁלְּמַטָּה מִן הֶעָפָר. אֲבָל אִם נִתְלָה הַשֶּׁרֶץ בָּאֲוִיר וְלֹא נָגַע בְּדָפְנֵי הַתַּנּוּר מִתּוֹכוֹ, לֹא נִטְמָא אֶלָּא מַה שֶּׁלְּמַעְלָה מִן הֶעָפָר:


מעפר ולמטן מיטמא במגע – if the unclean reptile touched/came in contact with the oven from within above from the dirt, what is below from the dirt is defile. But if the unclean reptile was suspended in the airspace and did not touch the walls of the oven from inside it, it did not defile anything other than what is above from the dirt [-line].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:6:2)


**בּוֹר.** חֲפִירָה לְמַטָּה בָּאָרֶץ:


בור (cistern) – a pit below the earth.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:6:3)


**דּוּת.** כְּבוֹר הוּא עָשׂוּי, אֶלָּא שֶׁהוּא בִנְיָן לְמַעְלָה מִן הַקַּרְקַע:


דות (cellar) – it is made like a cistern, but it is a building that is above from the ground.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:6:4)


**וְנָתַן שָׁם אֶבֶן.** בֵּין הַבּוֹר וּבֵין דֹּפֶן הַתַּנּוּר, לְהַחֲזִיק הַתַּנּוּר שֶׁלֹּא יִפֹּל לְתוֹךְ הַבּוֹר:


ונתן שם אבן – between the pit and the wall of the oven, to support the oven that it should not fall into the pit/cistern.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:6:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:6:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:6:5)


**אִם מַסִּיק מִלְּמַטָּה.** אִם כְּשֶׁמַּסִּיק הָאוּר מִלְּמַטָּה בְּתוֹךְ הַבּוֹר, הַתַּנּוּר נִסֹּק מִתּוֹכוֹ לְמַעְלָה דֶרֶךְ שׁוּלָיו, טָמֵא. וְאִם לָאו, שֶׁאֵינוֹ נִסֹּק מֵהֶסֵּק הָאוּר שֶׁלְּמַטָּה בְתוֹךְ הַבּוֹר, טָהוֹר. וּפְלֻגְתָּא דְרַבִּי יְהוּדָה וְרַבָּנָן דַּוְקָא בְהֶסֵּק רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁהוּא גְמַר מְלַאכְתּוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר וְעַל יְדֵי אוֹתוֹ הֶסֵּק הוּא מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה, רַבִּי יְהוּדָה סָבַר צָרִיךְ שֶׁיְּהֵא הַתַּנּוּר מְחֻבָּר לָאָרֶץ בְּהֶסֵּק רִאשׁוֹן, דִּכְתִיב תַּנּוּר וְכִירַיִם יֻתָּץ, וְאֵין שַׁיָּךְ לְשׁוֹן נְתִיצָה אֶלָּא בִמְחֻבָּר לַקַּרְקַע, דִּבְמִטַּלְטֵל נוֹפֵל לְשׁוֹן שְׁבִירָה לֹא לְשׁוֹן נְתִיצָה, הִלְכָּךְ אִם הַתַּנּוּר נִסֹּק דֶּרֶךְ שׁוּלָיו מֵהֶסֵּק שֶׁבְּתוֹךְ הַבּוֹר, חֲשִׁיב כִּמְחֻבָּר לַבּוֹר וְקָרִינַן בֵּיהּ יֻתָּץ, וְאִם אֵינוֹ נִסֹּק מֵהֶסֵּק הַבּוֹר הֲרֵי הוּא נִתֹּץ וְעוֹמֵד וְאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְקַיֵּם בּוֹ תוּ יֻתָּץ:


אם מסיק מלמטה – if when he kindles the flame from below within the cistern, the oven is heated from its insides from above through its rims, it is impure. But if not, that it is not heated from the heating of the flame that is below within the cistern, it Is pure. But the disagreement of Rabbi Yehuda and the Rabbis is specifically through the first heating which is the completion of the construction of the oven and through that heating, it is susceptible to receiving defilement, Rabbi Yehuda holds that the oven should be attached to the ground with the first heating, as it is written (Leviticus 11:35): “[And if any of those falls into an earthen vessel,] everything inside it shall be unclean and – the vessel – itself you shall break,” but the language of נתיצה/breaking up (as in Leviticus 11:35 – תנור וכירים יותץ /and [the vessel] itself you shall break) other than that which is attached to the round, for when something falls that is carried, it is the language of שבירה/breaking but not the language of נתיצה/cutting out or breaking up, therefore, if the oven is heated through its rim from the heating that is within the cistern, it is considered as attached to the cistern and we call it יותץ/broken up/cut out, but if it is not heated from the heating of the cistern, it is chipped off and standing and it is impossible to apply to it further יותץ/broken up/cut out.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:6:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:6:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:6:6)


**וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים הוֹאִיל וְהוּא נִסֹּק מִכָּל מָקוֹם טָמֵא.** דְּאָמַר קְרָא וּטְמֵאִים יִהְיוּ לָכֶם, מִכָּל מָקוֹם, וַאֲפִלּוּ אִם מַסִּיקוֹ כְשֶׁהוּא תָלוּי בְצַוַּאר הַגָּמָל הָוֵי הֶסֵּק וְנִגְמְרָה מְלַאכְתּוֹ בְכָךְ. וְהַכֹּל מוֹדִים בְּהֶסֵּק שֵׁנִי לְאַחַר שֶׁנִּגְמְרָה מְלַאכְתּוֹ שֶׁהוּא מִטַּמֵּא אֲפִלּוּ בְצַוַּאר הַגָּמָל. וַהֲלָכָה כַּחֲכָמִים:


וחכמים אומרים הואיל וניסוק מכל מקום טמא (since it is heated from any place, it is unclean) – as it stated in Scripture (Leviticus 11:35): “and unclean they shall remain for you/וטמאים יהיו לכם,” nevertheless, but even if he heated it when it is suspended upon the neck of a camel, it is heated, and its construction has been completed with that. But everyone admits that with the second heating after its construction has been completed, that it is defiled even on the neck of the camel. And the Halakha is according to the Sages.



### Mishnah 7

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:1)


**תַּנּוּר שֶׁנִּטְמָא.** הַתַּנּוּר עָשׂוּי כִקְדֵרָה גְדוֹלָה שֶׁאֵין לָהּ שׁוּלַיִם וּמִטַּלְטֵל, וּכְשֶׁבָּא לְקָבְעוֹ מְחַבְּרוֹ בָאָרֶץ וּמְדַבֵּק טִיט מִבַּחוּץ וּמְעַבֵּהוּ כְדֵי שֶׁיִּשְׁמֹר חֻמּוֹ, וְקָרֵי לַהּ טְפֵלָה, שֶׁמְּטַפְּלָהּ וּמְחַבְּרָהּ לוֹ:


תנור שנטמא – an oven that is made like large pot that lacks rims and is carried, when one comes to affix it, one attaches it to the ground and affixes plaster from the outside and makes it thick in order that it will preserve its heat/warmth, and we call it plastering that he plasters it and attaches it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:2)


**כֵּיצַד מְטַהֲרִים אוֹתוֹ.** כַּמָּה תְהֵא שְׁבִירָתוֹ וּתְהֵא מְטַהַרְתּוֹ:


כיצד מטהרים אותו – how much should be its breaking so that it purifies it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:3)


**חוֹלְקוֹ לִשְׁלֹשָׁה.** לַכְּלִי עַצְמוֹ מִבִּפְנִים. דְּאִי לִשְׁנַיִם, הַגָּדוֹל טָמֵא, דְּאִיכָּא רֻבָּא:


חולקו לשלשה – to the vessel itself from the inside. For if it is into two parts, the larger part is impure, for it is the majority.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:4)


**וְגוֹרֵר אֶת הַטְּפֵלָה.** שֶׁדָּבֵק עָלָיו, שֶׁגַּם הִיא מְחַבַּרְתּוֹ:


וגורר את הטפילה – [he scrapes off the plaster] that is glued to it, for it is also attaches it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:5)


**עַד שֶׁיְּהֵא בָאָרֶץ.** כְּלוֹמַר מַפִּילָהּ עַד הַקַּרְקַע. אִי נַמִּי, אַחוֹלְקוֹ קָאֵי, דְּלֹא סַגִּי בַחֲלֻקָּה עַד רֻבּוֹ, אֶלָּא חוֹלֵק עַד שֶׁיַּגִּיעַ לַקַּרְקַע:


עד שיהא בארץ – meaning to say, he lowers it down until the ground. Alternatively, it refers to dividing it, and it is not sufficient when dividing it until its majority, but dividing until it reaches the ground.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:7:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:6)


**וְלֹא עַד שֶׁיְּהֵא בָאָרֶץ.** וְלֹא לְחַלְּקוֹ עַד לְמַטָּה סָמוּךְ לָאָרֶץ:


ולא עד שיהא בארץ – but not to divide it until below it is near the ground.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:7:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:7)


**אֶלָּא מְמַעֲטוֹ מִבִּפְנִים.** עַד שֶׁלֹּא יִשָּׁאֵר אַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים שֶׁהוּא שִׁעוּר תְּחִלָּתוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי מֵאִיר:


אלא ממעטו מבפנים – unitl there should not remain four handbreadths which is the measure of the beginning of the oven. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Meir.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:7:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:8)


**צָרִיךְ לְהַסִּיעוֹ.** אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁחִלְּקוֹ, לֹא טָהֵר עַד שֶׁיַּפְרִיד הַחֲלָקִים זֶה מִזֶּה. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן:


צריך להסיעו – even though he divided it, he did not purify it until he separates the parts from each other. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Shimon.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:7:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:7:9)


**הַגָּדוֹל טָמֵא.** מִשּׁוּם דְּאִיכָּא רֻבּוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר:


הגדול טמא- because there is the majority of the oven.



### Mishnah 8

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:8:1)


**חֲתָכוֹ חֻלְיוֹת לְרָחְבּוֹ.** כְּמוֹ שֶׁחוֹתֵךְ שְׁפוֹפֶרֶת שֶׁל קָנֶה:


חתכו חוליות לרחבו (if he burned clay of an oven into tiles breadthwise) – like he cuts the tube of a reed.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:8:2)


**פָּחוֹת מֵאַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים.** אִם יֵשׁ בְּחֻלְיָא פָּחוֹת מֵאַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים וּבָאָה מִתַּנּוּר גָּדוֹל דְּלֵיכָּא רֻבָּא, טָהוֹר. אֲבָל אִיכָּא אַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים, טָמֵא, אַף עַל גַּב דַּהֲוֵי מִעוּט:


פחות מארבעה טפחים – if there is in the burned clay less than for handbreadths and it comes from a large oven where there isn’t a majority. But if there is four handbreadths, it is impure, even though it is a minority.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:8:3)


**מֵרְחוֹ בְטִיט.** בָּעֵי הֶסֵּק כְּתַנּוּר חָדָשׁ:


מרחו בטיט (if he smeared plaster over it) – it requires heating like a new oven.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:8:4)


**הִרְחִיק מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת הַטְּפֵלָה.** טִפּוּל שֶׁל טִיט שֶׁעָשָׂה, לֹא חִבְּרוֹ לַתַּנּוּר אֶלָּא רָחוֹק מִמֶּנּוּ:


הרחיק ממנו את הטפלה (if he removed from it the plaster) – paste of plaster that he made, and he did not attach it to the oven, but rather, removed [the plaster] from it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:8:5)


**וְנָתַן חֹל אוֹ צְרוֹר.** בֵּין הַטְּפֵלָה לַתַּנּוּר, וְעַל יְדֵי כָּךְ הַתַּנּוּר מְקַיֵּם חֻמּוֹ וְאוֹפִים בּוֹ:


שנתן חול או צרור –[and he placed sand or stones] between the plaster and the oven, and through this the oven preserves its warmth and one we bake in it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:8:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:8:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:8:6)


**הַנִּדָּה וְהַטְּהוֹרָה אוֹפוֹת בּוֹ.** דְּלָא חֲשִׁיבָא הַטְּפֵלָה חִבּוּר לַתַּנּוּר, כֵּיוָן שֶׁהִיא מְרֻחֶקֶת מִמֶּנּוּ:


הנדה והטהורה אופות בו – for the plastering is not considered an attachment to the oven, since it is distanced from it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:8:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:8:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:8:7)


**וְהוּא טָהוֹר.** שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה:


והוא טהור – and it is not susceptible to receive [ritual] impurity .



### Mishnah 9

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:9:1)


**תַּנּוּר שֶׁבָּא מְחֻתָּךְ.** שֶׁעֲשָׂאוֹ הָאֻמָּן דַּפִּים דַּפִּים כְּדֵי לְחַבְּרָן יַחַד עַל יְדֵי מִסְגְּרוֹת, הֵן זִירִים שֶׁקּוֹרִין צירקלא"ש, כְּעֵין שֶׁאָנוּ עוֹשִׂים לֶחָבִיּוֹת שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים בָּהֶן יַיִן. וּלְאוֹתָן זִירִים וּמִסְגְּרוֹת קוֹרֵא הַתַּנָּא לִמּוּדִין:


תנור שבא מחותך – that the artisan made it board/plank by board/plank in order to attach them together through rims, and they are crowns/wreaths that they call TZIRKELAAH, like the kind that we make for jugs when we place in them wine. And for those crowns/wreaths and rims – the Tanna/teacher calls למודין/frames.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:9:2)


**וּנְתָנָן עָלָיו וְהוּא טָהוֹר נִטְמָא.** לְאַחַר שֶׁנָּתַן עָלָיו הַלִּמּוּדִים וְהָיָה הַתַּנּוּר טָהוֹר מִתְּחִלָּה לְפִי שֶׁהָיָה דַפִּים דַּפִּים וְלֹא הָיָה מְחֻבָּר, חָזַר לִהְיוֹת מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה עַל יְדֵי הַלִּמּוּדִים הַלָּלוּ שֶׁמְּחַבְּרִים אוֹתוֹ:


ונתנן עליו והוא טהור נטמא – after he placed upon it the frame and the oven was pure from the outset because it was a series of boards/planks and there was no attachment. It returned to be susceptible to receive defilement through these frames when they attach them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:9:3)


**סִלֵּק אֶת לִמּוּדָיו.** וְנִתְפָּרְקוּ הַדַּפִּין זֶה מִזֶּה, אֵין לְךָ נְתִיצָה גְדוֹלָה מִזּוֹ, וְנִטְהַר הַתַּנּוּר. וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהֶחֱזִיר הַלִּמּוּדִים פַּעַם שְׁנִיָּה שׁוּב אֵינוֹ מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה, שֶׁאֵין הַלִּמּוּדִים מְבִיאִין לוֹ הַטֻּמְאָה אֶלָּא בְּפַעַם רִאשׁוֹנָה בִלְבַד כְּשֶׁבָּא מְחֻתָּךְ מִבֵּית הָאֻמָּן:


סילק את למודיו – and the boards/planks were taken apart one from the other, there is no greater breaking up/cutting out than this, and the oven becomes pure, even though he restored the frames a second time, they do not receive [ritual] impurity for the frames do not bring defilement other than only the first time when it comes in pieces from the house of the artisan.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:9:4)


**מֵרְחוֹ בְטִיט.** לְתַנּוּר זֶה שֶׁאֵין הַלִּמּוּדִים מְבִיאִין לוֹ הַטֻּמְאָה, טָמֵא עַל יְדֵי מְרִיחַת הַטִּיט.


מרחו בטיט [he plastered it with plaster] – for this oven for the frames do not bring him the defilement, but it defiles through the plastering with plaster.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:9:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:9:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:9:5)


**וְאֵין צָרִיךְ לְהַסִּיקוֹ.** כִּשְׁאָר כָּל תַּנּוּרִים שֶׁאֵין מְקַבְּלִין טֻמְאָה עַד שֶׁיַּסִּיקֵם, לְפִי שֶׁכְּבָר הֻסַּק בְּפַעַם רִאשׁוֹנָה כְּשֶׁבָּא מְחֻתָּךְ מִבֵּית הָאֻמָּן:


ואין צריך להסיקו – [he doesn’t need to heat it] like all the other ovens, for it doesn’t become susceptible to receive defilement until he heats them, because it was already heated the first time when it comes in pieces from the house of the artisan.



### Mishnah 10

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:10:1)


**חֲתָכוֹ חֻלְיוֹת.** שֶׁחֲתָכוֹ לַתַּנּוּר בְּרָחְבּוֹ לְחֻלְיוֹת, וְהִנִּיחַ חֻלְיָא עַל גַּבֵּי חֻלְיָא:


חתכו חוליות – when he cut it for the oven breadthwise into pieces, and placed one tile on top of another tile.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:10:2)


**וְנָתַן חֹל בֵּין חֻלְיָא לְחֻלְיָא.** וְטָח אוֹתוֹ בְּטִיט וְעָשָׂה לוֹ טְפֵלָה כְדֶרֶךְ שֶׁעוֹשִׂין לְתַנּוּרִים:


ונתן חול בסין חוליא לחוליא – and plastered it with plaster and made it plaster in the manner that they that make for ovens.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:10:3)


**רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר מְטַהֵר.** דְּכֵיוָן דְּיֵשׁ חֹל בֵּין הַסְּדָקִים, כְּשָׁבוּר דָּמֵי:


ר' אליעזר מטהר – for since there is sand between the fissures, it is like it is broken.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:10:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:10:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:10:4)


**וַחֲכָמִים מְטַמְּאִין.** שֶׁהַטְּפֵלָה עוֹשָׂה אֶת כֻּלּוֹ אֶחָד וּמְחַבֶּרֶת אֶת הַסְּדָקִים, וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁיֵּשׁ חֹל בֵּין חֻלְיָא לְחֻלְיָא:


וחכמים מטמאין – for the plaster makes all of it one and connects/attaches all of the fissures, and even though there is sand between each tile.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:10:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:10:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:10:5)


**וְזֶהוּ תַנּוּרוֹ שֶׁל עַכְנָאי.** לְכָךְ נִקְרָא תַנּוּרוֹ שֶׁל עַכְנַאי, שֶׁהִקִּיפוּהוּ הֲלָכוֹת כְּעַכְנָא זוֹ וְטִמְּאוּהוּ. עַכְנָא, נָחָשׁ שֶׁדַּרְכּוֹ לֵעָשׂוֹת כַּעֲגֻלָּה לְהַכְנִיס זְנָבוֹ לְתוֹךְ פִּיו, כָּךְ הִקִּיפוּ בִתְשׁוּבָה וּרְאָיוֹת רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר וַחֲכָמִים זֶה אֶת זֶה, עַל תַּנּוּר זֶה. וּלְבַסּוֹף מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהָיָה רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר יָחִיד כְּנֶגֶד רַבִּים, נִפְסְקָה הַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּים דְּלֹא כְרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר. וְהֵבִיאוּ כָל טָהֳרוֹת שֶׁטִּהֵר רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר וּשְׂרָפוּם בָּאֵשׁ וְנִמְנוּ וּבֵרְכוּהוּ, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהָיָה מַחֲזִיק בַּמַּחֲלֹקֶת כְּנֶגֶד רַבִּים:


וזהו תנורו של עכנאי – therefore it is called “The Oven of Akhnai,” that they encircled it with Halakhot like this snake and defiled it (see Tractate Berakhot 19a and Tractate Bava Metzia 59b). עכנא is a snake, that its custom is to make itself like a circle and to have its tail enter into its mouth, such is how they surrounded with responses and proofs of Rabbi Eliezer and the Sages each with the other, on this oven. And at the end, because Rabbi Eliezer was an individual [opinion] against the majority (i.e., the Sages), the law was decided like the Sages and not according to Rabbi Eliezer. And they brought all of the pure things that Rabbi Eliezer declared pure and burned them in fire and the decided to excommunicate him, because he encouraged dispute against the majority view.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:10:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:10:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:10:6)


**יוֹרוֹת הָעַרְבִיִּין.** לֶאֱפוֹת פַּת הֵן עֲשׂוּיִין. כְּדִמְפָרֵשׁ וְאָזֵיל:


יורות הערביין (cauldrons/improvised fire places of the Arabs/a cavity in the ground laid out with clay) – they are made to break bread, as will be explained further on.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:10:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:10:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:10:7)


**שֶׁל בֶּן דִּינָאי.** רַבּוֹתַי פֵּרְשׁוּ שֵׁם אָדָם שֶׁהָיָה עוֹשֶׂה תַנּוּרִים הַלָּלוּ. וַאֲנִי שָׁמַעְתִּי עַל שֵׁם שֶׁדָּנוּ בוֹ דִינִים הַרְבֵּה:


של בן דינאי – My Rabbis explained the name of a person who would make these ovens (see Tractate Sotah, Chapter 9, Mishnah 9). And I heard that is on account of the fact that they judged many laws.



### Mishnah 11

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:11:1)


**שֶׁל אֶבֶן וְשֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת טָהוֹר.** שֶׁל אֶבֶן טָהוֹר לְגַמְרֵי. וְשֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת טָהוֹר מִדִּין כְּלֵי חֶרֶס, שֶׁאֵינוֹ מִטַּמֵּא מֵאֲוִירוֹ, וְיֵשׁ לוֹ טָהֳרָה בְמִקְוֶה:


של אבן ושל מתכת טהור – [an oven] that is of stone is completely pure, and that of metal is pure from the law of an earthenware vessel, which does not defile from its airspace, and it has purity.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:11:2)


**וְטָמֵא מִשּׁוּם כְּלֵי מַתָּכוֹת.** שֶׁמְּקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה מִגַּבּוֹ וְנַעֲשֶׂה אַב הַטֻּמְאָה. וְאִם הוּא מְחֻבָּר לַקַּרְקַע אֵינוֹ מִטַּמֵּא, דְּכָל הַמְחֻבָּר לַקַּרְקַע הֲרֵי הוּא כַקַּרְקַע, חוּץ מִתַּנּוּר וְכִירַיִם שֶׁל חֶרֶס דִּכְתִיב בְּהוּ (ויקרא יא) תַּנּוּר וְכִירַיִם יֻתָּץ, אֶת שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ נְתִיצָה:


וטמא משום כלי מתכות – that it becomes susceptible to receive defilement from its outside and becomes a primary source of ritual impurity. But if it is attached to the ground, it does not defile, for all that is attached to the ground, behold it is like the ground, except for an oven and a portable stove on feet with caves for two pots which are of earthenware, as it is written concerning them (Leviticus 11:35): “[Everything on which the carcass of any of them falls shall be unclean:] an oven or stove shall be smashed,” that which has breaking up/cutting out.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:11:3)


**נִקַּב נִפְגַּם נִסְדַּק.** וְעָשָׂה טִפּוּל שֶׁל סִיד לִסְתֹּם הַנֶּקֶב וְהַפְּגָם וְהַסֶּדֶק, אוֹ שֶׁעָשָׂה עַל פִּיו תּוֹסֶפֶת שֶׁל טִיט, טָמֵא, כְּדִין תַּנּוּר שֶׁל חֶרֶס:


ניקב נפגם נסדק – and he made a treatment of plaster to close up the perforation or the damage or the crack. Or he made at its mouth a supplement of plaster, it is impure, like the law of an earthenware oven.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:11:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:11:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:11:4)


**וְכֵן בְּכִירָה.** וְכֵן שִׁעוּר נֶקֶב שֶׁל כִּירָה, כְּדֵי שֶׁיֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ הָאוּר, כְּשִׁעוּר נֶקֶב שֶׁל תַּנּוּר:


וכן בכירה – and similarly, the measurement of a perforation of a portable stove on feet with caves for two pots, in order that the flame can exude through it, like the measurement of the earthenware oven.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:11:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:11:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:11:5)


**וְעָשָׂה לָהּ פִּטְפּוּטִין.** הָכָא לֹא תָנֵי וְעָשָׂה לָהּ טְפֵלָה, [לְפִי] שֶׁאֵין עוֹשִׂין טְפֵלָה לְכִירָה שֶׁנִּקְּבָה אוֹ נִפְגְּמָה כְּמוֹ שֶׁעוֹשִׂין לְתַנּוּר, אֶלָּא כְשֶׁנִּקְּבָה אוֹ נִפְגְּמָה הַכִּירָה בִּמְקוֹם מוֹשָׁבָהּ רְגִילִין בִּמְקוֹם הַנֶּקֶב לַעֲשׂוֹת פִּטְפּוּטִין, הֵן רַגְלֵי הַכִּירָה, כְּמוֹ טריפי"ד בְּלַעַ"ז, שֶׁהַכִּירָה יוֹשֶׁבֶת עַל אוֹתָן פִּטְפּוּטִין:


ועשה לה פטפוטין (if he made legs for the stove – so that it no longer rests immediately on the ground) – here it does not teach: “that he made for it plaster/paste” [because] they don’t make plaster/paste for a portable stove on feet with caves for two pots that was perforated, damaged or cracked like they do for an oven, but rather, when it was perforated or damaged, the portable stove on feet with caves for two pots is in the place of the perforation to make legs for the stove, they are the legs of the portable stove on feet with caves for two pots, like TRIPID in the foreign language, that the portable stove on feet with caves for two pots sits on these legs for the stove.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 5:11:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:11:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/5:11:6)


**מֵרְחָהּ בְּטִיט.** טְהוֹרָה. שֶׁאֵין מֵרוּחַ שֶׁל טִיט מוֹעִיל אֶלָּא בְתַנּוּר שֶׁאוֹפִין הַלֶּחֶם בְּתוֹכוֹ, אֲבָל לֹא בְכִירָה, לְפִי שֶׁאֵין אוֹפִין וּמְבַשְּׁלִין בְּתוֹךְ הַכִּירָה עַצְמָהּ אֶלָּא מַנִּיחִין בְּתוֹכָהּ אוֹ עַל גַּבָּהּ הַקְּדֵרָה. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


מרחה בטיט – [if he spread plaster over it] it is pure, for the spreading/smearing of plaster on it, has no effect other than with an oven that they bread read inside it, but not with a portable stove on feet with caves for two pots, because they don’t bake or cook within this portable stove on feet with caves for two pots itself, but they leave it it within it or on top of the pot. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehuda.



## Chapter 6


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:1)


**הָעוֹשֶׂה שְׁלֹשָׁה פִטְפּוּטִים.** שְׁלֹשָׁה רַגְלַיִם יוֹשְׁבִים בָּאָרֶץ:


העושה שלשה פטפוטים – three legs/,pins that sit/rest on the land.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:2)


**וְחִבְּרָם בְּטִיט.** לְמַעְלָה בְרֹאשָׁם, כְּעֵין כְּלִי בַרְזֶל שֶׁקּוֹרִין טריפי"ד:


וחיברן בטיט – above their head, like a kind of iron vessel that they call TRIPID.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:3)


**קָבַע שְׁלֹשָׁה מַסְמְרִים.** שֶׁנָּעַץ אוֹתָם בַּקַּרְקַע:


קבע שלשה מסמרים – that he inserted them into the ground.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:4)


**טְהוֹרָה.** דִּכְלֵי מַתָּכוֹת הַמְחֻבָּרִים לַקַּרְקַע כְּקַרְקַע דָּמוּ וְאֵין מְקַבְּלִים טֻמְאָה:


טהורות – for metal vessels that are attached to the ground are like the ground itself, and they are not susceptible to receive [ritual] defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:5)


**וְחִבְּרָם בְּטִיט טְמֵאָה.** כְּכִירָה שֶׁל חֶרֶס, שֶׁהַטִּיט שֶׁבְּרֹאשָׁן נוֹתֵן לָהֶן תּוֹרַת חֶרֶס:


וחיברם בטיט טמאה – it is like a portable stove on feet with caves for two pots/כירה of earthenware, that the plaster/clay on their head makes it the designation of earthenware.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:6)


**עַד שֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה שְׁלִישִׁית.** כְּעֵין שְׁלֹשָׁה פִטְפּוּטִין:


עד שיעשה שלישית – similar to three clay pins forming a sort of tripod for the support of a pot.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:7)


**אוֹ עַד שֶׁיִּסְמֹךְ לַכֹּתֶל.** שֶׁהַכֹּתֶל יִסְמֹךְ אֶת הַקְּדֵרָה מִצַּד אֶחָד:


או עד שיסמוך לכותל – that the wall will sort the pot from one side.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:8)


**אַחַת בְּטִיט.** אַחַת חִבֵּר לַחֲבֶרְתָּהּ בְּטִיט בְּרֹאשָׁהּ:


אחת בטיט – one is fastened/attached to its neighbor with plaster/clay at its top.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:1:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:1:9)


**וְאַחַת שֶׁלֹּא בְטִיט.** שֶׁהַשְּׁלִישִׁית לֹא חִבֵּר. וְרַבִּי יְהוּדָה הִיא, וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


ואחת שלא בטיט – that the third one is not attached/fastened. And this is [the opinion of] Rabbi Yehuda, but the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehuda.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:2:1)


**הָאֶבֶן שֶׁהָיָה שׁוֹפֵת עָלֶיהָ וְעַל הַתַּנּוּר.** וְהָאֶבֶן מְחֻבֶּרֶת בְּטִיט:


האבן שהיה שופת עליה ועל התנור (the stone that he was placing the cooking pot over/by the fire as well as on the oven) – land the stone was attached with plaster/clay.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:2:2)


**עָלֶיהָ וְעַל הָאֶבֶן.** הַיְנוּ אַחַת בְּטִיט וְאַחַת שֶׁלֹּא בְטִיט:


עליה ועל האבן – that is one that is [affixed] with plaster and one that is not [affixed] with plaster.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:2:3)


**וְעַל הַסֶּלַע.** הַמְחֻבָּר מִשֵּׁשֶׁת יְמֵי בְרֵאשִׁית:


ועל הסלע – that is attached from the Six Days of Creation.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:2:4)


**טְהוֹרָה.** דִּכְתִיב יֻתָּץ טְמֵאִים הֵם, אֶת שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ נְתִיצָה יֵשׁ לוֹ טֻמְאָה, אֶת שֶׁאֵין לוֹ נְתִיצָה אֵין לוֹ טֻמְאָה. מִכָּאן אָמְרוּ, אֶבֶן שֶׁהָיָה שׁוֹפֵת עָלֶיהָ וְעַל הַתַּנּוּר, עָלֶיהָ וְעַל הַכִּירָה, עָלֶיהָ וְעַל הַכֻּפָּח, טְמֵאָה, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶן נְתִיצָה. עָלֶיהָ וְעַל הָאֶבֶן, עָלֶיהָ וְעַל הַסֶּלַע, עָלֶיהָ וְעַל הַכֹּתֶל, טְהוֹרָה, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁאֵין לָהֶן נְתִיצָה:


טהורה – as it is written (Leviticus 11:35): “[an oven or stove] shall be smashed. They are impure [and impure they shall remain for you],” that which has a breaking up/cutting out has [ritual] defilement; that which does not have breaking up/cutting out does not have [ritual] defilement. From here, they (i.e., the Rabbis) stated that a stone that he was placing the cooking pot over and on the oven, or on it and on the portable stove on feet with caves for two pots , or on it and on the small stove with room for only one pot, are impure, because they have a breaking up/cutting out; [but] upon it and on the stone, upon it and upon a rock, upon it and upon the wall, it is [ritually] pure, because they don’t have breaking up/cutting out.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:2:5)


**כִּירַת הַנְּזִירִים.** לְבַשֵּׁל שַׁלְמֵי נָזִיר שֶׁלּוֹקֵחַ מֵהֶן הַכֹּהֵן הַזְּרוֹעַ בְּשֵׁלָה:


כירת הנזירים – to cook the peace offerings of a Nazir that the Kohen takes from them the cooked shoulder (see Deuteronomy 18:3 and Tractate Hullin, Chapter 10, Mishnah 1).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:2:6)


**כִּירַת הַטַּבָּחִים.** שֶׁמּוֹכְרִים לָרַבִּים, וּמְסַדְּרִים הַרְבֵּה אֲבָנִים זוֹ אַחַר זוֹ וְשׁוֹפְתִין עֲלֵיהֶן קְדֵרוֹת הַרְבֵּה, שֶׁנִּמְצֵאת אֶבֶן אַחַת לִשְׁתֵּי קְדֵרוֹת, וּכְשֶׁנִּטְמֵאת הָאַחַת הָאֲחֵרוֹת טְהוֹרוֹת, מִידִי דַּהֲוָה אַקַּלְמָרִין הַמְתֹאָמוֹת דִּתְנַן לְעֵיל בְּפֶרֶק ב'‏ [מִשְׁנָה ז] שֶׁאִם נִטְמְאָה אַחַת מֵהֶן לֹא נִטְמְאוּ כֻלָּן:


כירת טבחים – that they sell to the masses and they arrange many stones one after another and places the upon them many pots, where there is found one stone for two pots, but when one [of the stones] is defiled, the others are pure, this is a matter that is like the double inkstand that is taught in the Mishnah above in Chapter 2 [Mishnah 7], that if one of them is defiled, the other rest of them are not defiled.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:3:1)


**שָׁלֹשׁ אֲבָנִים שֶׁעֲשָׂאָן שְׁתֵּי כִירַיִם.** שֶׁהָאֶבֶן הָאֶמְצָעִית מְשַׁמֶּשֶׁת לְזוֹ וּלְזוֹ:


שלש אבנים שעשאן שתין כירים – and the middle stone services both this one (i.e., the portable stove with caves for two pots) and that one (i.e., the other portable stove with caves for two pots).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:3:2)


**הָאֶמְצָעִית הַמְשַׁמֶּשֶׁת לַטְּמֵאָה.** חֶצְיָהּ שֶׁל הָאֶמְצָעִית הַמְשַׁמֶּשֶׁת לַחִיצוֹנָה שֶׁהִיא טְמֵאָה, טְמֵאָה. וְחֶצְיָהּ הַמְשַׁמֶּשֶׁת לַחִיצוֹנָה שֶׁהִיא טְהוֹרָה, טְהוֹרָה:


האמצעית המשמשת את הטמאה – half of the middle one (i.e., stove) that services the outer one which is [ritually] impure is impure. But the half that services the outer one that is pure is pure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:3:3)


**נֶחְלְטָה הָאֶמְצָעִית לְטֻמְאָה.** וְכֻלָּהּ טְמֵאָה:


נחלטה האמצעית לטמאה – and all of it (i.e., all three stones) are impure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:3:4)


**לִשְׁפֹּת עֲלֵיהֶן.** עַל שְׁתֵּי הַחִיצוֹנוֹת:


לשפות עליהן – [to set upon] the two outer ones (i.e., stones).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:3:5)


**הֶחֱזִירָהּ.** לָאֶמְצָעִית:


החזירה – [if he restored] the middle one (i.e., stone)


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:3:6)


**טְהוֹרָה.** שֶׁבָּטְלָה כִירָה רִאשׁוֹנָה וּכְאִלּוּ נִתַּץ כִּירַת הַיּוֹרָה הַגְּדוֹלָה:


טהורה – for the first portable stove on feet with caves for two pots/כירה is abolished and it is as if he placed on it the large pot of the cauldron/kettle.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:3:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:3:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:3:7)


**מְקַבֶּלֶת טֻמְאָה מִשֶּׁיַּסִּיקֶנָּה.** דְּבָעֵי הֶסֵּק כְּכִירָה חֲדָשָׁה:


מקבלת טומאה משיסיקנה – for it (if plastered) requires heating like a new portable stove on feet with caves for two pots.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:4:1)


**סָמַךְ לָזוֹ אֶבֶן אַחַת מִכָּאן וְלָזוֹ אֶבֶן אַחַת מִכָּאן.** וְנִמְצְאוּ עַכְשָׁיו שָׁלֹשׁ כִּירוֹת, הָאֶמְצָעִית טְמֵאָה וְהַחִיצוֹנוֹת טְהוֹרוֹת. הִלְכָּךְ שְׁתֵּי אֲבָנִים אֶמְצָעִיּוֹת חֶצְיָהּ שֶׁל זוֹ וְחֶצְיָהּ שֶׁל זוֹ [שֶׁל צַד הַטָּהוֹר] טָהוֹר, שֶׁמְּשַׁמֵּשׁ לַטָּהוֹר:


סמך לזו אבן אחת מכאן ולו אבן אחת מכאן – and they were found now three portable stoves with caves for two pots, the middle one is [ritually] impure and the outer ones are pure. Therefore, the two middle stones – half of this one and half of that one [of the pure side] is pure and he uses the pure [sections].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 6:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/6:4:2)


**נִטְּלוּ הַחִיצוֹנוֹת הַטְּהוֹרוֹת.** חָזְרוּ אֶמְצָעִיּוֹת לְטֻמְאָתָן כְּבַתְּחִלָּה וְכֻלָּן טְמֵאוֹת, שֶׁהֲרֵי אֵין כָּאן מְשַׁמֵּשׁ לַטָּהוֹר:


ניטלו החיצונות הטהורות – the middle ones return to their impurity as at the beginning, and all of them are impure, for behold there isn’t here any used for purity.



## Chapter 7


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:1)


**הַקַּלָתוּת שֶׁל בַּעֲלֵי בָתִּים.** בָּסִיס הֶעָשׂוּי לְכִירָה, וּמְקוֹם מוֹשָׁבָהּ נִקְרָא קֶלֶת:


הקלתות של בעלי בתים (the fire-place under a portable stove of householders) – a stand that is made for a portable stove with caves for two pots and the place of its sitting, which is called a קלת/fire-place.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:2)


**שֶׁנִּפְחֲתָה.** קַרְקָעִיתָהּ. וְהָיָה עֹמֶק הַפְּחָת פָּחוֹת מִשְּׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים, הֲרֵי הַכִּירָה מְקַבֶּלֶת טֻמְאָה, שֶׁאִם יַסִּיק בַּפְּחָת מִלְּמַטָּה תִּתְבַּשֵּׁל הַקְּדֵרָה שֶׁבַּכִּירָה מִלְּמַעְלָה:


שנפחתה (that was diminished) – its bottom. And the depth of the cavity was less than three handbreadths, the portable stove with caves for two pots/כירה receives defilement, for if he would heat with less from the bottom, the pot that is on the portable stove with caves for two pots would boil from above.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:3)


**יָתֵר מִכָּאן.** אִם הָיָה הַפְּחָת עֲמֻקָּה יוֹתֵר מִשְּׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים:
