יתר מכאן – if the cavity was deeper than three handbreadths.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:4)


**טְהוֹרָה.** שֶׁהֲרֵי הָאֵשׁ רְחוֹקָה מִן הַקְּדֵרָה שֶׁבַּכִּירָה וְאֵינָהּ מִתְבַּשֶּׁלֶת:


טהורה – for the fire is further from the pot that is on the portable stove with caves for two pots and does not boil.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:5)


**נָתַן אֶבֶן אוֹ צְרוֹר.** עַל מְקוֹם הַפְּחָת כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יִהְיֶה עֹמֶק הַפְּחָת שְׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים, טְהוֹרָה, לְפִי שֶׁאֵינָהּ חֲשׁוּבָה מִקַּרְקָעִית הַכִּירָה:


נתן אבן או צרור – on the place of the cavity in order that the depth of the cavity would not be three handbreadths, it is pure, because it is not considered from the bottom of the portable stove with caves for two pots.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:6)


**מֵרְחָהּ.** לְאֶבֶן זוֹ בְּטִיט:


מרחה (if he plastered it) – to this stone with clay/plaster.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:7)


**מְקַבֶּלֶת טֻמְאָה.** הַכִּירָה, מִכָּאן וּלְהַבָּא. שֶׁאֶבֶן זוֹ מִקַּרְקָעִית הַכִּירָה הִיא נֶחְשֶׁבֶת, וַהֲרֵי אֵין עֹמֶק הַפְּחָת שְׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים:


מקבלת טומאה – the portable stove with caves for two pots [is susceptible to receive defilement] from now on. For this stone is considered as from the bottom of the portable stove with caves for two pots, hence the depth of the cavity is not three handbreadths.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:8)


**וְזוֹ הִיא תְשׁוּבַת רַבִּי יְהוּדָה.** כְּשֶׁנֶּחְלְקוּ רַבִּי יְהוּדָה וַחֲכָמִים לְעֵיל בְּפֶרֶק תַּנּוּר תְּחִלָּתוֹ אַרְבָּעָה:


וזו היא תשובת רבי יהודה – when Rabbi Yehuda and the Sages disputed above in the Chapter “The Oven” (Chapter 5, Mishnah 6) that its beginning is four handbreadths.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:1:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:1:9)


**בְּתַנּוּר שֶׁנְּתָנוֹ עַל פִּי הַבּוֹר אוֹ עַל פִּי הַדּוּת.** מִכָּאן הֵבִיא רַבִּי יְהוּדָה רְאָיָה לִדְבָרָיו, דְּכִי הֵיכִי דְבָעִינַן הָכָא שֶׁיְּהֵא מַסִּיק מִלְּמַטָּה וּקְדֵרָה בְּשֵׁלָה מִלְּמַעְלָה, הָכִי נַמִּי בָעִינַן הָתָם:


בתנור שנתנו על פי הבור ועל פי הדות – from here, Rabbi Yehuda brought proof for his words. For just as that we require here that he heats from below and the pot cooks from above, so also we require it there (see Tractate Kelim, Chapter 5, Mishnah 6).



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:2:1)


**דָּכוֹן.** לְשׁוֹן מָקוֹם. כְּמוֹ דוּךְ פְּלַן [בְּרָכוֹת יח:]. וְהוּא מָקוֹם בּוֹלֵט מִן הַכִּירָה שֶׁכְּשֶׁמּוֹצִיאִין הַקְּדֵרָה מִן הַכִּירָה מוֹשִׁיבִין אוֹתָהּ עַל אוֹתָהּ הַבְּלִיטָה, וּפְעָמִים יֵשׁ לוֹ בֵית קִבּוּל שְׁתֵּי קְדֵרוֹת אוֹ שָׁלֹשׁ:


דכון (elevated spot in the kitchen for vessels/a stand fixed to the stove or portable oven) – it is the language of a place/stand, like “in a certain place/בדוך פלן” [Berakhot 18b]. And this is a place that projects/protrudes from the portable oven with caves for two pots/כירה, that when they remove the pot from the portable oven with caves for two pots, they set it down on this projection/protrusion but sometimes it has a receptacle for two or three pots.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:2:2)


**טָהוֹר מִשּׁוּם כִּירָה.** דְּאִם נִטְמֵאת הַכִּירָה לֹא נִטְמָא הוּא. אִי נַמִּי, אֵינוֹ מִטַּמֵּא בִמְחֻבָּר כַּכִּירָה:


טהור משום כירה – that if the portable oven with caves for two pots became [ritually] impure, it (i.e., the pot) did not become impure [on account of the portable oven]; alternatively, it does not defile what is attached like a portable oven with caves for two pots.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:2:3)


**הַצְּדָדִים שֶׁלּוֹ.** כְּתָלָיו שֶׁל דָּכוֹן שֶׁאֵינָן מִן הַכִּירָה:


הצדדים שלו – the walls of the stand fixed to the stove or portable oven that are not part of the portable oven.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:2:4)


**הָרַחַב שֶׁלּוֹ.** הוּא כֹתֶל הַכִּירָה עַצְמָהּ לְצַד בֵּית קִבּוּלוֹ שֶׁל דָּכוֹן. וּלְפִי שֶׁהַדָּכוֹן מַרְחִיב וְהוֹלֵךְ לְצַד הַכִּירָה קָרֵי לַהּ רַחַב:


הרחב שלו (its wide side) – this is the wall of the portable stove with caves for two pots itself to the side of the receptacle of the stand fixed to the stove/portable oven. But because the stand fixed to the stove/portable oven continually widens to the side of the portable oven, it is called רחב/its wide side.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:2:5)


**רַבִּי מֵאִיר מְטַהֵר.** דְּלָא חֲשִׁיב כַּכִּירָה:


רבי מאיר מטהר – for it is not considered like the portable oven with caves for two pots (see Tractate Kelim, Chapter 6, Mishnah 3).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:2:6)


**וְרַבִּי יְהוּדָה מְטַמֵּא.** דַּחֲשִׁיב כַּכִּירָה. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


ורבי יהודה מטמא – that it is considered like the portable oven with caves for two pots. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Yehuda.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:2:7)


**וְכֵן הַכּוֹפֶה אֶת הַסַּל.** וּבָנָה עַל גַּבָּיו כִּירָה, וּבוֹלֵט חוּץ לַכִּירָה. וְהַסַּל הוּא מִטַּמֵּא מִשּׁוּם כְּלִי עֵץ, וּכְשֶׁבָּנָה עָלָיו כִּירָה וְרֹחַב הַסַּל בּוֹלֵט חוּץ לְדָפְנֵי הַכִּירָה וְשׁוֹפְתִים קְדֵרוֹת עַל אוֹתָהּ הַבְּלִיטָה, דִּינוֹ כְדָכוֹן:


וכן הכופה את הסל – and built the portable stove with caves for two pots on its back/on top of it (i.e., the basket), and it protrudes beyond the portable stove. But the basket is what defiles because it is a wooden utensil, but when he built upon it the portable stove and the width of the basket protrudes beyond the walls of the portable stove and they place the pots on that protrusion, the law is like the stand fixed to the stove/portable oven.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:3:1)


**כִּירָה שֶׁנֶּחְלְקָה לְאָרְכָּהּ טְהוֹרָה.** כִּירָה מְקוֹם שְׁפִיתַת שְׁתֵּי קְדֵרוֹת. וּכְשֶׁנֶּחְלְקָה לְאָרְכָּהּ בָּטְלוּ שְׁתֵּי שְׁפִיתוֹת, וְאִם נֶחְלְקָה לְרָחְבָּהּ, שְׁתֵּי שְׁפִיתוֹת קַיָּמוֹת זוֹ לְבַדָּהּ וְזוֹ לְבַדָּהּ:


כירה שנחלקה לארכה טהורה – a portable stove with caves for two pots that opened for two pots. But when it is divided lengthwise, the two placings on/over the fire were eliminated, but if it was divided widthwise, the two placings over the fire remain, this one alone and that one alone.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:3:2)


**כֻּפָּח.** מְקוֹם שְׁפִיתַת קְדֵרָה אַחַת. וּבֵין שֶׁנִּסְדַּק לְאָרְכּוֹ בֵּין שֶׁנִּסְדַּק לְרָחְבּוֹ בָּטַל מְקוֹם הַשְּׁפִיתָה:


כופח – a place where there is an opening for one pot. But whether it is cracked lengthwise or whether it is cracked widthwise, all of the place where the pot is placed on/over the fire is eliminated.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:3:3)


**חֲצַר הַכִּירָה.** כְּעֵין מַחֲבַת גְּדוֹלָה שֶׁל חֶרֶס וְהַכִּירָה יוֹשֶׁבֶת בָּאֶמְצַע מְחֻבֶּרֶת לֶחָצֵר:


חצר הכירה – like a kind of large, earthenware pan [without a lid] and the portable oven with caves for two pots sits in the middle attached to the courtyard.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:3:4)


**שָׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת.** שֶׁכָּתְלֵי הֶחָצֵר גְּבוֹהִים שָׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת. כְּשֵׁם שֶׁשִּׁעוּר כִּירָה תְחִלָּתָהּ שָׁלֹשׁ, כְּדִתְנַן לְעֵיל בְּפֶרֶק הַתַּנּוּר, כָּךְ שִׁעוּר חֲצַר הַכִּירָה גָבְהוֹ אֵין פָּחוּת מִשָּׁלֹשׁ, וּפָחוּת מִשָּׁלֹשׁ אֵין אֲוִיר שֶׁלָּהּ חָשׁוּב. וּמִיהוּ מִטַּמְּאָה בְמַגָּע מִדְּרַבָּנָן. אִי נַמִּי, מִשּׁוּם דַּהֲוֵי כְּמוֹ יָד לַכִּירָה, וְיָד יֵשׁ לוֹ מַגָּע וְאֵין לוֹ אֲוִיר:


שלש אצבעות – that the walls of the courtyard are three fingers high. For just as the measure of the portable stove with caves for two pots, is three fingers at the outset, as is it is taught above in the Mishnah (Tractate Kelim, Chapter 5, Mishnah 2) in the Chapter “The Oven.” So as well is the measurement of the courtyard of the double stove, its height is not less than three fingers, but less than three [fingers], its airspace is not considered important. However, according to the Rabbis it defiles through contact. Alternatively, because there is something like a handle for the double stove, and the handle has contact, but not airspace.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:3:5)


**כֵּיצַד מְשַׁעֲרִין אוֹתָהּ.** מִשּׁוּם דְּכִירָה גְבוֹהָה מֵחָצֵר הַרְבֵּה וּצְרִיכִים אָנוּ לְשַׁעֵר מַה נֶחְשָׁב אֲוִיר הֶחָצֵר:


כיצד משערין אותה – because a portable stove with caves for two pots is a great deal higher than the courtyard and we must measure what is considered the airspace of the courtyard.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:3:6)


**נוֹתֵן אֶת הַשַּׁפּוּד.** רֹאשׁוֹ אֶחָד עַל כֹּתֶל הֶחָצֵר הַנָּמוּךְ וְרֹאשׁוֹ אַחֵר עַל כֹּתֶל הַכִּירָה הַגָּבֹהַּ, וְכָל שֶׁלְּמַטָּה מִן הַשַּׁפּוּד אִם נִתְלָה שָׁם שֶׁרֶץ אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהוּא לְמַעְלָה מִכָּתְלֵי הֶחָצֵר כְּאִלּוּ נִתְלָה לְמַטָּה, דְּכָל זֶה נֶחְשָׁב אֲוִיר הֶחָצֵר:


נותן את השפוד – one end on the lowest wall of the courtyard and the other end on the highest wall of the double stove, and everything that is below from the spit, if one suspended there an unclean reptile, even though it is a above from the walls of the courtyard as if it is suspended below, for all of this is considered the airspace of the courtyard.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:3:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:3:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:3:7)


**לֹא נִטְמֵאת הַכִּירָה.** דְּחָצֵר טְפֵלָה לַכִּירָה, וְאֵין כִּירָה טְפֵלָה לֶחָצֵר. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר בֶּן יַעֲקֹב:


לא נטמאת הכירה – for the court [of the stove] is subsidiary to the portable stove with caves for two pots, but the portable double stove is not subsidiary to the court [of the stove]. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:4:1)


**הָיְתָה מֻפְרֶשֶׁת.** שֶׁלֹּא בָּנָה הָאֻמָּן מִתְּחִלָּה הֶחָצֵר וְהַכִּירָה מְחֻבָּרִים יַחַד, אֶלָּא זוֹ לְעַצְמָהּ וְזוֹ לְעַצְמָהּ:


היתה מופרשת – that the artisan did not build from the outset the court/fender[of the stove] and the portable stove with caves for two pots being attached together, but rather, the one is on its own and the other is on its own.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:4:2)


**חֲלָקָה.** בְּלֹא בֵית קִבּוּל כְּלָל. וְזוֹ וְאֵין צָרִיךְ לוֹמַר זוֹ קָתָנֵי:


חלקה (smooth) – without a receptacle at all. It is taught this, but you don’t have to mention that.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:4:3)


**פִּטְפּוּטֵי כִירָה.** רַגְלֵי הַכִּירָה, שֶׁהֵם שְׁלֹשָׁה רַגְלַיִם וְהֵם גְּבוֹהִים שָׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת, נֶחְשָׁבִים כְּכִירָה וּמִטַּמְּאִים בְּמַגָּע וּבַאֲוִיר כַּכִּירָה עַצְמָהּ, וְכָל שֶׁכֵּן אִם הֵן פְּחוּתִים מִשָּׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת שֶׁהֵם נִדּוֹנִים כְּכִירָה:


פטפוטי כירה (clay pins forming a sort of tripod for the double stove) – the feet of the portable stove with caves for two pots, which are three feet, and they are three fingers high, and they are considered like the double stove, and become susceptible to [ritual] defilement through contact and through airspace like the double stove itself. And all the more so if they are less than three fingers, they are judged like the portable stove with caves for two pots/כירה.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:4:4)


**וַאֲפִלּוּ הֵן אַרְבָּעָה.** רַגְלַיִם, נִדּוֹנִים כְּכִירָה:


ואפילו הן ארבעה – [four] feet. They are judged lie the portable stove with caves for two pots.



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:5:1)


**נִטַּל אַחַד מֵהֶן.** הָיוּ שְׁלֹשָׁה וְנִטַּל אֶחָד מֵהֶן, אַכַּתִּי חֲזוּ קְצָת לִהְיוֹת שׁוֹפֵת עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת הַקְּדֵרָה וַחֲשִׁיב כְּנָתוּץ וְלֹא כְּנָתוּץ, הִלְכָּךְ מִטַּמְּאִים בְּמַגָּע וְאֵין מִטַּמְּאִין בַּאֲוִיר:


נטל אחד מהן – there were three [legs/props] and one of them was taken from them, they still appear partially able to place the cooking vessel over or by the fire and it is considered as chipped off/torn down and [also] not as chipped off/torn down. Therefore, it becomes susceptible to being defiled through contact does it does not become defiled through airspace.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:5:2)


**וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן מְטַהֵר.** שֶׁהָיָה רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר כָּל פִּטְפּוּטֵי כִירָה שֶׁאֵין מִטַּמְּאִין בַּאֲוִיר אֵין מִטַּמְּאִין בְּמַגָּע. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן:


ורבי שמעון מטהר – for Rabbi Shimon would state that all of the pins forming a sort of tripod for the support of a portable stove with caves for two pots that are not susceptible to being defiled through airspace are not made unclean through contact. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Shimon.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:5:3)


**עָשָׂה שְׁנַיִם.** עָשָׂה הָאֻמָּן מִתְּחִלָּתָהּ הַכִּירָה בִשְׁנֵי פִטְפּוּטִין:


עשה שנים – the artisan from the outset made the portable stove with caves for two stoves with two legs/pins.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:5:4)


**מִטַּמְּאִים בְּמַגָּע וּבַאֲוִיר.** דַּהֲווּ לְהוּ כִשְׁתֵּי אֲבָנִים שֶׁעֲשָׂאָן כִּירָה, דִּתְנַן לְעֵיל שֶׁהִיא טְמֵאָה:


מיטמאים במגע ובאויר – that they are like two stones that were made into a portable stove with caves for two pots, as it is taught in the Mishnah above (see Tractate Kelim, Chapter 6, Mishnah 1), that it is impure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:5:5)


**הָיוּ גְבוֹהִים.** הַפִּטְפּוּטִים:


היו גבוהים – the legs/pins.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:5:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:5:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:5:6)


**וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן מְטַהֵר.** אוֹתוֹ הָעוֹדֵף עַל שָׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת וּלְמַעְלָה, בֵּין בְּמַגָּע בֵּין בַּאֲוִיר. דְּכָל פִּטְפּוּט לְמַעְלָה מִשָּׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת לָא חֲשִׁיב כְּכִירָה:


ור' שמעון מטהר – that surplus above the three fingers and above, whether through contact or – thorough airspace. For every leg/pin that is above three fingers [in height] is not considered like a portable stove with caves for two pots.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:5:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:5:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:5:7)


**הָיוּ מְשׁוּכִים מִן הַשָּׂפָה.** כְּמִין בְּלִיטוֹת עֲשׂוּיִין בְּגוּף הַכִּירָה, וּמֵאוֹתָן בְּלִיטוֹת נִמְשָׁכִין הַפִּטְפּוּטִין שֶׁהֵן רַגְלֵי הַכִּירָה, וְהַשְׁתָּא נִמְצָאִים הַפִּטְפּוּטִים חוּץ מִן הַשָּׂפָה, וּמַה שֶּׁיֵּשׁ מֵהֶן בְּתוֹךְ שָׁלֹשׁ לַשָּׂפָה נֶחְשָׁב כַּכִּירָה עַצְמָהּ וּמִטַּמֵּא בְּמַגָּע וּבַאֲוִיר, וּבְמַה שֶּׁיֵּשׁ מֵהֶן מִחוּץ לְשָׁלֹשׁ, בְּהָא פְלִיגֵי רַבִּי מֵאִיר וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן. וּבְכֻלְּהוּ הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי מֵאִיר:


היו משוכים מן שפה (if they were withdrawn from the lip/rim) – like projections made in the body of the portable stove with caves for two pots. And from those projections, their legs/pins are stretched/conducted which are the feet of the portable stove with caves for two pots, and no, the legs/pins are found outside from the rim, but what there is of them that are within three [fingers] of the rim are considered like the portable stove with caves for two pots itself and become defiled through contact and through airspaces, but what there is of them outside of/beyond the three [fingers] is what Rabbi Meir and Rabbi Shimon dispute. And in all of them, the Halakha is according to Rabbi Meir.



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 7:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/7:6:1)


**כֵּיצַד מְשַׁעֲרִין אוֹתָן.** לְפִי שֶׁהַפִּטְפּוּטִים רְחוֹקִים זֶה מִזֶּה, וּכְשֶׁנִּמְצָא שֶׁרֶץ בֵּינֵיהֶם אֵין אָנוּ יְכוֹלִים לָדַעַת אִם הוּא בְתוֹךְ שָׁלֹשׁ לַשָּׂפָה וְטָמֵא, אוֹ חוּץ לְשָׁלֹשׁ וְטָהוֹר, לְרַבִּי מֵאִיר בַּאֲוִיר וּלְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֵּין בְּמַגָּע בֵּין בַּאֲוִיר, הִלְכָּךְ מוֹדֵד לְפִטְפּוּט זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת מִן הַשָּׂפָה וְכֵן לַשֵּׁנִי, וְנוֹתֵן הָאַמָּה שֶׁמְּסַרְגְּלִים בָּהּ אֶת הַסְּפָרִים בֵּינְתַיִם מִזֶּה לָזֶה, וְהִיא נִקְרֵאת כַּנָּה, וּמְסַרְגֵּל, וּמִן הַסַּרְגֵּל וְלִפְנִים טָמֵא, דְּהַיְנוּ נַמִּי מְקוֹם הַכַּנָּה, וּמִן הַסַּרְגֵּל וְלַחוּץ טָהוֹר:


כיצד משערין אותם – because the legs/pins are far from each other, and when an unclean reptile is found between them, we are not able to know if it is within the three [fingers] to the rim/lip and impure, or beyond the three [fingers] to the rim and pure for airspace for Rabbi Meir and for Rabbi Shimon, whether for contact and/or for airspace, therefore, one measures to this leg/pin three fingers from the rim/lip and similarly to the second and placer the cubit and draw [tracing] lines of the boundaries between them from one to the other, and this is called a כנה/putting a ruler between, measuring a straight line (or putting the base of the stone between them) and he draws lines, and from the tracing lines and inward is impure, that is, the place of the straight/ruled line, and from the tracing lines and outward is pure.



## Chapter 8


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:1)


**הַתַּנּוּר שֶׁחֲצָצוֹ.** שֶׁעָשָׂה מְחִצָּה בְּאֶמְצָעִיתוֹ וְחִלְּקוֹ עַד לְמַעְלָה מִפִּיו:


התנור שחצצו (the oven that was divided [by hangings/boards]) – that he made a partition in its mid-section and divided it until above from its top-most layer.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:2)


**הַכֹּל טָמֵא.** אֲפִלּוּ אֳכָלִים שֶׁבָּעֵבֶר הַשֵּׁנִי שֶׁל מְחִצָּה:


הכל טמא – even foods that are in the second side of the partition.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:3)


**כַּוֶּרֶת פְּחוּתָה וּפְקוּקָה בְקַשׁ.** לְהָכִי נָקַט פְּחוּתָה, דְּלָאו כְּלִי הִיא, דְּאִי הֲוָה שְׁלֵמָה הָיְתָה מַצֶּלֶת עַל אֳכָלִים שֶׁבְּתוֹכָהּ, דַּאֲפִלּוּ כְלִי שֶׁטֶף מַצִּיל, אֲבָל הַשְׁתָּא דְלָאו כְּלִי הִיא הַוְיָא כִמְחִצָּה בְעָלְמָא. וּפְקוּקָה בְקַשׁ לִרְבוּתָא נְקָטָהּ, דְּאַף עַל גַּב דִּפְחִיתָתָהּ פְּקוּקָה בְקַשׁ לֹא הַוְיָא כְלִי וְאֵין מַצֶּלֶת עַל אֳכָלִים שֶׁבְּתוֹכָהּ:


כוורת פחותה ופקוקה בקש (a defective bee-hive, which was repaired with stuffing of straw) – for this purpose, it (i.e., the Mishnah) took [the term] פחותה/defective, for it is not a vessel, for if were complete/full it would protect over the foods that are within it, for even a vessel that drips protects/saves, but here not it is not a vessel, it is a mere partition, and [the term] פקוקה בקש/stopped up with stuffing of straw – is taken [by the Mishnah] to add something new, for even though its defectiveness is stuffed with straw, it is not a vessel, and doesn’t protect the foods that are within it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:4)


**וּמְשֻׁלְשֶׁלֶת.** תְּלוּיָה:


ומשולשת – hanging.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:5)


**אִם הִצִּילָה בְמֵת הֶחָמוּר.** דְּכַוֶּרֶת פְּחוּתָה וּפְקוּקָה בְקַשׁ חוֹצֶצֶת בִּפְנֵי הַטֻּמְאָה בְאֹהֶל הַמֵּת, וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁטֻּמְאָתוֹ חֲמוּרָה לְטַמֵּא אָדָם וְכֵלִים טֻמְאַת שִׁבְעָה:


אם הצילה במת החמור – for a defective bee-hive that is repaired with the stuffing of straw divides in the face of defilement that is in the tent of a corpse, but even though its defilement is more grave than the defilement to a person or to vessels for a seven day defilement [period].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:6)


**לֹא תַצִּיל בִּכְלִי חֶרֶס הַקַּל.** שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְטַמֵּא אֶלָּא אֳכָלִים וּמַשְׁקִים:


לא תציל בכלי חרס הקל – which does not defile other than foods and liquids.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:7)


**שֶׁכֵּן חוֹלְקִים אֹהָלִים.** שֶׁדֶּרֶךְ בְּנֵי אָדָם לַחֲלֹק אֹהָלִים בִּמְחִצָּה, הִלְכָּךְ הַוְיָא כַּוֶּרֶת כִּמְחִצָּה וּמַצֶּלֶת בְּאֹהֶל הַמֵּת מִן הַטֻּמְאָה:


שכן חולקים אהלים – for it is the manner for people to divide tents with partitions; therefore, the bee-hive is like a partition that saves/protects the tent of a corpse from defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:1:8)


**שֶׁאֵין חוֹלְקִים כְּלֵי חָרֶס.** שֶׁאֵין דֶּרֶךְ לַחֲלֹק כְּלֵי חֶרֶס בִּמְחִצָּה. פֵּרוּשׁ אַחֵר וְעִקָּר, שֶׁכֵּן חוֹלְקִים אֹהָלִים, שֶׁמּוֹעֶלֶת חֲלֻקַּת מְחִצָּה בְאֹהָלִים, דְּהָא תְנַן בְּמַסֶּכֶת אֳהָלוֹת פֶּרֶק סָגוֹס עָבֶה, בַּיִת שֶׁחֲצָצוֹ בִּנְסָרִים אוֹ בִירִיעוֹת, טֻמְאָה בַבַּיִת, כֵּלִים שֶׁבְּתוֹךְ הַמְּחִצָּה טְהוֹרִים. וְאֵין חֲלֻקַּת הַמְּחִצָּה מוֹעֶלֶת בִּכְלֵי חֶרֶס, דְּגַבֵּי תַנּוּר תְּנַן הָכָא תַנּוּר שֶׁחֲצָצוֹ בִנְסָרִים אוֹ בִירִיעוֹת, נִמְצָא שֶׁרֶץ בְּמָקוֹם אֶחָד הַכֹּל טָמֵא. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר:


שאין חולקים כלי חרס – for there is no way to divide an earthenware vessel with a partition. Another explanation and essential: that we do divide tents for the dividing of tents with a partition has effect, for it is taught in the Mishnah in the Tractate Ohalot, in the Chapter סגוס עבה/A Thick Cloak (Chapter 15, Mishnah 4): “A house that was divided with boards or curtains, from the sides or from the roof beams – uncleanness is in the house; utensils that are within the partitioned-off area are clean.” But the division of the partition has no effect with earthenware vessels, for it is taught [in the Mishnah] regarding an oven here that was divided with boards or curtains, if an unclean reptile is found in one part, everything is impure. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Eliezer.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:1)


**הָיְתָה שְׁלֵמָה.** הַכַּוֶּרֶת:


היתה שלימה – the bee-hive.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:2)


**הַתַּנּוּר טָהוֹר.** דִּכְתִיב (ויקרא יא) אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל מֵהֶם אֶל תּוֹכוֹ, וְלֹא אֶל תּוֹךְ תּוֹכוֹ. וּבְפִיהָ לְמַעְלָה מִן הַתַּנּוּר אַיְרֵי, דְּאִי כֻלָּהּ מְשֻׁקַּעַת בַּתַּנּוּר, כְּחַד תּוֹךְ דָּמֵי:


התנור טהור – as it is written (Leviticus 11:33): “And if any of those (i.e., any article of wood, or a cloth or a skin, or a sack) falls into an earthen vessel, [everything inside it shall be impure and – the vessel – itself you shall break],” but not אל תוך תוכו/to what is inside of it [already], and we are speaking of when its mouth/topmost layer is above from the oven, for if all of it is sunk in the oven, it is like one thing within it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:3)


**אֹכָלִין שֶׁבְּתוֹכָהּ טְהוֹרִין.** דִּכְתִיב (שם) כָּל אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכוֹ יִטְמָא, וְלֹא שֶׁבְּתוֹךְ תּוֹכוֹ:


אוכלים שתוכה טהורין – as it is written (Leviticus 11:33): “everything inside it shall be impure,” and not שבתוך תוכו/what is already inside it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:4)


**נִקְּבוּ.** נֶקֶב הַמְטַהֵר אוֹתָן מִידֵי טֻמְאָתָן, שׁוּב אֵין תּוֹרַת כְּלִי עֲלֵיהֶן וְאֵינָן חוֹצְצִים בֵּין הַתַּנּוּר וּבֵין מַה שֶּׁבְּתוֹכָן. וְכַמָּה הוּא נֶקֶב הַמְטַהֵר אוֹתָן מִטֻּמְאָתָן,


ניקבו – the perforation that purifies them from their impurities, furthermore they no longer have the status of a vessel and they don’t divide/separate whether it is an oven or whether what is inside of it, and how much is the perforation that purifies them from their defilements.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:5)


**הֶעָשׂוּי לָאֳכָלִים.** שִׁעוּרוֹ כְמוֹצִיא זֵיתִים:


העשוי לאוכלים – its measurement is like bringing forth/removing olives.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:6)


**הֶעָשׂוּי לְכָךְ וּלְכָךְ.** לְאֳכָלִים וּלְמַשְׁקִים:


העשוי לכך ולכך – for food and liquids.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:7)


**מַטִּילִין אוֹתוֹ לְחֻמְרוֹ.** וְאִם נִקַּב כְּשִׁעוּר שֶׁל מַשְׁקִין שֶׁהוּא פָחוּת מִשִּׁעוּר הֶעָשׂוּי לָאֳכָלִים, שׁוּב אֵינוֹ מַצִּיל מִפְּנֵי הַטֻּמְאָה:


מטילין אותו לחומרו (they subject it to its more stringent [measure]) – but if he made the incision according to the measurement of liquids which is less than the measurement that is made for foods, he further is not able to save it because of the defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:2:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:2:8)


**בְּכוֹנֵס מַשְׁקֶה.** כְּשֶׁמְּשִׂימִין הַכְּלִי מִצַּד הַנֶּקֶב עַל הַמַּיִם נִכְנָסִים הַמַּיִם דֶּרֶךְ הַנֶּקֶב בְּתוֹךְ הַכְּלִי. וְהוּא גָדוֹל מִמּוֹצִיא מַשְׁקֶה:


בכונס משקה (with the capacity to admit liquid) – when they place the vessel from the side of the perforation, the water enters through the perforation into the vessel, and it is larger than that which liquid leaves/is removed.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:3:1)


**סְרֵידָא.** כְּמִין עֲרֵבָה קְטַנָּה שֶׁהַנַּחְתּוֹם מִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ לָלוּשׁ בָּהּ, וְאֵין לָהּ בֵּית קִבּוּל. וְרַמְבַּ"ם אוֹמֵר שֶׁהוּא לוּחַ שֶׁל חֶרֶס נְקוּבָה עֲשׂוּיָה כְעֵין שְׂבָכָה. מַעֲשֵׂה רֶשֶׁת, מְתַרְגְּמִינַן עוֹבַד סְרַדְתָּא:


סרידא (stuffed matting used for stoppers of stones, bag) – a kind of small kneading trough that the baker uses to knead in it and it lacks a receptacle. But Maimonides states that it is a board of perforated earthenware thar is made like a kind of net-work/mat, a netting, which we translate in Aramaic as עובד סרדתא/a person who works in netting.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:3:2)


**גַּפַּיִם.** אֳגָנִים וְאָזְנַיִם:


גפיים – rims and handles.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:3:3)


**שֶׁאֵין מַצִּילִים מִיַּד כְּלִי חֶרֶס.** מִלִּטַּמֵּא בַאֲוִיר כְּלִי חֶרֶס,


שאין מצילים מיד כלי חרס (do not save from the power of earthenware vessels/utensils – lacking an inner part) – from being susceptible to defilement from the airspace of an earthenware vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:3:4)


**אֶלָּא כֵלִים.** וְזוֹ הוֹאִיל וְאֵין לָהּ אָזְנַיִם אֵינָהּ חֲשׁוּבָה כְלִי:


אלא כלים – and this, for since it does not have handles, it is not considered a vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:3:5)


**נְחֻשְׁתּוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר.** קַרְקָעִיתוֹ וְתַחְתִּיתוֹ. וְדוֹמֶה לוֹ בִיחֶזְקֵאל יַעַן הִשָּׁפֵךְ נְחֻשְׁתֵּךְ:


נחושתו של תנור (from the copper rim of the stove) – its bottom and lowest point. And similar to it is found in Ezekiel (16:36): “Because of your brazen effrontery/יען השפך נחשתך, [offering your nakedness to your lovers for harlotry – just like the blood of your children, which you gave to all your abominable fetishes].”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:3:6)


**הֶחָבִית וְהַמַּשְׁקִין טְהוֹרִים.** דְּלֹא נִכְנְסוּ לַאֲוִירוֹ, דְּהָא לְמַטָּה מִנְּחֻשְׁתּוֹ קַיְמֵי. וַאֲפִלּוּ מְחֻבָּר אֲוִיר הַתַּנּוּר בַּאֲוִיר הֶחָבִית וַאֲפִלּוּ הֶחָבִית פְּתוּחָה וְנִכְנָס מֵאֲוִיר הַתַּנּוּר בְּפִיהָ, לֹא נִטְמָא הַיַּיִן בְּכָךְ, שֶׁאֵין אֲוִיר כְּלִי חֶרֶס מְטַמֵּא לֹא לְמַעְלָה וְלֹא לְמַטָּה אֶלָּא בְתוֹכוֹ:


החבית והמשקין טהורים – that they did not enter into its (i.e., the unclean reptile’s) airspace, for they stand below the copper rim of the stove, and even if the jar is open and enters from the airspace of the oven at its mouth, the wine is not defiled through this, for the airspace of an earthenware vessel does not defile neither above nor below other than within.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:3:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:3:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:3:7)


**הָיְתָה כְפוּיָה.** הֶחָבִית עַל פִּיהָ וּנְתוּנָה עַל פִּיו שֶׁל תַּנּוּר שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ שֶׁרֶץ, וְיֵשׁ בְּשׁוּלֵי הֶחָבִית לַחְלוּחִית יַיִן שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהּ טוֹפֵחַ עַל מְנָת לְהַטְפִּיחַ, לֹא נִטְמֵאת אוֹתָהּ הַלַּחְלוּחִית מִפְּנֵי אֲוִיר הַתַּנּוּר שֶׁנִּכְנָס לְתוֹךְ הֶחָבִית, כֵּיוָן שֶׁלֹּא הָיְתָה לַחְלוּחִית הַיַּיִן בְּתוֹךְ הַתַּנּוּר:


היתה כפויה – the jug [was turned upside down] on its lip and placed on the lip of the oven which has an unclean reptile in it, and on the rim of the jar the moisture of wine that is in it, moist enough in order to moisten other objects, this moisture is not defiled on account of the airspace of the oven that enters into the jar, because the moisture of the wine was not within the oven.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:4:1)


**הַקְּדֵרָה טְהוֹרָה.** וְהוּא שֶׁלֹּא רָאָה הַשֶּׁרֶץ אֲוִיר הַקְּדֵרָה כְּשֶׁנָּפַל בַּתַּנּוּר:


הקדרה טהורה – and it is case where the unclean reptile did not see the airspace of the pot when it fell into the oven.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:4:2)


**נִטְמָא.** הַמַּשְׁקֶה, וְחָזַר וְטִמֵּא אֶת הַקְּדֵרָה, כְּדִין כָּל מַשְׁקִין טְמֵאִין שֶׁמְּטַמְּאִים כֵּלִים:


נטמא – the liquid [is defiled if dripping liquid was in the pot] and it returned and defiled the pot, according to the law that all liquids are impure when they defile vessels.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:4:3)


**מְטַמְּאֶיךָ לֹא טִמְּאוּנִי.** הַקְּדֵרָה אוֹמֶרֶת לַמַּשְׁקִין, אֲוִיר כְּלִי חֶרֶס שֶׁקִּבַּלְתָּ מִמֶּנּוּ הַטֻּמְאָה לֹא טִמְּאוּנִי, דְּאֵין כְּלִי חֶרֶס מִטַּמֵּא מֵאֲוִיר כְּלִי חֶרֶס:


מטמאיך לא טמאוני (those things which made you unclean did not make me unclean) – the pot says to the liquids, the airspace of the earthenware vessel that you received the defilement from it did not defile me, for an earthenware vessel becomes defiled from the airspace of an earthenware vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:4:4)


**וְאַתָּה טִמֵּאתָנִי.** שֶׁנִּטְמֵאת הַקְּדֵרָה מֵחֲמַת מַשְׁקִים טְמֵאִים:


ואתה טמאתני – that he pot was defiled on account of the impure liquids.



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:5:1)


**וְנָפַל לַאֲוִיר הַתַּנּוּר טָהוֹר.** כָּל זְמַן שֶׁהַתַּרְנְגוֹל חַי. דְּטֻמְאָה בְלוּעָה הִיא וְאֵינָהּ מְטַמְּאָה:


ונפל אויר התנור טהור – all the time that the chicken is alive, the defilement was absorbed and does not defile.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:5:2)


**וְאִם מֵת טָמֵא.** וְהוּא שֶׁלֹּא שָׁהָה כְדֵי עִכּוּל מִשָּׁעָה שֶׁבָּלַע עַד שֶׁמֵּת. וְשִׁעוּר כְּדֵי עִכּוּל בָּעוֹפוֹת, מֵעֵת לְעֵת:


ואם מת טמא – and it (i.e., the unclean reptile/insect) did not tarry in order to be consumed from the time it was swallowed until it (i.e., the chicken) died. And the measurement in order for it to be consumed (i.e., fully digested) in fowl, is from the time of twenty-four astronomical hours.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:5:3)


**הַפַּת שֶׁבְּתוֹכוֹ שְׁנִיָּה.** דְּלֹא חָזִינַן לַתַּנּוּר כְּמַאן דְּמָלֵא טֻמְאָה וּכְאִלּוּ נָגַע הַשֶּׁרֶץ בַּפַּת, אֶלָּא הַתַּנּוּר תְּחִלָּה, שֶׁהַשֶּׁרֶץ [שֶׁ]הוּא אַב הַטֻּמְאָה נָפַל אֶל תּוֹכוֹ וַעֲשָׂאוֹ רִאשׁוֹן, וְחָזַר הַתַּנּוּר שֶׁהוּא רִאשׁוֹן וְטִמֵּא אֶת הַפַּת וְנַעֲשֵׂית שְׁנִיָּה:


הפת שבתוכו שניה – that we don’t view the oven like one that is filled with defilement and it is as if the unclean reptile came in contact with the bread, but rather, the oven is first degree, for the unclean reptile is a primary source of ritual defilement fell into inside and made it first-degree of ritual impurity. And the oven which is first degree, in turn, defiled the bread and made it second-degree of ritual impurity.



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:6:1)


**בֵּית שְׂאֹר מֻקָּף צָמִיד פָּתִיל.** בִּכְלִי חֶרֶס עָסְקִינַן, שֶׁמַּצִּיל בַּאֲוִיר הַתַּנּוּר בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁמַּצִּיל בְּאֹהֶל הַמֵּת, דִּכְתִיב (ויקרא יא) מִכָּל הָאֹכֶל אֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל, וְלֹא כָּל הָאֹכֶל, פְּרָט לְמֻקָּף צָמִיד פָּתִיל בִּכְלִי חֶרֶס וְנָתוּן לְתוֹךְ הַתַּנּוּר שֶׁאֵינוֹ מִטַּמֵּא מֵאֲוִיר הַתַּנּוּר. אֲבָל כְּלִי שֶׁטֶף אֵינוֹ מַצִּיל בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל עַל אֳכָלִים שֶׁבְּתוֹכוֹ, דְּהָכִי תָנֵי בְתוֹרַת כֹּהֲנִים, [כָּל] הָאֹכֶל, לְהָבִיא הַמֻּקָּף צָמִיד פָּתִיל בִּכְלִי שֶׁטֶף וְנָתוּן לְתוֹךְ הַתַּנּוּר, שֶׁאֵינוֹ מַצִּיל מִיַּד כְּלִי חֶרֶס:


בית שאור המוקף צמיד פתיל (a clay leaven pot with an airtight lid) – we ae dealing with an earthenware vessel, that saves in the airspace of the oven with an airtight lid in the manner that it saves in the tent of a corpse (as only the space within an earthenware vessel can contract ritual impurity – and everything within it remains ritually pure), as it is written (Leviticus 11:34): “As to any food that may be eaten, [it shall become impure if it came in contact with water; as to any liquid that may be drunk, it shall become impure if it was inside any vessel,” but not all of the food, excluding that which is surrounded with an airtight lid on an earthenware vessel and placed inside the oven that does not become defiled from the airspace of the oven. But a vessel that requires only rinsing to be restored to Levitical cleanness (see Tractate Hullin 25a; Tractate Zevakhim 3b) does not save with an airtight lid on the foods that are within it, as this is taught in the Halakhic Midrash (Sifra) to the Book of Leviticus, [All] the food, including that which is surrounded by an airtight lid with a vessel that requires only rinsing to be restored to Levitical cleanness and placed within the oven, that it does not save it from the hand of an earthenware vessel [and makes it impure].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:6:2)


**הַשְּׂאֹר וְהַשֶּׁרֶץ בְּתוֹכוֹ וְהַקֶּרֶץ בֵּינְתַיִם.** כְּגוֹן שֶׁיֵּשׁ לִכְלִי זֶה שְׁנֵי קִבּוּלִין, וְהַמְּחִצָּה הַמַּפְסֶקֶת בֵּין בֵּית קִבּוּל לַחֲבֵרוֹ נִקְרֵאת קֶרֶץ, לְשׁוֹן מֵחֹמֶר קֹרַצְתִּי גַּם אָנִי (איוב לג), וְהַמְּחִצָּה מַגַּעַת עַד שְׂפָתוֹ, וְהַשְּׂאֹר מִצַּד אֶחָד וְהַשֶּׁרֶץ מִצַּד אַחֵר וְהַקֶּרֶץ הִיא הַמְּחִצָּה הַחוֹצֶצֶת בֵּינְתַיִם, וּמֻקָּף הַכְּלִי כֻלּוֹ צָמִיד פָּתִיל, דְּנִמְצְאוּ הַשְּׂאֹר וְהַשֶּׁרֶץ שְׁנֵיהֶם מֻקָּפִים צָמִיד פָּתִיל:


השאור והשרץ בתוכו והקרץ בינתים – as for example, that this vessel has two receptacles, and the partition that divides between receptacle and its fellow is called a קרץ/[squeezed-in] partition; it is the language of (Job 33:6): "מחמר קרצתי גם-אני"/[You and I are the same before God;] I too was nipped from clay,” and the partition reaches until its rim, and the leaven from one side and the unclean reptile/insect from the other and the partition is the divider that separates between them, but if the entire vessel is surrounded with an airtight lid, that it is found that the leaven and the unclean insect are surrounded by an airtight lid.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:6:3)


**הַתַּנּוּר טָמֵא.** מֵחֲמַת הַשֶּׁרֶץ שֶׁבְּתוֹךְ הַצָּמִיד פָּתִיל. שֶׁצָּמִיד פָּתִיל מַצִּיל עַל הַטָּהֳרוֹת שֶׁבְּתוֹכוֹ מִלְּקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה, וְאֵינוֹ מַצִּיל עַל הַטֻּמְאָה שֶׁבְּתוֹכוֹ שֶׁלֹּא לְטַמֵּא אֶת אֲחֵרִים:


התנור טמא – on account of the unclean insect/reptile that is within the airtight lid. For the airtight lid saves/protects those pure things that are within from becoming susceptible to receiving ritual impurity, but it doesn’t save those unclean things found within from defiling other things.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:6:4)


**וְהַשְּׂאֹר טָהוֹר.** דַּהֲרֵי הוּא מֻקָּף צָמִיד פָּתִיל בִּפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ:


והשאור טהור – for it is surrounded by an airtight lid by itself.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:6:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:6:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:6:5)


**וְאִם הָיָה שָׁם פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.** שֶׁנִּפְרְצָה הַמְּחִצָּה שֶׁבֵּין הַשְּׂאֹר וּבֵין כַּזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת בְּפוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח:


ואם היה שם פותח טפח – that the partition that was between the leaven and an olive’s bulk from a corpse was beached with an opening of a square handbreadth [in length, breadth and height].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:6:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:6:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:6:6)


**הַכֹּל טָמֵא.** דְּטֶפַח עַל טֶפַח פָּתוּחַ מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה:


הכל טמא – that a handbreadth by a handbreadth that is open brings in the defilement.



### Mishnah 7

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:7:1)


**בָּעַיִן שֶׁל תַּנּוּר.** הוּא חֹר כְּעֵין עַיִן שֶׁעוֹשִׂים בַּתַּנּוּר לְהוֹצִיא הֶעָשָׁן, וּכְשֶׁמַּכְנִיסִים הַפַּת לַתַּנּוּר סוֹתְמִים אוֹתוֹ שֶׁלֹּא יֵצֵא הַחֹם, וְאֵינוֹ חֲשׁוּב כְּתוֹכוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר:


בעין של תנור – it is a hole similar to an eye that one makes in the oven to remove the smoke, and when they bring the bread into the oven, they stop up/close it so that they heat does not escape, and it is not considered as the inside of the oven.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:7:2)


**אִם הָיָה בָאֲוִיר.** בְּמָקוֹם מְגֻלֶּה שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה תַּחַת הָאֹהֶל, אֲפִלּוּ כַזַיִת מִן הַמֵּת נָתוּן בְּעֵינוֹ, טָהוֹר הַתַּנּוּר, דְּאֵין טֻמְאָה נִכְנֶסֶת לְתוֹכוֹ כֵיוָן שֶׁאֵין בָּעַיִן פּוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח:


אם היה באויר – in an uncovered place that was not underneath the tent, even an olive’s bulk from the corpse is placed in the eye/vent/outlet, the oven is ritually pure, for the defilement does not enter into it since the eye/outlet/vent is not open a [square] handbreadth [in length, breadth and height].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:7:3)


**וְאִם יֶשׁ בּוֹ פוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.** שֶׁעֳבִי שְׂפַת הָעַיִן הַחִיצוֹנָה בּוֹלֶטֶת וּמַאֲהֶלֶת עַל כַּזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת בְּטֶפַח עַל טֶפַח:


ואם יש בו פותח טפח – that the thickness of the rim of the outer eye/vent protrudes and overshadows on an olive’s bulk from the corpse by a square handbreadth.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:7:4)


**הַכֹּל טָמֵא.** הָעַיִן וְהַתַּנּוּר. שֶׁטֶּפַח עַל טֶפַח אֹהֶל מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה:


הכל טמא – the eye/vent/outlet and the oven [are impure] for a square handbreadth of the tent brings in the defilement.



### Mishnah 8

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:8:1)


**נִמְצָא בִמְקוֹם הַנָּחַת הָעֵצִים.** נִמְצָא הַשֶּׁרֶץ בַּמָּקוֹם שֶׁמַּנִּיחִין בּוֹ אֵשׁ וְעֵצִים בַּכִּירָה, וְהוּא הַמָּקוֹם שֶׁמַּשְׁלִיכִין מִמֶּנּוּ הָאֵשׁ מִשְּׁפַל [מִשְּׂפַת בֵּית] הַמּוֹקֵד:


נמצא מקום הנחת העצים – the insect/unclean reptile is found in the place where they place in it the fire and the wood/logs in the portable stove with caves for two pots/כירה, and it is the place which they throw from it the fire from the lowest point of the hearth.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:8:2)


**מִן הַשָּׂפָה הַחִיצוֹנָה וְלִפְנִים טָמֵא.** דָּעֳבִי כָתְלֵי הַכִּירָה נֶחְשָׁב כְּלִפְנִים וּכְאִלּוּ הוּא תוֹךְ הַכִּירָה:


מן השפה החיצונים ולפנים טמא – that the thickness of the walls of the portable stove with caves for two pots is considered as it is inside and as if it is within the double stove.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:8:3)


**וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים.** אֵין עֳבִי כָתְלֵי הַכִּירָה נֶחְשָׁב אֶלָּא כְלַחוּץ וְאֵינוֹ כְתוֹכָהּ שֶׁל כִּירָה. וַהֲלָכָה כַּחֲכָמִים:


וחכמים אומרים – the thickness of the walls of the portable stove with caves for two pots is not considered other than like the outside, and it is not like the inside of the portable stove with caves for two pots. And the Halakha is according to the Sages.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:8:4)


**מִכְּנֶגֶד שְׁפִיתַת הַקְּדֵרָה.** מִמָּקוֹם שֶׁמַּתְחִיל לִסְתֹּם אֲוִיר הַכִּירָה:


מכנגד שפיתת הקדרה (from the place where the pot is placed and inside – towards the fire) – from the place where one begins to close up the airspace of the portable stove with caves for two pots.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:8:5)


**נִמְצָא.** הַשֶּׁרֶץ:


נמצא – the insect/unclean reptile.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:8:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:8:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:8:6)


**מְקוֹם יְשִׁיבַת הַבַּלָּן.** בְּמָקוֹם שֶׁיּוֹשֵׁב הַמְחַמֵּם אֶת הַמַּיִם לַמֶּרְחָץ:


מקום ישיבת הבלן – in the place where the person who heats up the water for the bathhouse (i.e., the bathhouse attendant).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:8:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:8:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:8:7)


**אֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא מִן הַסְּתִימָה וְלִפְנִים.** מִסְּתִימַת הַקְּדֵרָה שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ הַמַּיִם אוֹ הַצֶּבַע אוֹ שְׁלִיקַת הַזֵּיתִים. וּבַתּוֹסֶפְתָּא מוּכָח דְּאֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא מִן הַסְּתִימָה וְלִפְנִים דְּקָאָמַר הָכָא, הַיְנוּ כְּשֶׁנִּתְלָה הַשֶּׁרֶץ בָּאֲוִיר וְלֹא נָגַע, אֲבָל בְּטֻמְאַת מַגָּע מְטַמֵּא אֲפִלּוּ מִן הַסְּתִימָה וְלַחוּץ:


אין טמא אלא מן הסתימה ולפנים – from the stopped-up part of the pot which has water in it or the dyer or the olive seethers. But in the Tosefta (Tractate Kelim Bava Kamma 6:15) it is proven that it is not impure other than from the stopped-up part and inside, as it states here, that is, when the insect/impure reptile is suspended in the airspace but doesn’t make contact, but with the defilement of contact, it defiles, even from the stopped-up part and outwards.



### Mishnah 9

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:9:1)


**בּוֹר שֶׁיֶּשׁ בּוֹ בֵית שְּׁפִיתָה.** הַחוֹפֵר בַּקַּרְקַע וְטָח בְּטִיט וְהַטִּיחַ יָכוֹל לַעֲמֹד מֵאֵלָיו, כְּגוֹן תַּנּוּרוֹ שֶׁל בֶּן דִּינַאי דִּתְנַן לְעֵיל בְּפֶרֶק תַּנּוּר תְּחִלָּתוֹ אַרְבָּעָה. וְאִית דְּגָרְסֵי כּוּר בְּכָ"ף, וְהוּא כְּלִי שֶׁמַּתִּיכִין בּוֹ הַזָּהָב וְהַכֶּסֶף וְהַמַּתָּכוֹת, לְשׁוֹן כּוּר הַבַּרְזֶל. וְלִי נִרְאֶה שֶׁהוּא תַנּוּר שֶׁל נַפָּחִים:


בור שיש בו בית שפיתה (a smelting pot which has a bottom or foot on which it can rest – a hole in the ground with an arrangement for putting a pot over fire) – a person who digs in the ground and plasters over the spot over with clay/mud and the plaster can stand (or form a vessel) on its own, such as the oven the son of Dinai, as is taught in the Mishnah above in the chapter “A Baking Oven, its Beginning/"תנור תחלתו" (see Tractate Kelim, Chapter 5, Mishnah 10 at the conclusion- who, according to Bartenura, states that he was a robber and would bake his bread in an oven like this and make these kinds of ovens, or a place where trials took place frequently; see also Tractate Sotah, Chapter 9, Mishnah 9, where this name also appears). But there are those who have the reading of כור/smelting pot with the letter כ'/Kaf (and not the ב'./Bet – as found in our editions of the Mishnah) – and it is a utensil/vessel in which they smelt in it gold and the silver and metals, he language of an iron furnace/כור ברזל. But to me, it appears that it is an oven of a blacksmith.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:9:2)


**פּוּרְנָה.** תַּנּוּר גָּדוֹל שֶׁל חֶרֶס וּפִתְחוֹ בְצִדּוֹ כְעֵין שֶׁלָּנוּ. וְטָהוֹר, מִשּׁוּם דִּמְשַׁמֵּשׁ עִם הַקַּרְקַע, כִּדְקָתָנֵי בַתּוֹסֶפְתָּא:


פורנה (a stationary large baking oven) – a large earthenware oven and its opening is at its side like our eye. But it is pure, because it is used with the ground, as is taught in the Tosefta (Tractate Kelim Bava Kamma, Chapter 6, Halakha 17).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:9:3)


**לִזְבֵּז.** שָׂפָה עָבָה:


לזבז – a thick rim.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:9:4)


**אִסְטְגִיּוֹת.** נְקָבִים כְּעֵין אוֹתָן שֶׁעוֹשִׂים לְתַנּוּרִים:


אסטגיות (rims, moldings around a stove) – perforations similar to those that they make for ovens.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:9:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:9:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:9:5)


**שְׂפָיוֹת.** שָׂפָה דַקָּה. וַהֲלָכָה כְּתַנָּא קַמָּא. וְרַבּוֹתַי פֵּרְשׁוּ, דְּלִזְבֵּז וְאִסְטְגִיּוֹת וּשְׂפָיוֹת הַכֹּל אֶחָד, וְלֹא פְלִיגֵי אֶלָּא שֶׁכָּל אֶחָד הָיָה שׁוֹנֶה כְפִי הַלָּשׁוֹן שֶׁשָּׁמַע מֵרַבּוֹ, שֶׁחַיָּב אָדָם לוֹמַר כִּלְשׁוֹן רַבּוֹ:


שפיות – a thin rim. But the Halakha is according to the first Tanna/teacher. But my Rabbis explained that a לזבז/thick rim and אסאגיות/rims, moldings around a stove and שפיות/thin rims are all one [thing]. But they do not disagree other than that each one was different according to the language that he heard from his master, and a person is obligated to state [something] according to the language of his teacher (see also Tractate Eduyot, Chapter 1, Mishnah 3).



### Mishnah 10

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:10:1)


**מַגַּע טְמֵא מֵת.** אָדָם שֶׁנָּגַע בִּטְמֵא מֵת וְנַעֲשָׂה רִאשׁוֹן, דִּטְמֵא מֵת הָוֵי אַב הַטֻּמְאָה וְעוֹשֶׂה הַנּוֹגֵעַ בּוֹ רִאשׁוֹן, וּמַשְׁקִין שֶׁבְּתוֹךְ פִּיו מְטַמְּאִין אֶת הַתַּנּוּר כְּשֶׁנִּכְנְסוּ לַאֲוִירוֹ. וְאַף עַל גַּב דְּהוּא עַצְמוֹ אֵינוֹ מְטַמְּאוֹ דְאֵין כְּלִי מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה אֶלָּא מֵאַב הַטֻּמְאָה, הֲרֵי זֶה אוֹמֵר מְטַמְּאֶיךָ לֹא טִמְּאוּנִי וְאַתָּה טִמֵּאתָנִי, כְּדִתְנַן בְּמַסֶּכֶת פָּרָה, דְּרַבָּנָן גָּזְרוּ עַל הַמַּשְׁקִים שֶׁיִּהְיוּ מְטַמְּאִים כֵּלִים, גְּזֵרָה מִשּׁוּם מַשְׁקֶה זָב וְזָבָה כִדְאָמְרִינַן בְּמַסֶּכֶת שַׁבָּת. וָאֳכָלִים דְּנָקַט הָכָא, כְּדִי נָסְבָא, שֶׁהֲרֵי אֵין אֹכֶל מְטַמֵּא כְלִי, אֶלָּא מַשְׁקִים בִּלְבַד מְטַמְּאִים כֵּלִים. וּקְפִיצַת פִּיו אֵינָהּ מַצֶּלֶת, דְּאֵין צָמִיד פָּתִיל מַצִּיל עַל הַטֻּמְאָה שֶׁבְּתוֹכוֹ מִלְּטַמֵּא אֲחֵרִים כְּדִתְנַן לְעֵיל, וּבַר מִן דֵּין הָא תַנְיָא בַתּוֹסֶפְתָּא דְכֵלִים הַכֹּל מַצִּילִים מִיַּד כְּלֵי חֶרֶס אֲפִלּוּ כְלֵי גְלָלִים וּכְלֵי אֲדָמָה חוּץ מִן הָאָדָם. הִלְכָּךְ, טָהוֹר שֶׁהָיוּ אֳכָלִים וּמַשְׁקִים לְתוֹךְ פִּיו וְהִכְנִיס רֹאשׁוֹ לַאֲוִיר הַתַּנּוּר שֶׁהוּא טָמֵא, נִטְמְאוּ, דְּאֵין הָאָדָם מַצִּיל בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל מִיַּד כְּלִי חֶרֶס:


מגע טמא מת – a person who came in contact with something defiled by the dead and becomes first [degree of ritual impurity], that the person defiled through contact with the dead is a primary source of ritual impurity and makes the individual who has contact first [degree of ritual impurity], and liquids and foods that are in his mouth defile the oven when they entered into its airspace. But even though he himself does not defile them, for a vessel does not become susceptible to receive ritual impurity other than from a primary source of ritual impurity. Behold this person states: “what rendered you unclean did not defile me, but you defiled me,”(see also Tractate Kelim 8:4)) as it is taught in the Mishnah in Tractate Parah ]Chapter 8, Mishnayot 2-7], that the Rabbis decreed regarding liquids that they would defile vessels, as a degree because the משקה זב וזבהliquid of a person with gonorrhea/זב and woman suffering from a flux/זבה as was stated in the Tractate Shabbat (which I could not locate. But using the Bar Ilan Responsa Project 25 plus, I was able to locate one mention of a passage with the words"משקה זב וזבה"are found only in Tractate Bekhorot 38a. I stand to be corrected). But the [word] “foods” that is taken here, it (i.e., the Mishnah) refers to it just by the way, without specific reason, for food does not defile a vessel, but only liquids defile vessels. But the closing of his lips does not save [from contracting defilement] for an airtight lid does not save/protect from the defilement that is within from defiling others as is taught in the Mishnah above (see Tractate Kelim, Chapter 8, Mishnah 6), and outside from the law , that which is taught in the Tosefta of Tractate Kelim [Bava Kamma, Chapter 6, Halakha 5]: “Everything affords protection from the power of a clay utensil, even a utensil made of dung or a utensil made of stones or a utensil made of dirt – except for man” (see The Tosefta, Jacob Neusner, Volume 2). Therefore, something pure that food and liquids were inside of its mouth and he brought his head into the airspace of the oven which is [ritually] impure, were defiled. But a man cannot save with an airtight lid from the earthenware vessel/utensil.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:10:2)


**בְּיָדַיִם מְסֹאָבוֹת.** יָדַיִם שֶׁהֵם שְׁנִיּוֹת לַטֻּמְאָה וּפוֹסְלוֹת אֶת הַתְּרוּמָה:


בידים מסואבות – hands which are second-degree of ritual impurity and which invalidate the heave-offering/Terumah.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:10:3)


**הִכְנִיס יָדוֹ לְתוֹךְ פִּיו.** לִטֹּל אֶת הַצְּרוֹר שֶׁבְּפִיו, אוֹ כָּל מִידִי:


הכניס ידו לתוך פיו – to take the pit that is in his mouth or everything.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:10:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:10:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:10:4)


**רַבִּי מֵאִיר מְטַמֵּא.** הַדְּבֵלָה. לְפִי שֶׁהַיָּדַיִם מְסֹאָבוֹת טִמְּאוּ אֶת הָרֹק לִהְיוֹת תְּחִלָּה מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא מַשְׁקֶה, וְהָרֹק טִמֵּא אֶת הַדְּבֵלָה, דְּרִאשׁוֹן עוֹשֶׂה שֵׁנִי בְחֻלִּין:


ר' מאיר מטמא – the cake of ground figs. For since his hands are unclean/repulsive, the spittle was defiled to become first [degree of ritual impurity] because it is liquid, and the spittle defiled the cake of ground figs, for something that is first-degree [of ritual impurity] makes something else second in non-holy things.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:10:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:10:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:10:5)


**וְרַבִּי יְהוּדָה מְטַהֵר.** סָבַר כָּל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא יָצָא הָרֹק מִן הַפֶּה לָא חֲשִׁיב מַשְׁקֶה.


ור' יהודה מטהר – he holds that all the while that the spittle did not leave from the mouth, it is not considered liquid.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:10:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:10:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:10:6)


**וְרַבִּי יוֹסֵי מְטַמֵּא.** כְּשֶׁהָפַךְ הַדְּבֵלָה מִצַּד זֶה לְצַד זֶה בְתוֹךְ פִּיו, שֶׁנֶּעֱקָר הָרֹק. וּמְטַהֵר בְּלֹא הָפַךְ, שֶׁכָּל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא נֶעֱקַר לֹא נֶחְשָׁב מַשְׁקֶה. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי:


ור' יוסי מטמא – that he turned over the cake of ground figs from this side to the other side within his mouth, that the spittle was uprooted. And it purifies without turning it over [in his mouth], whenever it is not uprooted, it is not considered liquid. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Yossi.



### Mishnah 11

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:11:1)


**הָאִשָּׁה שֶׁנָּטַף חָלָב מִדַּדֶּיהָ.** וְהִיא טְמֵאָה, וְחָלָב הַנּוֹטֵף מִדַּדֶּיהָ הָוֵי כְּמַשְׁקֶה שֶׁנָּגַע בָּהּ וְנַעֲשָׂה תְחִלָּה:


האשה שנטף חלב מדדיה – and she is [ritually] impure, and the milk that drips from her breasts is like liquid that came in contact with her and became first-degree [of ritual impurity] (See also Tractate Tevul Yom, Chapter 2, Mishnah 1).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:11:2)


**שֶׁהַמַּשְׁקֶה מְטַמֵּא לְרָצוֹן וְשֶׁלֹּא לְרָצוֹן.** וְאַף עַל גַּב דְּחָלָב הַנּוֹטֵף מִדַּדֶּיהָ שֶׁלֹּא לִרְצוֹנָהּ הָיָה, דְּלֹא נִיחָא לָהּ, אֲפִלּוּ הָכִי נִטְמָא הַתַּנּוּר. דִּלְעִנְיַן הֶכְשֵׁר זְרָעִים דַּוְקָא בָעִינַן דְּנִיחָא לֵיהּ, אֲבָל לֹא לְטַמֵּא:


שהמשקה מטמא לרצון ושלא ברצון – but even though that the milk that drips from her breasts it was not by her intent/desire, for it is not satisfactory to her, nevertheless, the oven is defiled. But with regard to the fitness of seats we especially require that is satisfactory to him, but not to defile.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:11:3)


**הָיְתָה גוֹרַפְתּוֹ.** שֶׁהָיְתָה גוֹרֶפֶת הַתַּנּוּר הַטָּמֵא לְהוֹצִיא אֶפְרוֹ:


היתה גורפתו – that she was sweeping the impure oven out to remove its ashes.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:11:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:11:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:11:4)


**וְהִכָּהּ קוֹץ וְיָצָא מִמֶּנָּה דָם.** וְדַם הַמַּכָּה חֲשִׁיב מַשְׁקֶה:


והכה קוץ ויצא ממנה דם – and the blood of the wound is considered liquid.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:11:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:11:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:11:5)


**וְנָתְנָה אֶצְבָּעָהּ לְתוֹךְ פִּיהָ.** כְּדֶרֶךְ הַנִּכְוִים בְּאֶצְבָּעָם שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים אֶצְבָּעָם בְּפִיהֶם:


ונתנה אצבעה תוך פיה – in the manner that those who are burned in their fingers that they place their fingers in their mouths.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 8:11:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:11:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/8:11:6)


**נִטְמָא.** גָּרְסִינַן. כְּלוֹמַר נִטְמָא הַתַּנּוּר מֵחֲמַת הָרֹק וְהַדָּם:


נטמא – we have as a reading. Meaning to say, the oven is defiled on account of the spittle and the blood.



## Chapter 9


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:1)


**מַחַט אוֹ טַבַּעַת.** טָמֵא:


מחט או טבעת – an impure/unclean [needle or ring] (from corpse uncleanness).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:2)


**שֶׁנִּמְצְאוּ בִנְחֻשְׁתּוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר.** בְּרִצְפַּת הַקַּרְקַע שֶׁהַתַּנּוּר מְחֻבָּר בָּהּ:


שנמצאו בנחושתו של תנור (that were found in the copper rim of the oven) – on the floor of the ground that the oven is attached to.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:3)


**נִרְאִין.** בַּתַּנּוּר:


נראין – in the oven.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:4)


**אֲבָל לֹא יוֹצְאִין.** בַּחֲלַל הַתַּנּוּר. כְּגוֹן שֶׁבְּלוּעִים בָּעֳבִי הָרִצְפָּה שֶׁל הַקַּרְקַע וְנִרְאִין בַּאֲוִירוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר אֲבָל אֵין בּוֹלְטִין לְתוֹכוֹ:


אבל לא יוצאין – in the airspace of the oven. As for example, that they are absorbed in the thickness of the floor of the ground and appear in the airspace of the oven but do not project/protrude into it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:5)


**אִם אוֹפֶה הוּא אֶת הַבָּצֵק.** אִם בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁמַּדְבִּיק הַפַּת לְתוֹכוֹ נוֹגֵעַ הַבָּצֵק בַּמַּחַט אוֹ בַטַּבַּעַת, נֶחְשָׁב כַּאֲוִירוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר וְטִמְּאוּהוּ. וְאִם לָאו, טָהוֹר, דְּתוֹכוֹ כָּתַב רַחֲמָנָא, וְהַאי לָאו תּוֹכוֹ הוּא. וּכְגוֹן שֶׁהָיוּ שָׁם בְּלוּעִים בָּרִצְפָּה קֹדֶם שֶׁחִבְּרוּ הַתַּנּוּר שָׁם, דְּאִם הִכְנִיסוּ אוֹתָם דֶּרֶךְ פִּיו שֶׁל תַּנּוּר, מִשֶּׁנִּכְנְסוּ לַאֲוִירוֹ נִטְמָא הַתַּנּוּר:


אם אופה הוא את הבצק – if at the time that he fastens the bread into it, the dough comes in contact with the needle or the ring, it is considered like the airspace of the oven and it defiles it. But if not, it is a pure, for the All-Merciful wrote "תוכו" (Leviticus 11:33 – “And if any of those fall into/תוכו an earthen vessel, everything inside it shall be unclean and – the vessel – itself you shall break), and this is not “inside it”/תוכו. As for example, that they were absorbed there in the floor prior to attaching the oven there, for if they brought them in through the mouth of the oven, when they entered into its airspace, the oven was defiled.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:6)


**בְּבָצֵק הַבֵּינוֹנִי.** לֹא שֶׁבְּלִילָתוֹ רַכָּה, שֶׁיֵּרֵד לְמַטָּה לַסְּדָקִין. וְלֹא שֶׁבְּלִילָתוֹ קָשָׁה, שֶׁאֵינוֹ נִדְבָּק:


בבצק הבינוני – not that its mixture is soft, that it descended below to the cracks. But not that its mixture was hard, that it does not affixed/attached.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:7)


**בִּטְפֵלַת הַתַּנּוּר.** הִיא הַטְּפֵלָה שֶׁל טִיט שֶׁעוֹשִׂים סְבִיב הַתַּנּוּר לְעַבּוֹתוֹ כְּדֵי שֶׁיַּחֲזִיק חֻמּוֹ:


בטפילת התנור (in the plaster of the oven) – it is the plaster of clay/mud that they place around the oven to thicken it so that it can hold/contain its heat.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:8)


**מֻקָּף צָמִיד פָּתִיל.** וּמֻנָּח בְּאֹהֶל הַמֵּת:


מוקף צמיד פתיל – and it is placed in the tent of the corpse.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:9)


**בְּטָמֵא.** אִם הַתַּנּוּר טָמֵא:


בטמא – if the oven is unclean/impure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:10)


**טְמֵאִים.** הַמַּחַט וְהַטַּבַּעַת הַנִּמְצָאִים בַּטְּפֵלָה שֶׁל תַּנּוּר:


טמאים – the needle and the ring that are found in the plaster of the oven.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:11)


**וּבְטָהוֹר טְהוֹרִים.** דְּכֵיוָן שֶׁהַתַּנּוּר מֻקָּף צָמִיד פָּתִיל וְנִצּוֹל, גַּם הֵם נִצּוֹלִים עִמּוֹ, דִּבְטִילֵי לְגַבֵּי טְפֵלָה:


ובטהור טהורים – for since the oven is surrounded by an airtight lid and is saved/protected, these also are protected with it, for in regard to the plaster, they are neutralized.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:12)


**נִמְצְאוּ בִמְגוּפַת הֶחָבִית.** בַּטִּיט שֶׁרְגִילִין לַעֲשׂוֹת בּוֹ כִסּוּי עַל פִּי הֶחָבִית:


נמצאו במגופת החבית (if they are found in the bung/stopper of the jar) – in the plaster that they regularly make for it as a cover over the mouth of the jar.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:13)


**מִצִּדֶּיהָ.** שֶׁל חָבִית:


מצדיה – of the jar.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:14)


**טְמֵאִים.** שֶׁאֵין צִדֵּי הֶחָבִית צְרִיכִים לַטִּיט:


טמאים – for the sides of the jar do not need the plaster.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:15)


**מִכְּנֶגֶד פִּיהָ.** אִם הַמַּחַט וְהַטַּבַּעַת נִמְשָׁכִים כְּנֶגֶד פִּי הֶחָבִית:


מכנגד פיה – if the needle and the ring are drawn opposite its mouth.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:16)


**טְהוֹרִין.** וּבִלְבַד שֶׁיִּהְיוּ בְתוֹךְ הַטִּיט שֶׁל מְגוּפָה וְלֹא יַכְנִיסֵהוּ לַאֲוִיר הֶחָבִית. וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהֵם נִרְאִים מִתּוֹכָהּ, הוֹאִיל וְאֵין נִכְנָסִין לַאֲוִירָהּ, טְהוֹרִין:


טהורין – provided/as long as that they will be within the plaster of the bung/stopper and not be brought into the airspace of the jar. But even though they appear from its inside, since they don’t enter into its airspace, they are clean/pure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:1:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:1:17)


**שׁוֹקְעִים בְּתוֹכָהּ וְתַחְתֵּיהֶן כִּקְלִפַּת הַשּׁוּם.** אִם הָיָה בֵין הַמַּחַט וְהַטַּבַּעַת וּבֵין אֲוִיר הֶחָבִית מְחִצָּה דַקָּה כִקְלִפַּת הַשּׁוּם שֶׁנִּמְצָא שֶׁהֵן בְּלוּעִים לְתוֹךְ הַמְּגוּפָה וְאֵין נִכְנָס לַאֲוִיר הֶחָבִית כְּלָל, טְהוֹרִים, דִּבְטִילֵי לְגַבֵּי הַמְּגוּפָה. אֲבָל אִם נִכְנָסִים לְתוֹךְ הֶחָבִית, טְמֵאִים, שֶׁאֵין צָמִיד פָּתִיל מַצִּיל בְּאֹהֶל הַמֵּת אֶלָּא עַל כְּלֵי חֶרֶס וָאֳכָלִים וּמַשְׁקִים, דְּבָרִים שֶׁאֵין לָהֶם טָהֳרָה בַמִּקְוֶה, אֲבָל עַל כְּלֵי מַתָּכוֹת כְּגוֹן מַחַט וְטַבַּעַת שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶן טָהֳרָה בַמִּקְוֶה, אֵין צָמִיד פָּתִיל מַצִּיל בָּהֶן, הִלְכָּךְ אִם נִכְנָסִים בְּתוֹךְ אֲוִיר הֶחָבִית, שֶׁאֵין בְּטֵלִים לְגַבֵּי מְגוּפָה, אֵין נִצּוֹלִים בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל. כָּךְ נִרְאֵית בְּעֵינַי פֵּרוּשׁ מִשְׁנָה זוֹ. וְרַבּוֹתַי לֹא פֵרְשׁוּהָ כָּךְ. וּפֵרוּשָׁם לֹא יָדַעְתִּי לְהַעֲמִידוֹ מְכֻוָּן וּלְכָךְ לֹא כְתַבְתִּיו:


שוקעים בתוכה ותחתיהן כקליפת השום (if they sink into it and under them is [plaster] about as much as a garlic peel) – if there was between the needle and/or the ring and between the airspace of the jar a thin divider like the garlic peel, that it is found that they protrude into the bung/stopper, but it does not enter into the airspace of the jar at all, the are pure, for they are nullified concerning the bung/stopper. But if they enter within the jar, they are impure/unclean, for the airtight lid does not save/protect in the tent of a corpse other than in an earthenware vessel for food and liquids, things that have no purification in a Mikveh/ritual bath. But on metal vessels, such as a needle and/or a ring, they have purification in a Mikveh, the airtight lid does not protect them, therefore if they enter into the airspace of the jar, the are not nullified regarding the bung/stopper and are not protected/saved by the airtight lid. Such appears in my eyes the explanation of this Mishnah. But my Teachers/Rabbis did not explain it thusly. But their explanation I did not know how to justify/maintain it and therefore I did not write it.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:2:1)


**וּמְנִיקָת בְּתוֹכָהּ.** כְּמִין קָנֶה חָלוּל עָשׂוּי מִמַּתֶּכֶת, שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים רֹאשׁוֹ אֶחָד בְּנֶקֶב הֶחָבִית וּמוֹצֵץ בְּפִיו מֵרֹאשׁוֹ הַשֵּׁנִי וְיוֹצְאִין כָּל הַמַּשְׁקִין שֶׁבֶּחָבִית דֶּרֶךְ אוֹתָהּ מְנִיקָת:


ומניקת בתוכה (and a syphon/tube is in it) – like a kind of hollow reed made from metal, that they place one head in the perforation of the jar and he sucks/drains with his mouth from the other head, and all of the liquids that are in the jar go out through this syphon/tube.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:2:2)


**הֶחָבִית וְהַמַּשְׁקִין טְהוֹרִים וּמְנִיקָת טְמֵאָה.** הֶחָבִית שֶׁל חֶרֶס, וּמְנִיקָת שֶׁבְּתוֹכָהּ שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת. הִלְכָּךְ הֶחָבִית וְהַמַּשְׁקִין שֶׁאֵין לָהֶם טָהֳרָה בַמִּקְוֶה, וְאִי מְטַהֲרַת לְהוּ וְהֵם שֶׁל עַם הָאָרֶץ לֹא אָתֵי חָבֵר לְאִשְׁתַּמּוֹשֵׁי בְהוּ, שֶׁהֲרֵי הֵם בְּדֵלִים מִמַּגָּעָם וּבְלָאו הָכִי נַמִּי כָל מַאֲכָלָם טָמֵא, לֹא גָזְרוּ בְהוּ רַבָּנָן, וְנִצּוֹלִים בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל, אֲבָל מְנִיקָת שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהּ טָהֳרָה בַמִּקְוֶה, אִם תְּטַהֲרֶנָּה אָתֵי חָבֵר לְאִשְׁתַּמּוֹשֵׁי בָהּ, שֶׁיִּשְׁאָלֶנָּה מֵעַם הָאָרֶץ וְיַטְבִּילֶנָּה וְיַעֲרִיב שִׁמְשָׁהּ וְיִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בָּהּ, כְּסָבוּר אֵין בָּהּ אֶלָּא מִשּׁוּם מַגַּע טָמֵא, וְהוּא לֹא יָדַע שֶׁהָיְתָה בְאֹהֶל הַמֵּת וּצְרִיכָה הַזָּאָה שְׁלִישִׁי וּשְׁבִיעִי, וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהָיְתָה בִכְלִי חֶרֶס הַמֻּקָּף צָמִיד פָּתִיל, אֵין צָמִיד פָּתִיל שֶׁל כְּלִי שֶׁל עַם הָאָרֶץ מַצִּילִין מִן הַטֻּמְאָה אֵצֶל חָבֵר, שֶׁכָּל כֵּלָיו שֶׁל עַם הָאָרֶץ הֵם בְּחֶזְקַת טֻמְאָה אֵצֶל חָבֵר, וּכְלִי טָמֵא אֵינוֹ מַצִּיל בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל, שֶׁאֵין מַצִּיל בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל אֶלָּא כְלִי חֶרֶס הַטָּהוֹר בִּלְבַד. וְאִלּוּ בָאוּ חֲכָמִים לִגְזֹר שֶׁלֹּא יַצִּיל שׁוּם כְּלִי חֶרֶס שֶׁל עַם הָאָרֶץ בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל, לֹא הָיוּ עַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת מְקַבְּלִין מֵהֶן, לְפִי שֶׁהֵן סְבוּרִין שֶׁהֵן בְּקִיאִין וְשׁוֹמְרִין כְּלֵיהֶן בְּטָהֳרָה. הִלְכָּךְ בִּכְלֵי חֶרֶס וָאֳכָלִים וּמַשְׁקִין שֶׁאֵין לָהֶן טָהֳרָה בַמִּקְוֶה, כְּשֶׁהָיוּ בְּתוֹךְ צָמִיד פָּתִיל שֶׁל כְּלֵי עַם הָאָרֶץ אוֹמְרִים לָהֶן טְהוֹרִים הֵן וְיִשְׁתַּמְּשׁוּ בָהֶן הֵן שֶׁמַּחֲזִיקִין כְּלֵיהֶן בְּחֶזְקַת טְהוֹרִים, וְאֵין לָחוּשׁ שֶׁמָּא יִשְׁאַל הֶחָבֵר מֵהֶן, שֶׁהֲרֵי הֵן אֶצְלוֹ בְחֶזְקַת טְמֵאִין וְאֵין לָהֶן טָהֳרָה עוֹלָמִית, אֲבָל בִּכְלֵי שֶׁטֶף דְּאִיכָּא לְמֵיחַשׁ שֶׁמָּא יִשְׁאַל הֶחָבֵר מֵהֶם וְיַטְבִּילֵם וְיִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בָּהֶם בְּלֹא הַזָּאָה שְׁלִישִׁי וּשְׁבִיעִי, עָשׂוּ דִין שָׁוֶה לַכֹּל וְאָמְרוּ דְאֵין כְּלִי שֶׁטֶף נִצּוֹל בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל:


החבית והמשקין טהורים והמניקת טמאה – the earthenware jar, but the syphon/tube that is within it is of metal. Therefore, the jar and the liquids that have no purification if the Mikveh, but if it purifies them and they belong to a commoner/uneducated person [who is not careful in the observance of laws of ritual purity], a Haver/member of a group dedicated to the punctilious observance of the commandments should not come to use them, for they are separated from their contact and if it is not, it would be so that all of its food is impure, the Rabbis did not make a decree concerning this, and they are protected/saved by an airtight lid, but a metal syphon/tube that has purification in a Mikveh/ritual bath, if one would purify it, a Haver/member of a group dedicated to the punctilious observance of the commandments would come to use it and he would borrow it from a common/uneducated person [who is not careful in the observance of the laws of ritual purity and immerse it [in a Mikveh] and when its sun had set (i.e., a sunset had passed for this object), he would use it, thinking that there is nothing in it other than because of contact with something impure, but he did not know that it had been in the tent of a corpse and it requires sprinkling [of a mixture of the ashes of the red heifer with waters of purification on the third and seventh days to purify it from the impurity imparted by a corpse, but even though it was in an earthenware vessel that is covered with an airtight lid, the airtight lid of vessels of a commoner/uneducated person [who is not careful in the observance of the laws of ritual purity] save/protect it from the defilement with a Haver, for all of the vessels of a commoner/uneducated person are under the presumption of defilement concerning a Haver, and an impure vessel does not protect/save with an airtight lid, for an airtight lid only protects/saves for a pure earthenware vessel alone. But whereas the Sages came to make a decree that the no earthenware vessel belonging to a common/uneducated person [who is not careful in the observance of the laws of ritual purity] does not protect [even] with an airtight lid, the people of the lands would not accept it from them. Because they would hold that they are expert and preserve their vessels/utensils in purity. Therefore regarding earthenware vessels and food and liquids which do not attain purity in a ritual bath/Mikveh, when they were within an airtight lid of a utensil belonging to a common/uneducated person, they say to them that they are pure and they would use them for they hold their vessels/utensils to be under the presumption of ritual purity, they should not be concerned lest the Haver should borrow from them, for they are, concerning him, in the presumption of being ritually impure and they don’t have purity ever, but a vessel that requires only rinsing in order to be restored to Levitical cleanness where there is a concern that perhaps the Haver will borrow it from them and he will immerse them [in a ritual bath] and use them without sprinkling [of a mixture of the ashes of the red heifer with waters of purification] on the third and seventh days [to purify it from the impurity imparted by a corpse], they made the law equivalent for all and stated that a vessel requiring only rinsing in order to be restored to Levitical cleanness is protected/saved by an airtight lid.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:2:3)


**וּבֵית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים אַף מְנִיקָת טְהוֹרָה.** קֹדֶם שֶׁשָּׁמְעוּ טַעֲמָן שֶׁל בֵּית שַׁמַּאי לֹא הָיוּ יוֹדְעִים מִפְּנֵי מָה אֳכָלִים וּמַשְׁקִין שֶׁבְּתוֹךְ צָמִיד פָּתִיל טְהוֹרִין וּכְלֵי מַתֶּכֶת טְמֵאִים וּלְאַחַר שֶׁשָּׁמְעוּ טַעֲמָן כִּדְפָרְשִׁינַן חָזְרוּ לְהוֹרוֹת כְּדִבְרֵי בֵית שַׁמַּאי:


ובית הלל אומרים אף מניקת טהורה – prior to their having heard the reasoning of the School of Shammai they did not know for what reason foods and liquids that are within an airtight lid are pure and metal vessels are impure, but after they heard their reasoning as we have explained, they (i.e., the School of Hillel) retracted to teach according to the words of the School of Shammai.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:3:1
