[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:3:1)


**לְמַטָּה מִנְּחֻשְׁתּוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר.** רִצְפָּה שֶׁמּוֹשִׁיבִין שָׁם הַתַּנּוּר. שֶׁהַתַּנּוּר עָשׂוּי כְּמִין קְדֵרָה גְּדוֹלָה שֶׁאֵין לָהּ שׁוּלַיִם, וּמְתַקְּנִים לוֹ רִצְפָּה בַקַּרְקַע וּמוֹשִׁיבִין אוֹתוֹ שָׁם, וְאוֹתָהּ רִצְפָּה הִיא נְחֻשְׁתּוֹ שֶׁל תַּנּוּר:


למטה מנחושתו של תנור – the block pavement that they place the oven on, for the oven is made like a kind of large pot that lacks rims, and they prepare for it a block pavement on the ground and place it there, and that block pavement is the ground of the oven.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:3:2)


**חַי נָפַל.** וְלֹא נִטְמָא הַתַּנּוּר. דְּאִי מֵת נָפַל, הָיָה הַתַּנּוּר מִטַּמֵּא בָּאֲוִיר כְּשֶׁנָּפַל דֶּרֶךְ פִּיו שֶׁל תַּנּוּר. וְהָא דְלָא תָלִינַן שֶׁמָּא שָׁם הָיָה קֹדֶם שֶׁהוֹשִׁיבוּ שָׁם הַתַּנּוּר, לְפִי שֶׁלִּפְעָמִים נִמְצָא הַשֶּׁרֶץ לַח וְנִכָּר שֶׁמֵּחָדָשׁ מֵת וְהַתַּנּוּר יֵשׁ יָמִים מְרֻבִּים שֶׁהוֹשִׁיבוּהוּ שָׁם, וְהַשְׁתָּא אִי אֶפְשָׁר לוֹמַר שֶׁהַשֶּׁרֶץ קָדַם שָׁם לַתַּנּוּר, דְּאִם כֵּן מֵחֹם הָאֵשׁ הָיָה נִשְׂרָף וְנַעֲשָׂה אֵפֶר, אֶלָּא תָלִינַן שֶׁמָּא חַי נָפַל, וְדֶרֶךְ שְׁרָצִים לַעֲשׂוֹת חֲפִירוֹת בַּקַּרְקַע לְהִטָּמֵן שָׁם, לְפִיכָךְ נִמְצָא לְמַטָּה מִנְּחֻשְׁתּוֹ:


חי נפל – [it fell while alive] but the oven was not defiled, for if it had fallen when dead, the oven would have been defiled in its airspace when it fell through the mouth of the oven. For this we don’t leave in doubt lest it was there prior that they placed the oven there, because sometimes, the unclean reptile is found moist and it is recognized that it just died and the oven has many days that they placed it there, but now it is impossible to say that the unclean reptile preceded the oven there, for if so, from the heat of the fire, it (i.e., the unclean reptile) would have been burned up and would have come ashes, but we leave in doubt that perhaps it fell while living, for it is the manner of unclean reptiles to make pits in the ground to be hidden/preserved there therefore it is found below the copper bottom or rim of the stove.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:3:3)


**שָׁם הָיוּ עַד שֶׁלֹּא בָא הַתַּנּוּר.** קֹדֶם שֶׁהוֹשִׁיבוּהוּ שָׁם וְלֹא רָאָה אֲוִיר הַתַּנּוּר:


שם היו עד שלא בא התנור – prior to their placing it (i.e., the oven) there and it did not see the airspace of the oven.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:3:4)


**בְּאֵפֶר מִקְלֶה.** שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה מֵחֲמַת שְׂרֵפַת הָאֵשׁ. וְהַיְנוּ לְמַעְלָה בַּחֲלַל הַתַּנּוּר. וּמִשּׁוּם דְּאַשְׁכְּחַן עָפָר דְּאִקְּרֵי אֵפֶר וְהָכָא בְאֵפֶר שֶׁל שְׂרֵפָה מִשְׁתַּעֵי, מִשּׁוּם הָכִי תָנָא אֵפֶר מִקְלֶה, לְשׁוֹן קָלוּי בָּאֵשׁ:


באפר מקלה (calcined ashes/wood ashes) – in the ashes that are made on account of the burning of the fire. But this is above in the cavity of the oven. For because we find dust that we call ashes, and here it is the ashes of burning that is referred to, because of this, it (i.e., the Mishnah) teaches the wood ashes/calcined ashes which is the language of קלוי באש/roasted in fire (see Leviticus 2:14: “[If you bring a grain offering of first fruits to the LORD, you shall bring new ears] parched with fire, [grits of the fresh grain, as your grain offering of first fruits].”



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:4:1)


**וְנָפַל לַאֲוִיר הַתַּנּוּר טָמֵא.** דְּמַשְׁקִין טְמֵאִין מְטַמְּאִין כְּלִי. וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהַמַּשְׁקִין בְּלוּעִין לְתוֹךְ הַסְּפוֹג, כִּפְלוּטִים דָּמוּ, לְפִי שֶׁסְּפוֹג עָשׂוּי לְהַכְנִיס וּלְהוֹצִיא בּוֹ:


ונפל לאויר התנור טמא – for impure liquids defile a vessel. But even though the liquids are absorbed within the sponge, they are like they are discharged/escaped, because the sponge is made to bring in and to release/expunge [the water] through it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:4:2)


**וְכֵן חֲתִיכָה שֶׁל לֶפֶת וְשֶׁל גֶּמִי.** הָווּ כִסְפוֹג. לְפִי שֶׁבְּגֶמִי בוֹדְקִין בּוֹ אֶת הַיַּיִן וְהָוֵי גַם הוּא עָשׂוּי לְהַכְנִיס וּלְהוֹצִיא כִסְפוֹג. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן:


וכן חתיכה של לפת ושל גמי – they are like a sponge. Because through the reed grass we examine through it the wine and it too is made to bring in and to release/expunge like a sponge. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Shimon [who permits the turnip and the reed grass].



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:5:1)


**חֲרָסִים שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בָּהֶן מַשְׁקִין טְמֵאִים.** כְּגוֹן עָבִיט שֶׁל מֵימֵי רַגְלַיִם שֶׁל זָב וְשֶׁל זָבָה שֶׁנִּשְׁבַּר וַחֲרָסָיו בָּלְעוּ מֵימֵי רַגְלֵיהֶם. וּמַיְרֵי כְגוֹן שֶׁהֱדִיחוּם בְּמַיִם שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים, שֶׁלֹּא נִשְׁאַר בָּהֶן מַשְׁקֶה טָמֵא. דְּאִי לֹא הֱדִיחוּם, נִטְמָא הַתַּנּוּר מֵחֲמַת הַמַּשְׁקִים הַדְּבוּקִין בְּדָפְנוֹתָיו כְּאִלּוּ הֵן בְּעֵין:


חרסים שנשתמש בהן משקין טמאים (potsherds that had been used with unclean liquids) – as for example, a large vessel for the collection of urine (for manufacturing purposes) of a man who has gonorrhea or a woman with a flux that was broken and its potsherds absorbed their urine. But we are speaking about, for example that they rinsed them in water three times in order that there should not remain in them unclean liquid. For if he did not rinse them, the oven is defiled on account of the liquids that are attached to their walls as if they are visible to the eye.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:5:2)


**שֶׁסּוֹף מַשְׁקֶה לָצֵאת.** כְּלוֹמַר, דֶּרֶךְ מַשְׁקֶה לָצֵאת עַל יְדֵי לִבּוּן הַחֲרָסִים, וְכֵיוָן שֶׁהָיוּ אֵלּוּ הַחֲרָסִים בַּתַּנּוּר בִּשְׁעַת הֶסֵּקוֹ יָצְאוּ הַמַּשְׁקִין מֵהֶן וְטִמְּאוּ הַתַּנּוּר מֵאֲוִירוֹ:


שסוף משקה לצאת – that is to say, it is the manner of liquid to exit through heating of the potsherds, and since that these potsherds were in the oven at the time of heating, the liquids left them and defiled the oven from its airspace.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:5:3)


**גֶּפֶת.** פְּסֹלֶת שֶׁל זֵיתִים לְאַחַר שֶׁהוֹצִיאוּ שַׁמְנָן:


גפת – the refuse of olives (i.e., peat) after they removed their oils.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:5:4)


**חֲדָשָׁה.** תּוֹךְ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ:


חדשה – within twelve months.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:5:5)


**יְשָׁנָה.** לְאַחַר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ, דְּבִסְתָמָא יָצָא כָל הַמַּשְׁקֶה שֶׁבָּהֶן:


ישנה – after twelve months, that all of the liquid that was in them left on their own.



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:1)


**וְהָלְכוּ עֲלֵיהֶן טְמֵאִים.** בְּנֵי אָדָם טְמֵאִים:


והלכו עליהם טמאים – ritually impure people [walked on them].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:2)


**טְהוֹרִים.** שֶׁלֹּא נִטְמְאוּ בִדְרִיסָתָן, כֵּיוָן שֶׁלֹּא נִקְרָא עֲלֵיהֶם שֵׁם טֻמְאָה בָעוֹלָם:


טהורים – they were not defiled through their treading/walking [on them], since they were not ever called/referred to as defiled.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:3)


**כּוּשׁ.** פֶּלֶךְ שֶׁהָאִשָּׁה טוֹוָה בוֹ וְיֵשׁ בַּרְזֶל עָקֹם בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וּשְׁמוֹ צִנּוֹרָא, וּפְעָמִים נִשְׁקַע הַבַּרְזֶל בְּתוֹךְ הָעֵץ וְכֻלּוֹ מְכֻסֶּה בָעֵץ:


כוש (reed used as a spindle) – a spindle that a woman spins on it and there is a curved/winding iron tool at its head and its name is צנורא /hook and sometimes the iron tool is sunk within the wood and all it is covered by the wood.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:4)


**מַלְמָד.** מַקֵּל אָרֹךְ וּבְרֹאשׁוֹ כְּעֵין מַסְמֵר דַּק, וּמַדְרִיכִים בּוֹ הַפָּרָה לִתְלָמֶיהָ, לְכָךְ הוּא קָרוּי מַלְמַד הַבָּקָר. וְהַמַּסְמֵר שֶׁבְּרֹאשׁוֹ קָרוּי דָּרְבָּן, כְּמוֹ דִּבְרֵי חֲכָמִים כַּדָּרְבֹנוֹת (קהלת יב):


מלמד (ox-goad/handle – in which the iron point was driven in so that nothing could be seen of it) – a long staff and at its head is something similar to a thin nail/pin, and they direct with it the cow to its furrow/ridge, therefore, it is called מלמד בקר/it trains the cattle. But the nail/pin that is at its head is called a goad/the iron point on the staff, like (Ecclesiastes 12:11): “The sayings of the wise are like goads.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:6:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:5)


**וּלְבֵנָה שֶׁבָּלְעָה אֶת הַטַּבַּעַת.** שֶׁגִּבֵּל הַטַּבַּעַת בְּטִיט הַלְּבֵנָה וְנִצְרְפָה עִמָּהּ בַכִּבְשָׁן:


ולבנה שבלעה את הטבעת (the clay brick which swallowed up the ring) – that the ring was kneaded in the plaster of the brick and smelted with it in the furnace/kiln.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:6:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:6)


**נִכְנְסוּ לְאֹהֶל הַמֵּת.** כְּשֶׁהֵן בְּלוּעִים וּטְמוּנִים בְּתוֹךְ הַכּוּשׁ אוֹ בְתוֹךְ הַמַּלְמָד אוֹ בְתוֹךְ הַלְּבֵנָה:


נכנסו לאוהל המת – when they are absorbed and hidden within the reed or within the ox-goad or within the brick.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:6:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:7)


**נִטְמָאוּ.** שֶׁאֵין מַצִּיל בְּאֹהֶל הַמֵּת וְכֵן מִיַּד כְּלֵי חֶרֶס אֶלָּא כְלִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ תּוֹךְ, וְהַאי לֹא דָמֵי אֶלָּא לְעֶצֶם כַּשְּׂעֹרָה הַכָּרוּךְ בְּסִיב:


נטמאו – for the tent of a corpse does not protect/save them and similarly from the hand of an earthenware vessel but rather a vessel that has an inside. But this is not similar other than a bone like the size of a barley corn that is wrapped in fibrous substance (i.e., bast of a palm tree).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:6:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:8)


**הֱסִיטָן הַזָּב.** אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁלֹּא נָגַע בָּהֶן אֶלָּא שֶׁהִכְרִיעָן:


הסיטן הזב (if the man with gonorrhea shook/shifted – to move it from its place) – even though he did not come in contact with them but that he overbalanced/outweighed them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:6:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:9)


**נִטְמָאוּ.** שֶׁהַזָּב מְטַמֵּא בְהֶסֵּט. אֲפִלּוּ הַמֻּקָּף צָמִיד פָּתִיל מִטַּמֵּא בְהֶסֵּט, כָּל שֶׁכֵּן הַאי:


נטמאו – for the person with gonorrhea defiles through shaking an object so as to move it from place to place. Even that which is surrounded by an airtight lid defiles through shaking, all the more so this.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:6:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:10)


**נָגַע בָּהֶן כִּכָּר שֶׁל תְּרוּמָה.** כְּשֶׁהֵן בְּלוּעִין:


נגע בהן ככר של תרומה – when they are absorbed.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:6:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:6:11)


**טָהוֹר.** הַכִּכָּר. וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהוּא שֶׁל תְּרוּמָה וְשֵׁנִי פוֹסֵל בּוֹ. וַאֲפִלּוּ הַבַּרְזֶל הַבָּלוּעַ הוּא אַב הַטֻּמְאָה לֹא אָמְרִינַן נַעֲשָׂה הָעֵץ הַמְכַסֶּה אוֹתוֹ רִאשׁוֹן אוֹ שֵׁנִי וְיִהְיֶה הַכִּכָּר שְׁלִישִׁי וְנִפְסָל, אֲבָל מְטַמְּאִים אֶת הַתַּנּוּר וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהֵן בְּלוּעִין, לְפִי שֶׁהַתַּנּוּר מִטַּמֵּא מֵאֲוִירוֹ וַאֲפִלּוּ לֹא נָגְעָה הַטֻּמְאָה בוֹ, וְטֻמְאָה בְלוּעָה מְטַמְּאָתוֹ כִּדְפָרֵישְׁנָא בְּפִרְקִין דִּלְעֵיל:


טהור – the loaf [is pure]. But even though it is of heave-offering and something of second-degree [of ritual uncleanness] defiles it, and even the iron that is absorbed/swallowed which is the primary source of ritual impurity we don’t say that we make the wood that covers it first [degree of ritual uncleanness] or second [degree of ritual uncleanness] and the loaf will be third [degree of ritual uncleanness] and be defiled, but it defiles the oven, and even though they are absorbed/swallowed, because the oven is defiled through its airspace and even if the defiling object did not come in contact with it, and the defilement that is absorbed from its defilement is as we explained in our chapter above (see Tractate Kelim, Chapter 8, Mishnah 5).



### Mishnah 7

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:7:1)


**סְרֵידָה.** כְּמִין עֲרֵבָה קְטַנָּה שֶׁהַנַּחְתּוֹם מִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בָּהּ, וְהִיא פְשׁוּטָה וְאֵינָהּ מְקַבֶּלֶת טֻמְאָה:


סרידה (stuffed matting/ slightly hollow perforated tile used for stoppers of stoves, bags/colander) – like a kind of small kneading trough that the baker uses, and it is stretched and is not susceptible to receive defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:7:2)


**שֶׁהִיא נְתוּנָה עַל פִּי הַתַּנּוּר.** וּמְמֻרַחַת בְּטִיט כְּדֵי לְהַקִּיף בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל וְלֹא יִטַּמָּא הַתַּנּוּר בְּאֹהֶל הַמֵּת:


שהיא נתונה על פי התנור – and it is crushed in plaster in order to surround it with an airtight lid and the oven will not become defiled in the tent of a corpse.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:7:3)


**נִסְדַּק מִן הַתַּנּוּר לַסְּרֵידָה.** הַיְנוּ שֶׁנִּסְדַּק הַמֵּרוּחַ:


נסדק מן תנור לסרידה (was cracked from the oven to the colander) – that is, the shaping was cracked.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:7:4)


**מְלֹא פִי מַרְדֵּעַ שֶׁלֹּא נִכְנָס.** הַמַּרְדֵּעַ הוּא מַלְמַד הַבָּקָר, וְיֵשׁ בְּהֶקֵּפוֹ טֶפַח וְעָבְיוֹ שְׁלִישׁ טֶפַח, שֶׁכָּל שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּעָבְיוֹ טֶפַח יֵשׁ בְּהֶקֵּפוֹ שְׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים. וְשִׁעוּר הַסֶּדֶק כְּשֶׁנִּסְדַּק הַמֵּרוּחַ, לְרַבָּנָן מְלֹא פִי הַמַּרְדֵּעַ בְּשָׁוֶה, וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵין הַנֶּקֶב גָּדוֹל שֶׁיִּכָּנֵס פִּי מַרְדֵּעַ בִּמְלֹאוֹ, הוֹאִיל וְשָׁוֶה הַסֶּדֶק מְלֹא פִי הַמַּרְדֵּעַ אֵין כָּאן צָמִיד פָּתִיל, וּלְרַבִּי יְהוּדָה לְעוֹלָם הָוֵי צָמִיד פָּתִיל עַד שֶׁיִּהְיֶה הַסֶּדֶק גָּדוֹל שֶׁיִּכָּנֵס בּוֹ פִי הַמַּרְדֵּעַ:


מלוא פי מרדע שלא נכנס (its measure is the tip of an ox-goad that cannot enter) – the ox-goad is that trains the cattle, and there is in its circumference a handbreadth, and its thickness is three handbreadths, for all that is of one-handbreadth in its thickness, there is in its circumference three handbreadths, and the measure of the crack when the smearing is cracked, according to the Rabbis, its measure is the tip of an ox-goad is equivalent, and even though the incision is not large when the tip of an ox enters, for since the crack is equivalent to the tip of an ox-goad, there isn’t here an airtight lid, but according to Rabbi Yehuda, there always is an airtight lid until the crack will be large enough that the tip of an ox-goad can enter.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:7:5)


**נִסְדְּקָה סְרֵידָה.** עַצְמָה, לְרַבָּנָן קִיל מִכְּשֶׁנִּסְדַּק הַמֵּרוּחַ וּלְרַבִּי יְהוּדָה קִיל כְּשֶׁנִּסְדַּק הַמֵּרוּחַ מִכְּשֶׁנִּסְדְּקָה סְרֵידָה עַצְמָהּ. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


נסדקה סרידה עצמה – according to the Rabbis, an enclosure/compartment once the pile of plaster is cracked , but according to Rabbi Yehuda, an enclosure/compartment that when the pile of plaster is cracked, from when the small kneading trough is itself cracked. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehuda.



### Mishnah 8

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:1)


**שֶׁנִּקַּב מֵעֵינוֹ.** עַיִן שֶׁל תַּנּוּר, הוּא הַנֶּקֶב שֶׁעוֹשִׂים בּוֹ כְדֵי שֶׁיֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ הֶעָשָׁן. וּמֵרְחוּ עֵינוֹ בְטִיט וּסְתָמוּהוּ וְנִקַּב אַחַר כָּךְ בִּמְקוֹם הַמֵּרוּחַ:


שנקב מעינו – the eye of the oven, this is the perforation/incision that one makes in it in order that the smoke can go out, and they seal the eye with plaster and close it up and make a perforation afterwards in the place of the plastering.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:2)


**נִכְנָס וְיוֹצֵא דּוֹלֵק.** שֶׁהַנֶּקֶב רָחָב וְהַכּוּשׁ נִכְנָס וְיוֹצֵא בְּרֶוַח:


נכנס ויוצא דולק – that the perforation is wide and the spindle staff enters and goes out in a wide space.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:3)


**נִקַּב מִצִּדּוֹ.** שֶׁל עַיִן:


ניקב מצדו – of the wood.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:4)


**וְכֵן הָיָה אוֹמֵר בִּמְגוּפַת הֶחָבִית.** וְכֵן הָיָה רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר בְּכָל הָנֵי, דְּדִינָם מִן הָאֶמְצַע נִכְנָס וּמִן הַצַּד אֵינוֹ נִכְנָס. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן:


וכן היה אומר במגופת החבית – and so would Rabbi Shimon say with all of these, that their law is that from the middle one enters, but from the side one does not enter. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Shimon.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:5)


**מְלֹא מִיצָה שְׁנִיָּה שֶׁל שִׁיפוֹן.** מְלֹא קֶשֶׁר שֵׁנִי שֶׁל קָנֶה שֶׁל שִׁיפוֹן, שֶׁהַשֵּׁנִי דַק מִן הָרִאשׁוֹן וְעָבֶה יוֹתֵר מִן הַשְּׁלִישִׁי, שֶׁהַקָּנֶה עָב מִלְּמַטָּה וּמִתְדַּקְדֵּק וְעוֹלֶה. שִׁיפוֹן, ויינ"א בְּלַעַ"ז:


מלא מיצה שניה של שיפון (is the thickness of the second joint of a stem of oats) – this thickness of the second knot of the reed of oats, that the second is thinner than the first but more thick than the third, that the reed is thick from the bottom and becomes thinner as one ascends. שיפון is VIINEH in the foreign tongue.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:8:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:6)


**לִשְׁאָר מַשְׁקִין.** כְּגוֹן שֶׁמֶן דְּבַשׁ וְחָלָב:


לשאר משקין – as for example, oil, honey and milk.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:8:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:7)


**אֲפִלּוּ כָל שֶׁהֵן טְמֵאִים.** אֲפִלּוּ נִקַּב כָּל שֶׁהֵן אֵין מַצִּילִין בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל וּטְמֵאִים:


אפילו כל שהן טמאים – even the slightest perforation does not protect with an airtight lid and they are defiled.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:8:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:8)


**שֶׁלֹּא נַעֲשׂוּ בִידֵי אָדָם.** שֶׁלֹּא נִקְּבוּ בְמִתְכַּוֵּן אֶלָּא מֵאֲלֵיהֶן:


שלא נעשו בידי אדם – that they were not perforated with intention, but that it happened on its own.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:8:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:9)


**נִקְּבוּ, הֶעָשׂוּי לָאֳכָלִים שִׁעוּרָן בְּזֵיתִים.** הַשְׁתָּא מַיְרֵי בְּשֶׁנִּפְחַת הַכְּלִי עַצְמוֹ וְנִקַּב. וְכָל הָנָךְ שִׁעוּרִים דִּלְעֵיל כְּשֶׁנִּפְחֲתָה סְתִימָה שֶׁבְּפִתְחוֹ:


ניקבו העשוי לאוכלים שיעורו בזיתים – now we are speaking of when the utensil itself was hollowed out/broken through and perforated. And all of these measurements that are above is when the closure/cover was hollowed out in its opening.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:8:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:10)


**שִׁעוּרָן בְּזֵיתִים.** אִם נִפְחַת בְּמוֹצִיא זַיִת בָּעֵי מֵרוּחַ, וּבְפָחוֹת מִכָּאן לֹא בָעֵי מֵרוּחַ. וּבַגְּמָרָא בְמַסֶּכֶת שַׁבָּת [דַּף צו] מוֹכִיחַ דִּכְלִי גָּדוֹל שֶׁנִּקַּב בְּמוֹצִיא רִמּוֹן, וּכְלִי קָטָן שֶׁנִּפְחַת בְּרֻבּוֹ, אֵין מֵרוּחַ וּסְתִימָה מוֹעִילִין בּוֹ, וְשׁוּב אֵינוֹ מַצִּיל בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל כֵּיוָן דְּבָטַל מִתּוֹרַת כְּלִי. וְאִם מֵרְחוֹ, נַעֲשֶׂה כָאֳכָלִים שֶׁגִּבְּלָן בְּטִיט, שֶׁאֵין הַטִּיט מַצִּילָן:


שיעורן בזיתים – if it was hollowed out when they remove the olive, it requires plastering/leveling, but less than this, it does not require plastering. And in the Gemara in Tractate Shabbat [96a] it proves that when a large vessel that was perforated when they remove the pomegranate and a small vessel that was hallowed out in its majority, the plastering and closing it up have no effect, and furthermore, it does not protect with an airtight lid since it it no longer has the status of a vessel. But if they plastered it, it becomes like foodstuffs that were kneaded with plaster that the plaster does not protect/save them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:8:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:11)


**שִׁעוּרָן בְּמַשְׁקִין.** בְּכוֹנֵס מַשְׁקֶה:


שיעורן במשקין – when one brings in liquids.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:8:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:12)


**הֶעָשׂוּי לְכָךְ וּלְכָךְ.** לְמַשְׁקִין וּלְאֳכָלִין:


העשוי לכך ולכך – for liquids and for foods.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 9:8:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/9:8:13)


**מַטִּילִין אוֹתוֹ לְחֻמְרוֹ.** וְאִם נִקַּב בְּכוֹנֵס מַשְׁקֶה אֵינוֹ מַצִּיל בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל עַד שֶׁיֻּמְרַח:


מטילין אותו לחומרו – but if he perforated at the place where the liquids enter, he does not save/protect it with an airtight lid until it is plastered over.



## Chapter 10


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:1)


**אֵלּוּ כֵלִים.** כְּלֵי גְלָלִים. שֶׁל צְפִיעֵי בָקָר:


אלו כלים. כלי גללים – of the dung of cattle.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:2)


**כְּלֵי אֲבָנִים וּכְלֵי אֲדָמָה.** דְּכָל הָנֵי אֵין לָהֶם טֻמְאָה לֹא מִדִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה וְלֹא מִדִּבְרֵי סוֹפְרִים, וּלְכָךְ מַצִּילִין בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל. וְאַף עַל גַּב דְּכָל כְּלִי פָתוּחַ, בִּכְלִי חֶרֶס מִשְׁתַּעֵי קְרָא, בִּכְלִי שֶׁטֻּמְאָה קוֹדֶמֶת לְפִתְחוֹ דְּהַיְנוּ כְלִי חֶרֶס שֶׁמִּטַּמֵּא מֵאֲוִירוֹ, מִכָּל מָקוֹם שְׁאָר כֵּלִים נַמִּי מְרַבִּינַן שֶׁמַּצִּילִים, מִדִּכְתִיב וְכָל:


כלי אבנים וכלי אדמה – for all of these they lack defilement whether from the words of the Torah or from the words of the Scribes/סופרים, and therefore they protect/save [from defilement in the airspace of a tent with a corpse] with an airtight lid. But even though that every open vessel (see Numbers 19:15), Scripture is speaking of an earthenware vessel, in a vessel that the defilement precedes its opening that is an earthenware vessel that becomes defiled from its airspace, nevertheless, we include the rest of the utensils that protect/save, as it is written (Numbers 19:15): "וכל כלי פתוח"/”And every open vessel, [with no lid fastened down, shall be impure].”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:3)


**וְעַצְמוֹת הַדָּג.** אִם עָשָׂה כְלִי מֵעַצְמוֹת בְּרִיּוֹת שֶׁבַּיָּם, מַצִּילִים, לְפִי שֶׁאֵין מְקַבְּלִים טֻמְאָה, כְּדִתְנַן לְקַמָּן בְּפֶרֶק י"ז כָּל שֶׁבַּיָּם טָהוֹר. וְכָל כֵּלִים מֵעַצְמוֹת הָעוֹף טְהוֹרִים, דִּכְתִיב (במדבר לא) וְכָל מַעֲשֵׂה עִזִּים, פְּרָט לָעוֹפוֹת:


ועצמות הדג – if he made a vessel/utensil from the bones of creatures that are in the sea, they save/protect. Since they are not susceptible to receive defilement, as it is taught in the Mishnah of [Tractate Kelim] Chapter 17 [Mishnah 13]: “Everything that is in the sea is pure”/כל שבים טהור. And vessels [made] from the bones of fowl are pure, as it is written (Numbers 31:20): “[You shall also purify every cloth, every article of skin,] everything made of goats’ hair/וכל מעשה עזים, [and every object of wood],” excluding fowl.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:4)


**כְּלֵי עֵץ הַטְּהוֹרִים.** כְּגוֹן כֵּלִים גְּדוֹלִים הַבָּאִים בְּמִדָּה שֶׁמַּחֲזִיקִים אַרְבָּעִים סְאָה בְלַח שֶׁהֵן כּוֹרַיִם בְּיָבֵשׁ, דְּלֹא מְקַבְּלֵי טֻמְאָה, דְּבָעִינַן דּוּמְיָא דְשַׂק שֶׁמִּטַּלְטֵל מָלֵא וְרֵיקָן, וְכֵיוָן שֶׁהֵן גְּדוֹלִים כָּל כָּךְ אֵין מִטַּלְטְלִים מְלֵאִים, וּמַצִּילִים בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל:


כלי עץ הטהורים – as for example large vessels that come in a measure that contains forty Seah in liquid measure which is equal to two KOR in dry measure (see Tractate Kelim, Chapter 15, Mishnah 1), that are not susceptible to receive defilement, for we require something similar to a sackcloth that can be carried full and/or empty, and since they are so large, they are not carried full, and they protect/save with an airtight lid.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:5)


**מִפִּיהֶן.** שֶׁהַצָּמִיד פָּתִיל בְּפִיהֶן:


מפיהן – that the airtight lid is in their mouth/at their opening.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:6)


**מִצִּדֵּיהֶן.** אִם נִקְּבוּ בְצִדֵּיהֶן וְהִקִּיפָן צָמִיד פָּתִיל:


מצדיהן – if they were perforated at their sides and were surrounded with an airtight lid.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:7)


**רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר מְטַמֵּא.** קָסָבַר כָּפוּי אֵינוֹ מַצִּיל, וַאֲפִלּוּ מֵרְחוֹ לְמַטָּה בַקַּרְקַע. שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר צָמִיד פָּתִיל עָלָיו, וְלֹא צָמִיד פָּתִיל עַל גַּבּוֹ. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר:


ר' אליעזר מטמא – for he holds that something that is turned upside down does not save/protect, and even it was smoothed into an even pile below the ground, as it states (Numbers 19:15): “[with no] lid fastened down,” and with no airtight lid on top of it. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yossi.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:8)


**עַל הַכֹּל מַצִּילִים.** כָּל הָנֵי כֵּלִים דִּתְנַן בְּמַתְנִיתִין, מַצִּילִין עַל כָּל מַה שֶּׁבְּתוֹכָן בֵּין הָיוּ בְתוֹכָן כְּלֵי שֶׁטֶף בֵּין כְּלֵי חֶרֶס בֵּין בְּגָדִים בֵּין אֳכָלִים וּמַשְׁקִים:


על הכל מצילין – all of these utensils that are taught in our Mishnah, they save/protect on everything that is within them, whether there were in them vessels only requiring rinsing in order to be restored to Levitical cleanness or whether earthenware vessels or whether clothes or whether foods or liquids.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:1:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:1:9)


**חוּץ מִכְּלֵי חֶרֶס.** שֶׁאֵין מַצִּילִים אֶלָּא עַל אֳכָלִים וּמַשְׁקִים וּכְלֵי חֶרֶס שֶׁבְּתוֹכָן, דְּבָרִים שֶׁאֵין לָהֶן טָהֳרָה בַמִּקְוֶה, וְלֹא עַל כְּלֵי מַתָּכוֹת וּבְגָדִים שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶם טָהֳרָה בַמִּקְוֶה. וְטַעְמָא פָרֵישְׁנָא בְּפִרְקִין דִּלְעֵיל. וּמִשְׁנָה זוֹ לְאַחַר חֲזָרָה שֶׁחָזְרוּ בֵית הִלֵּל לְהוֹרוֹת כְּדִבְרֵי בֵית שַׁמַּאי:


חוץ מכלי חרס – that they don’t protect/save other than on foods and liquids and earthenware vessels that are within them, things that have no purification in a Mikveh/ritual bath, and not on metal utensils and clothing, which have purification in a Mikveh. And the reason I explained in the chapter above (see Tractate Kelim, Chapter 9, Mishnah 2). But this Mishnah is after the School of Hillel retracted to teach according to the words of the School of Shammai.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:2:1)


**בַּמֶּה מַקִּיפִין.** בַּמֶּה סוֹתְמִים פִּי הַכְּלִי אוֹ מְדַבְּקִים הַכִּסּוּי עַל פִּי הַכְּלִי וְיֵחָשֵׁב צָמִיד פָּתִיל:


במה מקיפים – with what do they stop up the mouth of a vessel or seal up the covering upon the mouth of the vessel that it be considered an airtight lid?


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:2:2)


**גִּפְּסִיס.** מִין סִיד הוּא, וְיוֹתֵר לָבָן מִסִּיד, וְנִשְׂרָף בְּכִבְשָׁן כְּמוֹ הַסִּיד:


גפסים (gypsum) – is a kind of plaster/lime, but it is more white than plaster and is burned in an oven like the plaster.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:2:3)


**חַרְסִית.** כְּתִישַׁת חֲרָסִים, וְלָשִׁים אוֹתָהּ בַמַּיִם:


חרסית (potter’s clay/clay-ground) – the crushing/pounding of potter’s clay and they knead it in water.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:2:4)


**בַּעַץ.** הוּא בְּדִיל. אֶת הַבְּדִיל, מְתַרְגְּמִינַן יַת אַבְצָא. וְתַרְגּוּם יְרוּשַׁלְמִי בַּעְצָא:


בעץ (tin) – it is making a separation/partition, that which separates. We translate it in Aramaic as that which is tin. And the Aramaic translation in the Jerusalem Talmud is בעצא – tin.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:2:5)


**שֶׁהוּא פָתִיל וְאֵינוֹ צָמִיד.** כְּלוֹמַר כִּסּוּי הוּא, אֲבָל אֵינוֹ מְחֻבָּר וּמְדֻבָּק יָפֶה עַל פִּי הַכְּלִי:


שהוא פתיל ואינו צמיד (because it is a covering [i.e., the neck of the vessel] but it is not airtight [i.e., the lid]) – meaning to say that it is a covering, but it is not attached and glued well to the mouth of the vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:2:6)


**לֹא בִדְבֵלָה שְׁמֵנָה וְלֹא בְּבָצֵק שֶׁנִּלּוֹשׁ בְּמֵי פֵרוֹת.** וְאַף עַל גַּב דְּמַצִּילִים שֶׁהֲרֵי לֹא הֻכְשְׁרוּ לְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה, אַף עַל פִּי כֵן לְכַתְּחִלָּה אֵין מַקִּיפִין בָּהֶן, גְּזֵרָה שֶׁמָּא יֻכְשְׁרוּ, שֶׁיִּפְּלוּ עֲלֵיהֶן מַשְׁקִין הַמַּכְשִׁירִים, וְאֵין דָּבָר טָמֵא מַצִּיל:


לא בדבילה שמינה ולא בבצק שנלוש במי פירות – even though they protect/save for they were not susceptible to receive defilement, nevertheless they don’t stop them up with them, as a decree lest they become susceptible that liquids fall upon them that make them susceptible , for nothing that is impure can protect/save.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:2:7)


**וְאִם הִקִּיף.** וְלֹא בָא עֲלֵיהֶן מַיִם אוֹ אֶחָד מִן הַמַּשְׁקִין הַמַּכְשִׁירִין, הִצִּילוּ:


ואם הקיף – and water does not come upon them or one of the liquids that make them susceptible [for Levitical uncleanness], they save/protect.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:3:1)


**הַמְּחֻלְחֶלֶת.** מִתְנַעְנַעַת וּמִתְנַדְנֶדֶת, לְשׁוֹן וַתִּתְחַלְחַל הַמַּלְכָּה:


המחלחלת (the stopper of a jar/keg which can be moved round, without, however, falling out of itself) – that moves about in different directions and shakes, the language of (Esther 4:4): “the queen was greatly agitated.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:3:2)


**רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר מַצֶּלֶת.** דַּחֲשִׁיב לָהּ צָמִיד פָּתִיל הוֹאִיל וְאֵינָהּ יוֹצֵאת:


רבי יהודה אומר מצלת – that he considers it an airtight lid, since it does not go out.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:3:3)


**וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים אֵינָהּ מַצֶּלֶת.** דְּכֵיוָן דְּמִתְחַלְחֶלֶת לָאו צָמִיד פָּתִיל הוּא. וַהֲלָכָה כַּחֲכָמִים:


וחכמים אומרים אינה מצלת – for since it moves in different directions/shakes , it is not an airtight lid. And the Halakha is according to the Sages.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:3:4)


**הָיָה בֵית אֶצְבַּע.** שֶׁל מְגוּפָה מְשֻׁקָּע וְנִכְנָס לְתוֹךְ הֶחָבִית, חֲשִׁיב הַשֶּׁרֶץ שֶׁבְּתוֹכָהּ כְּאִלּוּ הוּא בְתוֹךְ הֶחָבִית. וּבֵית אֶצְבַּע הוּא הַמָּקוֹם מִן הַמְּגוּפָה שֶׁאָדָם מַכְנִיס אֶצְבָּעוֹ לְתוֹכוֹ:


היה בית אצבע (if its finger hold/stall) – of the stopper was sunk and entered into the jug, it is considered that the unclean insect that is within it is as if it is within the jug. And the finger-hold is the place from the stopper that a person places his finger into it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:3:5)


**אֳכָלִים שֶׁבְּתוֹכָהּ.** שֶׁבְּתוֹךְ בֵּית אֶצְבַּע הַשּׁוֹקֵעַ וְנִכְנָס לְתוֹךְ הֶחָבִית:


אוכלים שבתוכה – that are within the finger-hold/stall that sunk and entered into the jar.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:3:6)


**טְמֵאִים.** דִּמְגוּפַת הֶחָבִית כֶּחָבִית דָּמְיָא:


טמאים – for the stopper of the jar is like the jar itself.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:4:1)


**הַכַּדּוּר.** פלוט"א בְּלַעַ"ז:


הכדור – in the foreign tongue PALUTA.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:4:2)


**הַפְּקַעַת שֶׁל גֶּמִי.** לַח אָרֹךְ שֶׁכּוֹרְכִים אוֹתוֹ זֶה עִם זֶה וְעוֹשִׂים אוֹתוֹ עָגֹל כְּמִין פְּקָעִיּוֹת שֶׁל שְׁתִי. גלומור"ש בְּלַעַ"ז:


הפקעת של גמי (coil of rope made of reed grass) – moist [and] long that they wrap it one with the other and make it round like coils of weaving (in the longitudinal direction/warp). GLUMURSH in the foreign language.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:4:3)


**עַד שֶׁיְּמָרַח.** מִלְּמַטָּה שֶׁל כַּדּוּר אוֹ שֶׁל פְּקַעַת וּלְמַעְלָה, כְּדֵי שֶׁיְּכַסֶּה כֻּלּוֹ, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא חָלוּל:


עד שימרח (until he plasters) – from below the ball or of the coil and above, in order that it would cover anything, because it is hollow.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:4:4)


**וְכֵן מַטְלִית שֶׁל בֶּגֶד.** דְּכָל הָנֵי חֲלוּלִים נִינְהוּ. וְכֻלְּהוּ אֵין מַצִּילִין אֶלָּא כְּשֶׁאֵין בָּהֶם שִׁעוּר לְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה:


וכן מטלית של בגד (and similarly a patch of cloth/woven stuff) – for all of these are hollow, and all of them do not protect other than when they don’t have the measure to receive defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:4:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:4:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:4:5)


**וּקְשָׁרָהּ בִּמְשִׁיחָה.** בְּחוּט דַּק כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁעוֹשִׂים כְּשֶׁמְּכַסִּים פִּי הַנּוֹד בְּבֶגֶד אוֹ בִנְיָר שֶׁקּוֹשְׁרִים אוֹתוֹ, וּמוּסָף עַל הַקְּשִׁירָה בָעֵי נַמִּי מְרִיחָה מִן הַצְּדָדִין:


וקשרה במשיחה (and tied it with a cord) – with a thin thread like they do when they cover the mouth of the skin/leather bottle in a cloth or in a piece of paper when they tie it, and added on to the tie requires also plastering from the sides.



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:5:1)


**חָבִית שֶׁנִּתְקַלְּפָה.** חָבִית זְפוּתָה מִבִּפְנִים וְנִטַּל חֶרֶס מִמֶּנָּה מִבַּחוּץ, וְהַזֶּפֶת עוֹמֵד כְּנֶגְדּוֹ מִבִּפְנִים:


חבית שנתקלפה (an earthen jug which is peeled off – crumbled away – the pitch lining standing by itself) – a jug that is lined with pitch from the inside and the earthenware was taken from it from the outside and the pitch stands opposite it from the inside.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:5:2)


**קְבוֹתִים.** קַנְקַנִּים שֶׁל חֶרֶס שֶׁמַּנִּיחִין בָּהֶן מֻרְיָס נִקְרָאִים קְבוֹתִים:


קבותים (pots of pickle which are lined with pitch up to the rim – so that the lid does not touch the body of the vessel itself) – cans of earthenware in which they place in them brine/pickle [containing fish-hash] are called קבותים/pots of pickle [lined with pitch up to the rim].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:5:3)


**שֶׁגְּפָתָן.** שֶׁכִּסָּה אוֹתָן בְּמִין סִיד שֶׁקּוֹרִין גִּפְּסִים דִּתְנַן לְעֵיל שֶׁמַּקִּיפִין בּוֹ:


שגפסן (that they paste them [with gypsum to make them airtight]) – that he covers them with a a kind of plaster that they call plaster that they call גפסים/gypsum as is taught in the Mishnah above that they the surround it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:5:4)


**עִם הַשָּׂפָה.** לְמַטָּה מִשְּׂפַת הַכְּלִי, שֶׁנִּמְצָא הַצָּמִיד פָּתִיל מִבִּפְנִים וְהַשָּׂפָה מְגֻלָּה מִבַּחוּץ:


עם השפה – below from the lip of the vessel, that is found that airtight lid from the inside and the lip is revealed from the outside.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:5:5)


**רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר אֵין מַצִּילִין.** דְּקָסָבַר צָמִיד פָּתִיל עָלָיו כְּתִיב, וְלֹא צָמִיד פָּתִיל מִתּוֹכוֹ. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


ר' יהודה אומר אין מצילין – for he holds that that it is written (Numbers 19:15): “a lid fastened down”/"צמיד פתיל עליו", but not a lid fastened from within. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehuda.



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:6:1)


**וּסְתָמוּהָ שְׁמָרִים הִצִּילוּהָ.** סְתָמָא כַּחֲכָמִים דְּיֵשׁ צָמִיד פָּתִיל מִבִּפְנִים:


וסתמוה שמרים הצילוה (and the wine-lees have stopped up) – the anonymous teaching is like the [teaching of] the Sages that there is an airtight lid from the inside.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:6:2)


**עַד שֶׁיְּמָרַח.** סָבִיב לַזְּמוֹרָה מִן הַצְּדָדִים. אֲבָל עַל הַזְּמוֹרָה עַצְמָהּ לֹא בָעֵי מֵרוּחַ:


עד שימרח – around the vine-shoot from the sides. But on the vine-shoot itself, it doesn’t require plastering.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:6:3)


**נֶסֶר.** פְּשׁוּטֵי כְלֵי עֵץ הוּא:


נסר (boards) – it is plain, flat pieces of wood.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:6:4)


**בְּסִינִים.** שֶׁנָּתַן בֵּין נֶסֶר לְנֶסֶר קְלִפּוֹת דַּקּוֹת שֶׁל סְנֶה:


סינים – that he placed between each board thin husks of clay.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:6:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:6:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:6:5)


**אוֹ בְשֹׁגְמִין.** קְלִפֵּי עֵץ שֶׁל שֹׁגְמִין. וְאוֹתָן קְלִפִּין נָתַן בֵּין נֶסֶר לְנֶסֶר כְּדֵי לְחַבְּרָן:


או בשגמין (or with hinges/joints) – thin husks of joints/hinges (Maimonides says with bamboo). But those shells/peelings he placed between each board in order to attach them.



### Mishnah 7

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:7:1)


**תַּנּוּר יָשָׁן.** שֶׁהֻסַּק כְּדֵי לֶאֱפוֹת בּוֹ סֻפְגָּנִים, שֶׁזּוֹ הִיא גְּמַר מְלַאכְתּוֹ לִהְיוֹת חֲשׁוּב כְּלִי לְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה:


תנור ישן – that was heated in order to bake in it cakes made of spongy dough (i.e., a sort of crackers) that this is its completion of work to be considered a vessel susceptible to receive ritual impurity.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:7:2)


**חָדָשׁ.** שֶׁלֹּא הֻסַּק וְאֵינוֹ מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה:


חדש – that was not heated and is not susceptible to receive ritual impurity.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:7:3)


**וּסְרֵידָא עַל פִּי הַיָּשָׁן.** וְאֵינָהּ מְמֻרַחַת בְּטִיט, וְאֵין כָּאן צָמִיד פָּתִיל:


וסרידא על פי הישן (and a colander is over the mouth of the old) – but it is not spread with plaster, and there is no airtight lid here.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:7:4)


**נִטַּל הַיָּשָׁן וּסְרֵידָא נוֹפֶלֶת.** שֶׁאֵינָהּ נִסְמֶכֶת עַל פִּי הֶחָדָשׁ:


ניטל הישן וסרידא נופלת – that it is not adjoined on the mouth of the new oven.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:7:5)


**הַכֹּל טָמֵא.** שֶׁהַיָּשָׁן שֶׁעָלָיו הַסְּרֵידָא חֲשׁוּב כְּלִי וְאֵינוֹ מַצִּיל אֶלָּא בְּצָמִיד פָּתִיל, וַהֲרֵי אֵין כָּאן צָמִיד פָּתִיל. וְהֶחָדָשׁ שֶׁאֵינוֹ כְּלִי הָיָה חוֹצֵץ בִּפְנֵי הַטֻּמְאָה מִשּׁוּם אֹהֶל אִם הָיְתָה הַסְּרֵידָא נִסְמֶכֶת עָלָיו, דְּכָל הַמַּצִּיל מִשּׁוּם אֹהֶל אֵינוֹ צָרִיךְ לְצָמִיד פָּתִיל. אֲבָל בִּזְמַן שֶׁאֵין הַסְּרֵידָה נִסְמֶכֶת עָלָיו אֵין כָּאן אֹהֶל, הִלְכָּךְ הַכֹּל טָמֵא:


הכל טמא – for the old (i.e., oven) one that the colander is upon is considered a vessel and it does not protect other than with an airtight lid, and behold, there isn’t an airtight lid here. But the new (i.e., oven) one that is not a vessel would interpose in the face of the defilement because of the tent if the colander was adjoined upon it, for all that protects/saves because of a tent formed does not require an airtight lid. But at the time when the colander is not adjoined upon it, there isn’t a tent here, therefore everything is impure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:7:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:7:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:7:6)


**אִם אֵין בֵּין חָדָשׁ לַסְּרֵידָא פוֹתֵחַ טֶפַח.** אִם אֵין גֹּבַהּ טֶפַח בֵּין הַכִּסּוּי שֶׁעַל הַיָּשָׁן לַפֶּה שֶׁל הַתַּנּוּר הֶחָדָשׁ, נֶחְשָׁב הַכִּסּוּי שֶׁעַל הַיָּשָׁן כְּאִלּוּ הוּא בְּפִי הֶחָדָשׁ, וְנַעֲשָׂה הֶחָדָשׁ אֹהֶל וְחוֹצֵץ בִּפְנֵי הַטֻּמְאָה וְכָל מַה שֶּׁבְּתוֹכוֹ טָהוֹר:


אם אין בין חדש לסדירא פותח טפח – if it is not one handbreadth high between the covering that is on the old (i.e., oven) one to the mouth of the new oven, the covering that is upon the old one is considered as if it is in the mouth of he news, and the new becomes a tent which protrudes before the defilement and all that is within it is ritually pure (see also Tractate Ohalot, Chapter 3, Mishnah 7 and Chapter 12, Mishnah1).



### Mishnah 8

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:1)


**לְפָסִין.** כְּמוֹ אִלְפָּסִין. מַחֲבוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל שֶׁמְּבַשְּׁלִין בָּהֶן:


לפסין (tightly covered pot/stew-pot) – like אלפסין/tightly covered pots. Large iron pans – that they cook in them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:2)


**וְשִׂפְתוֹתֵיהֶן שָׁווֹת.** שֶׁאֵין שְׂפַת אַחַת מֵהֶן גְּבוֹהָה מֵחֲבֶרְתָּהּ:


ושפתותיהן שוות – that one rim from them is no higher than its neighbor.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:3)


**בָּעֶלְיוֹנָה.** הִיא הַפְּנִימִית שֶׁהַחִיצוֹנָה תַחְתֶּיהָ:


בעליונה – this is the inner one for the outer one is underneath it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:4)


**הִיא טְמֵאָה כוּ'.** אִם הַשֶּׁרֶץ בָּעֶלְיוֹנָה, אֳכָלִין שֶׁבַּתַּחְתּוֹנָה טְהוֹרִין, דְּרַחֲמָנָא אָמַר (ויקרא יא) כָּל אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל אֶל תּוֹכוֹ, וְלֹא אֶל תּוֹךְ תּוֹכוֹ, וְהַשֶּׁרֶץ שֶׁבָּעֶלְיוֹנָה תּוֹךְ תּוֹכוֹ דְתַחְתּוֹנָה הוּא. וְאִם הַשֶּׁרֶץ בַּתַּחְתּוֹנָה, לֹא נִטְמְאוּ הָאֳכָלִים שֶׁבָּעֶלְיוֹנָה, דְּרַחֲמָנָא אָמַר (שם) כָּל אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכוֹ יִטְמָא, וְלֹא שֶׁבְּתוֹךְ תּוֹכוֹ:


היא טמאה – if the unclean reptile/insect is in the upper [saucepan], foods that are in the lower one are clean/pure, for the All-Merciful stated (Leviticus 11:33): “And if any of those falls into an earthen vessel/כל אשר יפול אל תוכו” and not "אל תוך תוכו"/within that which it is into, but the unclean insect/reptile that is in the upper [saucepan] is within that which it is into – of the lower [saucepan]. But if the unclean insect in the lower [saucepan], the foods that are in the upper [saucepan] are not are not made impure, for the All-Merciful stated (Leviticus 11:33): "כל אשר בתוכו/everything inside it [shall be impure and -the vessel -itself you shall break],” but not that which is within it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:5)


**הָיוּ בְכוֹנֵס מַשְׁקֶה.** כְּלוֹמַר נְקוּבִים בְּכוֹנֵס מַשְׁקֶה דְּהַיְנוּ כְדֵי טָהֳרָתָן, דְּאִלְפָּסִין עֲשׂוּיִין לְמַשְׁקִים וּלְאֳכָלִין, וּמְטִילִין אוֹתוֹ לְחֻמְרוֹ בְּכוֹנֵס מַשְׁקֶה:


היו בכונס משקה ([if] they were [so damaged] that liquids could penetrate) – meaning to say, perforated so that liquids could penetrate that is, in order [to preserve] their ritual purity, for tightly covered pots are made for liquids and food-stuff, and we place upon them for stringency when liquids penetrate.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:8:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:6)


**הַשֶּׁרֶץ בָּעֶלְיוֹנָה.** דְּהַיְנוּ הַפְּנִימִית:


השרץ בעליונה – that is, the inner [saucepan].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:8:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:7)


**כֻּלָּן טְמֵאוֹת.** דְּרוֹאִין אֶת הַשֶּׁרֶץ כְּאִלּוּ הוּא בְכָל אַחַת, כֵּיוָן דִּנְקוּבוֹת בְּכוֹנֵס מַשְׁקֶה:


כולן טמאות – for we see the unclean insect as if it is each one [of the pans], since they are perforated where the liquids penetrate.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:8:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:8)


**בַּתַּחְתּוֹנָה.** דְּהִיא הַחִיצוֹנָה:


בתחתונה – which is the outer [saucepan].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:8:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:9)


**הִיא טְמֵאָה וְכֻלָּן טְהוֹרוֹת.** דְּאֵין טֻמְאָה נִכְנֶסֶת דֶּרֶךְ שׁוּלָיו. וּמִיהוּ אִם הָיוּ אֳכָלִים וּמַשְׁקִים בַּפְּנִימִית, נִטְמְאוּ, כֵּיוָן דְּלֹא מֵרַח הַנֶּקֶב כִּדְמוּכָח לְעֵיל בְּפֶרֶק שְׁמִינִי. וְהַיְנוּ טַעֲמָא, מִשּׁוּם דְּנִקַּב בִּכְדֵי טָהֳרָתוֹ נֶחְשָׁב כַּאֲוִיר שֶׁל חִיצוֹנָה, וָאֳכָלִים וּמַשְׁקִין מִטַּמְּאִין מֵאֲוִיר כְּלִי חֶרֶס וְאֵין אָדָם וְכֵלִים מִטַּמְּאִין מֵאֲוִיר כְּלִי חֶרֶס:


היא טמאה וכולן טהורות – for the defilement does not enter through its rims. But however, if there were food and liquids in the inner [saucepan], they were defiled, since the incision was not plastered over as is it is proven above in Chapter 8 [Mishnah 2]. And this is the reason, because he made a perforation in order [to preserve] its ritual purity, it is considered like the airspace of the outer vessel, and food-stuffs and liquids are made ritually impure from the airspace of an earthenware vessel, and neither people nor vessels are defiled from the airspace of earthenware vessels.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:8:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:10)


**הַשֶּׁרֶץ בָּעֶלְיוֹנָה.** הַשְׁתָּא מַיְרֵי בִּלְפָסִין שְׁלֵמוֹת:


השרץ בעליונה – now we are speaking about complete stew-pots.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:8:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:11)


**הִיא וְהַתַּחְתּוֹנָה טְמֵאָה.** דִּכְמֻנָּח בְּתוֹכָהּ דָּמֵי כֵּיוָן דְּעוֹדֶפֶת. אֲבָל אֶמְצָעִית טְהוֹרָה, דְּאֵין כְּלִי מִטַּמֵּא בַּאֲוִיר כְּלִי חֶרֶס:


היא והתחתנה טמאה – since it is like as if it is placed within it since it (i.e., the bottom saucepan) exceeds [the others in height], but the middle one is ritually pure, for a utensil does not become defiled through the airspace of an earthenware vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 10:8:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/10:8:12)


**כֹּל שֶׁיֶּשׁ בּוֹ מַשְׁקֶה טוֹפֵחַ טָמֵא.** נִטְמָא מַשְׁקֶה טוֹפֵחַ שֶׁבְּתוֹךְ הַכְּלִי הָאֶמְצָעִי מֵאֲוִיר כְּלִי חֶרֶס, וְחָזַר הַמַּשְׁקֶה וְטִמֵּא אֶת הַכֵּלִים. דְּרַבָּנָן גָּזְרוּ עַל מַשְׁקֶה שֶׁיְּטַמֵּא כְלִי, גְּזֵרָה מִשּׁוּם מַשְׁקֶה זָב וְזָבָה. וְהוּא הַדִּין דַּהֲוֵי מָצֵי לְאַשְׁמוֹעִינַן חִדּוּשׁ זֶה שֶׁל מַשְׁקֶה טוֹפֵחַ בָּרֵישָׁא כְּשֶׁהַשֶּׁרֶץ בָּעֶלְיוֹנָה וְהַתַּחְתּוֹנָה עוֹדֶפֶת וְיֵשׁ מַשְׁקֶה טוֹפֵחַ בָּאֶמְצָעִי:


כל שיש בו משקה טופח טמא (each one in which here is moist liquid is unclean) – the moist liquid that is within the middle vessel is defiled from the airspace of the earthenware vessel, and the liquid returned and defiled the utensils. For the Rabbis decreed on liquids that it would defile a utensil, as a decree because of the liquid of a man with gonorrhea and a woman with a flux . And the same law applies where one is able to inform us of this novel [concept] of moist liquid in the first clause [of the Mishnah] that the unclean insect in the upper and lower [saucepans] exceeds [the others] and there is moist liquid in the middle [pan].



## Chapter 11


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:1:1)


**כְּלֵי מַתָּכוֹת פְּשׁוּטֵיהֶן טְמֵאִים.** דְּלֹא אִתַּקַּשׁ לְשַׂק:


כלי מתכות פשוטיהן טמאים (metal vessels: their flat parts are impure) – for there is no analogy to a sack (see Leviticus 11:32; “And anything on which one of them falls when dead shall be impure: be it any article of wood, or a cloth, or a skin or a sack – any such article that can be put to use shall be dipped in water and it shall remain impure until evening; then it shall be pure; also see Tractate Kelim, Chapter 2, Mishnah 1: “Vessels of wood, and vessels of leather, and vessels of bone and vessels of glass: when they are flat, they are clean, and when they form receptacles, they are [susceptible of becoming] unclean.”).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:1:2)


**חָזְרוּ לְטֻמְאָתָן הַיְשָׁנָה.** חֲכָמִים גָּזְרוּ עַל כְּלֵי מַתָּכוֹת שֶׁהִתִּיכָן וְעָשָׂה מֵהֶן כֵּלִים חֲדָשִׁים, שֶׁיַּחְזְרוּ לְטֻמְאָתָן הַיְשָׁנָה. גְּזֵרָה שֶׁמָּא יֹאמְרוּ שְׁבִירָתָן שֶׁל כֵּלִים מְטַהֲרָתָן וּטְבִילָתָן מְטַהֲרָתָן. מַה שְּׁבִירָתָן אֵינָהּ טְעוּנָה הַעֲרֵב שֶׁמֶשׁ, שֶׁהֲרֵי מִשְׁתַּמְשִׁין בָּהֶן בְּאוֹתוֹ הַיּוֹם שֶׁנִּטְמְאוּ, וּשְׁבָרָן וְחָזַר וַעֲשָׂאָן חֲדָשִׁים, אַף טְבִילָתָן אֵינָהּ טְעוּנָה הַעֲרֵב שֶׁמֶשׁ, וְאָתְיָא לְמֶעֱבַד תְּרוּמָה וְקָדָשִׁים בְּכֵלִים שֶׁלֹּא הֶעֱרִיב שִׁמְשָׁן:


חזרו לטומאתן הישנה – The Sages made a decree regarding metal vessels that he melted them and made from them new vessels, that they return to their former defilement/uncleanness. This is a decree lest they say that the breaking of these utensils purifies them and their immersion [in a Mikveh] purifies them. Just as their breakage does not require the coming of sunset, for behold, we use them the entire day that they were defiled and he broke them and he returned and made of hem new [vessels], so [also] their being immersed does not require the coming of sunset, and it comes to make the heave offering and Holy Things in vessels that their sunset had not as yet arrived (see Talmud Shabbat 16b – this is the ordinance of Shimon ben Shetach).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:1:3)


**לֹא לְכָל טֻמְאָה אֶלָּא לְטֻמְאַת הַנָּפֶשׁ.** רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל סָבַר דְּטַעֲמָא דְגָזְרוּ עַל כְּלֵי מַתָּכוֹת שֶׁיַּחְזְרוּ לְטֻמְאָתָן יְשָׁנָה אֵינָהּ אֶלָּא גְזֵרָה שֶׁמָּא תִשְׁתַּכַּח תּוֹרַת מֵי חַטָּאת מִן הַכֵּלִים, שֶׁאֵין לְךָ אָדָם מַמְתִּין שִׁבְעַת יָמִים אֶלָּא שׁוֹבְרָן מִיָּד וְחוֹזֵר וְעוֹשֶׂה אוֹתָן חֲדָשִׁים, הִלְכָּךְ לֹא גָזְרוּ אֶלָּא לְטֻמְאַת מֵת בִּלְבַד שֶׁצְּרִיכִים הַזָּאַת שְׁלִישִׁי וּשְׁבִיעִי. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל:


לא לכל טומאה אלא לטומאת נפש – Rabban Shimon ben Gamaliel holds that the reason that they (i.e., the Rabbis) decreed regarding metal vessels that they return to the former uncleanness is not other than a decree lest the law of the waters of purification be forgotten from the vessels, for there isn’t a person that waits seven days but rather he breaks them immediately and makes from them (i.e., the vessels) anew, therefore, they didn’t decree other than regarding defilement from a corpse alone that requires sprinkling [of a mixture of ashes of the red heifer with special water] on the third and seventh days (see Numbers 19:12: “He shall purify himself with it on the third day and on the seventh day, and then be pure.”). But the Halakha is not according to Rabban Shimon ben Gamaliel.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:2:1)


**שֶׁיֶּשׁ לוֹ שֵׁם בִּפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ.** שֶׁהוּא יָדוּעַ וְנִכָּר וּמְיֻחָד בִּשְׁמוֹ:


שיש לו שם בפני עצמו – that is known and recognized and unique with its name.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:2:2)


**טָמֵא.** בֵּין יֵשׁ לוֹ בֵּית קִבּוּל בֵּין אֵין לוֹ בֵּית קִבּוּל:


טמא – whether it has a receptacle or it doesn’t have a receptacle [it is impure].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:2:3)


**הַנֶּגֶר.** יָתֵד שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל שֶׁנּוֹעֵץ רֹאשׁוֹ אֶחָד בַּקַּרְקַע וְרֹאשׁוֹ הַשֵּׁנִי אֲחוֹרֵי הַדֶּלֶת. אִי נַמִּי, כְּמִין עַמּוּד שֶׁסּוֹגֵר וּמַבְרִיחַ הַדֶּלֶת מִן הַקָּצֶה אֶל הַקָּצֶה:


הנגר (door-bolt, pin fitting into sockets top and bottom) – an iron peg whose one head one wedges into the ground and the other head in back of the door. Alternatively, it is similar to a pillar that closes and bolts the door from one end to the other.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:2:4)


**מַנְעוּל.** כָּל דָּבָר שֶׁנּוֹעֲלִים וְסוֹגְרִים בּוֹ הַדֶּלֶת נִקְרָא מַנְעוּל. וְדֻגְמָתוֹ בַּמִּקְרָא בְּשִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים (פרק ה) עַל כַּפּוֹת הַמַּנְעוּל:


מנעול – anything that locks and closes the door is called מנעול /a lock. And its example in Scripture is in the Song of Songs (5:5): “על כפות המנעול”/”Upon the handles of the bolt.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:2:5)


**פּוֹתָה.** כְּמִין כּוֹס קָטָן שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל קוֹבְעִים בָּאָרֶץ, וְצִיר הַדֶּלֶת סוֹבֵב עָלָיו כְּדֵי שֶׁיְּהֵא נוֹחַ לְהִפָּתֵחַ וּלְהִסָּגֵר. וְדֻגְמָתוֹ בַמִּקְרָא (מלכים א ז) וְהַפֹּתוֹת לְדַלְתוֹת הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי:


פותה (socket of the door-pin/the hole under the hinge) – it is similar to small cup of iron that they affix in the ground and the hinge of the door surrounds it in order that it is easy to open and to close. And an example of this in Scripture (I Kings 7:50): “and the hinge sockets for the doors on the innermost part of the House”/".והפותות לדלתות הבית הפנימית"


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:2:6)


**וְהַצִּנּוֹר.** קנאל"י בְּלַעַ"ז:


והצינור (door-socket/pivot) – KANALI in the foreign tongue.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:2:7)


**שֶׁנַּעֲשׂוּ לַקַּרְקָע.** לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בַּקַּרְקַע. וְכָל הַמְחֻבָּר לַקַּרְקַע הֲרֵי הוּא כַקַּרְקַע וְאֵינוֹ מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה:


שנעשו לקרקע – to use the ground. For everything that is attached to the ground is like the ground and is not susceptible to receive ritual impurity.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:1)


**הָעֶשֶׁת.** חֲתִיכָה שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל כְּשֶׁמּוֹצִיאִים אוֹתוֹ מִן הַמַּחְצָב:


העשת (wrought metal) –a piece of iron when they remove it from the quarry/mine.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:2)


**חֲרָרָה.** לְאַחַר שֶׁמַּתִּיכִים הַבַּרְזֶל עוֹשִׂים מִמֶּנּוּ עִגּוּל כְּמִין עוּגָה:


חררה (a ball of iron ore before it is smelted) – after they smelt the iron they make of it a round mold/loaf like a cake.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:3)


**סוֹבֵב שֶׁל גַּלְגַּל.** גַּלְגַּל הָעֲגָלָה שֶׁל עֵץ, עוֹשִׂים סְבִיבוֹ טַס שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל שֶׁלֹּא יִשָּׁבֵר בַּטְּרָשִׁים וּבַסְּלָעִים:


סובב על גלגל (the iron hoop of a wheel) – the wheel of a wagon of wood, they make around it a foil or other plating material of iron that won’t break on the stony/rugged ground or rocks.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:4)


**טַסִּין.** וַיְרַקְּעוּ אֶת פַּחֵי הַזָּהָב (שמות לט), מְתַרְגְּמִינַן וְרַדִּידוּ יַת טַסֵּי דְּדַהֲבָא:


טסין (foil, plate) –(Exodus 39:3): “They hammered out sheets of gold,” which we translate into Aramaic: “And they beat out/hammer foils of gold.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:5)


**כַּנֵּי כֵלִים.** בְּסִיסֵי כֵלִים. לְשׁוֹן וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ (שם), דִּמְתַרְגְּמִינַן וְיַת בְּסִיסֵיהּ:


כני כלים – the bases of utensils. The language of "את כנו" /”and its stand” (Exodus 30:28), which we translate into Aramaic, “and its stand.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:6)


**הוֹגְנֵי כֵלִים.** כְּמִין עֲנָק סְבִיבוֹת שְׂפַת הַכֵּלִים:


הוגני כלים (basin/אוגני of vessels) – like a necklace/chain that surrounds the rim of the vessels.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:7)


**אָזְנֵי כֵלִים.** בֵּית יָד שֶׁאוֹחֲזִים בּוֹ הַכְּלִי:


אזני כלים – handle that they grab hold of the vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:8)


**הַשְּׁחוֹלוֹת.** מַה שֶּׁנִּשְׁתַּיֵּר מִן הַכְּלִי לְאַחַר שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה. לְשׁוֹן כְּמִשְׁחַל בִּינִיתָא מֵחֲלָבָא (ברכות דף ח.) כִּי מִן הַמַּיִם מְשִׁיתִהוּ (שמות ב), מְתַרְגְּמִינַן אֲרֵי מִן מַיָּא שְׁחַלְתֵּיהּ:


השחלת (metal filings/shavings) – what remains from the vessel after it is made. The language of כמשחל בניתא מחלבא/(One’s death is like) drawing out hair from milk – /in Berakhot 8a and we translate [into Aramaic the passage](Exodus 2:10): “I drew him (Moses) out of the water,” I drew out the lion from the water.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:9)


**גְּרוּדוֹת.** שֶׁנִּגְרַד מִן הַכְּלִי בִּשְׁעַת עֲשִׂיָּתוֹ. לְשׁוֹן לְהִתְגָּרֵד בּוֹ הָאָמוּר בְּאִיּוֹב (פרק ב):


גרודות – that is scraped from the utensil at the time that it is made. The language is stated from Job 2:8): "[ויקח-לו חרש] להתגרר בו [ישב התוך-האפר]."/”[He took a potsherd] to scratch himself [as he sat in ashes].”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:10)


**טְהוֹרִים.** דְּלֹא חָיְשִׁינַן בְּכָל הָנֵי שֶׁמָּא מִכְּלִי טָמֵא בָאוּ וּכְשֶׁחָזַר וְעָשָׂה מֵהֶן כְּלִי חָזְרוּ לְטֻמְאָתָן יְשָׁנָה, דְּכָל הָנֵי לֹא נִרְאוּ לְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה מֵעוֹלָם, מִשּׁוּם דְּגָלְמֵי כְלֵי מַתָּכוֹת נִינְהוּ, וְגָלְמֵי כְלֵי מַתָּכוֹת אֵין מְקַבְּלִין טֻמְאָה. וְהָכִי תַנְיָא בַּתּוֹסֶפְתָּא, גָּלְמֵי כְלֵי מַתָּכוֹת טְהוֹרִים, וְאֵלּוּ הֵן גָּלְמֵי כְלֵי מַתָּכוֹת, כָּל שֶׁעָתִיד לָשׁוּף, לְשַׁבֵּץ, לְגָרֵד, וּלְכַרְכֵּב, וּלְהָקִישׁ בְּקֻרְנָס, מְחֻסָּר אֹגֶן אוֹ אֹזֶן, טָהוֹר:


טהורים – for we are not concerned in all of these that perhaps they came from an impure vessel and he returned and made from them [another] vessel, they returned to their earlier defilement, for all of these did not appear to be able to receive defilement ever, because they are unfinished vessels [lacking a receptacle], and unfinished metal vessels are not susceptible to receive defilement. And this is taught in the Tosefta (see Tosafot Yom Tov on this entry which referred me to Kelim Bava Metzia 2:17: “And what are the unfinished wooden objects which are unclean? Whatever one is destined to smooth, to scrape, to hollow out or to plane. [If] they lacked a cup, a border, an ear, or a hand, they are unclean. [If] they lacked hollowing, they are clean” (see also Tractate Kelim, Chapter 12, Mishnah 8). And which are those unfinished metal vessels? That which are destined to smooth, to adorn with designs, to scrape/plane, to make a rim by hollowing out the center/rounding off, and to beat with a mallet, that which is missing a chain surrounding the rim of the vessel or a handle is pure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:11)


**אַף מִן הַקְּצוּצוֹת.** אִם קָצַץ כֵּלִים לַחֲתִיכוֹת, כֵּלִים הַנַּעֲשִׂים מֵאוֹתָן חֲתִיכוֹת לֹא חָזְרוּ לְטֻמְאָתָן יְשָׁנָה. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן בֶּן נוּרִי:


אף מן הקצוצות (even from the cut metal, strip, wire) – if he cut the vessels in pieces, the vessels that are made from those pieces did not return to their earlier defilement. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yohanan ben Nuri.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:12)


**גְּרוּטָאוֹת.** כֵּלִים שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּבְּרוּ מִפְּנֵי תַשְׁמִישָׁן וְנַעֲשָׂה בָּהֶן חֲתִיכוֹת קְטַנּוֹת אַחֲרֵי בְלוֹתָן נִקְרָאִים גְּרוּטוֹת. וְהֵן קְטַנִּים מִשִּׁבְרֵי כֵלִים:


גרוטאות – vessels that were broken because of their usage and were made into small pieces after their aging are called גרוטות /fragments of vessels. But they are smaller than shards of vessels/shattered iron.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:13)


**וּמִן הַמַּסְמְרוֹת שֶׁיָּדוּעַ שֶׁנַּעֲשׂוּ מִכֵּלִים.** אַף עַל גַּב דְּלֹא יָדְעִינַן אִם מִכֵּלִים טְהוֹרִים בָּאוּ אוֹ מִן הַטְּמֵאִין:


ומן המסמרות שידוע שנעשו מכלים (and from nails known to have been made from other vessels) – even though we don’t know if they came from pure vessels or from the impure ones.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:14)


**טְמֵאִין.** טְמֵאִים הַכֵּלִים הַנַּעֲשִׂים מֵהֶם. דְּחָיְשִׁינַן שֶׁמָּא מִכֵּלִים טְמֵאִין בָּאוּ וְחָזְרוּ לְטֻמְאָתָן הַיְשָׁנָה:


טמאין – the vessels made from them are impure, for we are concerned that perhaps they came from impure vessels and returned to their former state of impurity.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:15)


**מִן הַמַּסְמְרוֹת.** סְתָם. דְּלֹא יָדְעִינַן אִם נַעֲשׂוּ מִכֵּלִים אוֹ מִן הָעֶשֶׁת:


מן המסמרות – undefined. That we don’t know if they were made from utensils or from the wrought iron.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:16)


**בֵּית שַׁמַּאי מְטַמְּאִין.** דְּגָזְרוּ הָנֵי אַטּוּ הָנֵי:


בית שמאי מטמאין – that they decreed that these are on account of those.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:3:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:3:17)


**וּבֵית הִלֵּל מְטַהֲרִין.** דְּלֹא גָזְרוּ:


ובית הלל מטהרין – that they didn’t decree.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:1)


**בַּרְזֶל טָמֵא.** שֶׁבָּא מִשִּׁבְרֵי כֵלִים:


ברזל טמא – that came from shards of vessels.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:2)


**שֶׁבְּלָלוֹ.** שֶׁטְּרָפָן זֶה בָזֶה וְהִתִּיכָן וְעָשָׂה מִשְּׁנֵיהֶם כְּלִי:


שבללו – that he mixed/scraped with each other and smelt them and made from both of them a vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:3)


**בַּרְזֶל טָהוֹר.** שֶׁבָּא מִן הָעֶשֶׁת וּמִן הַחֲרָרָה וְכוּ':


ברזל טהור – that came from the wrought iron or from the ball of iron ore, etc.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:4)


**אִם רֹב מִן הַטָּמֵא טָמֵא.** דְּחוֹזֵר לְטֻמְאָתוֹ הַיְשָׁנָה:


אם רוב מן הטמא טמא – that it returns to its original impurity.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:4:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:5)


**הַחֲלָמָא.** טִיט הַדָּבֵק כְּלֹבֶן בֵּיצָה:


חלמא (a sort of cement used for making vessels) – plaster that cleaves like the white of an egg.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:4:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:6)


**וּמִן הַגְּלָלִים.** שֶׁעֵרֵב הַטִּיט עִם גְּלָלֵי הַבָּקָר וְעָשָׂה מֵהֶן כֵּלִים וּצְרָפָן בַּכִּבְשָׁן. אִם רֹב מִן הַחֲלָמָא. מְקַבְּלִים טֻמְאָה כְּדִין כְּלֵי חֶרֶס. וְאִם רֹב מִן הַגְּלָלִים, טְהוֹרִים, דִּכְלֵי גְלָלִים אֵין מְקַבְּלִין טֻמְאָה:


ומן הגללים – that he combined the plaster with the excrement of cattle and made from them vessels and smelt them in a furnace/kiln. If a majority are from a sort of cement used for making vessels. For utensils of excrement are not susceptible to receive defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:4:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:7)


**קְלוֹסְטְרָא.** הַנֶּגֶר שֶׁל הַדֶּלֶת. וְהוּא הַיָּתֵד שֶׁנּוֹעֲלִים בּוֹ הַדֶּלֶת כִּדְפָרֵישְׁנָא לְעֵיל, רְגִילִים לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּרֹאשׁוֹ כְמִין תַּפּוּחַ, וְהוּא נִקְרָא גְלוֹסְטְרָא. וְאִם נַעֲשָׂה מִבַּרְזֶל טָמֵא, חוֹזֵר לְטֻמְאָתוֹ הַיְשָׁנָה, לְפִי שֶׁרָאוּי לָדוּךְ בּוֹ שׁוּמִין בִּמְדוֹכָה:


קלוסטרא (fastening, lock/bar) – the door-bolt/pin of the door. And it is a peg that they lock the door with as was explained above, it is customary to make at its head like a kind of apple/door-bolt and it is called a גלוסטרא. But if it was made from iron, it is impure, as it returns to its original state of impurity, because it is appropriate to crush the garlic in the mortar.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:4:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:8)


**וּמְצֻפָּה טְהוֹרָה.** אִם הָיְתָה שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל טָהוֹר וּמְצֻפָּה שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת טָמֵא, טְהוֹרָה, דְּבָתַר עִקָּרָא אָזְלִינַן וְלֹא בָתַר הַצִּפּוּי שֶׁהוּא שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת טָמֵא:


מצפה טהורה (plated wood with metal) – if it was from pure iron and covered with impure metal, it is pure, for we follow after that which is essential but not after the covering that is of impure metal.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:4:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:9)


**הַפִּין וְהַפּוּרְנָא.** שִׁנַּיִם הַקְּבוּעִים בַּפּוֹתַחַת, וְהַפִּין נִכְנָס בְּתוֹךְ הַפּוּרְנָא:


הפין והפורנא (pivots and the skeleton-key /clutch and cross-piece) – the fixed teeth in the lock (i.e., socket and pivot) and the pivot goes into the lock.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:4:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:4:10)


**שׁוֹמְטָהּ מִפֶּתַח זֶה וְתוֹלָהּ בַּחֲבֵרוֹ.** עַל יְדֵי גְרִירָה בִלְבַד, דְּטִלְטוּל מִן הַצַּד הוּא. אֲבָל טִלְטוּל גָּמוּר, לֹא. וְרַבִּי טַרְפוֹן שָׁרֵי אֲפִלּוּ טִלְטוּל גָּמוּר כִּי אָרְחֵיהּ. וְשֶׁמָּא אֲתָא תַנָּא לְאַשְׁמְעִינַן הָכָא דִקְלוֹסְטְרָא טְמֵאָה דִתְנַן בָּרֵישָׁא לָאו דִּבְרֵי הַכֹּל הִיא אֶלָּא פְּלֻגְתָּא דְרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְרַבִּי טַרְפוֹן, דִּלְרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ טְהוֹרָה, דְּכִי הֵיכִי דְלָא מְשַׁוֵּי לַהּ מָנָא לְעִנְיַן שַׁבָּת הָכִי נַמִּי לֹא מְשַׁוֵּי לַהּ מָנָא לְעִנְיַן טֻמְאָה:


שומטה מפתח זה ותולה בחבירו – through dragging alone, for it is carrying from the side. But complete carrying is not [permitted]. But Rabbi Tarfon permits even complete carrying like his guest, but perhaps the Tanna comes to teach us that here, with the impure lock that is taught in the first clause of the Mishnah, is not the opinion of all but rather the dispute between Rabbi Yehoshua and Rabbi Tarfon, for according to Rabbi Yehoshua it is pure, for in order that he does not compare it [to a vessel] with regard to the Sabbath, so here too, he does not compare it [to a vessel] with regard to defilement.



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:5:1)


**עַקְרָב שֶׁל פְּרֻמְבְּיָא.** מֶתֶג וָרֶסֶן וּפְרֻמְבְּיָא, אֶחָד הֵן. וְהַבַּרְזֶל הַנִּכְנָס בְּפִי הַבְּהֵמָה נִקְרָא עַקְרָב:


עקרב של פרומביא (bit of the halter/bridle) – reins and the bridle and the halter are one thing. And the iron that enters in the mouth of the animal is called the עקרב/bit.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 11:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/11:5:2)


**וּלְחָיַיִם.** מְחֻבָּרִים לָעַקְרָב כְּמִין שְׁנֵי טַסִּין מְצֻיָּרִים, אֶחָד מִכָּאן וְאֶחָד מִכָּאן עַל לְחָיֵי הַבְּהֵמָה, עֲשׂוּיִין לְנוֹי. וְהֵן טְהוֹרִין כְּשֶׁהֵן בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָן, דְּתַכְשִׁיטֵי בְהֵמָה נִינְהוּ, וְתַכְשִׁיטֵי בְהֵמָה וְכֵלִים אֵין מְקַבְּלִים טֻמְאָה:


ולחיים (the cheeks) – that are attached to the bit like two embroidered foils, one from here and one from there on the cheeks of the animal that are made for beauty.
