**שֶׁל מִתּוּחַ.** אִם הִתְקִינָהּ לִמְתֹּחַ בָּהּ שְׂפַת הַבֶּגֶד כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁהָאוֹרְגִים עוֹשִׂים:


של מתוח – if he prepared to stretch with it the rim of the cloth in the manner that the weavers do.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:5:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:5:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:5:7)


**בֵּין כָּךְ וּבֵין כָּךְ טְמֵאָה.** שֶׁהֲרֵי הִיא רְאוּיָה לִמְתֹּחַ בְּלֹא עֻקְצָהּ וּבְלֹא חֲרִירָהּ:


בין כך ובין כך טמאה – for it is appropriate for stretching without its point and without its eye [of the needle].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:5:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:5:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:5:8)


**אִם מְעַכֶּבֶת אֶת הַתְּפִירָה.** שֶׁאֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לִתְפֹּר בָּהּ מִפְּנֵי הַחֲלֻדָּה. וְיֵשׁ מְפָרְשִׁים, דְּכָל זְמַן שֶׁרֹשֶׁם הַחֲלֻדָּה נִכֶּרֶת בַּבֶּגֶד, הַיְנוּ עִכּוּב הַתְּפִירָה, טְהוֹרָה, דְּהָכִי מַשְׁמַע בְּפֶרֶק בַּמֶּה בְּהֵמָה [שַׁבָּת דַּף נב]:


אם מעכבת את התפירה – that he is unable to sew with it because of the rust. But there are those who interpret, all the while that the rust makes a known impression in the cloth, that is the delaying of sewing, and it is ritually pure, and this is implied in the Chapter [Five of Tractate Shabbat], “With what does a beast [go out on the Sabbath – folio 52b].”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:5:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:5:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:5:9)


**צִנּוֹרָא.** מַזְלֵג קָטָן עָקֹם בְּרֹאשׁוֹ, וּרְגִילִין לְהַפֵּךְ בּוֹ בָשָׂר עַל גַּבֵּי גֶחָלִים. וְיֵשׁ מֵהֶן קְטַנִּים שֶׁמּוֹחֲטִין בָּהֶן פְּתִילוֹת וּמְקַנְּחִים בָּהֶן נֵרוֹת. וּכְשֶׁפְּשָׁטָהּ הָוֵי כְמַחַט שֶׁנִּטַּל חֲרִירָהּ וְעֻקְצָהּ, וּטְהוֹרָה:


צנורא – a curved small fork at its head and it is customary to turn over the meat with it over the coals, but some of them are small that they trim the wicks with them and cleanse/wipe off the candles. But when it is straightened/flattened it is like a needle whose needle-eye or point is removed and it is ritually pure.



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:6:1)


**וְהַפִּין.** שִׁנַּיִם שֶׁל מַפְתֵּחַ שֶׁבָּהֶן פּוֹתְחִים הַדֶּלֶת. וְצוּרַת זֶה הַמַּפְתֵּחַ יָדוּעַ בְּמַלְכוּת מִצְרַיִם וּבְכָל אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל:


הפין (bit of a key) – the teeth of a key with which they open the door. And this form of this key is known in the Egyptian kingdom and throughout the land of Israel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:6:2)


**אֲפִלּוּ אַחַת טְמֵאָה.** וְאַף עַל גַּב דְּהַשִּׁנַּיִם בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָן בְּלֹא פוֹתַחַת טְהוֹרִים, קְבָעָן בַּפּוֹתַחַת טְמֵאִים, מִכָּל מָקוֹם הַשִּׁנַּיִם חֲשׁוּבִים עִקָּר וְהַפּוֹתַחַת מְשַׁמֶּשֶׁת:


אפילו אחת טמאה – and even though that the teeth on their own without a lock are ritually pure, they (i.e., the Sages) established it that with a lock they are ritually impure , nevertheless the teeth are considered as essential and the lock serves [the teeth].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:6:3)


**אַלְמוֹג.** קוראל"י בְּלַעַ"ז, וְהוּא צוֹמֵחַ בִּמְצוּלַת יָם, וּתְחִלָּתוֹ רַךְ קֹדֶם שֶׁיַּקְפִּאֵהוּ הָאֲוִיר, וּמְפַתְּחִים בּוֹ חוֹתָם. וּבַמִּקְרָא, עֲצֵי אַלְמֻגִּים:


אלמוג (coral- a species of cedar tree) – KORALI in the foreign language, and it grows in the depth of the sea. And its beginning is soft prior to the air making it float/become thick and they open with it something sealed. And in Scripture, it is עצי אלמוגים (I Kings 10:11): “[Moreover, Hiram’s fleet, which carried gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir a huge quanity] of almog wood/sandalwood [and precious stones].”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:6:4)


**הַשֵּׁן שֶׁבַּטַּס.** לֹא דָמֵי לְפִין שֶׁל פּוֹתַחַת, שֶׁהַשֵּׁן מְשַׁמֶּשֶׁת בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ, מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן בְּפִין, הִלְכָּךְ טְמֵאָה בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ:


השן שבטס (the key-ward fastened to a thin plate) – it is not similar to the bit of a key of that which opens for the tooth is used on its own, what is not the case with the bit of the key. Therefore, it is ritually impure on its own.



### Mishnah 7

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:7:1)


**הַכַּדּוּמִין.** עֵץ גָּדוֹל אָרֹךְ וְיוֹצְאִים מִמֶּנּוּ אֻנְקְלָיוֹת אֵילָךְ וָאֵילָךְ, וְתוֹלִין בְּאוֹתָן אֻנְקְלָיוֹת צְלוֹחִיּוֹת שֶׁל מַיִם בָּאֲוִיר כְּדֵי לְצַנְּנָן. וְרַמְבַּ"ם פֵּרֵשׁ, כְּמִין זֵר וְאֻנְקְלָיוֹת סְבִיבוֹתָיו וּבוֹ מַעֲלִין הַכֵּלִים שֶׁנָּפְלוּ לַבּוֹר:


הכדומין (a sort of lever with which a pitcher is fished out of the wall/grappling iron) – a big long piece of wood and hooks come out from it here and there and they suspend on those hooks flasks of water in the air in order to cool them off. But Maimonides explained, that is a kind of seed-pot with hooks all around them and on it they raise the utensils that fell into the pit.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:7:2)


**הָאַשְׁקְלוֹנִין.** שֶׁנַּעֲשִׂים בְּאַשְׁקְלוֹן:


האשקלונין – that are made in Ashkelon.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:7:3)


**הַמַּעְבֵּר וְהַמַּזְרֶה וְהַמָּגוֹג.** כֵּלִים עֲשׂוּיִן לְנַקּוֹת הַתְּבוּאָה מִן הַתֶּבֶן וּלְהַעֲבִיר הַתֶּבֶן מִמָּקוֹם לְמָקוֹם. הַמַּעְבֵּר יֵשׁ לוֹ שִׁנַּיִם וְדוֹמֶה לְיָד שֶׁל בְּנֵי אָדָם, וּבוֹ מַעֲבִירִין הַתֶּבֶן מִמָּקוֹם לְמָקוֹם. וְהַמַּזְרֶה בוֹ זוֹרִין הַחִטִּין בַּגֹּרֶן, לְפִיכָךְ נִקְרָא מַזְרֶה, וְשִׁנָּיו מְרֻבּוֹת מִשִּׁנֵּי הַמַּעְבֵּר. וְהַמָּגוֹג, שִׁנָּיו מְרֻבּוֹת מִשִּׁנֵּי הַמַּזְרֶה, וּבוֹ בוֹרְרִים הַתְּבוּאָה אַחַר שֶׁזָּרוּ אוֹתָהּ בַּמַּזְרֶה:


המעבר והמזרה ומגוב (pitchfork – for the first stage of winnowing – passing the grain from one side to the other; winnowing fan; rake – an agricultural implement with many teeth, forming a sort of sieve to separate the grain from the chaff) – utensils that are made to clean the grain from the straw and to transfer the straw from place ot place. The pitchfork/המעבר has teeth and it is similar to the hand of humans, and with it, they transfer the straw from place to place. And the winnowing fan they winnow the wheat in the granary/threshing floor , therefore it is called a מזרה/winnowing fan, and its teeth are greater in umber than the teeth of the pitchfork. And the מגוב/rake has even more teeth than that of the winnowing fan, and with it, they separate/sift the grain after they winnowed it with the winnowing fan.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:7:4)


**דָּבָר חָדָשׁ חִדְּשׁוּ סוֹפְרִים.** רְאוּיִין הָיוּ לִהְיוֹת טְהוֹרִים, דִּפְשׁוּטֵי כְלֵי עֵץ נִינְהוּ, וּמִשּׁוּם שֵׁן אַחַת שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת לֹא נָחֲתָא לְהוּ טֻמְאָה:


דבר חדש חידשו סופרים – they were appropriate to be ritually pure, for they are straight/flat wooden vessels, but because of one metal tooth, they were not put down as defiled.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:7:5)


**וְאֵין לִי מַה לְהָשִׁיב.** מִפְּנֵי מָה אָמְרוּ כֵן:


ואין לי מה להשיב – for what reason did they say this [to the critics].



### Mishnah 8

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:1)


**מַסְרֵק שֶׁל פִּשְׁתָּן.** יֵשׁ לוֹ שִׁנַּיִם מְרֻבּוֹת כְּעֵין מְחָטִים אֲרֻכִּים תְּחוּבִים בָּעֵץ, וּבוֹ סוֹרְקִים הַפִּשְׁתָּן:


מסרק של פשתן – it has multiple teeth like long needles that are inserted in wood, and through it, they comb the flax.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:2)


**וְנִשְׁתַּיֵּר בּוֹ שְׁתַּיִם טָמֵא.** אִם לֹא נִשְׁתַּיְּרוּ בוֹ אֶלָּא שְׁתֵּי שִׁנַּיִם בִּלְבַד, טָמֵא הַמַּסְרֵק, דְּאַכַּתִּי חֲזוּ לִמְלַאכְתָּן:


ונשתייר בו שתים טמא – if there did not remain on it anything other than two teeth alone, the comb is ritually impure, for it is still worthy for their work.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:3)


**אַחַת אַחַת בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָן טְמֵאוֹת.** כָּל שֵׁן וָשֵׁן בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ שֶׁנִּטְּלָה מִן הַמַּסְרֵק, טְמֵאָה, דְּחַזְיָא לִכְתֹּב בָּהּ בְּפִנְקָס שֶׁל שַׁעֲוָה:


אחת אחת בפני עצמו טמאות – each and every tooth on its own that had been removed from the comb is ritually impure, for it is worthy to write with it in a wax tablet.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:4)


**וְשֶׁל צֶמֶר.** מַסְרֵק שֶׁל צֶמֶר:


ושל צמר – a wool comb.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:5)


**אַחַת מִבֵּינְתַיִם.** שֶׁמִּכָּל שָׁלֹשׁ הַסְּמוּכוֹת נִטְּלָה הָאֶמְצָעִית, תּוּ לֹא חֲזִי:


אחת מבינתיים – from every three adjacent [teeth], the middle one was removed, it furthermore is not worthy [for use].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:8:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:6)


**הָיְתָה הַחִיצוֹנָה אַחַת מֵהֶן טָהוֹר.** הַשֵּׁן הַחִיצוֹנָה שֶׁל הַמַּסְרֵק הִיא רְחָבָה וְאֵינָהּ רְאוּיָה לִסְרֹק בָּהּ, כְּעֵין הַחִיצוֹנָה שֶׁבְּמַסְרֵק הָרֹאשׁ שֶׁלָּנוּ, הִלְכָּךְ אִם הַחִיצוֹנָה אַחַת מִן הַשָּׁלֹשׁ שֶׁנִּשְׁאֲרוּ, טָהוֹר הַמַּסְרֵק, שֶׁאֵינָהּ רְאוּיָה לִסְרֹק בָּהּ שֶׁאֵין כָּאן אֶלָּא שְׁתֵּי שִׁנַּיִם:


היה החיצונה אחת מהן טהור – the outer tooth of the comb is wide and is not appropriate to comb with it, for it is like the outer [tooth] that is on the head of our com, therefore, if the outer [tooth] is one from the three that remained, the comb is ritualluy pure, for it is not appropriate to comb with it for there are only two teeth here.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:8:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:7)


**וַעֲשָׂאָן לְמַלְקֶטֶת.** לִלְקֹט בָּהֶן אֶת הַשֵּׂעָר:


ועשאן למלקטת (he makes use of them as pinchers) – to gather the hair in them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:8:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:8)


**וְהִתְקִינָהּ לְנֵר.** לְהוֹצִיא בָהּ הַפְּתִילָה וּלְהֵיטִיב בָּהּ אֶת הַנֵּר:


והתקינה לנר – to remove the wick and/or to cleanse the lamp through it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 13:8:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/13:8:9)


**וּלְמִתּוּחַ.** גָּרְסִינַן. כְּלוֹמַר לִמְתֹּחַ בָּהּ שְׂפַת הַבֶּגֶד כְּדֶרֶךְ הָאוֹרְגִים [שֶׁתּוֹחֲבִים] מַחַט בִּשְׂפַת הַבֶּגֶד כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּמָּתְחוּ שִׂפְתוֹתֶיהָ:


ולמיתוח (stretching pin) – We have the reading [מיתוח], that is to stretch the rim of he cloth in the manner of the weavers who [insert] a needle in the rim of the cloth in order that they can stretch its rims.



## Chapter 14


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:1)


**כְּלֵי מַתָּכוֹת.** שֶׁנִּתְרוֹעֲעוּ וְנִשְׁבְּרוּ:


כלי מתכות – that became defective/cracked or broken.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:2)


**כַּמָּה הוּא שִׁעוּרָן.** כַּמָּה יִהְיֶה שִׁעוּר הַשֶּׁבֶר הַנִּשְׁאָר מֵהֶן וְיִקָּרֵא עוֹשֶׂה מֵעֵין מְלַאכְתּוֹ וְיִהְיוּ חֲשׁוּבִים כֵּלִים לִטַּמֵּא:


כמה הוא שיעורן – how much will be the measurement of the break/fracture that remains from them and that he can call it that it is doing of the nature of its labor and will be considered as vessels to be [susceptible to be] made impure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:3)


**מֵחַם.** שֶׁמְּחַמְּמִין בּוֹ מַיִם. וְהוּא גָּדוֹל מִקֻּמְקוּם:


מיחם (usually, a vessel for heating water – but here used for keeping coins in it – see Tosefta Bava Metziah 4:1) – that they warm up water in it. But it is larger than a kettle.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:4)


**כְּדֵי לְקַבֵּל סְלָעִים.** שֶׁכָּל סֶלַע אַרְבָּעָה דִינָרִין:


כדי לקבל סלעים – for each Selah is four denarim.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:5)


**הַלֶּבֶס.** אִית דְּגָרְסֵי הַלֶּפֶס. וְהוּא כְלִי נְחֹשֶׁת גָּדוֹל שֶׁמַּרְתִּיחִים בְּתוֹכוֹ מַיִם וְנוֹתְנִים בּוֹ קִיתוֹנוֹת קְטַנִּים לְהָדִיחָן בְּתוֹכוֹ:


הלבס (a cauldron) – And there those who have the reading הלפס . And it is a larger copper vessel that they boil water in it and place in it small ladles to rinse them in it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:6)


**כֻּלָּן בִּפְרוּטוֹת.** כֻּלָּן מְשַׁעֲרִים אִם יֵשׁ בַּשֶּׁבֶר שֶׁלָּהֶן כְּדֵי לְקַבֵּל פְּרוּטוֹת. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר:


כולן בפרוטות – in all of them they estimate if they have in their crack/broken part enough to receive coins. But the Halakha did not according to Rabbi Eliezer.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:7)


**הַמְחֻסָּר הֲגָפָה טָמֵא.** רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא מַיְרֵי בִּתְחִלַּת עֲשִׂיָּתָן שֶׁל כֵּלִים, וְקָאָמַר, דְּכֵלִים הַמְחֻסָּרִים הַכִּסּוּי שֶׁלָּהֶן, טְמֵאִין, דְּמִקְּרוּ נִגְמְרָה מְלַאכְתָּן. הֲגָפָה, מִלְּשׁוֹן יָגִיפוּ הַדְּלָתוֹת (נחמיה ז). וְהַרְבֵּה יֵשׁ בַּמִּשְׁנָה, כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּפְתַּח וְיִגֹּף וְתִגֹּב. אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁגָּפָן לֹא קָנָה דִּבְמַסֶּכֶת מַעְשֵׂר שֵׁנִי [פ"ג מי"ב], פֵּרוּשׁ, שֶׁכִּסָּה אוֹתָן בִּמְגוּפָה:


המחוסר הגפה טמא (missing the fragment of a vessel in order to be used/trimming) – Rabbi Akiva is speaking of the beginning of the formation of the vessels, and is speaking of, that vessels lacking their coverings are ritually impure, for they are called as having been completed for their usage. [The word] הגפה from the language (Nehemiah 7:3): “let the doors be closed and barred.” And there are many in the Mishnah [where this word appears – specifically in Tractate Avodah Zarah, Chapter 5, Mishnayot 3, 4 and 5]: “[time sufficient] to open [the jar] and stop it up and for the clay to dry.” Even if he corked them, he didn’t acquire them, that is in Tractate Maaser Sheni [Chapter 3, Mishnah 12], it explains, that he covered them with a bung/cork.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:1:8)


**וּמְחֻסָּר לְטִישָׁה טָהוֹר.** שֶׁהוּא חֲשׁוּב גָּלְמֵי כְלֵי מַתָּכוֹת שֶׁאֵינָן מְקַבְּלִין טֻמְאָה. לְטִישָׁה, לְשׁוֹן לֹטֵשׁ כָּל חֹרֵשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶל (בראשית ד):


ומחוסר לטישה טהור – that it is considered unfinished metal vessels that are not susceptible to receive ritual impurity. [The word] לטישה/hammering, furbishing, is the language of (Genesis 4:22): “who forged all implements of copper and iron.”



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:1)


**חַזְיָנָא.** נוֹהֲגִים לַעֲשׂוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הַמַּקֵּל כְּמִין תַּפּוּחַ שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל וְהוּא הַנִּקְרָא חַזְיָנָא. וְכָל עַבְדֵי מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם הַיּוֹם נוֹשְׂאִים בְּיָדָם מַקְלוֹת הַלָּלוּ, וְקוֹרִין לָהֶם אלדבו"ס. וּפְעָמִים שֶׁנּוֹעֲצִים בָּהֶם מַסְמְרִים כְּדֵי שֶׁיַּכּוּ בָּהֶם מַכָּה רַבָּה וְקָשָׁה:


חזינא (a cane with a metal knob) – it is the practice to make at the top of a staff [something] like a ball of iron and it is called a חזינא. And all the servants of the king of Egypt today carry in their hands these staffs. And we call them ALDBOM in Arabic. But sometimes when they stick in them nails, in order that they would strike with them a hard and mighty blow.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:2)


**שְׁלֹשָׁה סְדָרִים.** שֶׁל מַסְמְרִים, וְאָז חֲשׁוּב כְּלִי. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן:


שלשה סדרים – [three rows] of nails, and then it is considered a vessel. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Shimon.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:3)


**עֲשָׂאָן לְנוֹי.** כְּגוֹן שֶׁעֲשָׂאוֹ בְמַסְמְרִים דַּקִּים מְצֻיָּרִים כְּדֵי לְיַפּוֹת אֶת הַמַּקֵּל:


שעשאן לנוי (which one affixed for ornament) – as for example, that he made it with thin, sculpted nails in order to make the staff beautiful.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:4)


**טָהוֹר.** דַּהֲוֵי מַתֶּכֶת הַמְשַׁמֵּשׁ אֶת הָעֵץ, דִּתְנַן לְעֵיל שֶׁהוּא טָהוֹר. אֲבָל כְּשֶׁעֲשָׂאוֹ לְהַכּוֹת וְלַחְבֹּט, הֲרֵי עֵץ מְשַׁמֵּשׁ אֶת הַמַּתֶּכֶת וְטָמֵא:


טהור – it is metal that serves the wood, as it is taught above [Tractate Kelim, Chapter 13, Mishnah 6: “metal that serves the wood] is pure.” But when he made them to beat and/or to strike, this is wood that serves the metal, and it is ritually impure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:5)


**מְנִיקָת.** כְּמִין שְׁפוֹפֶרֶת שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת, וְהִכְנִיס בָּהּ אֶת הַמַּקֵּל:


מניקת (metal siphon) – like a kind of metal tube and inserted the staff in it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:6)


**וְכֵן בַּדֶּלֶת.** תַּחַת הַדֶּלֶת כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא תֹאכְלֶנָּה הָאָרֶץ:


וכן בדלת – under the door in order that it not eat into the ground.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:7)


**הָיְתָה כְלִי.** הָיְתָה שְׁפוֹפֶרֶת זוֹ כְּלִי בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ וְחִבְּרָהּ לְמַקֵּל וְאַחַר שֶׁחִבְּרָהּ רָאוּי לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בָּהּ בִּכְלִי:


היתה כלי – that this tube was a vessel on its own, and he attached it to the staff and after that it was attached, it is appropriate to use it as a vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:2:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:8)


**טְמֵאָה.** מְקַבֶּלֶת טֻמְאָה, וּטְמֵאָה כְּמוֹ שֶׁהָיְתָה:


[טמאה – it is susceptible to receive ritual impurity, and it is impure as it was].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:2:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:9)


**מֵאֵימָתַי הִיא טָהֳרָתָהּ.** מְנִיקָת שֶׁנִּטְמְאָה מֵאֵימָתַי תִּטְהַר וְתֵצֵא מִידֵי טֻמְאָתָהּ:


מאימתי היא טהרתה – the metal siphon that was defiled, from when does it become pure and leaves its [state of] defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:2:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:10)


**מִשֶּׁיְּחַבֵּל.** מִשֶּׁיַּשְׁחִיתֶנָּה וְיִפְחֹת צוּרָתָהּ:


משיחבל (from the moment he batters – the tube, for fitting it into the top of the staff) – from when he ruins it and lessens its form/shape.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:2:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:2:11)


**מִשֶּׁיְּחַבֵּר.** מִשֶּׁיְּחַבְּרֶנָּה בַדֶּלֶת אוֹ בַמַּקֵּל וְיִקְבְּעֶנָּה בְּמַסְמְרִים שֶׁלֹּא תְּשַׁמֵּשׁ עוֹד בִּכְלִי, כְּבָר בָּטַל שֵׁם כְּלִי מִמֶּנָּה וְיָצְאָה מִידֵי טֻמְאָתָהּ:


משיחבר – from when he attaches it to the door or to a staff and affixes it with nails, that it will no longer be used on the vessel, it has already cancelled the name of a vessel from it, and it has left its [state of] spiritual uncleanness.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:1)


**הַקַּנְטָר שֶׁל בַּנַּאי.** פֵּרְשׁוּ בּוֹ שֶׁהוּא שֵׁבֶט וּמַטֶּה שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל שֶׁהַבַּנָּאִים חוֹתְכִים בּוֹ אֶת הַכֹּתֶל:


הקנטר של בנאי (te builder’s pronged tool, bit or auger) – they explained it that it is a iron rod or staff that the builders cut the wall with.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:2)


**הַדָּקוֹר.** יָתֵד. כְּמוֹ יַחְפֹּר בַּדֶּקֶר וִיכַסֶּה דִּתְנַן בְּרֵישׁ פֶּרֶק קַמָּא דְבֵיצָה:


הדקור (the chisel of carpenters) – peg. Like “he would dig with a pronged tool/mattock and covers it up [i.e., the blood] as it is taught in the Mishnah in the first chapter of [Tractate] Betzah [Mishnah 2 – expressed by the School of Shammai].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:3)


**חָרָשׁ.** נַגָּר:


חרש – carpenter.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:4)


**יִתְדוֹת אֹהָלִים.** נוֹעֲצִים יְתֵדוֹת שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל בָּאָרֶץ וּמוֹתְחִים אֹהָלִים וְקוֹשְׁרִים מֵיתָרִים בַּיְתֵדוֹת. וְאֵין זֶה תַשְׁמִישׁוֹ עַל יְדֵי קַרְקַע, שֶׁהֲרֵי לְדָבָר הַמִּטַּלְטֵל הֵן מְשַׁמְּשִׁים:


יתדות אוהלים – they wedge-in iron pegs in the ground and extend/stretch tents and tie cords with pegs. But this is not usage via the ground, for it is for movables that hey are using it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:5)


**וְיִתְדוֹת הַמָּשׁוֹחוֹת.** מוֹדְדֵי הַקַּרְקַע לַחֲלֻקַּת אַחִים, נוֹעֲצִים יְתֵדוֹת בַּקַּרְקַע וְקוֹשְׁרִים בּוֹ חֶבֶל וּמוֹדְדִים:


ויתדות המשוחות (pegs of land measurers/surveyors) – measurers of the ground for the division for the brothers, they wedge-in pegs in the ground and tie a rope to them and measure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:6)


**שַׁלְשֶׁלֶת שֶׁל מָשׁוֹחוֹת טְמֵאָה.** לְפִי שֶׁבִּמְדִידַת הַחֶבֶל יֵשׁ עָוֶל. פְּעָמִים שֶׁמּוֹתֵחַ לָזֶה יוֹתֵר מִזֶּה, לְפִיכָךְ רְגִילִים לַעֲשׂוֹת שַׁלְשֶׁלֶת לִמְדֹּד בָּהּ:


שלשלת של משוחות טמאה (surveyors’ measuring chains) – since through the measuring of a cord there is perversion/fault. Sometimes that it stretches to this side more than to that, therefore, they regularly make a chain to measure it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:3:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:7)


**עֲשׂוּיָה לָעֵצִים.** לִקְשֹׁר בָּהּ חֲבִילָה שֶׁל עֵצִים, אוֹ לִמְדֹּד בָּהּ עֵצִים, שֶׁיֶּשׁ מְקוֹמוֹת שֶׁמּוֹכְרִים עֵצִים בְּמִדָּה מְלֹא חֶבֶל. וְהַשַּׁלְשֶׁלֶת הַמְיֻחֶדֶת לְכָךְ טְהוֹרָה, דְּהַוְיָא כְמַתֶּכֶת הַמְשַׁמֶּשֶׁת אֶת הָעֵץ:


עשויה לעצים – to tie with it a bundle of wood, or to measure wood with it, for there are places where they sell wood with the measurement of as much as cord. But the special chain for this is ritually pure, for it is metal that serves the wood.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:3:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:8)


**אַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים.** וְיוֹתֵר מִכֵּן לָא חֲשִׁיב יָד:


ארבעה טפחים – but more than this is not considered a handle.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:3:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:9)


**חֲמוֹר שֶׁל נַפָּחִים.** הָעֵץ שֶׁהַמַּפּוּחַ שֶׁל נַפָּחִים רוֹכֵב עָלָיו נִקְרָא חֲמוֹר. כָּךְ פֵּרְשׁוּהָ לִי רַבּוֹתַי. וּבְמָקוֹם אַחֵר מָצָאתִי שֶׁהוּא כְלִי בַרְזֶל כְּצוּרַת חֲמוֹר, וְהָאֻמָּן רוֹכֵב עַל הַקָּצֶה הָאֶחָד וּמַכֶּה עַל הַקָּצֶה הַשֵּׁנִי, וְעוֹשִׂים כָּךְ כְּשֶׁרוֹצִים לְהַכּוֹת עַל הַכֵּלִים הַגְּדוֹלִים שֶׁשְּׂפָתָן גְּבוֹהָה וּגְדוֹלָה מְאֹד:


חמור של נפחים (the smiths’ ass –on which the smith sits while using its head as an anvil) – the wood smithy rides upon is called a חמור. That is how my Rabbis explained it. But in another place I found that it is an iron vessel like the form of a donkey, and the artisan rides upon one end and beats/strikes the other end, and they do this when they want to strike all the large vessels whose rims are tall and very large.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:3:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:10)


**מְגֵרָה.** הַמַּסָּר שֶׁנּוֹסְרִים בָּהּ הַלּוּחוֹת, שֶׁנִּטְמֵאת, וְעָשָׂה שִׁנֶּיהָ בְּתוֹךְ הַחוֹר שֶׁל דֶּלֶת, לֹא יָצְאָה מִידֵי טֻמְאָה, וַהֲרֵי הִיא טְמֵאָה כְּמוֹ שֶׁהָיְתָה, עַד שֶׁיִּקְבְּעֶנָּה בַדֶּלֶת בְּמַסְמֵר. וְהָכִי מְפֹרָשׁ בַּתּוֹסֶפְתָּא:


מגרה (saw) – a tool with rough edges or teeth that they plane/saw boards with, that became defiled, and they put its teeth into the hole of the door, it did not leave its state of ritual impurity, for it is impure as it was, until they affix the door with a nail. And this is how it is explained in the Tosefta )Tractate Kelim Bava Metzia 4:10).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:3:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:11)


**עֲשָׂאָהּ מִלְּמַטָּה לְמַעְלָה.** שֶׁהֲפָכָהּ וּנְתָנָהּ הֲפוּכָה בְחוֹר הַדֶּלֶת:


עשאה מלמטה למעלה – that he revised it and placed it upside-down in the hole of the door.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:3:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:12)


**טְהוֹרָה.** אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁלֹּא קְבָעָהּ בְּמַסְמֵר:


טהורה – even though he did not affix it with a nail.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:3:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:13)


**כָּל הַכְּסוּיִן טְהוֹרִין.** לְפִי שֶׁאֵין לַכִּסּוּיִין שֵׁם בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָן:


כל הכיסויין טהורין – because the coverings do not have their own name.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:3:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:3:14)


**חוּץ מִשֶּׁל מֵחָם.** וְכָל כַּיּוֹצֵא בוֹ שֶׁיֶּשׁ לוֹ שֵׁם בִּפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ וּמִשְׁתַּמְּשִׁין בּוֹ בִּפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ, כְּמוֹ כִסּוּי טֶנִי שֶׁל רוֹפְאִים דִּתְנַן לְעֵיל פֶּרֶק טַבַּעַת אָדָם [מִשְׁנָה ג] דְּטָמֵא לְדִבְרֵי הַכֹּל, לְפִי שֶׁמַּנִּיחִין בוֹ סַמְמָנִים:


חוץ משל מיחם – and all those similar to it, that have a name of their own, and we use them on their own, like the covering of the physician’s medicine box as is taught above in [Tractate Kelim] Chapter 12 [Mishnah 3] “The Ring of the Man” which is ritually impure according to everyone, because it leaves dyes/artist’s materials.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:1)


**הָעֹל שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת טָמֵא.** דִּפְשׁוּטֵי כְלֵי מַתָּכוֹת מְקַבְּלִין טֻמְאָה:


העול של מתכת טמא – that flat metal vessels are susceptible to receive ritual impurity.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:2)


**קַטְרָב.** שְׁנֵי עֵצִים יֵשׁ, מִצַּד זֶה מִן הָעֹל וּמִצַּד זֶה מִן הָעֹל, וְהֵן נְקוּבִים, וּמַכְנִיסִין בְּתוֹךְ אוֹתוֹ נֶקֶב עֵץ וּשְׁמוֹ קַטְרָב, וְקוֹשְׁרִים אוֹתוֹ שֶׁלֹּא יִשָּׁמְטוּ הַבָּקָר. וְרַמְבַּ"ם פֵּרֵשׁ, שֶׁהַקַּטְרָב הוּא הָעֵץ שֶׁנִּמְשָׁךְ עַל שְׁנֵי צְדָדֵי הַבְּהֵמוֹת, וְהָעֹל בְּאֶמְצָעוֹ:


קטרב (a cross-piece in front of yoked animals or the pin fastening the ropes of the yokes to the poles) – there are two pieces of wood – from this side from the yoke and from that side from the yoke, and they are perforated, and they bring into that perforation a piece of wood which is called a קטרב, and they tie it so that they cattle will not be detached/loosened. But Maimonides explained, that a קטרב is wood hat that is stretched on the two sides of the animals, and the yoke is in the middle.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:3)


**וְהַכְּנָפַיִם.** הֵם שְׁנֵי קְצָווֹת שֶׁל קַטְרָב. מִלְּשׁוֹן עַל כַּנְפֵי בִגְדֵיהֶם. וְהֵם שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל:


והכנפיים (wings/side pieces that hold up the straps) – they are two ends of a קטרב. From the language of על כנפי בגדיהם/”on the corners of heir garments”(Numbers 15:38) and they are of iron.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:4)


**הַמְקַבְּלוֹת אֶת הָרְצוּעוֹת.** כְּלוֹמַר, אִם נַעֲשׂוּ הַקְּצָווֹת שֶׁל קַטְרָב לְקַבֵּל בָּהֶם אֶת הָרְצוּעוֹת, הֵן טְמֵאִים, שֶׁחֲשׁוּבִין כְּלִי. אֲבָל אִם נַעֲשׂוּ לְנוֹי, טְהוֹרִים, לְפִי שֶׁהִיא מַתֶּכֶת הַמְשַׁמֶּשֶׁת אֶת הָעֵץ:


המקבלות את הרצועות – that is to say, if the ends of the קרטב were made to receive the straps, they are ritually impure, for they are considered a vessel. But if they were made for adornment, they are ritually pure, because it is metal that is servicing the wood.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:4:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:5)


**וְהַבַּרְזֶל שֶׁתַּחַת צַוְּארֵי בְהֵמָה.** קוֹשְׁרִים עַל צַוְּארֵי בְהֵמָה בַּרְזֶל כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא תֵחָנֵק בַּחֶבֶל שֶׁקּוֹשְׁרִים בּוֹ הַקַּטְרָב:


והברזל שתחת צוארי בהמה – they tie iron on the necks of the animals in order that they should not choke with the cord that they tie upon it the קטרב.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:4:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:6)


**הַסּוֹמֵךְ.** יֵשׁ בְּאֶמְצַע הָעֹל כְּמִין טַבַּעַת גְּדוֹלָה וּבוֹ נִכְנָס רֹאשׁ הַמַּחְרֵשָׁה וְרֹאשׁ הָעֲגָלָה, וְאוֹתוֹ טַבַּעַת קָרוּי סוֹמֵךְ:


הסומך (the pin for attaching the pole to the wagon – or the ring suspended from the yoke and pulled over the front end of the pole) – in the middle of the yoke there is a kind of large ring, and through it enters the head of the plough/strigil and the head of the wagon, and that ring is called a סומך.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:4:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:7)


**מַחְגֵּר.** חֶבֶל שֶׁקּוֹשְׁרִים תַּחַת צַוַּאר הַשּׁוֹר. וְאִית דְּגָרְסֵי וְהַמַּסְגֵּר, וְהוּא יָתֵד [שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל] שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים בִּקְצֵה הָעֹל שֶׁלֹּא תִתְעַוֵּת הָעֲגָלָה מִפְּנֵי אֹרֶךְ הָעֹל:


מחגר (the rope around the neck of the animal tied to the wagon – or the prin fastening the yoke to the pole to prevent the wagon from vacillating) – a cord that they tie underneath the neck of the ox. And there are those who have the reading והמסגר (enclosure), and it is a peg that they place at the end of the yoke in order that the wagon not deteriorate/be perverted because of the length of the yoke.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:4:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:8)


**תַּמְחוּיוֹת.** כְּמִין קְעָרוֹת קְטַנּוֹת שֶׁל עֹל, וּקְרוּיִין תַּמְחוּיוֹת:


תמחויות (the partitions in a wagon for freight or baggage; a cavity in the yoke) – like a kind of small dishes of the yoke and they are called תמחויות.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:4:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:9)


**עִנְבָּל.** הוּא הַבַּרְזֶל הַמְקַשְׁקֵשׁ בְּתוֹךְ הַזּוֹג:


ענבל (clapper of a bell) – it is the iron that strikes within the body of the bell/clapper.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:4:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:10)


**צִנּוֹרָא.** אֻנְקְלִי שֶׁתּוֹחֲבִים בַּמַּשְּׂאוֹי שֶׁבָּעֲגָלָה שֶׁלֹּא יִפֹּל:


צנורא (hook, pin) – a hook that they insert in a load that is on the wagon so that it doesn’t fall.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:4:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:4:11)


**וּמַסְמֵר הַמְחַבֵּר אֶת כֻּלָּם.** כְּלוֹמַר, כָּל מַסְמֵר שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה לְחַבֵּר הַפְּרָקִין שֶׁל עֲגָלָה זוֹ בְּזוֹ. לַאֲפוֹקֵי הַמַּסְמְרִים שֶׁאֵינָן עֲשׂוּיִין לְחַבֵּר, אֶלָּא לְנוֹי. שֶׁאֵלּוּ אֵין מְטַמְּאִין:


ומסמר המחבר את כולם – that is to say, every nail that is made to attach the sections/links of the wagon one to the other. This excludes the nails that are not made to attach, but are only for adornment. For those do not defile.



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:1)


**הָעֹל הַמְצֻפֶּה.** בַּרְזֶל, טָהוֹר, לְפִי שֶׁהוּא מַתֶּכֶת שֶׁמְּשַׁמֵּשׁ אֶת הָעֵץ:


העול המצופה – [the yoke that is plated] with iron. It is ritually pure, because it is metal that services the wood.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:2)


**וּשְׁפוֹפָרוֹת.** כְּמִין שְׁפוֹפֶרֶת שֶׁל קָנֶה חָלוּל רְגִילִין לַעֲשׂוֹת מִמַּתָּכוֹת לְהַשְׁמִיעַ קוֹל:


ושפופרות – like a kind of tube of a hollow reed that they customarily make from metal to produce sound.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:3)


**וְהָאֲבָר.** עוֹפֶרֶת שֶׁנּוֹתְנִין בְּצַד צַוְּארֵי בְּהֵמָה לְנוֹי:


והאבר – lead that they place on the side of the neck of animals for adornment.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:4)


**וְהַסּוֹבֵב שֶׁל גַּלְגַּל.** גַּלְגַּל עֲגָלָה שֶׁל עֵץ עוֹשִׂים סְבִיבוֹתֶיהָ שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל שֶׁלֹּא יִשָּׁבֵר בַּטְּרָשִׁים וּבַסְּלָעִים:


והסובב של גלגל (the iron hoop of a wheel) – the wooden wheel of a wagon that they make surround it with iron so that it doesn’t break on crags and on rocks.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:5)


**טַסִּין.** לוּחוֹת דַּקּוֹת. פַּחֵי הַזָּהָב, מְתַרְגְּמִינַן טַסֵּי דְדַהֲבָא:


טסין – small boards. Golden plates and we translate it in Aramaic as golden plates.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:5:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:6)


**סַנְדְּלֵי בְהֵמָה שֶׁל מַתָּכוֹת טְמֵאִין.** לְפִי שֶׁעֲשׂוּיִין לִשְׁתּוֹת בָּהֶן אַנְשֵׁי הַחַיִל בַּמִּלְחָמָה:


סנדל בהמה של מתכות טמאין – because they are made to have the fighting men drink from them during war.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:5:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:7)


**שַׁעַם.** מִין גֶּמִי:


שעם (bamboo) – a kind of reed-grass/bulrushes.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:5:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:8)


**הַסַּיִף מֵאֵימָתַי מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה.** בְּסַיִף שֶׁהֶעֱלָה חֲלֻדָּה מַיְרֵי, שֶׁהוּא טָהוֹר. וּמֵאֵימָתַי מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה:


הסייף מאימתי מקבל טומאה – we are speaking of a sword that was brought up rust/mold, which is ritually pure, but when is it susceptible to receive ritual defilement?


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:5:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:9)


**מִשֶּׁיְּשׁוּפֶנּוּ.** כְּלִי יֵשׁ לְצוֹרְפִין וּלְחָרָשֵׁי בַרְזֶל שֶׁקָּרוּי הַצּוֹרְפִים בִּלְשׁוֹן מִקְרָא, וְתַרְגּוּמוֹ שׁוּפִינָא, וּבוֹ שָׁפִין וּמַחֲלִיקִין אֶת הַכֵּלִים שֶׁהֶעֱלוּ חֲלֻדָּה לְהָסִיר חֲלֻדָּתָן:


משישופנו (from when one polished it) – the goldsmith/smelter and those metal artisans who have vessels that are called הצורפים/smelters, goldsmiths in the language of Scripture, and its Aramaic translation is שופינא and they smelt and smooth the vessels that had rust come upon them to remove their rust.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:5:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:5:10)


**מִשֶּׁיַּשְׁחִיזֶנּוּ.** בַּמַּשְׁחֶזֶת שֶׁלּוֹ לְהָסִיר חֲלֻדָּתוֹ:


משישחיזנו (from when he whetted it) – with his whetting implement of stone or wood to remove its rust.



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:6:1)


**כְּסוּי טֶנִי שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת.** שֶׁל בַּעֲלֵי בָתִּים, טָהוֹר, כְּדִבְרֵי חֲכָמִים דִּפְלִיגֵי עֲלֵיהּ דְּרַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל לְעֵיל בְּפֶרֶק י"ב [מִשְׁנָה ו]. וְאִם מֵרְקוֹ וְלִטְּשׁוֹ וְעָשָׂה מִמֶּנּוּ מַרְאָה: **רַבִּי יְהוּדָה מְטַהֵר.** דִּסְבִירָא לֵיהּ מַרְאָה לֹא מְשַׁוֵּי לֵיהּ מָנָא:


כיסוי של טני של מתכת (covering of a metal basket) – of house owners, is ritually pure, according to the words of Sages who dispute on that of Rabban Gamaliel above in Chapter 12 [Mishnah 6] (of Tractate Kelim). But if he cleansed it and polished it and made from it a mirror, ר' יהודה מטהר – for he holds that a mirror is not worth to him anything.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:6:2)


**וַחֲכָמִים מְטַמְּאִין.** דְּמַרְאָה מְשַׁוֵּי לֵיהּ מָנָא. וַהֲלָכָה כַּחֲכָמִים:


וחכמים מטמאין – for a mirror is worth to him something. And the Halakha is according to the Sages.



### Mishnah 7

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:7:1)


**כְּלֵי מַתָּכוֹת מִטַּמְּאִין וּמִטַּהֲרִין שְׁבוּרִים.** כְּלֵי מַתָּכוֹת שֶׁנִּטְמְאוּ בְמֵת וְנִשְׁבְּרוּ, וְחָזַר וְעָשָׂה מֵהֶן כֵּלִים בּוֹ בַיּוֹם, שֶׁחָזְרוּ לְטֻמְאָתָן יְשָׁנָה, כֵּיוָן שֶׁהִזָּה עֲלֵיהֶן בְּעוֹדָן שְׁלֵמִים וְנִשְׁבְּרוּ, אֵין צָרִיךְ לְהַמְתִּין לְהַזָּאָה שְׁנִיָּה עַד הַשְּׁבִיעִי, אֶלָּא אֲפִלּוּ בְיוֹם אֶחָד מַזֶּה שְׁתֵּי הַזָּאוֹת, אַחַת קֹדֶם שְׁבִירָה וְאַחַת לְאַחַר שְׁבִירָה, וְהֵן טְהוֹרִין מִיָּד. דְּרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר כְּרַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל סְבִירָא לֵיהּ, דְּאָמַר לְעֵיל בְּפֶרֶק י"א דְּלֹא אָמְרוּ חָזְרוּ לְטֻמְאָתָן יְשָׁנָה אֶלָּא לְכֵלִים שֶׁנִּטְמְאוּ בְטֻמְאַת נֶפֶשׁ בִּלְבַד, וְטַעַם גְּזֵרָה זוֹ מִשּׁוּם גֶּדֶר מֵי חַטָּאת כִּדְפָרֵישְׁנָא לְעֵיל, הִלְכָּךְ לֹא חָשׁוּ אֶלָּא שֶׁיְּהֵא כָּאן שְׁתֵּי הַזָּאוֹת. וּמִיהוּ בְעוֹדָן שְׁבוּרִים לֹא מַהֲנֵי הַזָּאָה, דְּלֹא שַׁיְכָא הַזָּאָה בִּשְׁבָרִים. וּבָעֵי נַמִּי שֶׁתְּהֵא שְׁבִירָה מַפְסֶקֶת בֵּין הַזָּאָה לְהַזָּאָה, לְפִי שֶׁיֶּשׁ הֶפְסֵק יָמִים בֵּין הַזָּאַת שְׁלִישִׁי לְהַזָּאַת שְׁבִיעִי. וְלֹא רָצוּ לְהַחְמִיר בַּחֲזָרַת טֻמְאָה יְשָׁנָה, שֶׁהִיא דְרַבָּנָן, וְהֵקֵלּוּ שֶׁתּוֹעִיל בָּהּ הַזָּאָה אֲפִלּוּ שְׁתֵּיהֶן הַהַזָּאוֹת בְּיוֹם אֶחָד:


כלי מתכות מיטמאין ומהרין שבורים – metal utensils/vessels that were defiled through [contact with] a corpse and were broken, and he returned and made [new] utensils/vessels on that selfsame day, that they returned to their former [status of] ritual impurity, since he sprinkled [on the third and seventh days ashes from the red heifer mixed in water] upon them while they were whole and they became broken, one does not have to wait until the second sprinkling until the seventh [day], but rather even on one day, he sprinkles twice, one prior to breaking [them] and one after breaking [them] and they are ritually pure immediately. For Rabbi Eliezer holds like Rabban Shimon ben Gamaliel, who said above in Chapter 11 [Mishnah 1] that they didn’t say that the returned to their former [status of] ritual impurity, but rather, only [those] vessels that were defiled through the uncleanness of the soul alone, and the reason for this decree is because of the fence of the waters of the sin-offering as was explained above, therefore, they were not concerned other than that there would be here two [ritual] sprinklings [of the mixture of the water and ashes of the red heifer]. But however, while they are still broken, [ritual] sprinkling is not effective, for sprinkling is not connected with broken [utensils]. But it also requires that the breaking interrupts between each [ritual] sprinkling, because here is an interruption of days between the sprinkling of the third [day] and the sprinkling of the seventh [day]. But they did not want to be stringent in the return of the former ritual defilement which is according to the Rabbis, and they were lenient so that the sprinkling would be effective even that both sprinklings occurred on one day.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:7:2)


**רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אוֹמֵר אֵין הַזָּאָה פָּחוֹת מִשְּׁלִישִׁי וּשְׁבִיעִי.** דְּתַקּוּן כְּעֵין דְּאוֹרַיְתָא. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ:


ר' יהושע אומר אין הזאה פחות משלישי ושביעי – for they established it like that of the Torah [legislation]. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Yehoshua.



### Mishnah 8

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:1)


**מַפְתֵּחַ שֶׁל אַרְכֻּבָּה.** שֶׁמִּתְקַפֵּל כְּאַרְכֻּבָּה עִם הַשּׁוֹק, שֶׁעָשׂוּי כְמִין נוּ"ן כְּפוּפָה שֶׁלָּנוּ. וְרֹב מַפְתְּחוֹת שֶׁבְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׁמָעֵאל הֵם כֵּן:


מפתח של ארכובה (a key with a joint – broken at the joint) – that is scraped/cut at the knee/joint with the leg, that is made like our bent [letter] Nun. And most of the keys that are in the Land of Israel are like this.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:2)


**רַבִּי יְהוּדָה מְטַמֵּא.** וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


רבי יהודה מטמא – But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehuda.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:3)


**וְשֶׁל גַּם.** כְּמִין גַּ"ם יְוָנִית שֶׁהִיא כְּמִין נוּ"ן הֲפוּכָה:


ושל גם – like the Greek [letter] gamma which is like the inverted [letter] Nun.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:4)


**הָיוּ בּוֹ חָפִין.** כְּשֶׁנִּשְׁבַּר מִתּוֹךְ גּוּמוֹ, נִשְׁתַּיְּרוּ בוֹ חָפִין אוֹ נְקָבִין. חָפִין הֵם הַשִּׁנַּיִם. נְקָבִין, שֶׁנִּכְנָסִים בָּהֶן שִׁנֵּי הַמַּנְעוּל, שֶׁפְּעָמִים יֵשׁ בַּמַּפְתֵּחַ שִׁנַּיִם וְהֵן נִכְנָסִים בְּנִקְבֵי הַמַּנְעוּל וּפוֹתְחִים, וּפְעָמִים יֵשׁ נְקָבִים בַּמַּפְתֵּחַ וּמַכְנִיס אוֹתָן נְקָבִים בְּשִׁנֵּי הַמַּנְעוּל וּפוֹתֵחַ:


היו בו חפין (if it had teeth – of the bit) – when it was broken within its junction, if there remained in it teeth of the bit and gaps/holes, the חפין are the teeth, the gaps/holes are what the teeth of the lock enter into, that sometimes the key has teeth and they enter into the gaps of the lock and open up [the door], and sometimes there are holes in the key and he brings those gaps/holes into the teeth of the lock and opens up [the door].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:5)


**אוֹ שֶׁפָּרְצוּ זֶה לְתוֹךְ זֶה.** שֶׁלֹּא נִטְּלוּ הֶחָפִין וְלֹא נִסְתְּמוּ הַנְּקָבִין, אֶלָּא שֶׁפָּרְצוּ, כְּגוֹן שֶׁנֶּעֶקְמוּ הֶחָפִין וְנִתְרַחֲבוּ הַנְּקָבִין, שֶׁנּוֹגְעִים זֶה בָזֶה:


או שפרצו זה לתוך זה (or merged one into the other) – that the teeth were not removed and the gaps/holes were not blocked, but rather that they merged, as for example, when the teeth were curved or the gaps/holes widened and they touched each other.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:8:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:6)


**מְסַנֶּנֶת שֶׁל חַרְדָּל.** כְּמִין נָפָה שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת שֶׁהַחַרְדָּל נָתוּן בָּהּ וּמִסְתַּנֵּן וְקוֹלֶטֶת אֶת הַפְּסֹלֶת:


מסננת של חרדל (mustard mixture in the strainer – see also Tractate Shabbat, Chapter 20, Mishnah 2) – a kind of metal winnow that the mustard is placed in it and it strains and collects the refuse.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:8:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:7)


**מִלְּמַטָּן.** בְּשׁוּלֵי הַמְסַנֶּנֶת מִשֶּׁנִּפְרְצוּ בָהּ שְׁלֹשָׁה נְקָבִין וְנַעֲשׂוּ שְׁלָשְׁתָּן נֶקֶב אֶחָד, תּוּ לֹא חַזְיָא לְסַנֵּן בָּהּ:


מלמטן – in the rim of the strainer from when three holes merged and all three of them became one hole/gap, more than this, it is not appropriate to filter/strain in it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 14:8:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/14:8:8)


**אֲפַרְכֵּס.** כְּלִי שֶׁל רֵחַיִם רָחָב מִלְּמַעְלָה וּמֵצֵר וְהוֹלֵךְ מִלְּמַטָּה, וְנוֹתְנִים בּוֹ חִטִּים וְהוּא מוֹצִיא אוֹתָם קִמְעָא קִמְעָא בָּרֵחַיִם:


אפרכס (clepsydra) – a vessel of the millstone that is wide from above and gradually narrows from below, and we place it wheat in it and it issues them bit by bit in the millstone.



## Chapter 15


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:1)


**כְּלֵי עֵץ.** מִשְׁנָה זוֹ שְׁנוּיָה לְמַעְלָה בְּפֶרֶק ב', וַהֲדַר תַּנְיָא הָכָא מִשּׁוּם דִּינָא דִכְלֵי עֵץ וּכְלֵי עוֹר דְּבָעֵי לְאוֹרוּיֵי בְהוּ בְהָנָךְ פִּרְקִין:


כלי עץ – this Mishnah is taught above in Chapter 2 [of Tractate Kelim, Mishnah 1], and it teaches it once again here because of the law of wooden vessels/utensils and leather vessels/utensils that is necessary to teach about them in this chapter.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:2)


**הַשִּׁדָּה.** כְּמִין אָרוֹן:


השידה (chest/strong box) – like an ark/chest.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:3)


**וְהַתֵּבָה.** תֵּבַת הַשֻּׁלְחָנִין:


והתיבה – the chest of the money-changers.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:4)


**וְהַמִּגְדָּל.** בֵּית הָאוֹצָר שֶׁל עֵץ. בְּלַעַ"ז ארמריא"ו, וּבַעֲרָבִי אלמנס"ר:


והמגדל (and the tower/turret/cupboard) – a wooden treasure/store house, ARMREEOV in the foreign language and ALMNSAR in Arabic.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:5)


**וְכַוֶּרֶת הַקַּשׁ.** חֲשׁוּבָה כִּכְלִי עֵץ, לְפִי שֶׁעֲשׂוּיָה מִזַּנְבוֹת הַשִּׁבֳּלִין שֶׁהֵן קָשִׁין:


כוורת הקש (receptacle made of straw or weeds) – it is considered like a wooden vessel, because it is made from the tails of ears of grain which are hard.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:6)


**וּבוֹר סְפִינָה אֲלֶכְּסַנְדְּרִית.** סְפִינָה גְדוֹלָה שֶׁפּוֹרְשִׁין בָּהּ לַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל, קְרוּיָה סְפִינָה אֲלֶכְּסַנְדְּרִית, לְפִי שֶׁאֵין פּוֹרְשִׁים בַּיָּם מֵאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל לַאֲלֶכְּסַנְדְּרִיָּא אֶלָּא בִסְפִינָה גְדוֹלָה. וּמִפְּנֵי שֶׁמֵּי הַיָּם מְלוּחִים וְאֵין רְאוּיִין לִשְׁתִיָּה, עוֹשִׂים בִּסְפִינוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת כְּעֵין בּוֹר שֶׁל עֵץ וּמְמַלְּאִים אוֹתוֹ מַיִם מְתוּקִין הָרְאוּיִין לִשְׁתִיָּה:


ובור ספינה אלכסנדרית (tank of sweet water in Alexandrian merchantmen) – a large ship that sets sail on the Mediterranean Sea which is called the Alexandrian ship, because one does not set sail on the sea from the land of Israel to Alexandria other than in a large ship. But because the waters are salty, and are not appropriate for drinking, they make a kind of wooden tank on large ships and fill it with sweet water that is appropriate for drinking.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:7)


**שֶׁיֶּשׁ לָהֶם שׁוּלַיִם.** שֶׁאֵין תַּחְתֵּיהֶן חַד מִלְּמַטָּה, אֶלָּא רָחָב וְיוֹשֵׁב עַל הַקַּרְקַע:


שיש להם שולים – that their bottoms are not sharp from the bottom, but rather wide and sits on the ground.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:8)


**כּוֹרַיִם.** שִׁשִּׁים סְאָה:


כורים – sixty Seah.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:9)


**בְּיָבֵשׁ.** כְּגוֹן הַתְּבוּאָה וְזֵרְעוֹנִים וּפֵרוֹת:


ביבש – as for example grain and rows of plants in one bed/seeds and produce.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:10)


**טְהוֹרִין.** דְּאִתַּקַּשׁ כְּלֵי עֵץ וּכְלֵי עוֹר, לְשַׂק הַמִּטַּלְטֵל מָלֵא וְרֵיקָן, וְזֶה אֵינוֹ מִטַּלְטֵל מָלֵא לְפִי שֶׁגָּדוֹל יוֹתֵר מִדַּאי, וְאִם יְטַלְטְלוּהוּ מָלֵא יִשָּׁבֵר:


טהורין – and there is an analogy made [based upon being in close proximity in the same verse – see Leviticus 11:32) regarding wooden vessels and leather vessels, to a sack that is carried full or empty, and this is not carried full, because it is too large, for if it were carried full, it would break.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:11)


**בֵּין מְקַבְּלִים בֵּין שֶׁאֵינָן מְקַבְּלִים.** בֵּין שֶׁמְּקַבְּלִין יוֹתֵר מֵאַרְבָּעִים סְאָה, בֵּין שֶׁאֵין מְקַבְּלִין אֶלָּא פָּחוֹת:


בין מקבלים בין שאינן מקבלים – whether they hold more than forty Seah, whether they don’t hold other than less [than forty Seah].carry


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:12)


**דַּרְדּוּר עֲגָלָה.** חָבִית שֶׁל עֵץ עֲגֻלָּה עֲשׂוּיָה לוּחוֹת, כְּעֵין אוֹתָן שֶׁעוֹשִׂין בְּאֶרֶץ רוֹמִ"י. וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהִיא גְדוֹלָה, כֵּיוָן שֶׁהִיא לַעֲגָלָה, מִטַּלְטֶלֶת מְלֵאָה וְרֵיקָנִית, דְּסָבַר הַאי תַּנָּא טִלְטוּל עַל יְדֵי שְׁוָרִים שְׁמֵיהּ טִלְטוּל:


דרדור עגלה (a water tank on wheels) – a round wooden barrel that is made in tablets, like those that they make in the land of Rome. But even though it is large, since it is for a wagon, it is carried full or empty, for this Tanna/teacher (i.e., Rabbi Yehuda) holds that carrying by bulls/oxen is called carrying.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:13)


**וְקֻסְטוֹת הַמְּלָכִים.** כְּמִין מִגְדָּל שֶׁל עֵץ עָשׂוּי חֲדָרִים חֲדָרִים, שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים בּוֹ מִינֵי מַאֲכָל וְכֵלִים שֶׁל מַשְׁקֶה. וְהַמְּלָכִים מוֹלִיכִין אוֹתוֹ בַעֲגָלָה שֶׁהוֹלְכִים בָּהּ:


וקסטות המלכים (the provision boxes of kings) – like a kind of wooden turret/chest made into various rooms, and they place in it kinds of foods and drinking vessels. And the kings bring it on the wagon tat they travel in.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:14)


**וַעֲרֵבַת הָעַבְּדָנִים.** עֲרֵבָה שֶׁל עֵץ שֶׁהָעַבְּדָנִים שׁוֹרִין בָּהּ עוֹרוֹתֵיהֶן:


ועריבת העבדנים (trough used by tanners) – a wooden trough that the tanners soak in it their skins.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:15)


**אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמְּקַבְּלִין, טְמֵאִין.** כְּלוֹמַר, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמְּקַבְּלִין אַרְבָּעִים סְאָה אוֹ יוֹתֵר:


אע"פ שמקבלין טמאים – that is to say, even though it holds forty Seah or more.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:16)


**טְמֵאִין.** כְּדִמְפָרֵשׁ טַעֲמָא, שֶׁאֵין מִטַּלְטְלִים אֶלָּא בְמַה שֶּׁבְּתוֹכָן, כְּשֶׁהֵן מְלֵאִים דַּרְכָּן לִטַּלְטֵל:


טמאין, they are ritually impure. As it explains the reason that they do not carry other than what is within them, when they are full, it is their custom to be carried.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:1:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:1:17)


**עֲרֵבַת בַּעַל הַבָּיִת.** לְרַבִּי מֵאִיר טְמֵאָה, דְּהוּא טְהוֹרִין קָחֲשִׁיב, לְמֵימְרָא דְהָנֵי דַוְקָא טְהוֹרִין, וְהַשְּׁאָר טְמֵאִין. לְרַבִּי יְהוּדָה טְהוֹרָה, דְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה טְמֵאִים קָחֲשִׁיב, לְמֵימְרָא דְהָנֵי דַוְקָא טְמֵאִין, וְהַשְּׁאָר טְהוֹרִין. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


עריבת בעל הבית – according to Rabbi Meir it is ritually impure, for it is considered ritually pure, to state that these are specifically pure, but the rest are ritually impure. According to Rabbi Yehuda, they are ritually pure, for Rabbi Yehuda considers them impure, to say that these specifically are impure, but the rest are ritually pure. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Yehuda.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:1)


**אֲרוּבוֹת שֶׁל נַחְתּוֹמִים.** לוּחוֹת שֶׁהַנַּחְתּוֹמִים עוֹרְכִים עֲלֵיהֶן אֶת הַלֶּחֶם. וְאִית סְפָרִים דְּגָרְסֵי עֲרֵבוֹת:


ארובות של נחתומים (long ranging boards used by the bakers) – boards that the bakers arrange the bread upon. And there are books that have the reading עריבות/troughs.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:2)


**טְמֵאוֹת.** לְפִי שֶׁעֲשׂוּיִין בְּצוּרַת כְּלִי. וְאַף עַל גַּב דִּפְשׁוּטֵי כְלֵי עֵץ נִינְהוּ, טְמֵאוֹת מִדִּבְרֵי סוֹפְרִים:


טמאות – because they are made in the shape of a vessel, and even though they are flat wooden vessels, they are ritually impure from the words of the Scribes.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:3)


**שֶׁל בַּעֲלֵי בָתִּים טְהוֹרוֹת.** שֶׁאֵין עֲלֵיהֶן צוּרַת כְּלִי:


ושל בעלי בתים טהורות – that they don’t have the shape of a vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:4)


**סֵרְקָן.** יִפָּן בִּסְרִיקוֹן. וְהוּא שָׁשַׁר בִּלְשׁוֹן מִקְרָא. וּמָשׁוֹחַ בַּשָּׁשַׁר (ירמיה כב). בַּעֲרָבִי זנגפו"ר. וּבְלַעַ"ז מיני"ו:


סרקן (painted/colored them red) – beautify them with red paint, and it is ששר/red paint, vermillion in the language of Scripture, and "משוח בששר"/painted with vermillion (Jeremiah 22:14). In Arabic it is ZANGPOR and in the foreign language it is MINIV.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:5)


**כִּרְכְּמָן.** צְבָעָן בְּכַרְכֹּם:


כרכמן – colored them saffron.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:6)


**דַּף שֶׁל נַחְתּוֹמִין.** דַּף שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת. דְּאִלּוּ דַף שֶׁל עֵץ, פְּשׁוּטֵי כְלֵי עֵץ אֵין מְקַבְּלִין טֻמְאָה. וְאַף עַל גַּב דְּטָמֵא מִדְּרַבָּנָן, כְּשֶׁקְּבָעוֹ בַכֹּתֶל טָהוֹר לְדִבְרֵי הַכֹּל:


דף של נחתונים (baker’s board) – a metal board, for if it were a wooden board, plain wooden boards are not susceptible to receive ritual impurity. But even though they are impure according to the Rabbis, when it is affixed on the wall, it is ritually pure according to the words of all.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:7)


**רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר מְטַהֵר.** וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר:


ר' אליעזר מטהר – but the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Eliezer.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:2:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:8)


**סְרוֹד.** הִיא סְרֵידָא דִתְנַן לְעֵיל בְּכַמָּה דוּכְתֵי. וְהִיא עֲרֵבָה קְטַנָּה שֶׁהַנַּחְתּוֹם מִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בָּהּ. כְּדִמְתַרְגְּמִינַן אֶת בִּגְדֵי הַשְּׂרָד (שמות לא) יַת לְבוּשֵׁי שִׁמּוּשָׁא:


סרוד (frame) it is סרידה/the coarse web or matting/stuffed matting used for stoppers of stoves as is taught in the Mishnah above (see Tractate Kelim, Chapter 8, Mishnah 3, Chapter 9, Mishnah 7 and Chapter 10, Mishnah 7) in several places, and it is a small trough that the bakers use, as it we translate in Aramaic for "את בגדי השרד" /”the service/plaited vestments”(Exodus 31:10) ית לבושי שימושא/the clothing that is used in service/ministration.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:2:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:9)


**גִּפְּפוֹ.** עָשָׂה לוֹ מִסְגֶּרֶת סָבִיב. תַּרְגּוּם וַיְחַבֵּק, וְגַפֵּיף:


גיפפו (to attach a rim) – he made for him a rim around it. It is the Aramaic translation of ויחבק וגפיף/to embrace/surround.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:2:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:10)


**אִם הִתְקִינוֹ.** לַסְּרוֹד שֶׁל בַּעֲלֵי בָתִּים:


אם התקינו – for the frame of house-owners.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:2:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:11)


**לִהְיוֹת קוֹרֵץ עָלָיו.** כְּלוֹמַר לַחְתֹּךְ עָלָיו הַבָּצֵק. לְשׁוֹן מֵחֹמֶר קֹרַצְתִּי (איוב לג):


להיות קורץ עליו – that is to say, to make an incision of the dough on it. It is the language of (Job 33:6): “I too was nipped from clay.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:2:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:2:12)


**טָמֵא.** דִּסְבִירָא לֵיהּ לְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן, מִפְּנֵי מָה סְרוֹד שֶׁל נַחְתּוֹמִים טָמֵא, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁקּוֹרֵץ עָלָיו אֶת הַבָּצֵק וּמוֹלִיךְ עָלָיו מִקְרָצוֹת לַתַּנּוּר, וְשֶׁל בַּעֲלֵי בָתִּים נַמִּי אִם הִתְקִינוֹ לִהְיוֹת קוֹרֵץ עָלָיו אֶת הַבָּצֵק וּלְהוֹלִיךְ עָלָיו מִקְרָצוֹת לַתַּנּוּר, טָמֵא. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן:


טמא – for Rabbi Shimon holds because just as the frame of the baker is ritually impure that they nip upon it the dough and cast upon it from that which is nipped to the oven, also of those belonging to house-owners, if they arranged it so that he would be separating upon it the dough and to carry up on it from that which is nipped to the oven, it would be ritually impure. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Shimon.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:3:1)


**יַם נָפָה.** יְרִיעָה אֲרוּגָה מִשֵּׂעָר לְהוֹצִיא אֶת הַסֹּלֶת נָקִי מִן הַסֻּבִּין. וּלְפִי שֶׁיֶּשׁ סְבִיב הַיְרִיעָה זֵר שֶׁל לוּחַ גָּבֹהַּ, נִקְרָא יָם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁיֶּשׁ סְבִיב הַיָּם יַבָּשָׁה:


ים נפה (receiver of flour at sifting or in the mill) – a woven curtain from the gate to remove the clean fine flour from the bran flour. But because there is surrounding the curtain a crown of a tall board, it is called a ים/a receiver of flour at sifting, like there is dry land surrounding the sea.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:3:2)


**שֶׁל סִלָּתִים.** בּוֹרְרִים הַסֹּלֶת:


של סלתים – they sift the fine flour.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:3:3)


**גּוֹדֶלֶת.** הָאִשָּׁה שֶׁגּוֹדֶלֶת וְקוֹשֶׁרֶת שְׂעַר הַנָּשִׁים:


גודלת (sieve-like receptacle of the hair-dresser) – the woman who dresses and ties the women’s hair.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:3:4)


**מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהַבָּנוֹת.** הַנְּעָרוֹת בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁגּוֹדְלוֹת רֹאשָׁן מוֹשִׁיבוֹת אוֹתָן בְּתוֹךְ יַם נָפָה, לְקַבֵּל שָׁם מַה שֶּׁיִּפֹּל מֵרֹאשָׁן מִן הָעַפְרוּרִית וְעִרְבּוּבִיתָא דְרֵישָׁא. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


מפני שהבנות – the young women who have their heads dressed they place them within the receiver of flour at sifting or in the mill, to receive what might fall from their heads from the sandy matter in grain and the tangles and scabs of the head formed through uncleanliness. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Yehuda.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:4:1)


**כָּל הַתְּלוֹיִים.** הָעֲשׂוּיִין לַכְּלִי לִתְלוֹתוֹ בּוֹ:


כל התלויין – that are made for a utensil/vessel to hang upon it. כברת גרנות


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:4:2)


**טְמֵאִין.** דַּהֲווּ חִבּוּר לַכְּלִי:


טמאין – because they are an attachment to the vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:4:3)


**כִּבְרַת גְּרָנוֹת.** עֲשׂוּיָה לְהוֹצִיא הַחִטִּים וְלִקְלֹט הַמֹּץ, וּמַנִּיחִים הַכְּבָרָה עַל שְׁנֵי עֵצִים וּמְנַהֲלִין, וּכְשֶׁהֵן יְגֵעִים מַכְנִיסִים יְדֵיהֶן בַּתְּלוֹי שֶׁלָּהּ וּמְנַהֲלִין, וְהַיְנוּ דְקָתָנֵי דִמְסַיְּעִין בִּשְׁעַת מְלָאכָה:


כברת גרנות (large sieve of the threshing floor) – that is made to remove the wheat and to retain the chaff, and they place the sieve on two pieces of wood and sift it, and when they are tired, they put their hands on its hanger and sift, which is what it teaches [in the Mishnah] that they assist at the time of work.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:4:4)


**מַקֵּל הַבַּלָּשִׁין.** הַמְחַפְּשִׂין בְּתוֹךְ הַכֵּלִים לִרְאוֹת אִם יֵשׁ בּוֹ דָבָר שֶׁרָאוּי לִתֵּן מִמֶּנּוּ מֶכֶס לַמֶּלֶךְ. תַּרְגּוּם וַיְחַפֵּשׂ, וּבְלַשׁ:


מקל הבלשין (the commissioner’s pointed staff) – that he searches within the vessels to see if there is something appropriate to give from it as a taxes to the king. The Aramaic translation of “and he searches” is ובלש/and he searches, examines [for concealed goods].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:4:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:4:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:4:5)


**שֶׁהֵם מְסַיְּעִים בִּשְׁעַת מְלָאכָה.** מַכְנִיסִין יְדֵיהֶם בַּתְּלוֹי כְּשֶׁרוֹצִים לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בַּכְּלִי, וּמִסְתַּיְּעִים בּוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת מְלַאכְתָּן. וַהֲלָכָה כַּחֲכָמִים:


שהם מסייעים בשעת מלאכה – they bring their hands in on something hanging when they want to use a vessel, and they support with it to perform their work. And the Halakha is according to the Sages.



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:5:1)


**רַחַת.** שֶׁזּוֹרִים בָּהּ תְּבוּאָה וְקִטְנִיּוֹת. בַּעֲרָבִי אלרח"ה, וּבְלַעַ"ז פאל"א:


רחת (shovel) – that they winnow the grain and beans with. In Arabic it is ALRAKHA, and in the foreign tongue PALA.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:5:2)


**הַגָּרוֹסוֹת.** הָעוֹשִׂים גְּרִיסִים שֶׁל פּוֹל:


הגרוסות (grist-grinders) – that make pounded beans.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:5:3)


**טְמֵאָה.** לְפִי שֶׁיֶּשׁ לָהּ בֵּית קִבּוּל וַעֲשׂוּיָה לְהַכְנִיס בָּהּ לָרֵחַיִם:


טמאה – because it has a receptacle and is made to be entered into millstone.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:5:4)


**וְשֶׁל אוֹצָרוֹת.** עֲשׂוּיָה לִלְקֹט בָּהּ הַחִטָּה שֶׁהִיא מִן הַצְּדָדִים מִכָּאן וּמִכָּאן. וּלְנַקּוֹתָהּ שֶׁתִּתְיַשֵּׁב בָּאוֹצָר:


ושל אוצרות (and of storerooms) – made to collect in it the wheat which is from the sides from here and there, and to cleanse it when it settles in the storeroom.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:5:5)


**וְשֶׁל גִּתּוֹת.** לְהַשְׁלִיךְ הַחַרְצַנִּים וְהַזָּגִין חוּץ מִן הַגַּת:


ושל גיתית (and of winepresses) – to cast off the shells of grapes and the pomace of grapes outside of the winepress.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:5:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:5:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:5:6)


**לְכִנּוּס.** מִמְּקוֹם פְּזוּרָן, אֲבָל לֹא לְקַבֵּל בְּתוֹכוֹ:


לכינוס (for gathering) – from the place of their scattering, but not to receive into it.



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:1)


**נִבְלֵי הַשָּׁרָה.** נְבָלִים שֶׁמְּשׁוֹרְרִים בָּהֶם. לְשׁוֹן נֵבֶל וְכִנּוֹר:


נבלי השירה – harps that they sing with them. The language of lyre and harp (i.e., secular music).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:2)


**טְמֵאִין.** שֶׁהַנְּבָלִים וְהַכִּנּוֹרוֹת חֲלוּלִים הֵם וּמְנֻקָּבִים לְצַד הַנִּימִין לְהַשְׁמִיעַ קוֹל הַנִּגּוּן, וְדֶרֶךְ הַמְנַגְּנִים לְהַנִּיחַ בְּתוֹכָן הַמָּעוֹת שֶׁמְּקַבְּצִין מִבְּנֵי אָדָם הַבָּאִים לִשְׁמֹעַ, וְהָוֵי לֵיהּ מִטַּלְטֵל מָלֵא וְרֵיקָן:


טמאין – that the lyres and harps are profane and are perforated to the side of the strings in order to produce the sound of the melody. And it is the manner of those of play to leave within them the money that they collect from people who come to listen. And it is carried both full and empty.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:3)


**נִבְלֵי בְנֵי לֵוִי.** הַמְּנַגְּנִים עַל הַדּוּכָן:


נבלי בני לוי – who play on the platform [of the Temple].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:4)


**טְהוֹרִין.** שֶׁאֵינָן עֲשׂוּיִין לָתֵת בְּתוֹכָן מָעוֹת, וְאֵין עֲשׂוּיִין לְקַבֵּל:


טהורין – they are not made to place money in them, and they are not made to receive anything.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:5)


**כָּל הַמַּשְׁקִין טְמֵאִין.** כָּל אֶחָד מִשִּׁבְעָה מַשְׁקִין, שֶׁהֵן, מַיִם יַיִן שֶׁמֶן דְּבַשׁ חָלָב דַּם טַל, מְקַבְּלִין טֻמְאָה, וּמַכְשִׁירִין הַזְּרָעִים לְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה:


כל המשקין טמאין – each one of the seven liquids which are water, wine, oil, honey, milk, blood [and] dew, are susceptible to receive ritual defilement, and make fit the seeds to receive ritual defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:6)


**וּמַשְׁקֵה בֵית מַטְבְּחַיָּא.** הַמַּיִם וְהַדָּם שֶׁבְּבֵית הַמִּטְבָּחַיִם שֶׁבָּעֲזָרָה:


ומשקה בית מטבחיא – the water and the blood that are in the slaughterhouse that is in the Temple courtyard.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:7)


**טְהוֹרִין.** שֶׁהֵם אֵינָם מְקַבְּלִין טֻמְאָה, וְלֹא מַכְשִׁירִין הָאֳכָלִים לְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה:


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:8)


**כָּל הַסְּפָרִים מְטַמְּאִין אֶת הַיָּדַיִם.** לְפִי שֶׁבִּתְחִלָּה הָיוּ מַצְנִיעִים אֳכָלִים שֶׁל תְּרוּמָה אֵצֶל סֵפֶר תּוֹרָה, דְּאָמְרֵי הַאי קֹדֶשׁ וְהַאי קֹדֶשׁ, כֵּיוָן דְּחָזוּ דְקָאָתוּ סְפָרִים לִידֵי פְסֵידָא, שֶׁהָעַכְבָּרִים שֶׁהָיוּ מְצוּיִין אֵצֶל הָאֳכָלִים הָיוּ מַפְסִידִים אוֹתָן, גָּזְרוּ שֶׁיִּהְיוּ הַסְּפָרִים כָּל כִּתְבֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ פּוֹסְלִים אֶת הַתְּרוּמָה בְמַגָּעָן, וְגָזְרוּ עוֹד שֶׁהַיָּדַיִם הַנּוֹגְעוֹת בַּסְּפָרִים יִהְיוּ שְׁנִיּוֹת לַטֻּמְאָה וּפוֹסְלוֹת אֶת הַתְּרוּמָה:


כל הספרים מטמאין את הידים – because at the outset, they would hide the food of the heave-offering with the Torah scrolls, for they said: “this is holy, and that is holy,” since they saw that these Scrolls came to a loss, that the mice that would be found near the foods would cause loss to them, they (i.e., the Sages) decreed that all Scrolls of all Holy Writings defile the heave-offering through their contact, they decreed further that the hands that touch the Scrolls would be second-level of ritual defilement and would invalidate the heave-offering [for the Kohanim].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:9)


**מִסֵּפֶר הָעֲזָרָה.** סֵפֶר תּוֹרָה שֶׁכֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל קוֹרֵא בוֹ בְּעֶזְרַת נָשִׁים בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים. דְּלֵיכָּא לְמֵיחַשׁ שֶׁמָּא יָשִׂימוּ אֳכָלִים שֶׁל תְּרוּמָה אֶצְלוֹ, מִפְּנֵי מוֹרָאוֹ וַחֲשִׁיבוּתוֹ:


מספר העזרה – The Torah scroll that the High Priest reads from in the Women’s Court on Yom Kippur, for one should not be concerned lest they place food-stuffs of heave-offering near it, because of his fear and its importance.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:10)


**מַרְכּוֹף.** סוּס שֶׁל עֵץ שֶׁעוֹשִׂים הַלֵּיצָנִים לִרְכֹּב עָלָיו לְצַחֵק בּוֹ:


מרכוף (name of a musical instrument made stationary) – a wooden horse that the jesters/scoffers make to ride upon to make fun of.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:11)


**הַבַּטְנוֹן.** כְּלִי נִגּוּן גָּדוֹל, שֶׁהַמְנַגֵּן בּוֹ סוֹמְכוֹ עַל בִּטְנוֹ. וְקוֹרִים לוֹ בְּלַעַ"ז ציטר"א:


הבטנון (a sort of bagpipe, cittern fastened around the body; workingman’s pinafore, lute) – a large musical instrument, that the player rests on his stomach. And they call it TZITRA in the foreign language.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:12)


**הַנִּקְטְמוֹן.** מִין כְּלִי שֶׁל נִגּוּן עָשׂוּי בְּצוּרַת רֶגֶל שֶׁל עֵץ שֶׁעוֹשֶׂה מִי שֶׁנֶּחְתְּכָה רַגְלוֹ:


הנקטמון – a kind of musical instrument made in the form of a leg of wood that a person makes whose leg was cut/severed.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:13)


**וְהָאֵרוּס.** עָשׂוּי כְּמִין נָפָה שֶׁדָּפְנוֹתֶיהָ עֲגֻלּוֹת וְשׁוֹטְחִין עַל פִּיו עוֹר דַּק, וּמַכִּין עָלָיו בְּמַקֵּל וּמוֹצִיא קוֹל צָלוּל. וּבְלַעַ"ז טמבור"ו:


הארוס (drum) – made like a kind of sieve whose walls are round and they stretch thin leather over its mouth and strike it with a mallet and it produces a clear sound. TAMBOROV in the foreign tongue (i.e., tambourine).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:14
