[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:14)


**טָמֵא מוֹשָׁב.** אִם יָשַׁב עָלָיו זָב וְזָבָה נִדָּה וְיוֹלֶדֶת, נַעֲשֶׂה אַב הַטֻּמְאָה לְטַמֵּא אָדָם לְטַמֵּא בְגָדִים. דִּכְלִי הַמְיֻחָד לִישִׁיבָה הוּא:


טמא מושב – if a person with gonorrhea or a woman with a flux, a menstruating woman or a woman who gave birth to a child sat upon it, it becomes a primary form of Levitical impurity to ritually defile people [and] to ritually defile clothing. For it is a vessel that is special for sitting.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:15)


**שֶׁהָאַלָּיִת.** כְּלוֹמַר הַמְקוֹנֶנֶת וּמְיַלֶּלֶת יוֹשֶׁבֶת עָלָיו, לְפִי שֶׁרְגִילִין לִסְפֹּד וּלְקוֹנֵן עַל יְדֵי נִגּוּן שֶׁל אוֹתוֹ כְלִי. וְכֵן הַמִּנְהָג הַיּוֹם בְּאַרְצוֹת הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים:


שהאלית – that is to say those [women] who sing dirges and howl sit upon it, for they would regularly eulogize and sing dirges through the melody of that instrument. And such is the custom today in the countries of the Ishmaelites.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:16)


**אַלָּיִת.** לְשׁוֹן אֱלִי כִבְתוּלָה חֲגֻרַת שַׂק (יואל א). וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


אלית (the female wailer) – it is the language of (Joel 1:8): “Lament – like a maiden girt with sackcloth [for the husband of her youth!]"אלי כבתולה חגרת-שק [על-בעל נעוריה]". But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehuda.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 15:6:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/15:6:17)


**מְצֻדַּת הַחֻלְדָּה טְמֵאָה.** שֶׁיֶּשׁ עָלֶיהָ צוּרַת כְּלִי. מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן לִמְצוֹדַת עַכְבָּר:


מצודת החולדה טמאה – because it has upon it the form of a vessel, which is not the case regarding the trap of the mouse.



## Chapter 16


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:1)


**כָּל כְּלִי עֵץ.** שֻׁלְחָן הַכָּפוּל. עָשׂוּי חֻלְיוֹת אוֹ פְרָקִים, וּלְאַחַר שֶׁמְּסִירִים אוֹתוֹ כּוֹפְלִים חֻלְיוֹתָיו אוֹ פְרָקָיו זוֹ עַל זוֹ, וְכָל חֻלְיָא הַוְיָא כְּלִי בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ:


כל כלי עץ. שלחן הכפול – it is made by links/segment of earth cut out in digging a pit and piled up on its border or sections, and after they remove it, they fold the segments or sections one top of the other, and each segment is a vessel on its own.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:2)


**וְתַמְחוּי הַמִּזְנוֹן.** קְעָרָה גְדוֹלָה מְאֹד וּבְתוֹכָהּ קְעָרוֹת קְטַנּוֹת, וְנוֹתְנִים בְּכָל קְעָרָה מִן הַקְּטַנּוֹת מִין אֶחָד שֶׁל תַּבְשִׁיל. וּלְפִי שֶׁיֶּשׁ בְּתוֹכָהּ מִינִים הַרְבֵּה, נִקְרָא תַמְחוּי הַמִּזְנוֹן. תַּרְגּוּם לְמִינוֹ לִזְנוֹהִי:


תמחוי המזנון (a plate with many partitions – each of which, if separated, may be a receptacle) – a very large dish and within it are small dishes, and they place on each of the smaller dishes a course of cooked food. And because there is within it many different kinds, it is called תמחוי המזנון/a plate with many partitions. And in Aramaic translation it is called למינו לזנוהי.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:3)


**אֱפִיפוֹרִין.** כִּסֵּא שֶׁל פְּרָקִים:


אפיפורין (saddle cloth – protuberance/shape of the human buttock) – the seat of limbs.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:4)


**הַמָּגֵס.** תַּרְגּוּם קְעָרָה מְגִיסְתָּא:


המגס (tray, plate, dish) – the Aramaic translation of קערה מגיסתא/a dish from a tray.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:5)


**וְקוֹד הַבַּבְלִי.** כְּמִין קְעָרָה שֶׁל עֵץ. וּלְשׁוֹן חֲכָמִים הוּא, בִּמְקֵדָה בְזוּיָה, פֵּרוּשׁ קְעָרָה בְזוּיָה. וְכָל הַכֵּלִים הַלָּלוּ, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁנֶּחְלְקוּ, נִשְׁאָר לְכָל חֵלֶק מֵהֶם צוּרַת כְּלִי. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


קוד הבבלי (wooden Babylonian bowl – fragments of which may be used as a receptacle) – like a kind of wooden dish. And it is the language of the Sages, as it is explained, of a מקדה בזויה/fragment of a degraded vessel used for carrying fire. And all of these vessels, even though they were divided, remained in each section of them the form of a vessel. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehuda.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:6)


**מִשֶּׁיְּשׁוּפֵם בְּעוֹר הַדָּג.** לְהָסִיר קִסְמִין שֶׁבָּהֶם, דְּקֹדֶם לָכֵן לֹא חֲזוּ לִמְלַאכְתָּן, שֶׁמְּשָׂרְטִים אֶת הַבָּשָׂר. אֲבָל אִם אֵינָן מְחֻסָּרִין אֶלָּא שִׁיפָה שֶׁל צִחְצוּחַ וּמְרִיקָה, הָא קַיְמָא לָן [חֻלִּין כה] דְּגָלְמֵי כְלֵי עֵץ שֶׁעָתִיד לְשַׁבֵּץ וְלָשׁוּף טְמֵאִין:


משישופם בעור הדג (from when he rubs them with fish skin) – to remove the chips that are in them. For prior to this, they are not appropriate for the work, that they wound the skin. But if they are not lacking anything other than the rubbing of glistening and scouring/washing, we hold [see Tractate Hullin 25a]: “unfinished wood vessels that is to be adorned with designs and polished are ritually impure.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:7)


**גָּמַר שֶׁלֹּא לָשׁוּף.** שֶׁגָּמַר בְּלִבּוֹ לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בָּהֶם אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁלֹּא יָשׁוּף עוֹד:


גמר שלא לשוף – he determined in his heart to use them even though he will not polish/rub them any further.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:1:8)


**שְׁלֹשָׁה בָתִּים.** כְּשֶׁמְּסָרְגִים הַמִּטָּה בַחֲבָלִים, בֵּין כָּל חֶבֶל לְחֶבֶל קָרוּי בַּיִת. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי מֵאִיר:


שלשה בתים – when they make a partition by means of net-work/like lattices to the bed with ropes, between each rope it is called a בית/row. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Meir.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:1)


**הַסַּלִּים שֶׁל עֵץ.** מֵאֵימָתַי גְּמַר מְלַאכְתָּן:


הסלים של עץ – from when is the completion of their manufacture?


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:2)


**מִשֶּׁיַּחְסֹם.** כְּשֶׁאָדָם עוֹשֶׂה קֻפָּה אוֹ סַל וְגוֹמֵר אֶת שְׂפָתוֹ זוֹ הִיא חֲסִימָה:


משיחסום (to form the rim of basketwork or of a leather bag) – when a person makes a large vessel or a basket and completes the rim/peels them, this is החסימה/forming of the rim of a basket.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:3)


**וִיקַנֵּב.** לְאַחַר שֶׁגּוֹמֵר הַשָּׂפָה, וְנִשְׁתַּיְּרוּ קִסְמִין רָאשֵׁי קְרוּמִיּוֹת הַבּוֹלְטִין, פּוֹסְקָן וְקוֹטְמָן, וְזוֹ הִיא קְנִיבָה:


ויקנב (trimmed them – pinched off the projecting pricks) – after he completes the rim, when there remained the chips at the head of the protruding skin-like, scaly envelope of reed, he cuts and lops them off. And this is קניבה/trimming


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:4)


**שֶׁל תְּמָרָה.** סַלִּים הָעֲשׂוּיִן מֵחֲרִיּוֹת שֶׁל דֶּקֶל:


תמרה – baskets made from dried branches/twigs of palm-trees.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:5)


**שֶׁכֵּן מְקַיְּמִין.** בְּלֹא קְנִיבָה:


שכן מקיימין – without trimming.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:6)


**כַּלְכָּלָה.** סַל שֶׁל גֶּמִי:


כלכלה (basket – containing chosen fruits-designated for use) – a basket made of bulrushes.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:7)


**הַתְּלוֹיָה.** שֶׁיִּגְמֹר הַחֶבֶל שֶׁתּוֹלֶה בָהּ:


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:2:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:8)


**בֵּית הַלְּגִינִים.** כְּלִי שֶׁמַּנִּיחִין בּוֹ לְגִינִין לִשְׁמֹר:


בית הלגינים (case of wickerwork for flasks) – a vessel in which they place flasks for preservation.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:2:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:2:9)


**בֵּית הַכּוֹסוֹת.** כְּלִי שֶׁמַּצְנִיעִין בּוֹ כּוֹסוֹת:


בית הכוסות – a vessel that they hide cups In it



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:1)


**הַקְּנוֹנִין.** קָנוֹן שֶׁבּוֹרְרִים בּוֹ קִטְנִית. וְהוּא נַעֲשֶׂה מֵחֲרִיּוֹת שֶׁל דֶּקֶל:


הקנונין – a reed basket that they select in it pulse. And it is made from the twigs of palm trees.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:2)


**קְלָתוֹת.** קֻפּוֹת קְטַנּוֹת:


קלתות (vase-shaped basket/woman’s work basket) – small vessels.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:3)


**סוּגִים.** קֻפּוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת:


סוגים – large vessels [with partitions].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:4)


**שְׁנֵי דוּרִים לָרֹחַב שֶׁלָּהֶן.** לְאַחַר שֶׁאָרְגוּ שׁוּלֵי הַקֻּפָּה, אוֹרְגִים סְבִיבוֹתֶיהָ עִגּוּלִים כְּפִי מַה שֶּׁרוֹצֶה שֶׁתִּהְיֶה רְחָבָה בְדָפְנוֹתֶיהָ בְּגָבְהָהּ, וְאוֹתָן עִגּוּלִים שֶׁל דְּפָנוֹת קְרוּיִין דּוּרִים:


שני דורים לרוחב שלהן (two wreaths on their width) – after they wove the rims of the vessel, they weave around it circles according to what they want to be the width of the walls in its height, and those round/circular bands/walls are called דורים/wreaths.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:5)


**וְכַן שֶׁל מֹאזְנַיִם.** הַבָּסִיס שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים עָלָיו הַמֹּאזְנַיִם:


וכן של מאזנים – the base on which they place upon it the balance.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:6)


**דּוּר אֶחָד.** מִשֶּׁיַּגְבִּיהַּ עַל שְׂפָתוֹ עִגּוּל אֶחָד:


דור אחד – from when he lifts up the rim by one circular band.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:3:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:7)


**שְׁתֵּי צְפִירוֹת.** שְׁתֵּי סִבּוּבִים:


שתי צפירות (two circuits/circles) – two goings-around.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:3:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:8)


**וְהֶעָרָק.** שֶׁאֵין שְׂפָתוֹ גְבוֹהָה כִּשְׂפַת הַקֻּפָּה:


והערק (a long and flat vessel made of rush/bamboo) – that its rim is not as tall as the rim of the large vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:3:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:3:9)


**מִשֶּׁיַּעֲשֶׂה צְפִירָה אַחַת טָמֵא.** וְעָרָק עָשׂוּי מִשַּׁעַם וְאָרְכּוֹ יוֹתֵר מֵרָחְבּוֹ, כְּתֵבָה שֶׁל רַצְעָנִים. וְקָרוּי עָרָק. וְעַד שְׂרוֹךְ נַעַל (בראשית יד), תַּרְגּוּם וְעַד עַרְקַת מְסָאנָא. וּמִשּׁוּם דִּכְלֵי גֶמִי וְשַׁעַם דִּין כְּלֵי עֵץ יֵשׁ לָהֶם, הִלְכָּךְ תְּנִינְהוּ גַבֵּי הֲדָדֵי עִם כְּלֵי עֵץ:


משיעשה צפירה אחת טמא – and the long and flat vessel made of bamboo and its length is greater than its width, the writing of shoe-makers/saddlers is called ערק/long and flat vessel made of bamboo. It is the Aramaic translation of (Genesis 14:23): “[I will not take] so much as a thread or a sandal strap [of what is yours]” until the sandal strap. But because it is a bulrush and shoe, they have the law of a wooden vessel, therefore, we teach them together with wooden vessels.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:1)


**תּוּרְמֵל.** כִּיס שֶׁל עוֹר גָּדוֹל, שֶׁהָרוֹעֶה נוֹתֵן בּוֹ מְזוֹנוֹת וְכָל דָּבָר. וְדוֹמֶה לוֹ, וְלֹא הָרוֹעֶה בְתַרְמִילוֹ:


תורמל ([leather] bag) – a large leather pouch/bag that the shepherd places food and all things. And it is similar to it, but not the shepherd with his sack/bag.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:2)


**קִיחוֹתָיו.** מִסְגְּרוֹתָיו, כְּמִין אָזְנַיִם קְטַנּוֹת סְבִיבוֹת הַתּוּרְמֵל, וּמַכְנִיסִים בְּאוֹתָן אָזְנַיִם חֲבָלִים שֶׁסּוֹגְרִים אוֹתוֹ:


קיחותיו (shepherd’s bag) – its rims, like kinds of small ears/handles surrounding the leather bag, and he puts into those handles ropes that they close it with.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:3)


**סְקֹרְטְיָא.** עוֹר שֶׁלּוֹבְשִׁים הָעַבְּדָנִים בִּשְׁעַת מְלַאכְתָּן:


סקורטיא (leather coat, apron, table cover) – leather that the tanners wear at the time of their work.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:4)


**צִיצָתָהּ.** כְּעֵין צִיצִית שֶׁל טַלִּית, כָּךְ עוֹשִׂין לָהּ פְּתִילִים עַל כְּנָפַיִם לְקָשְׁרָם בָּהֶן. וְרַמְבַּ"ם פֵּרֵשׁ, סְקֹרְטְיָא עוֹר שֶׁאוֹכְלִים עָלָיו, וְצִיצָתָהּ, הוּא אֶמְצַע הָעוֹר שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים בּוֹ טַס שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת לְנוֹי, לְשׁוֹן צִיץ הַזָּהָב, שֶׁהוּא טַס שֶׁל זָהָב:


ציציתה (show-fringe) – like a kind of ritual fringes/Tzitzit of a Tallit/prayer shawl. So, we make the threads on its corners to tie attach them. But Maimonides explained, that סקורטיא, is leather that we eat upon, and its show-fringes is in the middle of the leather that we place upon it a foil/plate of metal for adornment, the language of the golden front plate (ציץ הזהב), which is a foil/plate of gold.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:4:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:5)


**טַבְּעוֹתֶיהָ.** טַבַּעַת נְחֹשֶׁת אוֹ בַּרְזֶל שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים בִּקְצֵה הַסְּקֹרְטְיָא:


טבעותיה – a copper or iron ring that they place on the edge of the leather coat.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:4:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:6)


**קָטָבוֹלְיָא.** עוֹר שֶׁמַּצִּיעִים עַל גַּבֵּי מִטָּה. וְקוֹרִים לוֹ בַעֲרָבִי נט"ע, וּפְשׁוּטֵי כְלֵי עוֹר מְקַבְּלִים טֻמְאָה מִדְּרַבָּנָן בִּלְבַד, כִּפְשׁוּטֵי כְלֵי עֵץ, וְדִינָן בָּזֶה שָׁוֶה, שֶׁאֵין מְקַבְּלִים טֻמְאָה מִדְּאוֹרַיְתָא אֶלָּא מִדְּרַבָּנָן בְּכָל שְׁאָר טֻמְאוֹת, חוּץ מִמִּשְׁכָּב וּמוֹשָׁב, שֶׁהֵן נַעֲשִׂים מִשְׁכָּב וּמוֹשָׁב מִדְּאוֹרַיְתָא כְּשֶׁהֵן מְיֻחָדִים לְכָךְ:


קטבליא (leather curtain, spread, cover – hide spread over the bed frame) – leather that they spread over the bed. And they call it NATAH in Arabic. And flat leather vessels are susceptible to receive ritual defilement from the Rabbis alone, like flat wooden utensils, and their law is similar in that they are not susceptible to receive ritual defilement from Torah, but rather from the Rabbis in all of the rest of the defilements except for the uncleanness caused by an unclean person lying o an object and the uncleanness caused by an unclean person’s sitting (i.e., the unclean seat) which ae made uncleanness by lying and uncleanness by sitting from the Torah when they are designated for this.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:4:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:7)


**הַכַּר וְהַכֶּסֶת.** כַּר קָטָן מִכֶּסֶת, וְעָשׂוּי לְהַנִּיחַ תַּחַת מְרַאֲשׁוֹתָיו. וְכֶסֶת תַּחַת כָּל גּוּפוֹ:


הכר והכסת – a mattress is smaller than a cushion, and is made to place under their heads. But the cushion [is made to be placed] underneath all of his body.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:4:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:4:8)


**פָּחוֹת מֵחֲמִשָּׁה טְפָחִים.** מְשַׁיְּרִים מִשּׁוּם פֶּתַח לְהַכְנִיס מִשָּׁם הַמּוֹךְ לְמַלְּאוֹת הַכַּר וְהַכֶּסֶת:


פחות מחמשה טפחים – they leave over/reserve because of the opening to bring in from there the hackled wool/lint/soft spongy substance to fill the mattress and the cushion.



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:5:1)


**פָּטִילְיָא.** קֻפָּה עֲשׂוּיָה מִמִּינִים שֶׁל עֲרָבָה, וְאוֹצְרִים בָּהּ גְּרוֹגָרוֹת:


פטיליא (wicker work – a sort of bale for packing dates, figs, etc.) – a basket made from species of trough, and they store in it dried figs.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:5:2)


**וַחֲסִינָה.** כְּמִין קֻפָּה עֲשׂוּיָה מִקּוֹצִים, וּמְשִׂימִין בָּהּ טִיט:


וחסינה (a wicker work used for purposes of storage) – like a kind of basket made from thorns, and they place plaster/clay upon it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:5:3)


**סוּגְנִיּוֹת.** לְשׁוֹן סוּגָה בַשּׁוֹשַׁנִּים, עוֹשִׂין כְּמִין כְּפִיפָה קְטַנָּה מִן הֶעָלִים וּמְכַסִּים בָּהּ פֵּרוֹת, וְאֵינָהּ אֶלָּא מְלֶאכֶת עֲרַאי:


סוגניות (loosely woven mats made of leaves [for covering up fruit]) – it is the language of סוגה בשושנים/”hedged about with lilies (Song of Songs 7:3). They make a kind of small basket of osier from the leaves and they cover fruits with it, but it is not other than a temporary construction.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:5:4)


**נְצָרִים.** מִצּוּרֵי הַדֶּקֶל:


נצרים (sprouts, shoots) – from the band made of palm-bark (i.e., wicker).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:5:5)


**חוֹתָל.** כְּלִי שֶׁעוֹשִׂים מֵחֲרָיּוֹת שֶׁל דֶּקֶל, וּמַנִּיחִין בּוֹ תְּמָרִים לַחִים וְהֵן מִתְבַּשְּׁלִים בְּתוֹכוֹ:


חותל (a bale which you can add to or take from – without cutting it open/wrapper of reed-matting) – a vessel that we make from the dried branches of the palm, and we place in it moist palm and they ripen in it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:5:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:5:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:5:6)


**נוֹתֵן לְתוֹכוֹ וְנוֹטֵל מִתּוֹכוֹ.** אֲבָל אִם אֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לְהוֹצִיא הַתְּמָרִים אֶלָּא אִם כֵּן יִקְרָעֶנּוּ אוֹ יַתִּיר הַחֲרִיּוֹת שֶׁלּוֹ, טָהוֹר, דְּכֵיוָן דְּקוֹרְעוֹ אוֹ מַתִּירוֹ מַשְׁלִיכוֹ לָאַשְׁפָּה, וְהָוֵי לְתַשְׁמִישׁ עֲרַאי:


נותן לתוכו ונוטל מתוכו – but if he is not able to remove the date-palms unless he tears it or loosens his dried palm branches, it is pure, for since he tears it or loosens it/unties it, he casts it into the dunghill/trash for it is of temporary use.



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:6:1)


**קְסָיָה.** בֵּית יָד שֶׁל עוֹר:


קסייא (a sort of glove for laborers) – a leather glove.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:6:2)


**שֶׁל זוֹרֵי גְרָנוֹת וְהוֹלְכֵי דְרָכִים וְשֶׁל עוֹשֵׂי פִשְׁתָּן טְמֵאָה.** דְּכֵיוָן דְּהִיא עֲשׂוּיָה כְּדֵי לֶאֱחֹז הַדָּבָר בְּיָדוֹ יָפֶה שֶׁלֹּא יִשָּׁמֵט מִמֶּנּוּ, אוֹ כְדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יִתְחֹב לוֹ קוֹץ בְּיָדוֹ, מִקְּרֵי עָשׂוּי לְקַבָּלָה, כֵּיוָן שֶׁהַדָּבָר שֶׁהוּא אוֹחֵז בּוֹ נִשְׁעָן עַל הַבֵּית יָד וּמְקַבְּלוֹ:


של זורי גרנות והולכי דרכים ושל עושי פשתן טמאה – for since it is made in order to hold the thing in his hand well so that it not become detached from him, or in order that a thorn not become inserted/stuck in his hand, it is called made for reception, for since the thing that he is holding on to lies on the glove and receives it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:6:3)


**שֶׁל גָּרוֹסוֹת.** הָעוֹשִׂים גְּרִיסוֹת שֶׁל פּוֹל בָּרֵחַיִם:


של גרוסות (of grist-makers) – that make pounded beans in the millstone.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:6:4)


**מִפְּנֵי הַזֵּעָה.** לִשְׁאֹב אֶת הַזֵּעָה כְּדֵי לְהָקֵר בְּשָׂרוֹ שֶׁלֹּא יַזִּיעַ. אִי נַמִּי, שֶׁלֹּא תְטַנֵּף זֵיעַת יָדָיו הַדָּבָר שֶׁהוּא אוֹחֵז בּוֹ:


מפני הזיעה – to absorb the perspiration in order to cool off his skin that he not perspire. Alternatively, the sweat of his hands will soil the thing that he is holding on to.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:6:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:6:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:6:5)


**טָהוֹר.** דְּתַשְׁמִישׁ עֲרַאי חֲשׁוּב:


טהור – for it is considered temporary usage.



### Mishnah 7

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:1)


**מַלְקוֹט.** עוֹר שֶׁמְּשִׂימִין בְּעֵינֵי הַפָּרָה כְּדֵי שֶׁתְּסַבֵּב וְתָדוּשׁ:


מלקוט (the bag – for receiving the excrements of working cattle) – leather that they place in the eyes of the cow in order that it should turn around and thresh.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:2)


**הֶחָסוּם.** כְּמִין מְצוֹדָה קְטַנָּה שֶׁל חֲבָלִים שֶׁחוֹסְמִים בָּהּ פִּי הַפָּרָה שֶׁלֹּא תֹאכַל:


החסום (muzzle) – like a kind of small net/trap of ropes that muzzle the in it the mouth of the cow in order that it cannot eat.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:3)


**מַדָּף שֶׁל דְּבוֹרִים.** כְּלִי שֶׁמְּשִׂימִים בּוֹ אֵשׁ וּגְלָלֵי בָקָר וּמְעַשְּׁנִים כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּבְרְחוּ הַנְּחִילִים שֶׁל דְּבוֹרִים מִן הַכַּוֶּרֶת וְיִקַּח הַדְּבַשׁ. מִלְּשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר תִּדְפֶנּוּ רוּחַ (תהלים א):


מדף של דבורים (vessel used for smoking the bees out) – a vessel that they place in it fire and the dung of cattle and they fumigate in order that the swarms of bees from the beehive will flee and he will take the honey. [This is] from the language of (Psalms 1:4): “[they are like the chaff] that wind blows away/אשר-תדפנו רוח.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:4)


**וְהַמְּנָפָה.** כְּלִי שֶׁמְּנִיפִין בּוֹ בִימוֹת הַחַמָּה לְהָבִיא הָרוּחַ:


והמנפה (and the fan) – a vessel/utensil that they wave on the hot days to bring the wind.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:5)


**קֻפְסָא.** כְּמִין אַרְגָּז קָטָן שֶׁהָאִשָּׁה נוֹתֶנֶת בּוֹ תַכְשִׁיטֶיהָ וְנוֹתֶנֶת עָלָיו כְּסוּת מִלְּמַעְלָה:


קופסא (the lid of a box) – a kind of small box/chest that the woman places in it her ornaments and places upon it a cover from above.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:6)


**קַמְטְרָא.** תֵּבָה שֶׁשּׁוֹמְרִים בָּהּ הַבְּגָדִים. עַל הַמֶּלְתָּחָה (מלכים ב י), מְתַרְגְּמִינַן עַל קוּמְטְרָה:


קמטרא – a chest that they protect clothing in it. We translate in Aramaic [the Biblical phrase] (2 Kings 10:22): “[He said to the man in charge] of the wardrobe, [‘Bring out the vestments for all the worshipers of Baal]” as on the chest protecting the clothing.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:7)


**וְהַמַּכְבֵּשׁ.** [כָּל חָרָשׁ עֵצִים] לְפִי מְלַאכְתּוֹ יֵשׁ לוֹ מָקוֹם שֶׁכּוֹבֵשׁ וְעוֹצֵר הָעֵץ כְּשֶׁהוּא מְעֻוָּת וְעָקֹם עַד שֶׁמְּיַשְּׁרוֹ:


והמכבש (the carpenter’s vise – for straightening wood) – [every wood carpenter/artisan] has, according his trade a place that he stores and gathers the wood that is crooked and curved until he straightens it out.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:8)


**וְהַקִּמְרוֹן.** הַמִּכְסֶה שֶׁעַל הַתֵּבָה הֶעָשׂוּי כְּעֵין קֻבָּה:


והקמרון (arched lid) – the cover that is upon the chest that is made like a kind of arched compartment.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:9)


**אַנְגְּלִין.** נַרְתִּיק שֶׁל עוֹר שֶׁעוֹשִׂין לַסֵּפֶר וּמַכְנִיסִים אוֹתוֹ בְתוֹכוֹ:


אנליגין (reading desk/pulpit) – a leather case that they make for a Scroll and they place it inside of it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:10)


**בֵּית הַנֶּגֶר.** נַרְתִּיק שֶׁל עוֹר שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים בְּתוֹכוֹ הַנֶּגֶר, הוּא הַיָּתֵד שֶׁמְּשִׂימִים אֲחוֹרֵי הַדֶּלֶת:


בית הנגר (door-bolt socket) – a leather case that the carpenter puts inside of it, which is the peg that they place on the back of the door.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:11)


**וּבֵית הַמַּנְעוּל.** נַרְתִּיק שֶׁל עוֹר שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים בּוֹ הַמַּנְעוּל שֶׁנּוֹעֲלִים בּוֹ הַדֶּלֶת:


ובית המנעול (lock-socket)– the leather case that they place in it the lock that locks the door.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:12)


**וּבֵית הַמְּזוּזָה.** קָנֶה שֶׁל מַתָּכוֹת שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים בּוֹ הַמְּזוּזָה:


ובית המזוזה – the metal beam that they place the Mezuzah in.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:13)


**וְהָאֵמוּם שֶׁל גּוֹדְלֵי מִצְנָפוֹת.** דְּפוּס כְּעֵין רֹאשׁ שֶׁל אָדָם שֶׁמְּתַקְּנִים עָלָיו הַמִּצְנֶפֶת:


והאמום של גודלי מצנפות (the block of the cap-makers) – a frame like a kind of head of a person that they prepare for him the priest’s turban.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:14)


**וְהַמַּרְכּוֹף.** כְּמִין סוּס שֶׁל עֵץ שֶׁהַלֵּיצָנִים מְשַׂחֲקִים בּוֹ. וְאִית דִּמְפָרְשֵׁי, כְּלִי שֶׁל עֵץ אֶרֶז הֶעָשׂוּי לְזַמֵּר:


והמרכוף (name of a musical instrument for he accompaniment of songs) – it is like a kind of wooden horse that the jesters/scoffers play with. But there are those who interpret/explain this, a wooden utensil of cedar that is made for music.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:15)


**וּרְבִיעִית שֶׁל אַלָּיִת.** וּבִמְנַעַנְעִים וּבִמְצַלְצְלִין, מְתַרְגְּמִינַן וּבִרְבִיעִין וּבְצֶלְצֱלִין:


ורביעית של אליית (wailer’s musical instrument) – and “with sistrums and cymbals,”(see II Samuel 6:5) that we translate in the Aramaic: “a sistra and cymbals.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:16)


**שֶׁל אַלָּיִת.** שֶׁל הַמְקוֹנֶנֶת. כְּמוֹ (יואל א) אֱלִי כִבְתוּלָה חֲגוּרַת שַׂק:


של אליית – of the female wailers. Like (Joel 1:8): “Lament – like a maiden girt with sackcloth [for the husband of her youth!].”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:17)


**גְּנוֹגְנִית הֶעָנִי.** תַּרְמִילוֹ שֶׁל עָנִי:


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:18)


**וְסָמוֹכוֹת הַמִּטָּה.** קוֹרוֹת שֶׁסּוֹמְכִין בָּהֶן הַמִּטָּה שֶׁלֹּא תִפֹּל:


וסמוכות המטה (supports/pillars of the bed) – beams that support the bed that it would not fall.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:19)


**טְפוּס שֶׁל תְּפִלִּין.** כְּמוֹ דְפוּס שֶׁל תְּפִלִּין:


טפוס של תפילין (block on which the case of the Tefillin is shaped) – like the frame of the Tefillin.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:20)


**אֵמוּם שֶׁל עוֹשֵׂי סַאגּוֹת.** דְּפוּס שֶׁל עוֹשֵׂי שַׁלְשְׁלָאוֹת. שֶׁעוֹשִׂין אוֹתָן עַל גַּבֵּי אֵמוּם הַיְנוּ [עַל גַּבֵּי] דְּפוּס. וְרַמְבַּ"ם גָּרֵיס, עוֹשֵׂי סוּתוֹת, לְשׁוֹן וּבְדַם עֲנָבִים סוּתוֹ (בראשית מט), וְהוּא הַדְּפוּס שֶׁל עֵץ שֶׁאוֹרְגִין עָלָיו הַבְּגָדִים:


אמום של עושי סאגוס (model/frame of dressmakers) – frame of those who make chains. That they make them on top of a model/frame, that is [on top of] a block. But Maimonides has the reading, עושי סותות/those who make dresses. It is the language of (Genesis 49:11): “His robe in blood of grapes.” And it is a wooden frame that one sews clothing upon it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:21)


**מְשַׁמְּשֵׁי מְשַׁמְּשָׁיו שֶׁל אָדָם.** כְּגוֹן כִּסּוּיֵי כֵלִים וְנַרְתִּיקֵי כֵלִים, שֶׁהֵם נַעֲשׂוּ לְשַׁמֵּשׁ הַכֵּלִים הַמְשַׁמְּשִׁים אֶת הָאָדָם:


משמשי משמשיו של אדם (all accessory items of essential equipment) – as for example, the coverings of utensils/vessels and the cases of vessels, which are made to serve the utensils that human beings use.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:7:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:7:22)


**בִּשְׁעַת מְלָאכָה וְשֶׁלֹּא בִשְׁעַת מְלָאכָה.** בִּזְמַן שֶׁהַכִּסּוּי מְשַׁמֵּשׁ אֶת הַכְּלִי לִשְׁמֹר מַה שֶּׁבְּתוֹכוֹ, וְהַיְנוּ שְׁעַת מְלָאכָה דִידֵיהּ, וּכְשֶׁאֵין כְּלוּם בַּכְּלִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ צָרִיךְ לְכִסּוּי קָרֵי לֵיהּ שֶׁלֹּא בִשְׁעַת מְלָאכָה. וְיֵשׁ כֵּלִים שֶׁמַּנִּיחִים עֲלֵיהֶן הַכִּסּוּי תָּמִיד בֵּין כְּשֶׁהוּא מָלֵא בֵּין כְּשֶׁהוּא רֵיקָן, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵין הַכִּסּוּי מְחֻבָּר בּוֹ, חֲשִׁיב כַּכְּלִי גוּפֵיהּ לְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה אֲפִלּוּ בִּזְמַן שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְחֻבָּר בּוֹ, כֵּיוָן שֶׁרָגִיל לִהְיוֹת תָּמִיד עָלָיו. וְהַאי כְּלָלָא דְרַבִּי יוֹסֵי, אַפְּשׁוּטֵי כְלֵי עֵץ הַמְשַׁמְּשִׁין אֶת הַכֵּלִים קָאֵי. אֲבָל כְּלֵי קִבּוּל, מִטַּמְּאִין בְּכָל עִנְיָן. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


בשעת מלאכה ושלא בשעת מלאכה – at the time when the covering services the vessel to protect what is within it, which is at the time of its service. But when there is nothing inside the vessel, that it doesn’t require a covering, it is called, not at the time of its service. But there are vessels that they always place the covering upon them whether it is full or whether it is empty, even though the covering is not attached to it, since it us generally always upon it. And this general principle of Rabbi Yossi refers to flat wooden vessels that service the vessels, but receptacles defile in every matter. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Yossi.



### Mishnah 8

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:1)


**הַפִּגְיוֹן.** סַכִּין שֶׁיֶּשׁ לוֹ שְׁתֵּי פִיּוֹת:


הפגיון (dagger) – a knife that has wo mouths.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:2)


**תִּיק מִכְחוֹל.** תִּיק הַכְּלִי שֶׁבּוֹ כּוֹחֲלִין הָעַיִן:


תיק מכוחל (a chest containing a staff used for painting the eye) – the case of a utensil that they paint the eye with it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:3)


**וּבֵית הַכְּחוֹל.** הַכְּלִי שֶׁשּׁוֹמְרִים בּוֹ אֶת הַכְּחוֹל:


ובית הכחול (case for the eye paint) – the vessel that protects the eye-paint that is in it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:4)


**מַכְתֵּב.** קֻלְמוֹס שֶׁל נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶל:


מכתב (stylus, writing tool) – a bronze and iron writing pen/reed.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:5)


**תְּרוּנְתֵּק.** תְּרֵין תִּיק. וְהוּא כְלִי אֶחָד וּבוֹ תִיקִין הַרְבֵּה חֲלוּקִים, לַקֻּלְמוֹס וְלַסַּכִּין וְלַמִּסְפָּרַיִם. וְרוֹפְאֵי הַחַבּוּרוֹת מִשְׁתַּמְּשִׁים בִּכְלִי זֶה הַרְבֵּה. וּבְלַעַ"ז פינארו"ל:


תרונתיק (trident, fork used in writing – probably for leveling the paper) – two cases. And it is one vessel and inside are many divided cases/sheaths, for reeds, knives and scissors. And the doctors of the associations/communities use this vessel a great deal. And in the foreign language, PINAROL.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:8:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:6)


**פָּגוֹשׁוֹת.** חִצִּים רְחָבִים. וּמְחִי קָבָלּוֹ [יְחֶזְקֵאל כו], מְתַרְגְּמִינַן וּמְחַת פָּגוֹשׁוֹהִי:


פגושות (catapult) – wide arrows and they wound those who receive them and we translate it in Aramaic ומחת פגושוהי/and he wounds with a battering projectile.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:8:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:7)


**סִמְפּוֹנְיָא.** כְּלִי זֶמֶר שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת:


מצדו טהור – that all that one he brings into it from the side is not considered a case but rather a mere covering.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:8:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:8)


**מִצִּדּוֹ טָהוֹר.** שֶׁכָּל שֶׁמַּכְנִיסוֹ מִן הַצַּד אֵינוֹ חֲשׁוּב נַרְתִּיק, אֶלָּא מִכְסֶה בְעָלְמָא:


סמפוניא – a [molten] metal musical instrument.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:8:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:9)


**הָאַלָּה.** שֵׁבֶט שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל וּבְרֹאשׁוֹ עִגּוּל כְּמוֹ כַדּוּר, וְיוֹצְאִים בּוֹ יְתֵדוֹת שֶׁדּוֹמוֹת לִשְׁקֵדִים, בַּעֲרָבִי קוֹרִין לוֹ דבו"ס, וּבְלַעַ"ז מאצ"א:


האלה (wrapping of a lance] – a copper staff and at its top is a circle like a ball, and pegs that are similar to almonds come out from it. In Arabi they call is DVUS.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:8:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:10)


**הֶעָשׂוּי לְחִפּוּי.** לְמִכְסֶה. תַּרְגּוּם מִכְסֶה, חוֹפָאָה:


העשוי לחיפוי – for covering. It is the Aramaic translation of cover/roofing.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 16:8:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/16:8:11)


**טָהוֹר.** דְּתַנְיָא, יָכוֹל שֶׁאֲנִי מְרַבֶּה חִפּוּי כֵלִים לְטֻמְאָה, תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר (ויקרא יא) אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה מְלָאכָה בָהֶם, פְּרָט לְחִפּוּי כֵּלִים:


טהור – as it is taught in a Baraita, it is possible that I increase the covering of vessels for impurity, as the inference teaches us (Leviticus 11:32): “[And anything on which one of them falls when dead shall be impure: be it any article of wood, or a cloth or a skin, or a sack – ] any such article that can be put to use [shall be dipped in water, and it shall remain impure until evening; then it shall be pure].”



## Chapter 17


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:1:1)


**כָּל כְּלֵי בַעֲלֵי בָתִּים שִׁעוּרָן בְּרִמּוֹנִים.** אִם נִקְּבוּ בְּמוֹצִיא רִמּוֹן, טְהוֹרִים:


כל כלי בעלי בתים שיעורן ברמונים – if they made an incision while removing a pomegranate, they are ritually pure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:1:2)


**רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר בְּמַה שֶּׁהֵן.** כָּל הַכֵּלִים שִׁעוּרָן כְּשֶׁאֵין רְאוּיִין לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בָּהֶן מֵעֵין הַתַּשְׁמִישׁ שֶׁהָיוּ מִשְׁתַּמְּשִׁים בָּהֶן תְּחִלָּה, כְּגוֹן כֵּלִים הַמְיֻחָדִים לַתְּאֵנִים שִׁעוּרָן בְּמוֹצִיא תְאֵנָה, וְהַמְיֻחָדִים לַזֵּיתִים שִׁעוּרָן בְּמוֹצִיא זַיִת. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר:


ר' אליעזר אומר במה שהן – all the vessel, their measure is when they are not appropriate to use them in the form the usage that they would initially use them. As for example, vessels that are designated for figs, their measure is when they remove a fig, and those which are designated for olives, their measure is when one removes an olive. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Eliezer.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:1:3)


**קֻפּוֹת הַגַּנָּנִים.** קֻפּוֹת בַּעֲלֵי הַגִּנּוֹת שֶׁעֲשׂוּיִין לִתֵּן בָּהֶם יְרָקוֹת:


קופות הגננים – baskets that those who own the gardens that they are used to place vegetables in them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:1:4)


**שִׁעוּרָן בְּמוֹצִיא אֲגֻדּוֹת יָרָק.** וּבְהָא מוֹדֶה תַנָּא קַמָּא לְרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר דְּאֵין שִׁעוּרָן בְּמוֹצִיא רִמּוֹן:


שיעורן במוציא אגודות ירק and in this, the first Tanna/teacher agrees with Rabbi Eliezer that their measure is not when removing a pomegranate.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:1:5)


**בְּתֶבֶן.** בְּמוֹצִיא תֶבֶן:


בתבן – when removing straw.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:1:6)


**גְּבָבָא.** תֶּבֶן דַּק מְעֹרָב בְּזֶבֶל. תַּרְגּוּם לְקוֹשֵׁשׁ קַשׁ (שמות ה), לְגַבָּבָא גִילָא. וְהַבַּלָּנִים דְּהַיְנוּ בַּעֲלֵי הַמֶּרְחֲצָאוֹת שׂוֹרְפִין אוֹתוֹ בַמֶּרְחֲצָאוֹת:


גבבא – thin straw mixed in manure. It is the Aramaic translation of (Exodus 5:12): “[Then the people scattered throughout the land of Egypt] to gather stubble for straw,” raking stubble/straw [that is rounded]. But the bathing attendants, that is, the owners of the bathhouses burn it in the bathhouses.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:1:7)


**כֻּלָּן בְּרִמּוֹנִים.** בֵּין שֶׁל בַּעֲלֵי בָתִּים בֵּין שֶׁל גַּנָּנִים. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ:


כולן ברמונים – whether they are of those who own homes or those who are gardeners. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehoshua.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:2:1)


**בִּפְקָעִיּוֹת שֶׁל שֶׁתִי.** מַטְוֵה הַשְּׁתִי דַק מִשֶּׁל עֵרֶב. כִּדְמוּכָח בִּכְתֻבּוֹת בְּפֶרֶק אַף עַל פִּי [דַּף סד]. וּפְקָעִיּוֹת שֶׁל שְׁתִי הֵן קְטַנִּים מִפְּקָעִיּוֹת שֶׁל עֵרֶב. וּפֵרוּשׁ פְּקָעִיּוֹת, גלוממור"י בְּלַעַ"ז. אִי נַמִּי מטאס"י בְּלַעַ"ז:


פקעיות של שתי (measured by ordinary size of warp/longitudinal clews) – the yarn of the warp/longitudinal clews is thinner than that of the latitudinal ones, as is found in [Tractate] Ketubot 64b, in Chapter [Five]"אף על פי" /Even though. And the longitudinal/warp clews are smaller than the latitudinal/woof clews. And the explanation of פקעיות is GLOMARI in the foreign tongue. Alternatively, MATASI in the foreign tongue.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:2:2)


**אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמְּקַבֶּלֶת שֶׁל עֵרֶב טְמֵאָה.** הָכִי קָאָמַר, וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵינָהּ מְקַבֶּלֶת שֶׁל שְׁתִי אִם מְקַבֶּלֶת שֶׁל עֵרֶב טְמֵאָה, שֶׁשִּׁעוּרָהּ בְּמוֹצִיא עֵרֶב, שֶׁהוּא גָדוֹל מִמּוֹצִיא שְׁתִי. וְכֵן אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמְּקַבֵּל אֶת הַתַּמְחוּיִין טָמֵא, כְּלוֹמַר אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהַנֶּקֶב גָּדוֹל שֶׁאֵינָהּ מְקַבֶּלֶת אֶת הַקְּעָרוֹת, אִם מְקַבֵּל אֶת הַתַּמְחוּיִין שֶׁהֵן גְּדוֹלִים מִן הַקְּעָרוֹת, עֲדַיִן מִקְּרֵי חֲזִי לְתַשְׁמִישׁוֹ הָרִאשׁוֹן וְטָמֵא:


אע"פ שמקבלת של ערב טמאה – this is what he said: But even though it does not receive warp clews, if it receives woof clews, it is ritually unclean. That its measure is the removal of the woof, which is larger than removing the warp. And similarly, even though it holds trays, it is ritually impure, that is to say, even though the incision is large and it doesn’t hold/receive the dishes, if it holds/receives the trays which are larger than the dishes, it is still called worthy of its first usage and is ritually impure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:2:3)


**אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמְּקַבֵּל אֶת הָרְעִי.** אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְקַבֵּל אֶת הַמַּשְׁקִין, אִם מְקַבֵּל אֶת הָרְעִי טָמֵא. בֵּית הָרְאִי, כְּמוֹ בֵית הָרְעִי. כְּלִי שֶׁנִּפְנֶה בוֹ וְיֵשׁ בּוֹ צוֹאָה וּמֵי רַגְלַיִם:


אע"פ שמקבל את הרעי – even though it (i.e., a night chamber/chamber pot) [which is too defective] does not receive/retain the liquids, if it retains solid excrement, like the chamber pot/night chamber, it is ritually impure. The digestive organ, like the night chamber/chamber pot. A vessel that one eases oneself in and it has excrement and urine in it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:2:4)


**מִפְּנֵי שֶׁאֵין מְקַיְּמִין אוֹתוֹ.** גָּרְסִינַן. וְאִית דְּגָרְסֵי, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהֵן מְקַיְּמִין אוֹתוֹ, וְאַמִּלְּתָא דְתַנָּא קַמָּא קָאֵי, דְּאָמַר אִם מְקַבֵּל אֶת הָעֵרֶב וְאֶת הַתַּמְחוּיִין וְאֶת הָרְעִי טָמֵא, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהֵן מְקַיְּמִין וְשׁוֹמְרִים אוֹתוֹ, כֵּיוָן דַּחֲזִי לְהָכִי. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל:


מפני שאין מקיימין אותו – is our reading (“because they do not keep it”). But there are those who have the reading of “because they keep it.” But it refers to the matter of the first Tanna/teacher, who stated, that if it keeps the woof and the trays and the digestive organ is ritually impure, because they keep it and protect it, since it is appropriate for this. But the Halakha is not according to Rabban Gamaliel.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:3:1)


**שִׁעוּרָן בְּכִכָּרוֹת שֶׁל פָּת.** שִׁעוּר שְׁבִירָתָן, בְּמוֹצִיא כִכָּרוֹת שֶׁל פַּת:


שיעורן בככרות של פת – the measure of their breakage through the removal of loaves of bread.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:3:2)


**אֱפִיפְיָרוֹת.** כְּלִי אָרוּג מִקָּנִים אוֹ זְמוֹרוֹת:


אפיפיירות (frames for hangings – to which reeds were fastened from the bottom upwards – crosswise – for support) – a woven utensil made from reeds or vine-shoots.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:3:3)


**שֶׁעָשָׂה לָהּ קָנִים מִלְּמַטָּה לְמַעְלָה.** שֶׁנִּפְחֲתוּ שׁוּלֵיהֶן וְהִכְנִיס קָנִים מִמַּטָּה לְמַעְלָה לְהַחְזִיק הַשּׁוּלַיִם:


שעשה לה קנים מלמטה למעלה – that their borders/rims were opened and they brought in reeds from the bottom to the top to strength the rims at the bottom of the vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:3:4)


**גַּפַּיִם.** שֶׁגִּפְּפָהּ סָבִיב. תַּרְגּוּם וַיְחַבֵּק, וְגַפֵּיף. פֵּרוּשׁ אַחֵר, גַּפַּיִם, שֶׁעָשָׂה לָהּ אָזְנַיִם:


גפים (handles) – that they attached as a rim. [It is] the Aramaic translation of ויחבק/and he embraced and throw arms around. Another explanation: arms/handles – that he made for them handles.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:3:5)


**אִם אֵינָהּ יְכוֹלָה לִנָּטֵל בַּגַּפַּיִם.** שֶׁכְּשֶׁאוֹחֵז בַּגַּפַּיִם אֵין הַכְּלִי עוֹלֶה עִמּוֹ:


אם אינה יכולה לינטל גפים – that when he holds the handles, the vessel does not go up with him (and it is not susceptible to receiving ritual defilement).



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:1)


**הָרִמּוֹנִים שֶׁאָמְרוּ.** הָא דִתְנַן בְּרֵישׁ פִּרְקִין כָּל כְּלֵי בַעֲלֵי בָתִּים שִׁעוּרָן בְּרִמּוֹנִים, כְּשֶׁיִּהְיוּ שְׁלֹשָׁה רִמּוֹנִים אֲחוּזִים זֶה בָזֶה וְיֵצֵא הָאֶחָד דֶּרֶךְ הַנֶּקֶב, זֶהוּ שִׁעוּר שֶׁל מוֹצִיא רִמּוֹן:


הרמונים שאמרו – that which is taught at the beginning of our chapter, “All Utensils of householders – their measure [is] with pomegranates” (Chapter 17, Mishnah 1), when there would be three pomegranates fastened with each other, and one came out through the path of an incision, this is the measure of someone removing a pomegranate.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:2)


**כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּטֹּל וִיהַלֵּךְ.** שֶׁמִּתּוֹךְ נִעְנוּעַ שֶׁל נְטִילָה וְהִלּוּךְ מְמַהֵר הָרִמּוֹן לָצֵאת דֶּרֶךְ הַנֶּקֶב:


כדי שיטול ויהלך (sufficient in order that one may take and shake) – that through the waving/shaking of taking it and shaking it – the pomegranate speedily leaves through the incision.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:3)


**וּבְקֻפָּה כְדֵי שֶׁיַּפְשִׁיל לַאֲחוֹרָיו.** שֶׁמִּתּוֹךְ הַפְשָׁלָה לַאֲחוֹרָיו הוּא מְמַהֵר לָצֵאת:


ובקופה כדי שיפשיל לאחוריו – that through hanging it behind him, he quickens the [pomegranate’s] leaving.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:4)


**שֶׁאֵינָן יְכוֹלִים לְקַבֵּל רִמּוֹנִים.** שֶׁהֵן קְטַנִּים:


שאינן יכולים לקבל רמונים – that they are small.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:4:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:5)


**כְּגוֹן הָרֹבַע.** רֹבַע הַקַּב:


כגון הרובע – a quarter of a Kab.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:4:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:6)


**שִׁעוּרָן בְּרֻבָּן.** כֵּיוָן דְּנִפְחַת רֻבּוֹ, טָהוֹר:


שיעורן ברובן – since the majority was reduced/lowered, it is ritually pure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:4:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:7)


**נִפְרְצוּ.** נִפְחֲתוּ וְחָסְרוּ:


נפרצו (if they were broken through) they were lessened and missing.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:4:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:8)


**נִגְמְמוּ.** בְּשִׂפְתוֹתֵיהֶן:


נגממו (if they are worn off – i.e., the sides of the vessel after becoming too thin) – at theirat their borders/rims.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:4:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:4:9)


**שִׁעוּרָן בְּמַה שֶּׁהֵן.** אִם נִשְׁאַר בָּהֶן כְּדֵי לְקַבֵּל כָּל שֶׁהוּא, טְמֵאִין. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן:


שיעורן כמה שהן – if there remains In them to receive/retain any amount, they are ritually impure. But the Halakha is according to Rabbi Shimon.



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:1)


**הָרִמּוֹן שֶׁאָמְרוּ.** דִּכְלִי שֶׁנִּקַּב בְּמוֹצִיא רִמּוֹן טָהוֹר:


הרמון שאמרו – that a vessel that is perforated with the removal of a pomegranate is ritually pure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:2)


**וּלְמָה הֻזְכְּרוּ רִמּוֹנֵי בָדָאן.** כֵּיוָן שֶׁאֵין מְשַׁעֲרִין בָּהֶן, אֶלָּא בְרִמּוֹן בֵּינוֹנִי:


ולמה הוזכרו רמוני בדאן – because we don’t estimate through them, other than through an intermediate-sized pomegranate.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:3)


**שֶׁיְּהוּ מְקַדְּשִׁים בָּהֶן.** שֶׁאִם אֶחָד מֵרִמּוֹנֵי בָדָאן שֶׁל עָרְלָה אוֹ שֶׁל כִּלְאֵי הַכֶּרֶם נִתְעָרֵב עִם אֶלֶף רִמּוֹנִים שֶׁל הֶתֵּר, נִתְקַדְּשׁוּ כֻּלָּן וְנֶאֶסְרוּ. מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן בְּרִמּוֹנִים שֶׁל שְׁאָר מְקוֹמוֹת:


שיהו מקדשים בהם – that if one of the pomegranates of Baddan are Orlah/fruit that grows during the first three years after a tree was planted or of food crops in a vineyard (i.e., it is forbidden to plant or maintain other crops in a vineyard – rendering the entire vineyard forbidden) that is mixed up/combined with one-thousand pomegranates that are permitted, all of them are sanctified/dedicated and forbidden, which is not the case with the pomegranates of other places.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:4)


**בָּדָאן.** שֵׁם מָקוֹם:


Baddan is the name of a place.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:5)


**לְשַׁעֵר בּוֹ אֶת הַכֵּלִים.** קָסָבַר דְּמוֹצִיא רִמּוֹן דְּכֵלִים, בְּרִמּוֹנֵי בָדָאן מְשַׁעֲרִינַן:


לשער בו את הכלים (to measure utensils with them) – for he holds that a person who removes a pomegranate of vessels, the pomegranates of Baddan measure them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:5:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:6)


**אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה לֹא הֻזְכְּרוּ רִמּוֹנֵי בָדָאן וְכוּ'.** אֲבָל לְעִנְיַן קִדּוּשׁ אֵין חִלּוּק בֵּין רִמּוֹנֵי בָדָאן לִשְׁאָר רִמּוֹנִים, דְּכֻלָּן מְקַדְּשִׁים, דְּסָבַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה כָּל שֶׁדַּרְכּוֹ לִמָּנוֹת מְקַדֵּשׁ. בְּפֶרֶק הַתַּעֲרֹבוֹת וּבְרֵישׁ מַסֶּכֶת בֵּיצָה:


אמר ר' יהודה לא הוזכרו רמוני בדאין וכו' – but in regard to sanctification, there is no distinction between the pomegranates of Baddan and the rest of the pomegranates, for all are sanctified. For Rabbi Yehuda holds that everything whose manner is to be counted is sanctified. In the Chapter of the Mixtures (Chapter 8 of Tractate Zevakhim), and at the beginning of the Tractate Betzah (3a).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:5:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:7)


**בָּדָאן וְגֶבַע.** שְׁנֵי מְקוֹמוֹת שֶׁל כּוּתִים הֵן, וְנִכָּרִים הָיוּ רִמּוֹנִים וְחָצִיר שֶׁל מְקוֹמוֹת הַלָּלוּ [מֵרִמּוֹן וְחָצִיר] שֶׁל שְׁאָר מְקוֹמוֹת. וְכוּתָאֵי וַדַּאי לֹא מְעַשְּׂרֵי מַאי דִּמְזַבְּנֵי לְאַחֲרִינֵי, דְּלֹא חָיְשֵׁי אַלִּפְנֵי עִוֵּר לֹא תִתֵּן מִכְשׁוֹל, אַף עַל גַּב דִּלְנַפְשַׁיְהוּ מְעַשְּׂרֵי. הִלְכָּךְ מִתְעַשְּׂרִים וַדַּאי בְּכָל מָקוֹם:


בדאן וגבע – two places of Cutheans, and the pomegranates and leeks of these places [from Rimon and Hatzir] of the rest of the places. But the Cutheans definitely do not tithe what they sell to others, and they are not anxious regarding [the Biblical verse in Leviticus 19:16): “place a stumbling block before the blind,” for even though for themselves they tithe, therefore, they definitely tithe in every place (previously certainly untithed).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:5:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:5:8)


**חֲצִירֵי.** כָּרְתִי פורו"ש בְּלַעַ"ז. כְּמוֹ אֶת הֶחָצִיר וְאֶת הַבְּצָלִים (במדבר יא):


חצירי – leeks are called PURUSH in the foreign tongue, like (Numbers 11:5): “the leeks and the onions.”



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:6:1)


**כַּבֵּיצָה שֶׁאָמְרוּ.** גַּבֵּי טֻמְאַת אֳכָלִים, שֶׁאֵין מְטַמְּאִין בְּפָחוֹת מִכַּבֵּיצָה:


בביצה שאמרו – regarding the ritual impurity of food, that they do not defile with less than an egg’s bulk.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:6:2)


**נוֹתֵן לְתוֹךְ הַמַּיִם.** מְמַלֵּא כוֹס מַיִם, וְנוֹתֵן לְתוֹכוֹ גְדוֹלָה שֶׁבַּגְּדוֹלוֹת וּקְטַנָּה שֶׁבַּקְּטַנּוֹת, וְחוֹלֵק הַמַּיִם הַיּוֹצְאִין לִשְׁנֵי חֲלָקִים, וְהַחֵלֶק הָאֶחָד הוּא שִׁעוּר בֵּיצָה:


ונותן לתוך מים – he fills a cup of water, and places into the largest of the large ones and the smallest of the small ones (i.e., eggs), and divides the volume of the water coming out into two parts and the one part is the measurement of an egg.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:6:3)


**וְכִי מִי מוֹדִיעֵנִי.** כְּלוֹמַר כְּשֶׁלּוֹקֵחַ גְּדוֹלָה שֶׁבַּגְּדוֹלוֹת שֶׁמָּא יֵשׁ יוֹתֵר גְּדוֹלָה הֵימֶנָּה. וְכֵן קְטַנָּה שֶׁבַּקְּטַנּוֹת שֶׁמָּא יֵשׁ יוֹתֵר קְטַנָּה מִמֶּנָּה:


וכי מי מודיעני – that is to say, that when a person takes the largest of the large ones, perhaps there is one larger than [even] that one. And similarly, the smallest of the small, perhaps thee is something smaller than it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:6:4)


**הַכֹּל לְפִי דַעְתּוֹ שֶׁל רוֹאֶה.** לְפִי אֹמֶד דַּעְתּוֹ שֶׁהִיא בֵּינוֹנִית לְמַרְאֵה עֵינָיו. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי:


הכל לפי דעתו של רואה – according to the estimate of his mind, which is the intermediate according to his eyesight. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Yossi.



### Mishnah 7

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:7:1)


**כַּגְּרוֹגֶרֶת שֶׁאָמְרוּ.** לְהוֹצָאַת שַׁבָּת, וּלְשִׁתּוּפֵי מְבוֹאוֹת. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


כגרוגרת שאמרו – for the removal [of foodstuffs] on Shabbat and to the merging of alleyways. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehuda (see also Tractate Shabbat, Chapter Seven, Mishnah Four and Tractate Eruvin, Chapter 7, Mishnah 8).



### Mishnah 8

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:8:1)


**כַּזַּיִת שֶׁאָמְרוּ.** כְּגוֹן כַּזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת וּמִן הַנְּבֵלָה שֶׁמְּטַמֵּא, וְרֹב שִׁעוּרִים שֶׁבַּתּוֹרָה בְכַזַּיִת:


כזית שאמרו – as for example, like an olive’s bulk from the dead or from the carrion that ritually defiles, and most of the measurements that are in the Torah are like an olive’s bulk.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:8:2)


**אֵגוֹרִי.** שֶׁשַּׁמְנוֹ אָגוּר בְּתוֹכוֹ:


אגורי (fit for storage, of good quality) – whose oil is stored within it (see Tractate Berakhot 39a).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:8:3)


**כַּשְּׂעֹרָה שֶׁאָמְרוּ.** עֶצֶם כַּשְּׂעֹרָה:


כשעורה שאמרו – a bone like a barleycorn (see also Tractate Negaim, Chapter Four, Mishnah Six).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:8:4)


**כָּעֲדָשָׁה שֶׁאָמְרוּ.** שֶׁרֶץ מְטַמֵּא בְכָעֲדָשָׁה, וּמִחְיָה בְכָעֲדָשָׁה:


כעדשה שאמרו – a creeping thing defiles like that of a lentil, and is sustenance like that of a lentil.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:8:5)


**מְבִיאִין טֻמְאָה.** עַל אָדָם הַנּוֹשְׂאָן:


מביאין טומאה – upon a person who carries them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:8:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:8:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:8:6)


**בָּעֳבִי הַמַּרְדֵּעַ.** דְּהַיְנוּ מַלְמַד הַבָּקָר. וְעָבְיוֹ אֶצְבַּע וּשְׁלִישׁ אֶצְבַּע בְּגֻדָּל, שֶׁהֵם שְׁתֵּי אֶצְבָּעוֹת בִּקְטַנּוֹת. שֶׁהַטֶּפַח אַרְבַּע אֶצְבָּעוֹת בְּגֻדָּל, שֶׁהֵם שֵׁשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת קְטַנּוֹת. וְנִמְצָא הֶקֵּפוֹ טֶפַח. שֶׁכָּל שֶׁיֶּשׁ בְּרָחְבּוֹ טֶפַח יֵשׁ בְּהֶקֵפוֹ שְׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים. וְגָזְרוּ עַל שֶׁיֶּשׁ בְּהֶקֵפוֹ טֶפַח, אַטּוּ עַל שֶׁיֶּשׁ בְּעָבְיוֹ טֶפַח שֶׁהוּא מֵבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה מִן הַתּוֹרָה:


בעובי המרדע (like the thickness of an ox goad) – that is from the study of cattle, and its thickness is one finger and a third-of a finger in size, which are two fingers in smallness. And the handbreadth is four fingers in size, which are six small fingers. And it is found that its circumference is a handbreadth. For everything that is its width of a handbreadth there is in its circumference three handbreadths, but they (i.e., the Rabbis) decreed on that which has a circumference of a handbreadth, on account of that whose thickness is a handbreadth, that he brings the ritual defilement from the Torah.



### Mishnah 9

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:9:1)


**הָאַמָּה שֶׁאָמְרוּ.** לְעִנְיַן שַׁבָּת וְעֵרוּבִין וְסֻכָּה וּמִדּוֹת וְכִלְאַיִם:


האמה שאמרו – to the matters of Shabbat and Eruvin and Sukkah and the measurements [of the Temple] and Kilayim/mixed seeds.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:9:2)


**בְּאַמָּה בֵּינוֹנִית.** הִיא אַמָּה בַּת שִׁשָּׁה טְפָחִים. דְּאִיכָּא אַמָּה בַּת חֲמִשָּׁה [קְטַנָּה מִמֶּנָּה], וְאִיכָּא אַמָּה גְדוֹלָה בַּת שִׁשָּׁה וְאֶצְבַּע, וְאַמָּה בַּת שִׁשָּׁה הִיא הַבֵּינוֹנִית:


באמה בינונית – this cubit is six handbreadths long. For there is a cubit that is five [handbreadths] [that is smaller than it]. And there is larger cubit that is six [handbreadths] and a finger in length. But the cubit that is six [handbreadths] is the medium-sized one.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:9:3)


**שְׁתֵּי אַמּוֹת.** שְׁתֵּי מִדּוֹת שֶׁבָּהֶן מוֹדְדִים הָאַמּוֹת, וְכָל אַחַת מֵהֶן אַמָּה:


שתי אמות – two measurements that with them they measure the cubits, and each one of them is a cubit.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:9:4)


**בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה.** חֶדֶר אֶחָד בָּנוּי עַל שַׁעַר מִזְרָחִי שֶׁל עֲזָרָה, וְעָלָיו שׁוּשָׁן הַבִּירָה מְצֻיֶּרֶת, כְּדֵי שֶׁתְּהֵא עֲלֵיהֶם אֵימַת מַלְכוּת:


בשושן הבירה – one room is built on the eastern gate of the courtyard, and upon it, the capital city of Shushan is painted on it, in order that the fear of the kingdom be upon them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:9:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:9:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:9:5)


**עַל שֶׁל מֹשֶׁה.** עַל אַמָּה בַּת שִׁשָּׁה טְפָחִים:


על של משה – on the cubit that is six handbreadths long.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:9:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:9:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:9:6)


**שֶׁהָאֻמָּנִין נוֹטְלִים בַּקְּטַנָּה.** שֶׁהָיָה הַגִּזְבָּר מַתְנֶה עִם הָאֻמָּנִים, כָּךְ וְכָךְ אַמּוֹת בִּנְיָן תַּעֲשׂוּ לְבֶדֶק הַבַּיִת מֵאַמּוֹת שֶׁל מֹשֶׁה, בְּכָךְ וְכָךְ דָּמִים, וּמַחְזִירִים לוֹ בְמִדַּת הָאַמָּה הַיְתֵרָה עָלֶיהָ אֶצְבַּע, כְּדֵי שֶׁיּוֹסִיפוּ מִשֶּׁלָּהֶם עַל תְּנָאָם, פֶּן יִפְחֲתוּ וְנִמְצְאוּ בָאִין לִידֵי מְעִילָה שֶׁנֶּהֱנוּ מִן הַהֶקְדֵּשׁ. וְלָמָּה שְׁתַּיִם, חֲדָא לְכַסְפָּא וְדַהֲבָא, שֶׁכְּשֶׁמַּתְנִים עִם צוֹרְפֵי זָהָב וָכֶסֶף לַעֲשׂוֹת טַבְלָא בַּת אַרְבַּע וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת בָּאַמָּה שֶׁל מֹשֶׁה, מַחֲזִירִים לַמִּדָּה הַיְתֵרָה עָלֶיהָ חֲצִי אֶצְבַּע, לֹא לַמִּדָּה הַיְתֵרָה עָלֶיהָ אֶצְבַּע, לְפִי שֶׁאֻמָּנוּת יְקָרָה הִיא וְאֵין מַפְסִידִין אוֹתָן כָּל כָּךְ:


שהאומנין נוטלים בקטנה – that the treasurer/manager would make a condition with the artisans – such-and-such cubits they would make in the building for the keeping of the Temple in repair, from the cubits of Moses, such and such a costs, and they would return to him by a finger (see Tractate Menahot 98a) the measurement of the longer cubit upon it, in order that they would add from their own on their condition, lest they make it less, and it is found that they come to commit a religious sacrilege that they benefited from that which was dedicated to the Temple. And why two? One for silver and gold, that when they make a condition with those who smelt gold and silver to make a tablet of four or five cubits in the cubit of Moses, they restore to the extra measure of it a half-finger, not for the additional measurement upon it of a finger, since the artistry is costly and they don’t cause them to lose so much.



### Mishnah 10

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:10:1)


**כָּל הָאַמּוֹת הָיוּ בֵינוֹנִיּוֹת.** בְּאַמָּה בַּת שִׁשָּׁה:


כל האמות היו בינונית – which a cubit that is six handbreadths in length.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:10:2)


**חוּץ מִמִּזְבַּח הַזָּהָב.** שֶׁהָיָה אַמָּה עַל אַמָּה:


חוץ ממזבח הזהב – that was a cubit by a cubit.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:10:3)


**וְהַקֶּרֶן.** שֶׁל מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת. שֶׁהָיוּ לוֹ עַל אַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹתָיו אַרְבַּע אֲבָנִים שֶׁל אַמָּה גֹבַהּ, וְאַמָּה עַל אַמָּה עֳבִי. וְאוֹתָהּ אַמָּה הָיְתָה בְּאַמָּה בַּת חֲמִשָּׁה:


והקרן – of the bronze altar. For it had on its four corners four stones of a cubit in height and a cubit by a cubit in thickness. And that cubit was with the cubit that was five [handbreadths in length].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:10:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:10:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:10:4)


**וְהַסּוֹבֵב וְהַיְסוֹד.** שֶׁל מִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת. וּבְפֶרֶק ג'‏ דְּמַסֶּכֶת מִדּוֹת הֵן מְפֹרָשִׁים:


והסובב והיסוד – of the bronze altar. And in the third chapter of [Tractate] Middot, they are explained (see Tractate Middot, Chapter three, Mishnah one).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:10:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:10:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:10:5)


**אַמַּת בִּנְיָן.** כְּגוֹן חוֹמַת הַבַּיִת וּמִזְבַּח הָעוֹלָה:


אמת בנין – such as the wall of the Temple and the altar of the burnt-offering.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:10:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:10:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:10:6)


**אַמַּת כֵּלִים.** כְּגוֹן אָרוֹן וְשֻׁלְחָן וּמִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי מֵאִיר:


אמת כלים – such as the Ark, and the table and the Golden Altar. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Meir.



### Mishnah 11

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:1)


**בְּמִדָּה דַקָּה.** שֶׁל מִדְבָּר קְרוּיָה מִדָּה דַקָּה. לְפִי שֶׁיֶּשׁ מִדְבָּרִית יְרוּשַׁלְמִית וְצִפּוֹרִית, וּמִדְבָּרִית קְטַנָּה שֶׁבְּכֻלָּן:


במדה דקה (a smaller measure) – of the wilderness, it is called the smaller measure, because there is the Jerusalem wilderness and the Tzipori/Sepphoris [measurement] (in the Upper Galilee), but the wilderness one is smaller than all of them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:2)


**מִדּוֹת הַלַּח.** הִין וַחֲצִי הִין:


מדות הלח – a Hin (i.e., twelve LOG or 72 egg bulks) and one-half of a Hin.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:3)


**וְהַיָּבֵשׁ.** עִשָּׂרוֹן וַחֲצִי עִשָּׂרוֹן:


והיבש – the Issaron (i.e., one-tenth of an Ephah) and the half-Issaron.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:11:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:4)


**בָּאִיטַלְקִי.** בְּמִדָּה שֶׁל אִיטָלִיאָה שֶׁל יָוָן. וְזוֹ הִיא מִדְבָּרִית שֶׁהָיְתָה בִימֵי מֹשֶׁה:


באיטלקי in the Italian measurement of Greece, and this is the wilderness one that existed at the time of Moses.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:11:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:5)


**כְּפִי מַה שֶּׁהוּא אָדָם.** בֵּין קָטָן וּבֵין גָּדוֹל:


כפי מה שהוא אדם – whether small or large [as in the size of the person].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:11:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:6)


**קוֹמֵץ הַמִּנְחָה.** דִּכְתִיב (ויקרא ב) וְקָמַץ מִמֶּנּוּ מְלֹא קֻמְצוֹ:


קומץ המנחה (the handful of the meal-offering) – as it is written (Leviticus 2:2): “[The priest] shall scoop out of it a handful [of its choice flour and oil, as well as all of its frankincense].”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:11:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:7)


**וְחוֹפְנֵי קְטֹרֶת.** שֶׁל יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים, דִּכְתִיב (שם טז) וּמְלֹא חָפְנָיו קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים דַּקָּה:


וחפני קטורת (and he takes both hands full of incense) – of Yom Kippur, as it is written (Leviticus 16:12): “and two handfuls of finely ground aromatic incense.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:11:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:8)


**כִּמְלֹא לֻגְמָיו.** אִם שָׁתָה מְלֹא לֻגְמָיו בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים, חַיָּב. וּלְפִי לֻגְמָיו שֶׁל שׁוֹתֶה מְשַׁעֲרִינַן:


כמלוא לוגמיו ([and drinks] a mouthful ) – if he drank a mouthful on Yom Kippur, he is liable. And according to the mouthful of the person who drinks we measure/estimate.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:11:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:9)


**כִּמְזוֹן שְׁתֵּי סְעֻדּוֹת לָעֵרוּב.** עֵרוּבֵי תְחוּמִין אֵינוֹ בְּפָחוֹת מִמְּזוֹן שְׁתֵּי סְעוּדוֹת:


כמזון שתי סעודות ולעירוב – the joining of borders is not with less than food for two meals.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:11:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:10)


**מְזוֹנוֹ לְחֹל.** כְּמָזוֹן לִשְׁתֵּי סְעוּדוֹת שֶׁל חֹל שֶׁאוֹכֵל מְעַט, וְלֹא כִמְזוֹן שְׁתֵּי סְעוּדוֹת שֶׁל שַׁבָּת דְּאָכֵיל טְפֵי, מִשּׁוּם דִּבְסִים תַּבְשִׁילֵיהּ, וְרַוְחָא לִבְסוּמֵי שְׁכִיחַ:


מזונו לחול – like the food for two meals of a weekday when he eats a little bit, but not like the food for two meals on Shabbat that he eats more because of the sweetness of his cooking, it is found that for delicacies there is always room.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:11:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:11)


**לַשַּׁבָּת אֲבָל לֹא לַחֹל.** דְּאַדְּרַבָּה, שְׁתֵּי סְעוּדוֹת שֶׁל שַׁבָּת פְּחוּתִים מִשְּׁתֵּי סְעוּדוֹת שֶׁל חֹל, כֵּיוָן דִּבְשַׁבָּת סָעֵיד שָׁלֹשׁ סְעוּדוֹת, אֵינוֹ מַרְבֶּה לֶאֱכֹל בְּכָל סְעוּדָה:


לשבת אבל לא לחול – for on the contrary, two meals of the Sabbath day are less than two meals of the weekday, because a person eats three meals on Shabbat and he doesn’t increase his eating at each meal.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:11:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:12)


**וְאֵלּוּ וָאֵלּוּ מִתְכַּוְּנִים לְהָקֵל.** כָּל אֶחָד מֵהֶן מִתְכַּוֵּן לְמָעֵט בַּכִּכָּר שֶׁל עֵרוּב:


ואלו ואלו מתכוונים להקל (these and those intend to give the more lenient ruling) – each one of them intendents to lessen the loaf of the Eruv.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:11:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:13)


**מִשְּׁתֵּי יָדוֹת לְכִכָּר מִשָּׁלֹשׁ לְקָב.** דַּי לָעֵרוּב בִּשְׁתֵּי יָדוֹת שֶׁל כִּכָּר שֶׁל שָׁלֹשׁ כִּכָּרוֹת לַקָּב, נִמְצָא כִכָּר שָׁלֵם שְׁלִישִׁית הַקָּב, וּשְׁתֵּי יְדוֹתֶיהָ הָוֵי כִּכָּר שֶׁל עֵרוּב:


משתי ידות לככר משלש לקב ([it should consist] of two-thirds of a loaf [of a size] three to the Kab)-it is enough for an Eruv with two-thirds of loaf of [a size] three loaves to the Kab. It is found that a complete loaf is one-third of a Kab, and its two-thirds of a loaf is a loaf of the Eruv.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:11:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:11:14)


**מִכִּכָּר בְּפֻנְדְּיוֹן.** כִּכָּר הַלָּקוּחַ בְּפֻנְדְּיוֹן מִן הַנַּחְתּוֹם כְּשֶׁנִּמְכָּרִים אַרְבַּע סְאִים בְּסֶלַע. וְאַרְבַּע סְאִים הֵן עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה קַבִּין שֶׁכָּל סְאָה הִיא שִׁשָּׁה קַבִּין, וְהַסֶּלַע הִיא אַרְבָּעָה דִינָרִים, וְהַדִּינָר שֵׁשׁ מָעִין, נִמְצָא הַסֶּלַע עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע מָעִין, וְנִמְצָא עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה קַבִּין לְעֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה מָעִין קַב לְכָל מָעָה, וְהַמָּעָה שְׁנֵי פֻנְדְּיוֹנִים, הֲרֵי הַכִּכָּר הַנִּמְכָּר בְּפֻנְדְּיוֹן הוּא חֲצִי קַב. אֲבָל מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהַחֶנְוָנִי רוֹצֶה לְהִשְׂתַּכֵּר, וִיצִיאַת הָאֲפִיָּה וְהַטְּחִינָה, לֹא יִהְיֶה הַכִּכָּר הַנִּמְכָּר בְּפֻנְדְּיוֹן כְּשֶׁנִּמְכָּרִים אַרְבַּע סְאִין בְּסֶלַע אֶלָּא רֹבַע קַב, וְהָרֹבַע הָאַחֵר הוֹלֵךְ בִּשְׂכַר הַחֶנְוָנִי וִיצִיאַת הָאֲפִיָּה וְהַטְּחִינָה. הֲרֵי כִּכָּר הַלָּקוּחַ בְּפֻנְדְּיוֹן הוּא רֹבַע הַקַּב, דְּהַיְנוּ שֵׁשׁ בֵּיצִים, וְהוּא שִׁעוּר שְׁתֵּי סְעֻדּוֹת, וְהַיְנוּ כִכָּר שֶׁל עֵרוּב. וְכֵן הֲלָכָה:


מככר בפונדיון – a loaf that is purchased with a Pundiyon/Dupondium (a Roman coin equal to two I ssar/16 Perutot) from the baker when four Seah of what are worth one Sela. And four Seah are twenty-four Kab that each Seah is six Kabim. And the Sela is four Denarim and the Denar is worth six Ma’ah, and he Ma’ah is worth two Pundiyonim, therefore, the loaf that is sold for Pundiyon is one-half of Kab. But because the shopkeeper wishes to make a profit, and the costs of baking and grinding , the loaf will not be sold for a Pundiyon when they are sold four Seah for a Sela, but rather one-quarter of a Kab, and the other one-quarter goes to the profit of the shopkeeper and the expenses of baking and grinding.
