Therefore, a loaf that is purchased for a Pundiyon is one-quarter of a Kab, which is six eggs, and it is the measurement of two meals, which is the loaf of the Eruv. And this is the Halakha (according to Rabbi Yohanan ben Beroka).



### Mishnah 12

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:1)


**מְלֹא תַרְוָד רָקָב.** מְלֹא כַף עַפְרוּרִית מִן הַמֵּת אַחַר שֶׁכָּלָה כָּל לַחוּת שֶׁבּוֹ:


מלא תרווד רקב (a ladleful of corpse mold) – see also – Tractate Nazir, Chapter 7, Mishnah 2 (a spoonful of Rakab) – he filled a spoon of sandy-matter of grain from the corpse after all the moistness has been depleted.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:2)


**מְלֹא תַרְוָד גָּדוֹל שֶׁל רוֹפְאִים.** שֶׁהוּא גָדוֹל מִשְּׁאָר תַּרְוָדִים. וְשִׁעוּרוֹ מְלֹא חָפְנַיִם:


מלא תרווד גדול של רופאים (filled a large spoon of the physicians – two handfuls) – which is larger than all the ladles, and its measure is two handfuls.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:12:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:3)


**כַּגְּרִיס הַקִּלְקִי.** כַּחֲצִי פוֹל הַבָּא מִמָּקוֹם שֶׁשְּׁמוֹ קִלְקִי, וְהַפּוֹלִים שֶׁבּוֹ גְּדוֹלִים מִשְּׁאָר פּוֹלִים. וְשִׁעוּר מְקוֹם גְּרִיס הַקִּלְקִי, תֵּשַׁע עֲדָשׁוֹת שָׁלֹשׁ עַל שָׁלֹשׁ מְרֻבָּעוֹת. וּמְקוֹם עֲדָשָׁה, אַרְבַּע שְׂעָרוֹת, נִמְצָא מְקוֹם הַגְּרִיס שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשֵׁשׁ שְׂעָרוֹת:


כגריס הקלקי (like the Cilician split bean) – it is a bean that comes from a place whose name is Kilki, and the beans there are larger than all other beans. And the measure of the place of the Cilician split bean is nine lentils, three-by-three square. And the place of the lentil, is four hairs, and it is found that the place of split bean is thirty-six hairs.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:12:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:4)


**כּוֹתֶבֶת הַגַּסָּה.** גְּדוֹלָה מִשְּׁאָר תְּמָרִים. וְשִׁעוּרָהּ מְעַט פָּחוֹת מִכַּבֵּיצָה:


כותבת הגסה (a large date of a certain species) – larger than other date-palms, and its measure is a bit less than that of an egg.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:12:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:5)


**כָּמוֹהָ וּכְגַרְעִינָתָהּ.** שֶׁצָּרִיךְ לִמְעֹךְ חֲלָלָהּ:


כמוה וכגרעינתה (the like of it together with its kernel of the stone fruit) – that one must crush its open space.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:12:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:6)


**וְנוֹדוֹת יַיִן וָשֶׁמֶן.** שֶׁל עוֹר שֶׁנִּקְּבוּ, שִׁעוּר הַנֶּקֶב שֶׁלָּהֶן:


ונודות יין ושמן (and bags of wine and oil) – of leather that were perforated, the measure of their perforation.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:12:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:7)


**כְּפִיקָה גְדוֹלָה.** שֶׁמְּשִׂימִים בַּפֶּלֶךְ כְּשֶׁהַנָּשִׁים טֹווֹת בּוֹ:


כפיקה גדולה (like a large coil or tuft used as a stopper) – that they place in the spindle that women spin with.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:12:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:8)


**וּמָאוֹר.** כְּמִין חַלּוֹן שֶׁמִּמֶּנּוּ הָאוֹרָה נִכְנֶסֶת לַבַּיִת:


ומאור – it is a kind of window from which the light enters into the house.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:12:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:9)


**שֶׁלֹּא נַעֲשָׂה בִידֵי אָדָם.** כְּגוֹן חוֹר שֶׁחֵרְרוּהוּ מַיִם אוֹ שְׁרָצִים, אוֹ שֶׁנָּפַל הֶעָפָר מֵאֵלָיו וְנַעֲשָׂה שָׁם נֶקֶב. וְאִם לֹא חָשַׁב עָלָיו לְתַשְׁמִישׁ אוֹ לְמָאוֹר, שִׁעוּרוֹ לְהָבִיא אֶת הַטֻּמְאָה מֵאֹהֶל הַמֵּת לַבַּיִת לְדֶרֶךְ הַנֶּקֶב:


שלא נעשה בידי אדם – as for example a cavity/hole that water or reptiles make, or that the dirt fell on its own and a perforation was made there. But if he did not think of it for use or for as a source of light, its measure to bring the defilement from the tent of the corpse to the house through the path of the incision.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:12:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:10)


**כְּאֶגְרוֹפוֹ שֶׁל בֶּן בָּטִיחַ.** דְּהַיְנוּ אָדָם יָדוּעַ אֶצְלָם, וּבֶן בָּטִיחַ שְׁמוֹ, שֶׁהָיָה אֶגְרוֹפוֹ גָדוֹל:


באגרופו של בן אבטיח – that is a man known among them and Ben Batiach is his name, that he had a large fist.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:12:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:11)


**וְשֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה בִידֵי אָדָם.** שֶׁעֲשָׂאוֹ אָדָם לְהַכְנִיס אֶת הָאוֹרָה:


ושנעשה בידן אדם – or that a person made it to bring in the light.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:12:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:12)


**נֵירוֹנִית.** מַטְבֵּעַ שֶׁל נֵירוֹן קֵיסָר:


נירונית (Neronian) – a coin of Nero Caesar.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:12:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:12:13)


**כִּמְלֹא נֶקֶב שֶׁבָּעֹל.** מְלֹא מַקְדֵּחַ שֶׁל לִשְׁכָּה. וּפֻנְדְּיוֹן הָאִיטַלְקִי וְסֶלַע הַנֵּירוֹנִית וּמְלֹא נֶקֶב שֶׁבָּעֹל, כֻּלָּן שִׁעוּר אֶחָד לָהֶן. וְיֵשׁ מְקוֹמוֹת שֶׁהָיוּ יוֹדְעִים בְּאֶחָד מֵהֶן וְלֹא בְאַחֵר, הִלְכָּךְ תְּנִינְהוּ לְכֻלְּהוּ:


כמלוא נקב בשעול (the hole in a yoke) – like [the hole made by] the larger carpenters’ borer kept in the Temple cell. And the Italian Pundiyon and the Neronian stone, and the hole in a yoke, all of them is one measurement. But there are places where they knew about one of them, but not the other, Therefore, we teach all of them.



### Mishnah 13

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:13:1)


**כֹּל שֶׁבַּיָּם טָהוֹר.** כָּל בְּרִיּוֹת שֶׁבַּיָּם אִם עָשָׂה מֵעוֹרָן כֵּלִים, אֵין מְקַבְּלִין טֻמְאָה, דִּכְתִיב (ויקרא יא) אוֹ בֶגֶד אוֹ עוֹר אוֹ שַׂק, מַה בֶּגֶד מִן הַגָּדֵל מִן הָאָרֶץ, אַף עוֹר מִן הַגָּדֵל מִן הָאָרֶץ:


כל שבים טהור – all the creatures that are I the sea, if he made vessels from their skin, they do not receive defilement, as it is written (Leviticus 11:32): “[And anything on which one of them falls when dead shall be impure: be it any article of wood,] or a cloth, or a skin, or a sack –[any such article that can be put to use shall be dipped in water, and it shall remain impure until evening, then it shall be pure],” just as cloth is from something that grows from the earth, even too the skin that that which grows in the earth.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:13:2)


**חוּץ מִכֶּלֶב הַמַּיִם.** לְפִי שֶׁכָּל שְׁאָר בְּרִיּוֹת שֶׁבַּיָּם אֵין אֶחָד מֵהֶם בּוֹרֵחַ לַיַּבָּשָׁה כְּשֶׁבָּאִים לָצוּד אוֹתָם, אֶלָּא כֶלֶב הַיָּם בִּלְבַד, הִלְכָּךְ הָוֵי בִכְלַל עוֹרוֹת הַיַּבָּשָׁה, וְאִם עָשָׂה כְלִי מֵעוֹרוֹ מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא:


חוץ מכלב המים – because all the rest of the creatures of the sea – not one of them flees to the dry land when [hunters] come to hunt them, other than the sea dog alone, therefore, it is included within the skins of the dry land, and if he made a vessel from its skin, it is susceptible to receive defilement. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Akiva.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:13:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:13:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:13:3)


**אֲפִלּוּ חוּט אֲפִלּוּ מְשִׁיחָה.** וּבִלְבַד שֶׁיְּחַבְּרֶנּוּ לוֹ בְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁאִם הָיוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מִן הַגָּדֵל בָּאָרֶץ מְחֻבָּרִים בְּחִבּוּר כָּזֶה הָיָה טָמֵא הָאֶחָד כְּשֶׁנִּטְמָא חֲבֵרוֹ:


אפילו חוט אפילו משיחה (even a thread or a cord) – and as long as he connects them for himself on the road that if both of them were from what grows on the land are attached with a connection like this, the one would become defiled when its partner was defiled.



### Mishnah 14

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:1)


**יֵשׁ בְּמַה שֶּׁנִּבְרָא בַיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן טֻמְאָה.** הָכִי קָאָמַר, יֵשׁ דְּבָרִים שֶׁנִּבְרְאוּ בְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁהָעוֹשֶׂה כְלִי מֵהֶם יֵשׁ בָּהֶם טֻמְאָה, כְּגוֹן הָאָרֶץ שֶׁנִּבְרֵאת בְּיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן, וּכְלֵי חֶרֶס הַנַּעֲשִׂים מִמֶּנָּה טְמֵאִים:


יש במה שנברא יום הראשון טומאה – this is what he said: There are things that were created on the First Day [of the Creation of the world], that one who makes vessels from them, they have ritual defilement, such as the land which was created on the first day, and earthenware vessels that are made from it are ritually defiled.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:2)


**בַּשֵּׁנִי אֵין בּוֹ טֻמְאָה.** שֶׁבּוֹ נִבְרָא רָקִיעַ וְאֵין בּוֹ טֻמְאָה:


בשני אין בו טומאה – for on it, the firmament was created and it lacks ritual defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:14:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:3)


**בַּשְּׁלִישִׁי.** נִבְרְאוּ אִילָנוֹת, וּכְלֵי עֵץ הַנַּעֲשִׂים מֵהֶם מְקַבְּלִים טֻמְאָה:


בשלישי – [on the third day] trees were created, and wood vessels made from them are susceptible to receive ritual defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:14:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:4)


**בָּרְבִיעִי.** נִתְלוּ הַמְּאוֹרוֹת, וְאֵין בָּהֶם טֻמְאָה:


ברביעי – the heavenly lights were suspended [in the sky], and they lack ritual defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:14:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:5)


**בַּחֲמִישִׁי.** עוֹפוֹת וְדָגִים, וְאִם עָשָׂה מֵהֶן כֵּלִים אֵין מְקַבְּלִים טֻמְאָה:


בחמישי – [on the Fifth day] birds and fish [were created], and if he made vessels from them, they are not susceptible to receive ritual defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:14:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:6)


**חוּץ מִכְּנַף הָעוֹז.** כְּנַף הָעָזְנִיָּה. דְּרַבָּנָן גָּזְרוּ טֻמְאָה בְכֵלִים הַנַּעֲשִׂים מִמֶּנָּה, דְּאָתֵי לְאַחְלוּפֵי בִשְׁאָר כֵּלִים:


חוץ מכנף העוז (except for the wing of the black eagle) – the wing of the black eagle, for the Rabbis decreed ritual defilement with vessels made from her, for one can come to switch it with other vessels.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:14:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:7)


**וּבֵיצַת הַנַּעֲמִית הַמְצֻפָּה.** בַּת הַיַּעֲנָה מְתַרְגְּמִינַן נַעֲמִיתָא. וְרַבָּנָן גָּזְרוּ טֻמְאָה בְבֵיצָתָהּ כְּשֶׁהִיא מְצֻפָּה, כֵּיוָן דִּבְלֹא צִפּוּי נַמִּי עוֹמֶדֶת. אֲבָל בִּשְׁאָר בֵּיצִים, אֲפִלּוּ בִמְצֻפָּה לֹא גָזְרוּ, כֵּיוָן דִּבְאֵינָהּ מְצֻפָּה לֹא קַיְמָא כְלָל:


וביצת הנעמית המצופה (the glazed shell of an ostrich egg) – we translate into Aramaic the בת היענה (see Leviticus 11:16) – the egg of an ostrich is called נעמיתא/an ostrich egg. But the Rabbis decreed ritual defilement on its egg when it is a glazed shell, since without he covering, it also stands, but the rest of the eggs, even with a glazed shell, they did not make a decree, since it is not covered, it doesn’t exist at all.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:14:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:14:8)


**כֹּל שֶׁנִּבְרָא בַיּוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי טָמֵא.** חַיּוֹת וּבְהֵמוֹת וּשְׁרָצִים וְאָדָם. אִם עָשָׂה כֵלִים מֵעַצְמוֹתֵיהֶן אוֹ מֵעוֹרוֹתֵיהֶן, מְקַבְּלִים טֻמְאָה:


כל שנברא ביום הששי טמא – beasts and animals and reptiles and mankind [were created on the Sixth day of Creation], if one made vessels from their bones or from their skins, they are susceptible to receive ritual defilement.



### Mishnah 15

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:15:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:15:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:15:1)


**הָעוֹשֶׂה כְלִי קִבּוּל מִכָּל מָקוֹם.** וַאֲפִלּוּ לֹא עֲשָׂאוֹ רָאוּי לְקַבֵּל אֶלָּא מַשֶּׁהוּ:


העושה כלי קבול מכל מקום – and even if he did not make it, it is worthy to receive [ritual defilement] other than something.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:15:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:15:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:15:2)


**מִשְׁכָּב וּמוֹשָׁב מִכָּל מָקוֹם.** לִישִׁיבָה מֻעֶטֶת. כְּגוֹן שֶׁהָיָה נִשְׁעָן אוֹ נִתְלֶה בוֹ:


משכב ומושב (surface designated for lying and sitting) – for sitting a little bit, as for example, that he was leaning or suspended upon it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:15:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:15:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:15:3)


**מֵעוֹר הַמַּצָּה.** דְּלֹא מָלִיחַ וְלֹא קָמִיחַ וְלֹא עָפִיץ:


מעור המצה (from an untanned hide) – that it was not pickled nor its hides dressed with flour, nor tanned [with gall-nut].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:15:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:15:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:15:4)


**וּמִן הַנְּיָר.** הֶעָשׂוּי מֵעֲשָׂבִים:


ומן הנייר – that is made from grasses.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:15:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:15:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:15:5)


**שֶׁיֶּשׁ לָהֶן מַעֲשֶׂה.** כֵּיוָן שֶׁחֲקָקוּם:


דיש להן מעשה – since they hollowed them out [to shape a vessel].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:15:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:15:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:15:6)


**וְאֵין לָהֶם מַחֲשָׁבָה.** אִם חָשְׁבוּ לָמֹד בָּהֶן עָפָר כְּמוֹת שֶׁהֵן חֲקוּקִים מֵאֲלֵיהֶן וְלֹא עָשׂוּ בָהֶן מְלָאכָה, אֵין מַחְשַׁבְתָּן מְבִיאָתָן לִידֵי טֻמְאָה:


ואין להם מחשבה (they lack the capacity to effect intention) – if they thought to fashion the dirt as it fashioned on is own, but they didn’t do any work, their intention does not bring them to ritual defilement.



### Mishnah 16

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:16:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:16:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:16:1)


**קְנֵה הַמֹּאזְנַיִם.** הָרַמָּאִים עוֹשִׂין אוֹתוֹ חָלוּל וּמַנִּיחִין בַּחֲלָלוֹ כֶסֶף חַי, וּכְשֶׁשּׁוֹקְלִין מַטִּין בַּקָּנֶה מְעַט וְהוֹלֵךְ הַכֶּסֶף חַי לְצַד הַדָּבָר הַנִּשְׁקָל וּמַכְבִּיד וּמַכְרִיעוֹ:


קנה המאזנים (the beam of the balance) – The deceivers make it hollowed out and place in the hallowed out section, pure silver, and when they weigh it, it diverts/perverts the beam a bit and the live silver goes to the side of the thing that is being weighted and makes it heavy and overwhelms it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:16:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:16:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:16:2)


**וְהַמָּחוֹק.** שֶׁמּוֹחֲקִין בּוֹ הַמִּדָּה כְשֶׁהִיא גְדוּשָׁה. וְאִם עוֹשִׂין אוֹתָהּ שֶׁל דְּלַעַת וְכַיּוֹצֵא בָהּ מִן הַדְּבָרִים הַקַּלִּים, הוּא מֵקֵל, וְרַע לַמּוֹכֵר. וְאִם עוֹשִׂים אוֹתוֹ מִמַּתֶּכֶת, הוּא מַכְבִּיד, וְרַע לַלּוֹקֵחַ. אֲבָל עוֹשִׂים אוֹתוֹ שֶׁל זַיִת וְשֶׁל אֱגוֹז וְשֶׁל אֶשְׁכְּרוֹעַ. וְהָרַמַּאי עוֹשֶׂה הַמָּחוֹק שֶׁל זַיִת וְשֶׁל אֱגוֹז חָלוּל, כְּשֶׁהוּא מוֹכֵר מַכְנִיס בּוֹ מַתֶּכֶת כְּדֵי שֶׁיַּכְבִּיד, וּכְשֶׁהוּא קוֹנֶה מְסַלְּקוֹ:


והמחוק (an instrument for levelling a measure of grain/a strike) – that blots out the measurement when it is heaped up. But if they make it of gourds/cucumbers and similar things like it from the light things which lighten it and are bad for the seller, but if one makes of metal which makes it heavy and bad for the purchaser. But one makes it of olives and nuts and of box-tree/ebony tree. But the deceiver makes the instrument for levelling a measure of grain of olive and of hallowed out nuts, and when he sells it, he brings in metal in order that it would be made heavy, but when he purchases, he removes it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:16:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:16:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:16:3)


**וְהָאֵסֶל.** מוֹט שֶׁנּוֹשְׂאִים בּוֹ בַכָּתֵף. וּכְשֶׁיֶּשׁ פּוֹעֲלִים מְרֻבִּים, לְאַחַר שֶׁקִּבֵּל שָׂכָר מֵשִׂים בְּבֵית קִבּוּל שֶׁבַּמּוֹט אֶת שְׂכָרוֹ, וְאוֹמֵר לְבַעַל הַבַּיִת לֹא נָתַתָּ לִי שְׂכָרִי, וּכְשֶׁמְּחַפְּשִׂים אוֹתוֹ אֵין נוֹתְנִים לֵב לְחַפֵּשׂ שָׁם:


והאסל (a carrying yoke – in which there is a hidden receptacle for money) – a balancing pole/staff that they carry it on the shoulder. But when there are many workers, after he has received his payment/compensation, he places the compensation in the receptacle that is in the balancing pole/staff, and states to the house owner (i.e., the boss), “You did not give me my compensation,” and when they search him, they don’t give attention to search there [in the carrying pole].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:16:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:16:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:16:4)


**קָנֶה שֶׁל עָנִי שֶׁיֶּשׁ בּוֹ בֵית קִבּוּל מַיִם.** וְשׁוֹתֶה מֵהֶן, וּכְשֶׁשּׁוֹאֲלִים אוֹתוֹ אִם טָעַם כְּלוּם, אוֹמֵר אֲנִי מִתְעַנֶּה הַיּוֹם. וְרַבּוֹתַי פֵּרְשׁוּ, בֵּית קִבּוּל מַיִם, בֵּית קִבּוּל מַשְׁקִין, וּכְשֶׁטּוֹרֵחַ אֵצֶל בַּעַל הַבַּיִת בְּבֵית הַבַּד גּוֹנֵב בּוֹ מִן הַשֶּׁמֶן:


קנה של עני שיש בו בית קבול מים – and he drinks from them, and when they ask him if he tasted anything, he states, “I am fasting today.” But My Rabbis explained, a receptacle for water is a receptacle for liquids, and when he is busy [with his work] with the owner/the boss in the olive press, he steals from the oil there.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:16:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:16:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:16:5)


**מַקֵּל שֶׁיֶּשׁ בּוֹ בֵית קִבּוּל מְזוּזָה וּמַרְגָּלִית.** וְעוֹשִׂין כֵּן כְּדֵי לִגְנֹב בּוֹ אֶת הַמֶּכֶס:


מקל שיש לו בית קיבול מזוזה ומרגליות – and they use them as such in order to steal in it the taxes/tolls.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:16:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:16:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:16:6)


**אוֹי לִי אִם אֹמַר.** שֶׁמָּא יִלְמְדוּ מִמֶּנִּי בְנֵי אָדָם לְרַמּוֹת:


אוי לי אם אומר – perhaps/lest that people learn from me to deceive [others].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:16:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:16:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:16:7)


**וְאוֹי לִי אִם לֹא אֹמַר.** שֶׁמָּא יֹאמְרוּ הָרַמָּאִין, אֵין תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים בְּקִיאִים בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ, וּמִתּוֹךְ כָּךְ יָבֹאוּ לְרַמּוֹת יוֹתֵר. וְלָמָּה אֲמָרָם, מִשּׁוּם דִּכְתִיב (הושע יד) כִּי יְשָׁרִים דַּרְכֵי ה'‏ צַדִּיקִים יֵלְכוּ בָם וּפוֹשְׁעִים יִכָּשְׁלוּ בָם:


אוי לי אם לא אומר – perhaps/lest the deceivers will say that the Sages are not experts in the work of our hands, and through this they will come to deceive even more. And why did he say [these things]? Because it is written (Hosea 14:10): “For the paths of the LORD are smooth; The righteous can walk on them, while sinners stumble on them.”



### Mishnah 17

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:17:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:1)


**תַּחְתִּית הַצּוֹרְפִים.** צוֹרְפֵי זָהָב וָכֶסֶף יֵשׁ תַּחְתֵּיהֶם כְּלִי שֶׁשְּׁמוֹ תַחְתִּית, וְהוּא עָשׂוּי לָתֵת בְּתוֹכוֹ גְרוּטָאוֹת שֶׁל כֶּסֶף וְשֶׁל זָהָב. אֲבָל שֶׁל נַפָּחִים אֵין עָשׂוּי לְקַבֵּל וְלֹא מְיֻחָד נַמִּי לִישִׁיבָה:


תחתית הצורפים (the goldsmith’s anvil) – those who smelter gold and silver, their bottoms/base are a vessel which is called a frame in which an anvil is set. And it is made to place within it silver and/or gold rubbish/broken ware. But that of a smith is not made to receive, and it is not made explicitly also for sitting.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:17:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:2)


**מַשְׁחֶזֶת.** שֶׁל עֵץ שֶׁמַּשְׁחִיזִין בָּהּ אֶת הַסַּכִּין. וְעוֹשִׂין לָהּ בֵּית קִבּוּל שֶׁמֶן, שֶׁמּוֹשְׁחִין בָּהּ שֶׁמֶן לְהַשְׁחִיז:


משחזת (whetting implement of stone or wood) – of wood that they sharpen/whet the knives. And they make for it a receptacle for oil that they smear [the implements] with oil to sharpen them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:17:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:3)


**פִּנְקָס שֶׁל שַׁעֲוָה.** שֶׁיֶּשׁ לַחֶנְוָנִי וְלַשֻּׁלְחָנִי שֶׁכּוֹתֵב עָלָיו בְּחֶרֶט:


פנקס של שעוה – that the storekeeper has and the money changer that he writes upon it with a stylus/engraving tool.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:17:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:4)


**קַשׁ.** זַנְבוֹת הַשִּׁבֳּלִים. וְעוֹשִׂים מֵהֶם מַחְצְלָאוֹת:


קש – the tails of the ears of grain, and make mats out of them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:17:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:5)


**וּשְׁפוֹפֶרֶת הַקַּשׁ.** שֶׁהוּא חָלוּל וְיֵשׁ לוֹ בֵּית קִבּוּל:


ושפופרת הקש – which is hollow and it has a receptacle.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:17:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:6)


**רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא מְטַמֵּא.** וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁקִּבּוּלוֹ מֻעָט, דְּהָא תְנַן לְעֵיל הָעוֹשֶׂה כְלִי קִבּוּל מִכָּל מָקוֹם טָמֵא. וְקָמִפְלְגֵי אִי הָוֵי דָבָר הָעוֹמֵד אִי לֹא, דְּאֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא דָבָר הָעוֹמֵד מֵאֵלָיו. וְרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא חֲשִׁיב לֵיהּ דָּבָר הָעוֹמֵד, וְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן בֶּן נוּרִי לָא חֲשִׁיב לֵיהּ דָּבָר הָעוֹמֵד. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא:


רבי עקיבא מטמא – and even though its receptacle is small, for it is taught in the Mishnah above (see Tractate Kelim, Chapter 17, Mishnah 15), “that a person who makes a receptacle of any sort – it is ritually defiled.” And there is a difference of opinion if it is thing that is standing or not, for there is nothing unclean/defiled other than if it stands on its own. But Rabbi Akiva considers something that is standing, whereas Rabbi Yohanan ben Nuri does not consider for himself something that is standing. But the Halakha is according to Rabbi Akiva.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:17:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:7)


**פַּקּוּעוֹת.** דְּלַעַת מִדְבָּרִית. וְיֵשׁ אוֹמְרִים אֲבַטִּיחִים קְטַנִּים מָרִים, וְקָנֶה שֶׁלָּהֶן חָלוּל כִּשְׁפוֹפֶרֶת שֶׁל קַשׁ:


פקועות (bitter-apple/a gourd) – a desert gourd. But there are those who say, small, bitter melons. And their reed is hollow like the tube of straw.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:17:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:8)


**חֵלֶף.** מִין עֵשֶׂב הוּא וְעוֹשִׂים מִמֶּנּוּ חֲלָפִים וּמַחְצְלָאוֹת. וְקוֹרִין לוֹ בַעֲרָבִי חלפ"ה:


חלף (rush/shoot) – it is a kind of grass and they make from it shoots/rush and mats. And they call it CHALFA in Arabic.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:17:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:9)


**טְהוֹרָה.** מִטֻּמְאַת שֶׁרֶץ. אֲבָל לֹא מִמִּשְׁכָּב וּמוֹשָׁב. שֶׁהִיא מִטַּמְּאָה מִשְׁכָּב וּמוֹשָׁב דְּאוֹרַיְתָא אִם אֵינָהּ עֲשׂוּיָה לְסַכֵּךְ:


טהורה – from the ritual defilement of a reptile, but not from laying and sitting, for according to the Torah, if it is not made for overhanging boughs or twigs.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:17:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:10)


**קָנֶה שֶׁחֲתָכוֹ לְקַבָּלָה.** לָתֵת בּוֹ כְּחֹל וְכַיּוֹצֵא בוֹ:


קנה שחתכו לקבלה – to place in it powder for painting the eye-lids/stibium.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 17:17:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/17:17:11)


**הַכָּכָי.** הַמֹּחַ הַלָּבָן שֶׁבְּתוֹךְ הַקָּנֶה. וְקֹדֶם לָכֵן אֵין לַקָּנֶה טֻמְאָה וַאֲפִלּוּ מִדִּבְרֵי סוֹפְרִים:


הככי (pith/a web-like reed pith that has substance) – the white marrow that is withing the reed. But prior to this, the reed does no have susceptibility to receive defilement, and even according to the words of the Scribes.



## Chapter 18


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:1:1)


**הַשִּׁדָּה.** נִמְדֶּדֶת מִבִּפְנִים. דִּתְנַן לְעֵיל (פרק טו) כְּלֵי עֵץ שֶׁהַמַּחֲזִיק אַרְבָּעִים סְאָה בְלַח שֶׁהֵן כּוֹרַיִם בְּיָבֵשׁ, טָהוֹר, וְהַיְנוּ אַמָּה עַל אַמָּה בְרוּם שָׁלֹשׁ אַמּוֹת. וְהָכָא קָמִפְלְגֵי כֵיצַד מוֹדְדִים, לְבֵית שַׁמַּאי מוֹדְדִין חָלָל שֶׁבִּפְנִים, וְלֹא עֳבִי הַדְּפָנוֹת וְהַשּׁוּלַיִם. וּלְבֵית הִלֵּל הַכֹּל מוֹדְדִין, חוּץ מֵעֳבִי הָרַגְלַיִם וּלְבַזְבְּזִים שֶׁהוּא הַזֵּר שֶׁעַל הַשָּׂפָה. וּלְרַבִּי יוֹסֵי מוֹדְדִים אַף עֳבִי רַגְלֵי הַשִּׁדָּה וְהַלְּבַזְבְּזִים. וּלְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אִם אֵין רַגְלֶיהָ גְּבוֹהִים טֶפַח מוֹדְדִים אַף הָאֲוִיר שֶׁבֵּין רֶגֶל לְרֶגֶל. וַהֲלָכָה כְּבֵית הִלֵּל אַלִּיבָּא דְתַנָּא קַמָּא:


השידה. נמדדת מבפנים – as it is taught in the Mishnah above (Tractate Kelim, Chapter 15, Mishnah 1), all wooden utensils that hold forty Seah in something moist, which are iron tools for crowding olives into the vat when dry, is ritually pure, that is a cubit by a cubit by a height of three cubits. And here there is a matter of dispute – how does one measure it? According to the School of Shammai, they measure the hollow that is within, and not the thickness of the walls and rims. But according to the School of Hillel, they measure except from the thickness of the legs and the vertical rim/edge (by which a flat vessel is made into a vessel-like receptacle) which he pressed/molded on the rim. And according to Rabi Yossi, hey measure the thickness of the legs of the chest and the vertical rim. But according to Rabbi Shimon, if its legs are not a handbreadth high, they measure even the airspace that is between each leg. But the Halakha is according to the School of Hillel in accordance with the first Tanna/teacher.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:1)


**מוּכְנִי.** אוֹפַן כְּעֵין אוֹפַנֵּי הָעֲגָלָה. וּלְפִי שֶׁהַשִּׁדָּה נִשֵּׂאת עָלֶיהָ קְרוּיָה מוּכְנִי. לְשׁוֹן אֶת הַכִּיּוֹר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ (שמות ל):


המוכני (the machine for lifting weights, wheel-work) – it is a wheel, like a sort of wheels of a wagon, and since the chest is carried upon it, it is called a מוכני/wheel-work. It is the language of (Exodus 30:28): “and the laver and its stand.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:2)


**בִּזְמַן שֶׁהִיא נִשְׁמֶטֶת.** שֶׁאָדָם יָכוֹל לְסַלְּקָהּ מִן הָעֲגָלָה:


בזמן שהיא נשמטת(at the time when it may slipped off) – that a person may remove it from the wheel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:3)


**אֵינָהּ חִבּוּר לָהּ.** וְהִיא חֲשׁוּבָה כְּלִי לְעַצְמָהּ. וְאִי שִׁדָּה בַּת קִבּוּלֵי טֻמְאָה שֶׁאֵינָהּ מַחְזֶקֶת אַרְבָּעִים סְאָה וְנִטְמֵאת הַשִּׁדָּה, לֹא נִטְמֵאת הַמּוּכְנִי, וְאִי לָאו בַּת קִבּוּלֵי טֻמְאָה הִיא וְנָגְעָה טֻמְאָה בַמּוּכְנִי, הַמּוּכְנִי טְמֵאָה, דְּלָא חֲשִׁיבָא מִן הַשִּׁדָּה, וְהִיא מִטַּלְטֶלֶת מְלֵאָה וְרֵיקָנִית וְיֵשׁ לָהּ בֵּית קִבּוּל:


אינה חבור לה (and it is not connected to it) – and it is considered a vessel to itself. But if is a chest with a receptacle, it is a defilement that does not hold forty Seah, and the chest is defiled, but the wheel-work is not defiled, but if it is not a receptacle, it is defilement, and the defilement came in contact with the wheel-work, the wheel-work is ritually impure, because it is not considered from the chest, and it is carried full and empty and there is a receptacle.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:4)


**וְאֵינָהּ נִמְדֶּדֶת עִמָּהּ.** בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן אַמָּה עַל אַמָּה בְּרוּם שָׁלֹשׁ אַמּוֹת. דְּלָא חֲשִׁיבָא כָעֳבִי הָרַגְלַיִם, וַאֲפִלּוּ לְרַבִּי יוֹסֵי אֵינָהּ נִמְדֶּדֶת עִמָּהּ:


ואינה נמדדת עמה – in the accounting of a cubit by a cubit at the height of three cubits, for it is considered like the thickness of the legs, and even according to Rabbi Yossi, it is not measured with it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:5)


**וְאֵינָהּ מַצֶּלֶת עִמָּהּ בְּאֹהֶל הַמֵּת.** שֶׁאִם הַשִּׁדָּה בְּבֵית הַקְּבָרוֹת מַצֶּלֶת עַל כֵּלִים שֶׁבְּתוֹכָהּ, כֵּיוָן דְּמַחְזֶקֶת אַרְבָּעִים סְאָה. וְאִם בּוֹלְטִים מִמֶּנָּה כֵּלִים כְּנֶגֶד [גֹּבַהּ] הַמּוּכְנִי מִלְּמַעְלָה, אֵין הַמּוּכְנִי מַצֶּלֶת עָלֶיהָ, דְּמוּכְנִי מְקַבֶּלֶת טֻמְאָה וְאֵינָהּ חוֹצֶצֶת בִּפְנֵי הַטֻּמְאָה:


ואינה מצלת עמה באוהל המת (and does not offer protection with it in the tent of the corpse) – for if the chest is in the cemetery, it protects over the vessels that are within it, since it supports/strengthens forty Seah. But if vessels protrude from it corresponding [to the height] of the wheel-work from above, the wheel-work does not protect it, for a wheel-work is susceptible to receive defilement and does not interpose before the defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:6)


**בִּזְמַן שֶׁבְּתוֹכָהּ מָעוֹת.** דִּכְלִי בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ הִיא, וּבָסִיס לְדָבָר הָאָסוּר. אֲבָל אִם אֵינָהּ נִשְׁמֶטֶת שָׁרֵי, מֵאַחַר דְּלֹא הָווּ בְתוֹךְ הַשִּׁדָּה שֶׁהִיא עִקַּר הַכְּלִי:


בזמן שבתוכה מעות – it is a vessel of is own accord, and is the base for a prohibited thing, but it is permitted if it is not detached, for after that they were not within the chest which is the essence of the vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:7)


**קִמְרוֹן.** כְּעֵין קֻבָּא שֶׁעוֹשִׂין עַל גַּבֵּי הַשִּׁדָּה:


קמרון (arched lid) – like a kind of arched compartment over the chest.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:2:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:8)


**נִמְדָּד עִמָּהּ.** לְהַשְׁלִים אַרְבָּעִים סְאָה:


נמדד עמה – to complete the forty Seah.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:2:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:9)


**כֵּיצַד מוֹדְדִים אוֹתוֹ.** כְּשֶׁהוּא קָבוּעַ:


מודדים אותו – when it is fixed.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:2:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:10)


**רֹאשׁ תּוֹר.** בַּאֲלַכְסוֹן. דְּהַאי קִמְרוֹן אֵינוֹ כְנֶגֶד כָּל הַשִּׁדָּה אֶלָּא כִפָּה כְנֶגֶד מִקְצָת חֲלָלָהּ, וּכְשֶׁבָּא לִמְדֹּד אֲוִירָהּ רוֹאִין כְּאִלּוּ חוּט נָתוּן בַּאֲלַכְסוֹן מִכֹּתֶל הַשִּׁדָּה עַד רֹאשׁ הַכִּפָּה, וְחָלָל שֶׁתַּחְתָּיו נִמְדָּד:


ראש תור (how is an arched top-piece measured? By drawing an equilateral triangle circumscribing the curve) – a diagonal line. For this arched lid does not correspond to the entire chest, but rather it covers over part of the empty space, and he comes to measure the airspace, we view it as if a chord is placed in the diagonal line from the wall of the chest until the top of the arch, and the empty space that is below it is measured.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:2:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:11)


**אִם אֵינָהּ יְכוֹלָה לַעֲמֹד בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ.** הַשִּׁדָּה בְלֹא הַקִּמְרוֹן הַקָּבוּעַ בָּהּ:


אם אינה יכולה לעמוד בפני עצמה – the chest without the arched lid that is fixed in it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:2:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:2:12)


**טְהוֹרָה.** אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵינָהּ מַחְזֶקֶת אַרְבָּעִים סְאָה. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


טהורה – even though it does not hold forty Seah. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehuda.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:1)


**אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמְּקַבְּלִים.** כְּלוֹמַר אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁלֹּא נִקְּבוּ בִנְטִילַת הָרַגְלַיִם וְיֵשׁ לָהֶן בֵּית קִבּוּל כְּבַתְּחִלָּה:


אע"פ שמקבלים (even though they contain/retain) – that is to say, even though they did not make an incision while taking the legs, and they have a receptacle as at the outset.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:2)


**טְהוֹרִין.** שֶׁכֵּיוָן שֶׁנִּטַּל אַחַת מִן רַגְלֵיהֶן שׁוּב אֵינָן חֲשׁוּבִין כְּלִי, לְפִי שֶׁאֵינָן מְקַבְּלִין כְּדַרְכָּן אֶלָּא נוֹטִין לְצַד אֶחָד וְכִשְׁבוּרִים דָּמוּ:


טהורין – that since he took one of their legs off, they were no longer regarded as a vessel, because they do not receive/retain in their manner, but rather lean to one side and are like they are broken.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:3)


**רַבִּי יוֹסֵי מְטַמֵּא.** כֵּיוָן שֶׁלֹּא נִקְּבוּ בִנְטִילַת אַחַת מֵרַגְלֵיהֶן. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי. וְרַמְבַּ"ם גָּרֵיס, וְשֶׁאֵינָן מְקַבְּלִים כְּדַרְכָּן רַבִּי יוֹסֵי מְטַמֵּא. וּמִלְּתָא בְאַנְפֵּי נַפְשַׁהּ הִיא, וְהָכִי קָאָמַר, שִׁדָּה תֵבָה וּמִגְדָּל שֶׁאֵינָן מְקַבְּלִין אַרְבָּעִים סְאָה כְּשֶׁהֵן יוֹשְׁבִין כְּדַרְכָּן וְאִם מַטִּין אוֹתָן מְקַבְּלִין אַרְבָּעִים סְאָה, רַבִּי יוֹסֵי מְטַמֵּא כֵּיוָן שֶׁאֵין מְקַבְּלִים כְּדַרְכָּן, וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים הוֹאִיל וּמְקַבְּלִים מִכָּל מָקוֹם, חֲשִׁיבֵי מַחְזִיקִים אַרְבָּעִים סְאָה וּטְהוֹרִין:


ר' יוסי מטמא – since no incision had been made in them with the removal of one of their legs. But the Halakah is not according to Rabbi Yossi. But Maimonides had a different reading:"ושאינן מקבלים כדרכן ר' יוסי מטמא." (i.e., instead of saying: “even though that they do not contain something according to their usual fashion. Rabbi Yossi declares ritually impure/unclean,” Maimonides’ version of the text states, “they do not contain something according to their usual fashion.”). But it is something for itself, and this is how he understood it. A chest, a box and a turret which do not contain forty Seah when they sit in the prescribed manner, if one tilts them/causes them to lean, they contain forty Seah, Rabbi Yossi declares them unclean/impure since they don’t contain according to their usual fashion, but the Sages state for since that they do contain/retain, nevertheless, they are considered and containing forty Seah and are pure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:4)


**וְנַקְלִיטֵי הַמִּטָּה.** שְׁנֵי עַמּוּדִים אֶחָד מְרַאֲשׁוֹתֵי הַמִּטָּה וְאֶחָד בְּמַרְגְּלוֹתֶיהָ, וּמְשִׂימִין מַקֵּל מִזֶּה לָזֶה וּמַשְׁלִיכִין עָלָיו סָדִין וְנַעֲשֶׂה אֹהֶל:


נקליטי המטה (poles of the bed) – two pillars, one from about the head of the bed and one at its foot and they place a staff from one to the other and cast a sheet over it and it becomes a tent.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:5)


**וַחֲמוֹר.** תַּחַת מַלְבֵּן הַמִּטָּה מְשִׂימִין עֵץ חָלוּל שֶׁהַמַּלְבֵּן מֻנָּח עָלָיו וְנִקְרָא חֲמוֹר:


וחמור (a stand on which the bedstead is placed) – under the frame of the bed, they place a hallow piece of wood that he frame is lying upon, and it is called a חמור/a stand.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:6)


**וְחִפּוּי.** כְּגוֹן צִפּוּי שֶׁמְּצַפִּים הַמִּטָּה וְנַקְלִיטֶיהָ:


וחפוי (a covering) – as for example, a covering that cover the bed and its poles.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:3:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:7)


**טְהוֹרִים.** דַּהֲוֵי מַתֶּכֶת הַמְשַׁמֵּשׁ לְעֵץ:


טהורים – that is metal which serves the wood.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:3:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:8)


**מַלְבֵּן.** לוּחוֹת חֲלוּלִים עֲשׂוּיִים לְהַנִּיחַ תַּחַת כַּרְעֵי הַמִּטָּה שֶׁלֹּא יֵרָקְבוּ מִלַּחְלוּחִית הַקַּרְקַע. וּמִטַּלְטְלִים עִם הַמִּטָּה, הִלְכָּךְ טְמֵאִים, דְּכַמִּטָּה דָמוּ:


מלבן (frame) – hollow tablets made to be placed under the legs of the bed so that they do not rot from the moistness of the ground, and they are carried with the bed, therefore they are ritually impure, for they are similar to the bed.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:3:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:3:9)


**וּמַלְבְּנֵי בְנֵי לֵוִי טְהוֹרִין.** לְפִי שֶׁרְגִילִין לַעֲלוֹת לִירוּשָׁלַיִם וְהוֹלְכִים מֵעִיר לְעִיר, וְאֵין מוֹלִיכִין הַמִּטּוֹת עִמָּהֶן וּמוֹלִיכִין הַמַּלְבְּנִים, הִלְכָּךְ אֲפִלּוּ קְבוּעִים בְּקַרְקְעֵי הַמִּטָּה הוֹאִיל וְסוֹפָן לִנָּטֵל לָאו כַּמִּטָּה חֲשִׁיבֵי:


ומלבני בני לוי טהורין – because they would regularly go to Jerusalem and would go from city to city and they don’t bring the beds with them but they do bring the frames, therefore, even though they are fixed in the bottoms of the bed, for since they will ultimately be taken up, they are not considered like the bed.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:4:1)


**מַלְבֵּן שֶׁנְּתָנוֹ עַל לְשׁוֹנוֹת.** עֵץ הֶעָשׂוּי כְּעֵין לָשׁוֹן שֶׁהַמַּלְבֵּן מֻנָּח עָלָיו:


מלבן שנתנו על לשונות – wood made like a longue that the bed frame is lying upon.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:4:2)


**רַבִּי מֵאִיר וְרַבִּי יְהוּדָה מְטַמְּאִין.** שֶׁאַף הוּא מִטַּלְטֵל עִם הַמִּטָּה כְּמוֹ מַלְבֵּן:


ר' מאיר ור' יהודה מטמאין – that even this is carried with the bed like the frame.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:4:3)


**רַבִּי יוֹסֵי וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן מְטַהֲרִין.** דְּלֹא מִטַּלְטֵל בַּהֲדֵי מִטָּה כֻלֵּי הַאי. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן:


ר' יוסי ור' שמעון מטהרין – that it is not carried with the bed all that much. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Yossi and Rabbi Shimon.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:4:4)


**שֶׁמַּלְבְּנֵי בְנֵי לֵוִי טְהוֹרִין.** וְאַף עַל גַּב דִּקְבִיעֵי בְכַרְעֵי הַמִּטָּה, הוֹאִיל וְסוֹפָן לִנָּטֵל טְהוֹרִים, הָנֵי לְשׁוֹנוֹת נַמִּי פְעָמִים נִטָּלִים מִמַּלְבְּנֵי הַמִּטָּה וְלָאו כַּמִּטָּה חֲשִׁיבֵי:


שמלבני בני לוי טהורין – for even though that they are fixed in the legs of the bed, since that ultimately they are taken off, they are ritually pure, these tongues are also sometimes removed from the frames of the bed, and are not considered like the bed.



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:1)


**מִטָּה שֶׁהָיְתָה טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס.** שֶׁשָּׁכַב עָלֶיהָ זָב, אוֹ נִתְלָה אוֹ נִשְׁעַן:


מטה שהיתה טמאה מדרס (a bed that was ritually impure through treading) – that a person with gonorrhea who lay on it or was suspending from it or leaning on it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:2)


**קְצָרָה.** אוֹתָן עֵצִים שֶׁבְּרֹחַב הַמִּטָּה לְצַד מְרַאֲשֹׁתֶיהָ אוֹ מַרְגְּלוֹתֶיהָ:


קצרה (the short board, the board at the head and at the foot of the bed) – those pieces of wood that are at the width of the bed to the side from its head or from its feet.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:3)


**אֲרֻכָּה.** אוֹתָן עֵצִים שֶׁבְּאֹרֶךְ הַמִּטָּה מִיָּמִין אוֹ מִשְּׂמֹאל, וְהֵם נִקְרָאִים אֲרֻכּוֹת הַמִּטָּה:


ארוכה – those pieces of wood that are at the length of the bed from the right or from the left, and they are called ארוכות המטה/long board, long side of the bedstead.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:4)


**טְהוֹרָה.** דְּתוּ לֹא חַזְיָא וְהַוְיָא כְשִׁבְרֵי כֵלִים שֶׁהֵן טְהוֹרִים:


טהורה – for they further are not proper and they are like shards of vessels that are ritually pure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:5)


**רַבִּי נְחֶמְיָה מְטַמֵּא.** וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי נְחֶמְיָה:


ר' נחמיה מטמא – But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Nehemiah.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:5:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:6)


**גָּדַד.** חָתַךְ וְקָטַע. כְּמוֹ גֹדוּ אִילָנָא:


גדר – he severed and broke off (i.e., cut) like cut down a tree.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:5:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:7)


**שְׁתֵּי לְשׁוֹנוֹת לוֹכְסָן.** שְׁנֵי עֵצִים הָעֲשׂוּיִין כְּלָשׁוֹן, שֶׁמַּלְבְּנֵי הַמִּטָּה מֻנָּחִים עֲלֵיהֶן. חֲתָכָן בָּאֲלַכְסוֹן, אֶחָד שֶׁבְּמִקְצוֹעַ מִזְרָחִית דְּרוֹמִית וְאֶחָד שֶׁבְּמִקְצוֹעַ מַעֲרָבִית צְפוֹנִית, טְהוֹרָה, דְּתוּ לֹא חַזְיָא. וְכֵן אִם גָּדַד שְׁתֵּי כְרָעַיִם טֶפַח עַל טֶפַח לוֹכְסָן, מִכֶּרַע שֶׁבְּמִקְצוֹעַ מִזְרָחִית דְּרוֹמִית גָּדַד טֶפַח, וּמִכֶּרַע שֶׁבְּמִקְצוֹעַ מַעֲרָבִית צְפוֹנִית גָּדַד טֶפַח, כִּשְׁבוּרָה דָמְיָא:


שתי לשונות לוכסן (two tongues diagonally – two pieces of wood that are made like a tongue, that the frames of the bed are placed upon them, he cuts them with crosswise/diagonally, one that is in the southeastern corner and one that is in the northwest corner, are ritually pure, for they are not appropriate. And similarly if he cut two legs a handbreadth by a handbreadth diagonally, from the leg that is in the southeast corner he cut a handbreadth, and from the leg in the northwest corner he cut a handbreadth, it is like it is broken.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:5:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:5:8)


**אוֹ שֶׁמִּעֲטָהּ מִטֶּפַח.** שֶׁגָּדַד רַגְלֶיהָ וְאֵין טֶפַח מִן הַמִּטָּה לָאָרֶץ, לָא חֲשִׁיבָא:


או מיעטה מטפח (or he diminished it by a handbreadth) – that he cut its legs and there is no handbreadth from the bed to the ground, it is not considered [of value, and hence is pure].



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:6:1)


**וְתִקְּנָהּ טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס.** עֲדַיִן עוֹמֶדֶת בְּטֻמְאָתָהּ, כֵּיוָן דְּקַיְמָא שְׁנִיָּה:


ותיקנה טמאה מדרס – it still stands in its defilement/impurity, since the second side exists.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:6:2)


**טְהוֹרָה מִן הַמִּדְרָס.** אַף עַל גַּב דְּנִתַּקְּנָה רִאשׁוֹנָה קֹדֶם שֶׁנִּשְׁבְּרָה שְׁנִיָּה, מִכָּל מָקוֹם טְהוֹרָה, דְּפָנִים חֲדָשׁוֹת בָּאוּ לְכָאן, שֶׁלְּאַחַר שֶׁיָּרְדָה לָהּ טֻמְאַת מִדְרָס נִתְחַדְּשׁוּ לָהּ פָּנִים הַלָּלוּ וְאֵין זוֹ הָרִאשׁוֹנָה, מֵאַחַר שֶׁכְּבָר נִתְקַלְקֵל בָּהּ כְּדֵי בִטּוּלָהּ:


טהורה מן המדרס – even though the first was repaired prior to the second side being broken. Nevertheless, it is ritually pure/clean, for new faces had appeared here, for after it went down through the defilement of treading/Midras, these faces renewed themselves and this is not the first, for after it had been ruined enough in order that it be voided.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:6:3)


**אֲבָל טְמֵאָה מַגַּע מִדְרָס.** מִשּׁוּם דַּאֲרֻכָּה רִאשׁוֹנָה כְשֶׁנִּשְׁבְּרָה וְתִקְּנָהּ שֶׁהֵבִיא אֲרֻכָּה אַחֶרֶת תַּחַת הַשְּׁבוּרָה וְחִבְּרָהּ לַמִּטָּה, נִטְמֵאת מַגַּע מִדְרָס, שֶׁהֲרֵי נָגְעָה בַמִּטָּה הַטְּמֵאָה מִדְרָס, וְכִי נִשְׁבְּרָה שְׁנִיָּה דְפָרַח מִנַּהּ טֻמְאַת מִדְרָס, אִשְׁתַּיַּר בָּהּ טֻמְאַת מַגָּע, דְּכָל הַמִּטָּה מְחֻבֶּרֶת לָרִאשׁוֹנָה שֶׁנִּתַּקְּנָה:


אבל טמאה מגע מדרס – because the long side of the bedstead was first when it was broken and fixed and he brought a new long side in place of the broken one and attached it below, it became defiled through contact via treading/Midras, for it (the person with gonorrhea) had touched the bed who was impure through treading, and when the second [board] was broken, that it sprouting from it the defilement of treading, there remained in it the defilement of contact, for the entire bed is connected to the first board when it was fixed.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:6:4)


**עַד שֶׁנִּשְׁבְּרָה שְׁנִיָּה טְהוֹרָה.** דְּכֵיוָן דְּנִשְׁבְּרוּ שְׁתֵּי הָאֲרֻכּוֹת, תּוּ לֹא חַזְיָא. וְלֹא דָמֵי לְהֵיכָא דְנִתְפָּרְקָה וְכֻלָּהּ קַיֶּמֶת, דְּהָתָם סוֹפוֹ לְהַחֲזִיר פְּרָקֶיהָ וּלְחַבְּרָהּ:


עד שנשברה שניה טהורה ([if one did not have the time to repair the first] before the second was broken – it – the bed is pure) – for since the two long bedsteads were broken, they are no longer fit for use. And it is not similar to where it was taken apart and all of it exists, for there, it will be eventually be put back together with its fellow parts.



### Mishnah 7

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:7:1)


**כֶּרַע.** שֶׁל מִטָּה שֶׁהָיְתָה טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס. שֶׁדָּרַס הַזָּב עַל הַכֶּרַע כְּשֶׁהָיָה בִּפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה מְחֻבָּר לַמִּטָּה:


כרע – [leg] of a bed which was impure with defilement by treading. That the person with gonorrhea tread on the bed leg when he was on its own and it was not connected to the med.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:7:2)


**כֻּלָּהּ טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס.** דְּחִבּוּר עֲבִיד לָהּ כְּאִלּוּ כֻלָּהּ גוּף אֶחָד:


כולה טמאה מדרס – for attachment was done to it, as if it is all one body.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:7:3)


**הָיְתָה טְמֵאָה טֻמְאַת שִׁבְעָה.** כְּגוֹן שֶׁנָּגְעָה בְמֵת:


היתה טמאה טומאת שבעה – such as, for example, that it came in contact with a corpse.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:7:4)


**טֻמְאַת עָרֶב.** כְּגוֹן שֶׁנָּגְעָה בִטְמֵא מֵת:


טומאת ערב – that it came in contact with someone who was defiled through contact with a corpse.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:7:5)


**וְהַמִּטָּה טְהוֹרָה.** דְּלֹא נִטְמֵאת בִּנְגִיעַת הַכֶּרַע. דְּרִאשׁוֹן הֲוָה, וְאֵין אָדָם וְכֵלִים מְקַבְּלִין טֻמְאָה אֶלָּא מֵאַב הַטֻּמְאָה:


והמטה טהורה – that it (8.e. the bed) was not defiled through contact of the leg [of the bed]. For it was first [degree of ritual impurity], and a person nor vessels are susceptible to defilement other than from a primary source of defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:7:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:7:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:7:6)


**מַעְדֵּר.** כְּלִי עֵץ שֶׁיֶּשׁ לוֹ שִׁנַּיִם וּמְהַפְּכִים בּוֹ אֶת הַתֶּבֶן, וְשִׁנָּיו שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת. וּלְפִי שֶׁהַשִּׁנַּיִם שֶׁל פְּרָקִים וּנְעוּצִים בּוֹ, דִּינוֹ כְדִין מִטָּה שֶׁהִיא שֶׁל פְּרָקִים. וְהַאי וְכֵן, אַטֻּמְאַת שִׁבְעָה קָאֵי, דְּאֵין מַעְדֵּר מִטַּמֵּא מִדְרָס:


מעדר (mattock, share of the plough/pitchfork for the first stage of winnowing – passing the grain from one side to the other) – a wooden vessel/utensil that has teeth that turn over the straw, and its teeth are metal. And because the teeth are of joints inserted therein, its law is like that of a bed which is of links. And this and similar to it, it is referring to the defilement for seven days, for the share of the plough does not defile through treading.



### Mishnah 8

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:8:1)


**תְּפִלָּה.** בִּתְפִלִּין שֶׁל רֹאשׁ שֶׁנָּגְעוּ בְמֵת אַיְרֵי, שֶׁיֶּשׁ בָּהֶן אַרְבָּעָה בָתִּים, וְכָל בַּיִת נִקְרֵאת קְצִיצָה:


תפלה – it is speaking of the Tefillin of the head that came in contact with a corpse, for it has four compartments, and every compartment is called a קציצה/capsule, compartment.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:8:2)


**הִתִּיר קְצִיצָה.** הֶעֱבִיר בַּיִת אֶחָד וְהֵבִיא אַחֵר תַּחְתָּיו:


התיר קציצה (he untied/loosened the compartment) – he removed one compartment and brought another in its place.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:8:3)


**טְמֵאָה טְמֵא מֵת.** דְּחִבּוּרָן מְשַׁוֵּי לְהוּ גוּף אֶחָד:


טמאה טמא מת – that their connection/attachment makes them one body.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:8:4)


**וְכֵן שְׁנִיָּה וְכֵן שְׁלִישִׁית.** כָּל זְמַן שֶׁהָרְבִיעִית קַיֶּמֶת, מֵחֲמַת שֶׁמְּחֻבֶּרֶת לָרְבִיעִית. אֲבָל כְּשֶׁהֶעֱבִיר גַּם הָרְבִיעִית וְהֶחְלִיפָהּ בְּאַחֶרֶת, פָּרְחָה מִנַּיְהוּ טֻמְאַת מֵת, וְנִשְׁתַּיֵּר בַּשָּׁלֹשׁ קְצִיצוֹת טֻמְאַת מַגַּע טְמֵא מֵת, שֶׁהֲרֵי נָגְעוּ בָרְבִיעִית כְּשֶׁחִבְּרָן וְהִיא עֲדַיִן קַיֶּמֶת. אֲבָל רְבִיעִית כְּשֶׁהֻחְלְפָה, אֵין בְּגוּפָהּ טֻמְאָה כְלָל, דְּאִי מִשּׁוּם דְּנָגְעָה בַשָּׁלֹשׁ, אֵין מַגָּע עוֹשֶׂה מַגָּע, שֶׁהַשָּׁלֹשׁ רִאשׁוֹנוֹת חֲדָשׁוֹת נִינְהוּ שֶׁנָּגְעוּ בִטְמֵא מֵת, וְאֵין הָרְבִיעִית הַחֲדָשָׁה מְקַבֶּלֶת מֵהֶן טֻמְאָה, וְאֵין טֻמְאָה בָרְבִיעִית הַחֲדָשָׁה אֶלָּא מֵחֲמַת שֶׁמְּחֻבֶּרֶת לַשָּׁלֹשׁ הַטְּמֵאוֹת מַגָּע. הִלְכָּךְ כְּשֶׁחָזַר וְהֶחְלִיף הַשָּׁלֹשׁ פַּעַם שְׁנִיָּה, טָהֲרוּ כֻלָּן וַאֲפִלּוּ מַגָּע לֵית בְּהוּ:


וכן שניה וכן שלישית – all the time that the fourth [compartment] exists. On account that it is attached to the fourth [compartment]. But when he removed also the fourth and exchanged it for another, the defilement from [contact with] the dead flies out from it, and there remains in the three compartments/capsules [of the Tefillin of the head] the defilement from contact with something which had been defiled through contact with a corpse, for it came in contact with the fourth [capsule/compartment] when they attached them and it still exists. But the Fourth [capsule/compartment], when it was switched out, there is no defilement in its body at all, for if it was because it come in contact with the three [other] compartments, contact [uncleanness] does not cause contact uncleanness, since the first three [compartments] are new, that came in contact with someone who had been in contact with a corpse, the new forth [compartment] does not receive defilement from them, and there is no defilement in the new fourth [compartment] other than on account that is attached to the three which are defiled through contact. Therefore, when he return and switched out the three [compartments] a second time, all of them are pure, and there is no contact [with defilement] in them.



### Mishnah 9

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:9:1)


**טְהוֹרָה.** וַאֲפִלּוּ אִיכָּא אֲרֻכָּה וּשְׁתֵּי כְרָעַיִם, הוֹאִיל וְאֵין בְּדַעְתָּם לְהַחֲזִיר. וְכִי מַהֲנֵי, דַּוְקָא בְמָקוֹם שֶׁהַכֹּל לְאָדָם אֶחָד:


טהורה – and even where there is a longboard/bedside and two legs, but it is not their intention to restore, and where they benefit, is specifically in a place that everything belongs to one person.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:9:2)


**מְקַבֶּלֶת טֻמְאָה מִכָּאן וּלְהַבָּא.** אֲבָל לְמַפְרֵעַ לֹא, דְּכֵיוָן דְּחִלְּקוּהָ פָּרְחָה טֻמְאָה מִנַּהּ:


מקבלת טומאה מכאן ולהבא – but not retroactively, for when they (i.e., the brothers or joint owners) divided it half, the defilement flew off from it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:9:3)


**מִטַּמֵּאת חֲבִילָה.** אִם פֵּרְשָׁה הַכֶּרַע מִן הָאֲרֻכָּה וְעוֹמֶדֶת עִם הַקְּצָרָה, הָוֵי חִבּוּר, וְאִם נִטְמֵאת הַכֶּרַע נִטְמֵאת הַקְּצָרָה. כְּשֵׁם שֶׁכְּשֶׁכֻּלָּהּ שְׁלֵמָה אִם נִטְמָא אֶחָד מֵאֲבָרֶיהָ נִטְמֵאת כֻּלָּהּ, כָּךְ נַמִּי כְּשֶׁפֵּרַשׁ הַכֶּרַע מִן הָאֲרֻכָּה וְעוֹמֶדֶת עִם הַקְּצָרָה, נַעֲשֵׂית חֲבִילָה עִם הַקְּצָרָה, וּכְשֶׁנִּטְמֵאת הַכֶּרַע נִטְמֵאת הַקְּצָרָה עִמָּהּ:


מיטמאה חבילה (becomes unclean only when combined) – if the leg [of the bed] was removed from the longboard/beside and stands with the short board/the board at the head and at the foot of the bed, it is combined/connected, but if the leg is defiled, the longboard is defiled. For just as when it is complete/whole, if one of its pieces is defiled, all of it is defiled, so also when they remove the leg from the longboard and it stands with the shortboard, and when the leg is defiled, the shortboard is defiled as well.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:9:4)


**וּמִטַּהֶרֶת חֲבִילָה.** שֶׁאִם הִטְבִּיל הַכֶּרַע עִם הַקְּצָרָה אֵין הַקְּצָרָה חוֹצֶצֶת עָלֶיהָ, כִּי הֵיכִי דְלָא חַיְצָה עָלֶיהָ כְּשֶׁמַּטְבִּילָהּ כְּשֶׁהִיא שְׁלֵמָה:


ומטהרת חבילה – and if he immersed the leg [of the bed] in a Mikveh/ritual bath with the shortboard of the bed, the shortboard does not interpose upon it, for just as it does not interpose upon it when we immerse it (i.e., the bed) when it is whole/complete.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:9:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:9:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:9:5)


**וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים מִטַּמֵּאת אֵבָרִים.** וְלֹא חֲבִילָה. דְּאִם נִטְמֵאת כֶּרַע, הִיא טְמֵאָה וְלֹא קְצָרָה, דְּאֵינָהּ חִבּוּר כִּשְׁלֵמָה:


וחכמים אומרים מטמא איברים – and not when combined, that if the leg [of the bed] had become defiled, it [alone] is defiled and not the shortboard [of the bed], for it is not combined like something whole/complete.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 18:9:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:9:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/18:9:6)


**וּמִטַּהֶרֶת אֵבָרִים.** כְּשֶׁבָּא לְהַטְבִּילָהּ מַטְבִּיל הַכֶּרַע בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ, וְלֹא חֲבִילָה עִם הַקְּצָרָה, שֶׁהַקְּצָרָה חוֹצֶצֶת עָלֶיהָ, דְּאֵינָהּ חִבּוּר כִּשְׁלֵמָה, דְּמַטְבִּיל מִטָּה שְׁלֵמָה טְהוֹרָה אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁלֹּא פֵרְקָהּ, אֲבָל הַשְׁתָּא דְפֵרְשָׁה הַכֶּרַע מִן הָאֲרֻכָּה לֹא הָוֵי חֲבִילָה עִם הַקְּצָרָה, וְצָרִיךְ לְהַטְבִּילָהּ בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ. וַהֲלָכָה כַּחֲכָמִים. כָּךְ נִרְאֵית פֵּרוּשׁ מִשְׁנָה זוֹ מִן הַתּוֹסֶפְתָּא, וְכָךְ פֵּרְשׁוּהָ רַבּוֹתַי:


ומטהרת אברים – when he comes to immerse it [in a Mikveh/ritual bath], the leg is by itself, and not the combination with the short board [of the bed] for the short board interposes upon it. That which is not connected is like a whole [bed], for when one immerses a whole bed [in the Mikveh] it is ritually pure even though he did not break it apart, but now that it separated the leg from the long board, it is not combined with the shortboard, and it is necessary to immerse it [in a Mikveh] on its own. The Halakha is according to the Sages. So it appeared that the explanation of this Mishnah is from the Tosefta (Tractate Kelim Bava Metzia, Chapter 8, Halakha 8), such is how my teachers/Rabbis explained it.



## Chapter 19


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:1:1)


**הַמְפָרֵק אֶת הַמִּטָּה לְהַטְבִּילָהּ.** אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמִּטַּהֶרֶת כְּשֶׁהִיא שְׁלֵמָה, פְּעָמִים שֶׁהִיא גְדוֹלָה וְאֵינָהּ יְכוֹלָה לִכָּנֵס בַּמִּקְוֶה וְצָרִיךְ לְפָרְקָהּ:


המפרק את המטה להטבילה – even though it had become defiled while it was whole/complete, sometimes, on occasion when it is large and is unable to enter the Mikveh [whole], and one needs to take it apart.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:1:2)


**וְהַנּוֹגֵעַ בַּחֲבָלִים.** גָּרְסִינַן, כְּלוֹמַר, בֵּין מְפָרֵק בֵּין נוֹגֵעַ בַּחֲבָלִים טָהוֹר. וּבְמִטָּה שֶׁנִּטְמֵאת בְּמֵת אוֹ בְמִשְׁכַּב הַזָּב אַיְרֵי, וּכְגוֹן שֶׁאֵין בַּמִּטָּה אֲרֻכָּה וּשְׁתֵּי כְרָעַיִם, וַאֲפִלּוּ הָכִי צָרִיךְ לְהַטְבִּילָהּ, כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא תַּחֲזֹר לְטֻמְאָתָהּ כְּשֶׁיְּחַבְּרֶנָהּ. וְהַנּוֹגֵעַ בַּחֲבָלִים טָהוֹר, דְּמִכֵּיוָן שֶׁפֵּרְקָהּ שׁוּב אֵין הַחֲבָלִים חִבּוּר:


והנוגע בחבלים – this is our reading. Meaning to say, whether one takes it (i.e., the bed) apart or one touches the ropes, one is ritually pure. But we are speaking about a bed that was defiled through contact with a corpse or though a person with gonorrhea lying on it, and as for example, that is no on the bed a long board and two legs, even though, it is necessary to immerse it [in a Mikveh], in order that it not return to its defilement when it is connected. But the person who touches the ropes is ritually pure, for since he took it (i.e., the bed) apart, the ropes are no longer connected.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:1:3)


**הַחֶבֶל מֵאֵימָתַי חִבּוּר.** בִּתְחִלָּה כְּשֶׁאָדָם מְסָרֵג אֶת הַמִּטָּה שְׁלֵמָה וְסוֹרֵג בָּהּ שְׁלֹשָׁה בָתִּים וַעֲדַיִן נִשְׁאָר הַחֶבֶל אָרֹךְ הַרְבֵּה, נִטְמֵאת הַמִּטָּה נִטְמָא הַחֶבֶל, וְהַנּוֹגֵעַ בַּחֶבֶל, טָמֵא, דְּכֻלּוֹ חִבּוּר הוֹאִיל וְסוֹפוֹ לְסָרְגוֹ:


החבל מאימתי חיבור – at the outset when a person makes a partition by means of net-work/makes a zig-zag completely and girds it with three [rows of] meshes with it, and the rope still remains very long. If the bed became defiled, the rope is defiled. And a person who touches the rope, is impure. For it is all connected/attached, for ultimately, one is making a partition by means of net-work.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:1:4)


**מִן הַקֶּשֶׁר וְלִפְנִים.** אִם קָשַׁר חֶבֶל אַחֵר לְזֶה הַחֶבֶל שֶׁסּוֹרֵג בּוֹ, אֵין הַחֶבֶל הָאַחֵר חִבּוּר מִן הַקֶּשֶׁר וְלַחוּץ:


מן הקשר ולפנים – if he tied another rope to this rope that he is making a lattice-work with, the other rope is not attached from the knot and outward.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:1:5)


**נִימֵי הַקֶּשֶׁר.** כְּשֶׁקּוֹשְׁרִים שְׁנֵי חֲבָלִים זֶה בָזֶה מַנִּיחִין מְעַט מֵרָאשֵׁי הַחֲבָלִים מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה יוֹצְאִים חוּץ לַקֶּשֶׁר, וְהֵן נִקְרָאִים נִימֵי הַקֶּשֶׁר:


נימי הקשר (fringes of a knot) – when they tie in a knot two ropes with one another, they leave a bit from the heads of the ropes from this side and from that side they exit beyond the knot, and they are called the “fringes of a knot.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:1:6)


**הַנּוֹגֵעַ בְּצָרְכּוֹ טָמֵא.** דְּכֵיוָן דְּצֹרֶךְ לַקֶּשֶׁר הֵם, שֶׁאִם הָיָה קוֹשֵׁר בְּרֹאשׁ הַחֶבֶל מַמָּשׁ הָיָה הַקֶּשֶׁר נִתָּר, נִמְצָא שֶׁאֵלּוּ הַנִּימִין מַעֲמִידִים הַקֶּשֶׁר וְכַקֶּשֶׁר דָּמוּ:


הנוגע בצורכו – for since there is a need to tie them in a knot, that if the knot at the actual top of the of the rope was an extra knot, it is found that these fringes establish the knot an they are like the knot itself.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:1:7)


**רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר שָׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת.** הָווּ חִבּוּר, דְּהוּא צֹרֶךְ הַקֶּשֶׁר. טְפֵי לֹא:


רבי יהודה אומר שלש אצבעות – is an attachment/connection, and he requires the knot, but not more.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:2:1)


**הַחֶבֶל הַיּוֹצֵא מִן הַמִּטָּה.** מַה שֶּׁנִּשְׁאַר מִמֶּנּוּ לְאַחַר שֶׁגָּמַר הַסֵּרוּג:


החבל היוצא מן המטה – what remains from it [hangs over the bed] after he completed the plaiting.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:2:2)


**עַד חֲמִשָּׁה טְפָחִים טָהוֹר.** דְּלֹא חֲזִי לְמִידִי לְצֹרֶךְ הַמִּטָּה, וְלָא חֲשִׁיב לָהּ יָד:


עד חמשה טפחים טהור – for it is not appropriate for the needs of the bed, and it is not considered a handle.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:2:3)


**מֵחֲמִשָּׁה וְעַד עֲשָׂרָה טָמֵא.** דַּחֲזִי לִקְשֹׁר בָּהּ הַפְּסָחִים. שֶׁהָיוּ רְגִילִים לִקְשֹׁר שָׁם הַפֶּסַח בַּחֶבֶל שֶׁבְּכַרְעֵי הַמִּטָּה כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּהְיֶה מְזֻמָּן לָהֶם. וַחֲזִי נַמִּי לְשַׁלְשֵׁל בּוֹ אֶת הַמִּטָּה, כְּלוֹמַר לְהוֹרִידָהּ מִן הָעֲלִיָּה לַגַּג, אִי נַמִּי לְהוֹרִידָהּ אֶל הַמִּקְוֶה לְהַטְבִּילָהּ כְּשֶׁנִּטְמֵאת:


מחמשה ועד עשרה טמא – for it is appropriate to knot with it the Passover sacrifices. For they would regularly tie up the Passover sacrifices with a rope that is on the leg of the bed in order that it be ready for them. And it was appropriate also to let it down [over the side of the bed] , that is to say, to lower it from the attic to the roof. Alternatively, to lower it to the ritual bath to immerse it when it became defiled.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:2:4)


**מֵעֲשָׂרָה וְלַחוּץ טָהוֹר.** דְּמַה שֶּׁיֶּשׁ בַּחֶבֶל יוֹתֵר מֵעֲשָׂרָה אֵינוֹ מְשַׁמֵּשׁ לְצֹרֶךְ הַמִּטָּה כְּלוּם:


מעשרה ולחוץ טהור – for what there is on a rope more than ten [handbreadths] he does not use at all for the purposes of the bed.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:3:1)


**הַמִּזְרָן.** כְּמִין אֵזוֹר אוֹ אַבְנֵט שֶׁל אָרִיג שֶׁכּוֹרְכִים אוֹתוֹ סְבִיב הַמִּטָּה כְּדֵי לְחַבֵּר פְּרָקֶיהָ. וּפְעָמִים שֶׁהוּא גָּדוֹל הַרְבֵּה וְנִגְרָר וְיוֹצֵא חוּץ מִן הַמִּטָּה:


המיזרן (girth, hanging from the bed – a strap of cloth which is wound over the bed to keep the covering in position) – a kind of girdle or woven belt that they tie around the bed in order to attach its joints/links. But sometimes it is too large and it drags and extends beyond the bed.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:3:2)


**הַיּוֹצֵא מִן הַמִּטָּה.** וְהַמִּטָּה טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס:


היוצא מן המטה – and the bed is impure from treading.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:3:3)


**כָּל שֶׁהוּא.** אֲפִלּוּ יוֹצֵא כַּמָּה אַמּוֹת חוּץ לַמִּטָּה, הַכֹּל טָמֵא:


כל שהוא – even if it extends outward a few cubits beyond the bed, everything is impure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:3:4)


**רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר עַד עֲשָׂרָה טְפָחִים.** טָמֵא בְטֻמְאַת הַמִּטָּה. מֵעֲשָׂרָה וּלְמַעְלָה טָהוֹר. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי:


ר' יוסי אומר עד עשרה טפחים – it is impure through the defilement of the bed. From ten [handbreadths] and beyond it is pure. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Yossi.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:3:5)


**שְׁיָרֵי מִזְרָן.** מִזְרָן שֶׁבָּלָה וְנִקְרַע, כַּמָּה יִשְׁתַּיֵּר מִמֶּנּוּ וְיִהְיֶה טָמֵא:


שיירי מיזרן – a girth that was worn out or torn, whatever that will remain from it, and it will be ritually impure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:3:6)


**שִׁבְעָה טְפָחִים.** דִּבְצִיר מֵהָכִי לֹא חֲזִי לְמִידִי וְלָא חֲשִׁיב כְּלִי:


שבעה טפחים – for less than this, it is not appropriate for anything and it is not considered a vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:3:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:3:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:3:7)


**חֶבֶק.** יֵשׁ מְפָרְשִׁים, בֶּגֶד עָב וְקָשֶׁה שֶׁמְּשִׂימִים עַל הַחֲמוֹר כְּשֶׁבָּא מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ וְהוּא מַזִּיעַ, כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יִצְטַנֵּן לְאַחַר שֶׁמְּסִירִין מִמֶּנּוּ הָאֻכָּף. וְיֵשׁ מְפָרְשִׁים, שֶׁמְּשִׂימִים אוֹתוֹ עַל מַשְּׂאוֹי הַחֲמוֹר כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יֻפְסַד אִם יֵרְדוּ עָלָיו גְּשָׁמִים:


חבק (a band with which the saddle or housing of an animal is fastened around its belly) – there are those who explain/interpret , a thick and hard piece of cloth that they place on the donkey when it comes from the road and it is sweating, , in order that it not catch cold when they remove the saddle from it. And there are those who explain, that they place it on the burden of the donkey in order that it not be lost if rains fell upon it.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:4:1)


**נִשָּׂא הַזָּב עַל הַמִּטָּה וְעַל הַמִּזְרָן.** לָאו דַּוְקָא נִשָּׂא עַל הַמִּזְרָן, אֶלָּא נִשָּׂא הַזָּב עַל הַמִּטָּה שֶׁהַמִּזְרָן כָּרוּךְ סְבִיבוֹתֶיהָ וְיוֹצֵא מִמֶּנָּה:


נישא הזב על המטה ועל המיזרן (if the person with gonorrhea was carried on the bed and on the girth) – not exactly carried on the bed girth, but rather that the person with gonorrhea was carried on the bed that the girth is tied around it and extends from it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:4:2)


**מְטַמֵּא שְׁנַיִם וּפוֹסֵל אֶחָד דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי מֵאִיר.** רַבִּי מֵאִיר לְטַעֲמֵיהּ דְּאָמַר לְעֵיל דַּאֲפִלּוּ הַמִּזְרָן יוֹצֵא מִן הַמִּטָּה כָּל שֶׁהוּא וַאֲפִלּוּ טוּבָא הָוֵי חִבּוּר לַמִּטָּה וּמְטַמֵּא שְׁנַיִם וּפוֹסֵל אֶחָד, כַּמִּטָּה עַצְמָהּ. שֶׁכָּל שֶׁהַזָּב נִשָּׂא עָלָיו וְנַעֲשָׂה מִשְׁכָּב וּמוֹשָׁב שֶׁל זָב, הָוֵי אַב הַטֻּמְאָה, וְהַנּוֹגֵעַ בּוֹ הָוֵי רִאשׁוֹן, וְרִאשׁוֹן עוֹשֶׂה שֵׁנִי, וְשֵׁנִי עוֹשֶׂה שְׁלִישִׁי לִפְסֹל אֶת הַתְּרוּמָה בִּלְבַד אֲבָל לֹא לְטַמֵּא. וְהַיְנוּ מְטַמֵּא שְׁנַיִם דְּהַיְנוּ רִאשׁוֹן וְשֵׁנִי, וּפוֹסֵל אֶחָד וְהוּא שְׁלִישִׁי שֶׁהוּא פָסוּל בַּתְּרוּמָה בִּלְבַד, וְהַמִּזְרָן כָּל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא פֵּרַשׁ מִן הַמִּטָּה חֲשִׁיב כְּאַב הַטֻּמְאָה וּמְטַמֵּא שְׁנַיִם וּפוֹסֵל אֶחָד, אֲבָל לְאַחַר שֶׁפֵּרַשׁ לֹא הָוֵי אֶלָּא כִוְלַד הַטֻּמְאָה וּמְטַמֵּא אֶחָד וּפוֹסֵל אֶחָד, כְּדִין נוֹגֵעַ בְּמִשְׁכַּב הַזָּב:


מטמא שנים ופוסל אחד דברי ר' מאיר – Rabbi Meir according to his reason that he stated above (see previous Mishnah, Tractate Kelim, Chapter 19, Mishnah 3), that even if the bed birth extends from the bed a little bit, and even more, it is attached/connected to the bed, and the two are made impure and renders [the heave-offering] unit, like the bed itself. For all that the person with gonorrhea is carried upon and acts of lying and sitting are performed by the person with gonorrhea, which is a primary category of ritual impurity, and the person who touches is first degree [level of ritual impurity], and something that is first-degree [level of ritual impurity] makes something else second [degree level of ritual impurity] , and something that is second degree [level of ritual impurity] makes something third [degree level of ritual impurity] to invalidate the heave-offering/priest’s due alone, but not to make it impure. And this is where he defiles two degrees, which are first [degree of ritual impurity] and second [degree of ritual impurity] and he invalidates one and it is third [degree level of impurity] and it is invalid for heave offering alone. And the bed girth all the while that it was not removed from the bed is considered like a primary source of ritual impurity, and it defiles two and invalidates one, but after he removes it, it is nothing other than a derivative of the defilement which defiles one and invalidates one, according to the law of a person who touches that which the person with gonorrhea lies upon.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:4:3)


**רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר וְכוּ'.** רַבִּי יוֹסֵי לְטַעֲמֵיהּ דְּאָמַר לְעֵיל [עַד] עֲשָׂרָה טְפָחִים וְתוּ לֹא. הִלְכָּךְ זֶה שֶׁבְּתוֹךְ עֲשָׂרָה חֲשׁוּב חִבּוּר לַמִּשְׁכָּב וּמְטַמֵּא שְׁנַיִם וּפוֹסֵל אֶחָד כָּל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא פֵּרַשׁ, אֲבָל מַה שֶּׁחוּץ לַעֲשָׂרָה לֹא חֲשׁוּב חִבּוּר לַמִּשְׁכָּב, וְדִינוֹ כְּפֵרַשׁ, דִּמְטַמֵּא אֶחָד וּפוֹסֵל אֶחָד:


ר' יוסי אומר = Rabbi Yossi according to his reasoning, who stated above (in Tractate Kelim, Chapter 19, Mishnah 3) ten handbreadths and not further. Therefore, that which is within ten [handbreadths] is considered a connection/attachment to lying [by a person with gonorrhea], and it defiles two and invalidates one all the while that he did not remove it. But what is beyond ten [handbreadths] is not considered an attachment to the lying [by a person with gonorrhea], and its law is as it was explained, that it defiles one and invalidates one.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:4:4)


**נִשָּׂא עַל הַמִּזְרָן מֵעֲשָׂרָה וְלִפְנִים טְמֵאָה.** גָּרְסִינַן, וְלֹא גָרְסִינַן טָמֵא. וְהָכִי פֵרוּשָׁא, נִשָּׂא הַזָּב עַל הַמִּזְרָן הַיּוֹצֵא מִן הַמִּטָּה, אִם נִשָּׂא מֵעֲשָׂרָה וְלִפְנִים לְצַד הַמִּטָּה, הַמִּטָּה טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס, דְּכֵיוָן דְּכָל עֲשָׂרָה חֲשִׁיבֵי חִבּוּר לַמִּטָּה, כְּשֶׁנִּטְמָא מִזְרָן נִטְמֵאת הַמִּטָּה. אֲבָל מֵעֲשָׂרָה וְלַחוּץ דְּלֹא הָווּ חִבּוּר לַמִּטָּה, טְהוֹרָה הַמִּטָּה וְלֹא נִטְמֵאת [בְּטֻמְאַת] הַמִּזְרָן. כָּךְ נִרְאֵית בְּעֵינַי פֵּרוּשׁ מִשְׁנָה זוֹ. וְגִרְסַת רַבּוֹתַי דְּגָרְסֵי טָמֵא וְטָהוֹר וּפֵרוּשָׁן, לֹא נִתְקַבֵּל לִי. וְכֵן דִּבְרֵי הָרַמְבַּ"ם שֶׁכָּתַב בְּפֵרוּשׁ מִשְׁנָה זוֹ לֹא נִכְנְסוּ בְּאָזְנַי כְּלָל. וְדִקְדַּקְתִּי אַחַר כָּךְ בְּחִבּוּרוֹ בְּהִלְכוֹת כֵּלִים פֶּרֶק כ"א [הֲלָכָה ט], נִרְאֶה לִי שֶׁשָּׁם חָזַר בּוֹ וּפֵרֵשׁ מִשְׁנָה זוֹ כְּמוֹ שֶׁפֵּרַשְׁתִּיהָ כָּאן:


נישא על המזרן מעשרה ולפנים טמאה – this is our reading (i.e., טמאה). But we don’t have the reading of טמא/impure. And this is an explanation: if the person with gonorrhea was carried on the bed girth that extends from the bed, if he was carried from ten [handbreadths] and within to the side of the bed, the bed is impure through treading/Midras, for since all ten [handbreadths] are considered an attachment to the bed, but from ten [handbreadths] and beyond it is not an attachment/connection to the bed, and the bed is pure and its not defiled [with the defilement] of the bed girth. Such it appears in my eyes an explanation/commentary on this Mishnah. And the reading of my Teachers/Rabbis who have the [textual] reading "טמא וטהור" /impure and pure and their explanation, but it was not acceptable to me. And similarly the words of Maimonides who wrote in his commentary to this Mishnah did not enter my eyes are all.
