And I investigated afterwards in his work (i.e., the Mishneh Torah) in the Laws of Kelim/Vessels, Chapter 21 [Halakha 9] – it appears to me that there he retracted and explained this Mishnah as I explained it here.



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:5:1)


**כֻּלָּהּ טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס.** וְכָל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא פֵּרַשׁ הַמִּזְרָן מִן הַמִּטָּה הָוֵי כַמִּטָּה עַצְמָהּ כִּדְפָרֵשִׁית:


כולה טמאה מדרס – ;and all the time that he did not remove the bed girth from the bed, it is like the bed itself, as I have explained.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:5:2)


**וְהַמִּזְרָן מַגַּע מִדְרָס.** וּמְטַמֵּא אֶחָד וּפוֹסֵל אֶחָד, כְּדִין כָּל נוֹגֵעַ בְּאַב הַטֻּמְאָה:


והמזרן מגע מדרס – and it defiles one and invalids one, like the law of all who touch/come in contact with a primary category of ritual impurity.



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:6:1)


**וְנָגַע בָּהֶן הַמֵּת.** כְּשֶׁהֵן כְּרוּכִים יַחַד:


ונגע בהן המת – when they are wrapped together.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:6:2)


**טְמֵאִים טֻמְאַת שִׁבְעָה.** בְּהָא לֹא פָלֵיג רַבִּי יוֹסֵי. דְּדַוְקָא בְטֻמְאַת מִדְרָס קָאָמַר עַד עֲשָׂרָה טְפָחִים טָמֵא מֵעֲשָׂרָה וְלַחוּץ טָהוֹר, אֲבָל לִשְׁאָר טֻמְאוֹת, אֲפִלּוּ מֵאָה אַמָּה כֻּלּוֹ חִבּוּר. כְּגוֹן מִזְרָן שֶׁהוּא כָּרוּךְ עַל הַמִּטָּה וְנִכְנְסָה הַמִּטָּה לְאֹהֶל הַמֵּת אוֹ נָגְעָה בְשֶׁרֶץ, וְכֵן אִם נִכְנַס קָצֶה מִן הַמִּזְרָן לְאֹהֶל הַמֵּת אוֹ נָגַע בְּשֶׁרֶץ, נִטְמֵאת הַמִּטָּה נִטְמָא הַמִּזְרָן, נִטְמָא הַמִּזְרָן נִטְמֵאת הַמִּטָּה, וַאֲפִלּוּ הָיָה הַמִּזְרָן יוֹצֵא מִן הַמִּטָּה מֵאָה אַמָּה:


טמאים טומאת שבעה – in this, Rabbi Yossi does not dispute. For especially in the defilement of treading/Midras it is stated, up until ten handbreadths it is impure; from ten [handbreadths] and beyond it is ritually pure. But concerning the rest of the defilements, even one hundred cubits all together is an attachment, such as the bed girth which is wrapped on a bed and the bed enters into the tent of a corpse or that it touched a reptile, and similarly if a piece from the bed girth enters into the tent of a corpse or touched a reptile, if the bed is defiled, the bed girth is defiled; if the bed girth is defiled, the bed is defiled, and even if the bed birth extends from the bed for one-hundred cubits.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:6:3)


**פֵּרְשׁוּ טְמֵאִים טֻמְאַת שִׁבְעָה.** וְלֹא הָווּ כְּכֵלִים שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּבְּרוּ, כֵּיוָן דְּכָל אֶחָד מֵהֶן כְּלִי בִּפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ. אַף עַל גַּב דִּלְעִנְיַן קַבָּלַת טֻמְאָה חֲשׁוּבִים כִּכְלִי אֶחָד וּכְשֶׁנָּגְעָה טֻמְאָה בְאֶחָד מֵהֶן נִטְמָא הָאַחֵר:


פירשו טמאים טומאת שבעה – and they are not like vessels that were broken, since each one of them is a vessel in its own right. Even though that regarding the matter of acquiring defilement they are considered like one vessel, and when defilement touched one of them, the other was defiled [as well].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:6:4)


**שֶׁנִּטְּלוּ שְׁתֵּי אֲרֻכּוֹת שֶׁלָּהּ.** וְלֹא נִשְׁתַּבְּרוּ, וְהֵן רְאוּיוֹת לְהַחְזִירָן לִמְקוֹמָן, הִלְכָּךְ לֹא טָהֲרָה הַמִּטָּה מִטֻּמְאָתָהּ בִּנְטִילַת הָאֲרֻכּוֹת:


שניטלו שתי ארוכות – its [two long pieces], and they did not beak. And they are appropriate to be restored to their places, therefore, the bed was not purified from its defilement with the taking of the long pieces.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:6:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:6:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:6:5)


**נִשְׁתַּבְּרוּ חֲדָשׁוֹת טְמֵאָה.** שֶׁהֲרֵי הַיְשָׁנוֹת קַיָּמוֹת וְלֹא נִשְׁתַּנּוּ הַנְּקָבִים, וְהָוֵי כְנִתְפָּרְקָה אֵבָר אֵבָר וְכָל אֵבָרֶיהָ שְׁלֵמִים. אֲבָל נִשְׁתַּבְּרוּ הַיְשָׁנוֹת, טְהוֹרָה, לְפִי שֶׁהַיְשָׁנוֹת הֵן שֶׁהָיוּ בַּמִּטָּה כְשֶׁנִּטְמֵאת, וּכְשֶׁנִּשְׁתַּבְּרוּ הָוֵי הַמִּטָּה שֶׁבֶר כְּלִי, דְּלֹא חַזְיָא בְלֹא אֲרֻכּוֹת:


נשתברו חדשות טמאה – for since the old ones and the sockets/perforations were not changed, and when he removed each part of the bedstead and all of its bedsteads are whole. But when the old ones were broken, they are pure, because the old ones were on the bed when it became defiled, and when they were broken, the bed is a broken vessel, for it is not appropriate without the long pieces.



### Mishnah 7

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:7:1)


**תֵּבָה שֶׁנִּפְחֲתָה מִלְּמַעְלָן.** הַכִּסּוּי שֶׁלָּהּ:


תיבה שנפחתה מלמעלן )a box which was damaged from above) – its covering.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:7:2)


**טְמֵאָה טְמֵא מֵת.** דְּכֵיוָן דְּשׁוּלֶיהָ קַיָּמִים אַכַּתִּי חַזְיָא לְתַשְׁמִישׁ. וְדַוְקָא טֻמְאַת מֵת. אֲבָל לֹא טֻמְאַת מִדְרָס, דְּלֹא חַזְיָא לִישִׁיבָה:


טמאה אמא מת – because its rim/bottom still exists, it is worthy for use. And specifically, defilement through contact with the dead, but not defilement by treading, for it is not appropriate for sitting.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:7:3)


**נִפְחֲתָה מִלְּמַטָּן.** בְּשׁוּלֶיהָ. בָּטַל בֵּית קִבּוּל שֶׁלָּהּ וּטְהוֹרָה לְגַמְרֵי:


נפחתה מלמטן – at its rims/bottoms, its receptacle was annulled and it is completely pure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:7:4)


**מְגוּרוֹת שֶׁלָּהּ.** אוֹצָרוֹת שֶׁבָּהּ, דְּהַיְנוּ חֲדָרִים שֶׁבְּתוֹכָהּ שֶׁלֹּא נִפְחֲתוּ עִמָּהּ, טְמֵאוֹת:


מגורות שלה (its drawers [in a chest]) – the treasures/storehouse within, that is the rooms that are in it that were not damaged with it, are impure.



### Mishnah 8

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:8:1)


**הַתּוּרְמֵל.** כִּיס גָּדוֹל שֶׁל עוֹר שֶׁהָרוֹעֶה נוֹתֵן חֲפָצָיו לְתוֹכוֹ, וּבְתוֹךְ הַתּוּרְמֵל יֵשׁ כִּיסִין קְטַנִּים כְּמוֹ הַמְּגוּרוֹת בַּתֵּבָה:


התורמל (bag – the inside pocket of which has become defective) -a large leather pocket that the shepherd puts his belongings into, and within the bag, there are small pockets like the drawers in a box.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:8:2)


**הַחֵמֶת.** נֹאד שֶׁל עוֹר:


חמת (bottle – of a skin of a he-goat/wether) – leather skin or bottle.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:8:3)


**שֶׁהַבֵּיצִים שֶׁלָּהּ מְקַבְּלוֹת עִמָּהּ.** כְּשֶׁמַּפְשִׁיטִין עוֹרוֹת הָאֵילִים וְהַתְּיָשִׁים הַזְּכָרִים נִשְׁאָר הָעוֹר שֶׁבִּמְקוֹם הַבֵּיצִים כְּמִין כִּיס קָטָן, וְאִם נִפְחֲתוּ טְהוֹרוֹת, דְּבָטַל בֵּית קִבּוּל שֶׁלָּהֶן:


שהביצים שלה מקבלות עמה when they flay/shed the skin of the male rams and wethers/he-goats, there remains the leather that is in place of the genitals/testicles, like a small pocket, but if they were damaged, they are ritually pure, for their receptacle has been nullified.



### Mishnah 9

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:9:1)


**שֶׁפִּתְחָהּ מִצִּדָּהּ.** כְּשֶׁפִּתְחָהּ מִלְּמַעְלָה אֵינָהּ טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס, דְּאִם יָשַׁב עָלֶיהָ וּבָאִים לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בָּהּ אוֹמְרִים לוֹ עֲמֹד וְנַעֲשֶׂה מְלַאכְתֵּנוּ. אֲבָל כְּשֶׁפִּתְחָהּ מִן הַצַּד, יָכוֹל לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁיּוֹשֵׁב עָלֶיהָ:


שפתחה מצדה (that was damaged from its side) – When it was damaged from above, it was not impure by treading, for if he sat upon it and comes to use it, they say to him: “Stand and let us do our work.” But when it was damaged from the side, it is possible to use it even though he sits upon it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:9:2)


**בִּזְמַן שֶׁאֵינָהּ גְּבוֹהָה עֲשָׂרָה טְפָחִים.** כְּשֶׁגְּבוֹהָה עֲשָׂרָה לֹא חַזְיָא לִישִׁיבָה כֻלֵּי הַאי:


בזמן שאינה גבוהה עשרה טפחים – when it is ten [handbreadths] high, it is not appropriate for sitting all that much.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:9:3)


**אוֹ שֶׁאֵין לָהּ לִזְבֵּז.** דִּכְשֶׁיֶּשׁ לָהּ לִזְבֵּז מַזִּיק לַיּוֹשֵׁב:


או שאין לה לזבז (or when it does not have a vertical rim/edge – buy which a flat vessel is made into a vessel-like receptacle) – when it has a vertical rim which damages the person who sits upon it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:9:4)


**נִפְחֲתָה מִלְּמַטָּן.** בְּשׁוּלֶיהָ. לֹא חַזְיָא לְתַשְׁמִישׁ, אֲבָל חַזְיָא לִישִׁיבָה:


נפתחה מלמטן – at its rim/bottom. It is not appropriate for use, but is appropriate for sitting.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:9:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:9:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:9:5)


**מִפְּנֵי שֶׁבָּטַל הָעִקָּר.** עִקַּר הַתֵּבָה הִיא עֲשׂוּיָה לְהַחְזִיק בְּשׁוּלֶיהָ מַה שֶּׁמְּשִׂימִים בְּתוֹכָהּ, וְעַל יָדָם הִיא נִקְרֵאת כְּלִי. וְכֵיוָן שֶׁנִּפְחֲתוּ שׁוּלֶיהָ וּבָטְלוּ, בָּטְלוּ גַם דָּפְנוֹתֶיהָ מִלְּמַעֲלָן וְשׁוּב אֵינָהּ מְקַבֶּלֶת שׁוּם טֻמְאָה. וַהֲלָכָה כַּחֲכָמִים:


מפני שבטל העקר (because the primary purpose was annulled) – the primary purpose of the box is that its made to support its rim what one places within it, and through that, it is called a vessel. But because its rim was damaged and it was nullified, also its walls from above are nullified and it no longer receives any form of defilement. And the Halakha is according to the Sages.



### Mishnah 10

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:10:1)


**מִשְׁפֶּלֶת.** קֻפָּה גְּדוֹלָה שֶׁמּוֹלִיכִין בָּהּ הַזֶּבֶל וְהָאַשְׁפָּה:


משפלת (a wicker basket carried on a pole over the shoulder) – a large basket that they carry the manure and the trash.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:10:2)


**שֶׁנִּפְחֲתָה מִלְּקַבֵּל רִמּוֹנִים.** שֶׁזֶּהוּ שִׁעוּרָהּ לִטַּהֵר כְּשֶׁנִּקְּבָה בְּמוֹצִיא רִמּוֹן:


שנפחתה מלקבל רמונים – for this is its measure to become purified, when an incision is made when removing pomegranates.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:10:3)


**רַבִּי מֵאִיר מְטַמֵּא.** אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהִיא טְהוֹרָה מִשְּׁאָר טֻמְאוֹת, טְמֵאָה הִיא מִדְרָס, שֶׁרְאוּיָה לִישִׁיבָה:


ר' מאיר מטמא – even though it is more pure than all of the other defilement things, it is impure from treading, which is appropriate for sitting.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 19:10:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:10:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/19:10:4)


**וַחֲכָמִים מְטַהֲרִין.** וַהֲלָכָה כַּחֲכָמִים:


וחכמים מטהרין – And the Halakha is according to the Sages [for when the primary purpose is annulled, the secondary purpose is annulled].



## Chapter 20


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:1)


**הַכָּרִים.** עֲשׂוּיִין לְמַלְּאוֹתָן צֶמֶר אוֹ נוֹצָה, וְאָדָם נוֹתְנָן תַּחַת מְרַאֲשׁוֹתָיו:


הכרים (mattresses) – made to be filled with wool or feathers/down, a a person places them underneath his head.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:2)


**וְהַכְּסָתוֹת.** כְּמוֹ כָרִים הֵן, אֶלָּא שֶׁהֵן אֲרֻכִּים וּגְדוֹלִים וְכָל גּוּפוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם שׁוֹכֵב עֲלֵיהֶן:


והכסתות (cushions) – they ae like mattresses, but they are long and large, and the entire body of a person lies on them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:3)


**מַרְצוּפִין.** כְּמִין שַׂקִּים שֶׁל עוֹר גְּדוֹלִים שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים בָּהֶן סְחוֹרוֹת שֶׁמּוֹלִיכִין בַּסְּפִינוֹת:


מרצופין (packing bags, leather bags, sacks – adapted for ship-loads) – like a species of large leather sacks that they place in them goods that they take on ships.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:4)


**הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ טְמֵאִים מִדְרָס.** דְּכָל הָנֵי עֲבִידֵי נַמִּי לִשְׁכִיבָה:


הרי אלו טמאים מדרס – fo all of these are used also for lying.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:5)


**קְלוּסְטוֹר.** כְּמִין סַל וּכְפִיפָה שֶׁתּוֹלִין בְּפִי הַבְּהֵמָה, וְנוֹתְנִים בָּהּ מִסְפּוֹא וּשְׂעֹרִים וְהַבְּהֵמָה אוֹכֶלֶת כְּשֶׁהִיא מְהַלֶּכֶת:


קלוסטור (basket – fodder basked used instead of a muzzle) – a kind of folded basket that they suspend in the mouth of an animal, and they put in it fodder and barley-corn and the animal eats when it is walking.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:6)


**תּוּרְמֵל.** כִּיס גָּדוֹל שֶׁל עוֹר שֶׁהָרוֹעֶה נוֹתֵן שָׁם כָּל חֲפָצָיו:


תורמל – a large leather pocket that the shepherd places there all of his belongings.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:7)


**כְּרֵיתִית.** שַׂק שֶׁל עוֹר קָטָן:


כריתית (a leather bag containing one Se’ah) – a small leather bag.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:8)


**רִבְצָל.** חֵמֶת קָטָן שֶׁל עוֹר שֶׁמְּשִׂימִים בּוֹ בְשָׂמִים:


רבצל (small bag for perfumes, spices) – small leather bag that they place spices in.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:1:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:9)


**מִזְוָדָה.** כְּלִי שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים בּוֹ צֵידָה לַדֶּרֶךְ. תַּרְגּוּם צֵידָה זְוָדִין:


מזודה (traveling bag containing provisions) – a vessel that they place in it food/provisions for travel. The Aramaic translation of "צידה" – is "זוודין" – travel bag.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:1:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:10)


**הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ טְמֵאִים מִדְרָס.** כָּל אֵלּוּ הַשְּׁנוּיִים בַּמִּשְׁנָה, אִם יֵשׁ בְּכֻלָּן הַשִּׁעוּר הַמְפֹרָשׁ בָּהֶן אוֹ יוֹתֵר, מְטַמְּאִין מִדְרָס, דִּמְשַׁמְּשִׁין שְׁכִיבָה עִם מְלַאכְתָּן. אֲבָל בְּפָחוֹת מִכְּשִׁעוּר הַמְפֹרָשׁ בָּהֶן, לֹא:


הרי אלו טמאים מדרס – all of these that are taught in the Mishnah, if each of them has the measurement that is explained with them or more, they defile through treading/Midras, and they are used for lying with their work/task. But not with less than the defined measure [of the Mishnah].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:1:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:11)


**נִפְחֲתוּ טְהוֹרִין.** שֶׁכָּל אֵלּוּ עֲשׂוּיִין לְקַבֵּל, שֶׁהַקִּבּוּל הַהוּא מְכִינָם וּמַזְמִינָם לִהְיוֹת רְאוּיִין לְמִשְׁכָּב וּמוֹשָׁב, וּכְשֶׁנִּפְחַת בָּטַל הָעִקָּר שֶׁהוּא הַקִּבּוּל שֶׁבַּעֲבוּרוֹ הָיָה קָרוּי כְּלִי:


נפחתו טהורין – for all of these are made to receive/hold things, that the receptacle prepares them and designates them to be fit for lying and sitting, and when it becomes damaged/worn out, the primary purpose which is reception is annulled , and for that purpose it was called a vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:1:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:1:12)


**וּבָטְלָה הַטְּפֵלָה.** שֶׁהִיא טֻמְאַת מִדְרָס:


ובטלה הטפלה – which is defilement by treading.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:1)


**חֵמֶת חֲלִילִין.** חֵמֶת מָלֵא רוּחַ וּמְשִׂימִין הַחֲלִילִים בְּפִי הַחֵמֶת וְהָרוּחַ יוֹצֵא דֶרֶךְ הַנְּקָבִים וּמוֹצִיא מִן הַחֲלִילִים קוֹל שֶׁל שִׁיר:


חמת חלילין (bagpipe) – a bag that is full of wind and they place the flutes in he mouth of the bag and the wind exits through the incisions/holes and produces from the flutes a sound of song.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:2)


**טְהוֹרָה מִן הַמִּדְרָס.** דְּלֹא חַזְיָא לִשְׁכִיבָה:


טהורה מן המדרס – for it is not fit for lying.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:3)


**עֲרֵבַת פִּיסוֹנוֹת.** עֲרֵבָה שֶׁמְּבִיאִין בָּהּ אֲבָנִים קְטַנּוֹת וְרִגְבֵי אֲדָמָה כְּדֵי לָתֵת בַּנִּדְבָּכִים שֶׁל בִּנְיָן. וּפִיסוֹנוֹת לְשׁוֹן שְׁקַל פִּיסָא שְׁדָא בֵיהּ דְּאָמְרִינַן בַּגְּמָרָא בְסַנְהֶדְרִין גַּבֵּי מַרְקוּלִיס:


עריבת פיסונות (a trough for mixing mortar) – a trough that they bring into it small stones and clods of earth in order to provide a mold filled with earth or rubble of ethe building. And [the word] פיפוסנות is the language of “he took up a lump [of brittle stone] and threw it at it (the idolatrous statue)” as we state in the Gemara in [Tractate] Sanhedrin 64a concerning Mercurius (name of the Roman divinity, identified with the Grecian Hermes).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:4)


**בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים מִדְרָס.** קָסָבְרֵי מְשַׁמֶּשֶׁת שְׁכִיבָה עִם מְלַאכְתָּהּ. וּבֵית הִלֵּל סָבְרֵי אֵינָהּ מְשַׁמֶּשֶׁת:


בית שמאי אומרים מדרס – for they hold that they use it for lying with their work. But the School of Hillel holds that they don’t use it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:5)


**שֶׁנִּסְדְּקָה טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס.** וְאִם לֹא נִסְדְּקָה אֵינָהּ טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס, דְּאוֹמְרִין לוֹ עֲמֹד וְנַעֲשֶׂה מְלַאכְתֵּנוּ. אֲבָל כְּשֶׁנִּסְדְּקָה וּמוֹצִיאָה מַשְׁקִין, אֵינָהּ רְאוּיָה אֶלָּא לִשְׁכִיבָה. וּפְחוּתָה מִשְּׁנֵי לֻגִּים, אוֹ יְתֵרָה מִתִּשְׁעָה קַבִּין, אֵינָהּ טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס וַאֲפִלּוּ נִסְדְּקָה:


שנסדקה טמאה מדרס (which was split is impure through treading) – but if it was not split, it not impure through treading, for we say to him: “Stand and let us do our work.” But when it was split and liquids come out, it is not worthy other than for lying. But less than two LOG or more than nine Kab, is not ritually impure through treading and even if it was split.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:6)


**וְנִתְפְּחָה.** מֵחֲמַת גְּשָׁמִים מִתְנַפֵּחַ הָעֵץ וְנִסְתָּם הַסֶּדֶק:


ונתפחה (and it swelled up) – on account of the rains the wood swells and the split is closed up.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:7)


**טְמֵאָה טֻמְאַת מֵת.** כְּמוֹ שֶׁהָיְתָה בַּתְּחִלָּה קֹדֶם שֶׁנִּסְדְּקָה, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁיֶּשׁ לָהּ בֵּית קִבּוּל. וְאֵינָהּ טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס, דְּאֵינָהּ מְיֻחֶדֶת לִשְׁכַּב עָלֶיהָ, הוֹאִיל וּמִשְׁתַּמְּשִׁין בָּהּ בְּלִישָׁה:


טמאה טומאת מת – as it was at the outset before it became split, because it has a receptacle. But it is not impure from treading, for it is not designated to lie upon it, for they use it in kneading.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:2:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:8)


**בַּקָּדִים וְנִסְדְּקָה.** לְאַחַר שֶׁנִּתְפַּח הָעֵץ וְנִסְתַּם הַסֶּדֶק, הִנִּיחָהּ בְּרוּחַ קָדִים וְנִסְדְּקָה:


בקדים ונסדקה – after the wood had swelled up and the split had closed up, he placed it in an east wind and it split.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:2:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:9)


**טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס.** דְּחָזְרָה לִהְיוֹת רְאוּיָה לִשְׁכִיבָה וְלֹא לָלוּשׁ בָּהּ:


טמאה מדרס – that it returned to being fit for lying but not to knead with it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:2:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:10)


**זֶה חֹמֶר בִּשְׁיָרֵי כְלֵי עֵץ.** דִּתְחִלָּתָן אֵין טְמֵאִין מִדְרָס, וּכְשֶׁנִּסְדְּקוּ טְמֵאִים מִדְרָס:


זה חומר בשיירי כלי עץ – that at their outset they are not impure through treading, but when they are split, they are impure through treading.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:2:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:11)


**כְּלֵי נְצָרִים.** סַלִּים עֲשׂוּיִין מִנְּצָרִים שֶׁל עֲרָבָה וְכַיּוֹצֵא בָּהֶן:


כלי נצרים – baskets made of wickerwork of willows and of similar things.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:2:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:12)


**עַד שֶׁיִּתְחַסֵּמוּ.** שֶׁתִּגָּמֵר שְׂפָתָן הָעֶלְיוֹנָה:


עד שיתחסמו (until they be sealed/glazed) – when their upper rim/lip is completed.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:2:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:2:13)


**אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁנָּשְׁרוּ שִׂפְתוֹתֵיהֶן כָּל שֶׁהֵן.** שֶׁנָּפְלוּ שִׂפְתוֹתֵיהֶן וְלֹא נִשְׁאָר בְּשִׂפְתוֹתֵיהֶן אֶלָּא כָּל שֶׁהֵן, טָמֵא:


אע"פ שנשרו שפתותיהן כל שהן – that their lips fell and there doesn’t remain anything of their lips to any degree at all, they are ritually impure.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:1)


**מַקֵּל.** שֶׁל עֵץ בְּעָלְמָא שֶׁעֲשָׂאוֹ בֵית יָד לַקֻּרְדֹּם לְפִי שָׁעָה, שֶׁלֹּא קְבָעוֹ בְתוֹכוֹ:


מקל – merely [a wooden] staff that a handle/heft for a hatchet according to the time [of use], but did not fit it [permanently] within it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:2)


**חִבּוּר לַטֻּמְאָה בִּשְׁעַת מְלָאכָה.** דְּאַף עַל גַּב דִּבְאַפֵּי נַפְשֵׁיהּ פְּשׁוּטֵי כְלֵי עֵץ לֹא מְקַבְּלֵי טֻמְאָה, הָכָא בֵית יָד הוּא, וְיָדוֹת נִתְרַבּוּ לְכָל תּוֹרַת טֻמְאַת הַכְּלִי אוֹ הָאֹכֶל, וְאִם נִטְמָא הַקֻּרְדֹּם נִטְמָא הַבֵּית יָד, וְכֵן אִם נָגְעָה טֻמְאָה בַּבֵּית יָד נִטְמָא הוּא וְנִטְמָא הַקֻּרְדֹּם עִמּוֹ. וְדַוְקָא בִשְׁעַת מְלָאכָה הָוֵי חִבּוּר לַטֻּמְאָה, שֶׁלֹּא בִשְׁעַת מְלָאכָה לֹא, דְּשֶׁלֹּא בִשְׁעַת מְלָאכָה אָדָם עָשׂוּי לְזָרְקוֹ לְבֵין הָעֵצִים:


חיבור לטומאה בשעת מלאכה (is a connector for uncleanness at the time of its use) – even though that on its own, it is a plain wooden vessel, it does not receive ritual uncleanness; but here it is a sleeve, and handles increased through the Torah of the defilement of the vessel or the food, and if the ax/hatchet became defiled, the handle became defiled, and similarly, if the defilment came in contact with the handle, it is defiled, and the ax/hatchet became defiled with it. And specifically, at the time of work there is a connector/attachment to defilement, but not during the time when not working., for when it is not the time of work, a person generally would throw them among the wood.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:3)


**דְּיוּסְטָר.** כְּלִי הַמְשַׁמֵּשׁ לִשְׁנֵי צְדָדִים. דְּיוּ, שְׁנַיִם. סְטָר, צַד. כְּדִמְתַרְגְּמִינַן לִסְטָר חַד. וְהוּא מַקֵּל שֶׁיֶּשׁ בּוֹ שְׁנֵי נְקָבִים אֶחָד מִלְּמַטָּה וְאֶחָד מִלְּמַעְלָה, וּשְׁתֵּי יְתֵדוֹת תְּחוּבוֹת בָּהֶן אַחַת מִמִּזְרָח לְמַעֲרָב וְאַחַת מִצָּפוֹן לְדָרוֹם, וְהַנָּשִׁים מְסֵכוֹת בּוֹ אֶת הַמַּטְוֶה שֶׁבַּפֶּלֶךְ, וְקוֹרִין לוֹ נספ"א בְּלַעַ"ז. וּפְעָמִים שֶׁעוֹשִׂין אוֹתָן יָדוֹת מִבַּרְזֶל וּמְקַבְּלִין טֻמְאָה:


דיוסטר (the transverse staff of the upright loom/pole reaching from end to end) – a vessel that one uses for two sides. [The word דיוסטר – is now broken down into its component parts. "דיו" is “two;” "סטר" is “sides,” as we translate in Aramaic, “to one side.” And it is a staff that has two incisions, one from the bottom and the other from the top, and two handles are inserted in them, one from the east to the west and one from the north and the south, and the women roll the yarn that is in the spindle, and we call it NASPA in the foreign language. And sometimes they make these handles from iron and they receive ritual impurity.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:4)


**קְבָעוֹ בִכְלוֹנָס.** קָבַע הַדְּיוּסְטָר דְּהַיְנוּ הַמַּקֵּל עִם שְׁתֵּי יְתֵדוֹתָיו בִּכְלוֹנָס, דְּהַיְנוּ עֵץ אָרֹךְ וְגָדוֹל הַתָּקוּעַ בָּאָרֶץ:


קבעו בכלונס (if he inserted the transverse staff of the loom in the beam/yarn winder) – if he inserted the transverse staff of the pole reaching from end to end), that is the staff with its two handles/pegs in the beam, which is a long and large piece of wood that is fastened into the ground.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:5)


**טָמֵא.** הַדְּיוּסְטָר מִכָּאן וָאֵילָךְ אִם נָגְעָה בוֹ טֻמְאָה, דַּהֲוֵי הַמַּקֵּל חִבּוּר לַיְתֵדוֹת בֵּין בִּשְׁעַת מְלָאכָה בֵּין שֶׁלֹּא בִשְׁעַת מְלָאכָה, כֵּיוָן שֶׁנִּקְבָּע, שֶׁאֵין אָדָם עָשׂוּי לְזָרְקוֹ לְבֵין הָעֵצִים. אֲבָל הַכְּלוֹנָס עַצְמוֹ אֵינוֹ חִבּוּר לוֹ, שֶׁאִם נָגְעָה טֻמְאָה בַכְּלוֹנָס לֹא נִטְמָא הַדְּיוּסְטָר:


טמא – the traverse staff of the upright loom reaching from end to end is impure from this side and that, if the defilement came in contact with it, for it is an attached staff to the handles/pegs whether at the time of work or not at the time of work, since it was affixed, a person is not likely to throw it among the wood, but the traverse staff of the loom in the beam, it is not attached to it, and the rest of it whether above or below is ritually pure, for the staff of the loom in the beam is long and large.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:6)


**עָשָׂה בוֹ הַדְּיוּסְטָר.** שֶׁקָּבַע שְׁתֵּי הַיְתֵדוֹת בְּגוּפוֹ שֶׁל כְּלוֹנָס:


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:3:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:7)


**אֵין טָמֵא.** מִן הַכְּלוֹנָס אֶלָּא מַה שֶּׁהוּא לְצֹרֶךְ הַיְתֵדוֹת לְהָסֵךְ אֶת הַמַּטְוֶה, וְהַשְּׁאָר בֵּין מִלְּמַעְלָה בֵּין מִלְּמַטָּה טָהוֹר, שֶׁהַכְּלוֹנָס אָרֹךְ הוּא וְגָדוֹל:


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:3:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:8)


**כִּסֵּא.** שֶׁהוּא עָשׂוּי, וּקְבָעוֹ בִכְלוֹנָס, הַכִּסֵּא טָמֵא מִדְרָס, וְאֵין הַכְּלוֹנָס חִבּוּר לוֹ לִהְיוֹת מִטַּמֵּא מִדְרָס כְּמוֹתוֹ:


כסא – that is made, and it is affixed into the traverse staff of the loom in the beam, the chair is impure through treading, but the traverse staff of the loom in the beam is not attached to it to be made impure through treading like it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:3:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:9)


**עָשָׂה בוֹ כִסֵּא.** מִן הַכְּלוֹנָס עַצְמוֹ עָשָׂה כִסֵּא:


עשה בו כסא –from the traverse staff of the loom in the beam, he made a chair.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:3:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:10)


**אֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא מְקוֹמוֹ.** דְּהַיְנוּ צֹרֶךְ הַיְשִׁיבָה. וּשְׁאָר הַכְּלוֹנָס טָהוֹר:


אין טמא אלא במקומו – that is, the need of the sitting. But the rest of the traverse staff of the loom in the beam is pure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:3:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:3:11)


**קָבַע הַכִּסֵּא בְקוֹרַת בֵּית הַבַּד.** שֶׁעוֹצְרִים בָּהּ הַשֶּׁמֶן מִן הַזֵּיתִים. הַכִּסֵּא טָמֵא מִדְרָס, וְהַקּוֹרָה אֵינָהּ חִבּוּר וּטְהוֹרָה. וְאִם מֵעֵץ הַקּוֹרָה עַצְמָהּ הַכִּסֵּא עָשׂוּי בְּרֹאשָׁהּ הָאֶחָד, אַף הַכִּסֵּא טָהוֹר, דְּאוֹמְרִים לוֹ עֲמֹד וְנַעֲשֶׂה מְלַאכְתֵּנוּ. וְתַנְיָא בְתוֹרַת כֹּהֲנִים, אֲשֶׁר יֵשֵׁב עָלָיו יִטְמָא, יָכוֹל אֲפִלּוּ יֵשֵׁב עַל הָאֶבֶן וְעַל הַקּוֹרָה, תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר, כְּלִי, וְלֹא אֶבֶן וְלֹא קוֹרָה. אוֹצִיא אֶת אֵלּוּ, וְלֹא אוֹצִיא כְלֵי אֲבָנִים כְּלֵי גְלָלִים כְּלֵי אֲדָמָה, תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר הַכְּלִי, כְּלִי הַמְיֻחָד לְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה, וְכֵלִים הַלָּלוּ אֵין מְקַבְּלִים טֻמְאָה לְעוֹלָם. אֵין לִי אֶלָּא כִסֵּא וְסַפְסָל וְקַתֶּדְרָא הַמְיֻחָדִים לִישִׁיבָה, מִנַּיִן תֵּבַת הַבַּלָּנִים, תֵּבָה שֶׁפִּתְחָהּ מִצִּדָּהּ, עֲרֵבָה מִשְּׁנֵי לֹג עַד תִּשְׁעָה קַבִּין שֶׁנִּסְדְּקָה וְאֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לִרְחֹץ בָּהּ רַגְלוֹ אַחַת, תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר וְכָל הַכְּלִי, רִבָּה. יָכוֹל אֲפִלּוּ כָפָה סְאָה וְיָשַׁב עָלֶיהָ, תַּרְקָב וְיָשַׁב עָלָיו, תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר אֲשֶׁר יֵשֵׁב, הַמְיֻחָד לִישִׁיבָה, לֹא שֶׁאוֹמְרִים לוֹ עֲמֹד וְנַעֲשֶׂה מְלַאכְתֵּנוּ:


קבע הכסא בקורת בית הבד (if he affixed the chair onto a beam in the olive press) – that gathers/stores away the il from the olives, the chair is ritually impure through treading, but the beam is not attached and is a pure. But if from the wood of the beam itself the chair is made at one end, even the chair is pure, for we say to him: “Stand and let us do our work.” And it is taught in a Baraitha in Torat Kohanim [i.e., the Sifra, the Halakhic Midrash on the Book of Leviticus): “[Any bedding on which the one with the discharge lies shall be unclean, and every object] on which he sits shall be unclean” (Leviticus 15:4) – “it includes even one who sat on a stone or on the beam, the inference teaches us, a vessel, but not a stone nor a beam, and I will not exclude the vessels of stone, the vessels of excrement or vessels of earth, the inference teaches us the vessel, the vessel that is designated to receive impurity, but these vessels do not receive defilement ever (see Sifra Metzora, Parshat Zahav, portion 4, beginning of the seventh chapter, letter 10). I lack all other than a chair or a bench or a chair with a back/soft seat that is designated for sitting , from where is the chest of the bath attendant, a chest that opened from its side, a trough from two LOG until nine Kab that was chipped, he is unable to wash his foot in it, the inference teaches us, “and all the vessel,” which is an extension. It is possible even if he covered a Seah and sat upon it, a field requiring three Kab of seed and he sat upon it, the inference teaches us, “on which he sits” (Leviticus 15:4), that which is designated for sitting, we don’t say to him: “Stand up, and let us do our work” (see Talmud Shabbat 59a).



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:4:1)


**עַד שֶׁיְּקַצֵּעַ.** שֶׁיַּחְתְּכֶנָּה וִיתַקְּנֶנָּה לִישִׁיבָה. וַהֲלָכָה כַּחֲכָמִים:


עד שיקצע (until he smooths/cuts off/trims the rough parts) – that he would cut it off and establish it for sitting. And the Halakha is according to the Sages.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:4:2)


**אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁקְּבָעָהּ בַּכֹּתֶל טְמֵאָה.** טֻמְאַת מֵת אוֹ שֶׁרֶץ. וְלֹא בָטְלָה מִתּוֹרַת כְּלִי וְלֹא אָמְרִינַן כְּלִי הַמְחֻבָּר לַקַּרְקַע כְּקַרְקַע דָּמֵי אֶלָּא כְשֶׁהָיָה מְחֻבָּר לַקַּרְקַע מִתְּחִלָּתוֹ, אוֹ שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה כְדֵי לְשַׁמֵּשׁ אֶת הַקַּרְקַע:


אע"פ שקבעה בכותל טמאה – through defilement through a corpse or a reptile. But it is not annulled from being a vessel, and we don’t say a vessel that is attached to the ground is like the ground itself, but rather only when it was attached/connected to the ground at its outset, or that it was made in order to serve the ground.



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:1)


**כֹּפֶת.** כְּלִי הַמְיֻחָד לִישִׁיבָה, וְשֶׁל תְּמָרָה הוּא:


כופת (a stool/a block with a concave top to sit upon) – a vessel designated for sitting. And it is of date-palm.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:2)


**שֶׁקְּבָעוֹ בְנִדְבָּךְ.** בְּשׁוּרַת הַבִּנְיָן:


שקבעו בנדבך (that was fixed into a course of the wall, course of bricks/stones) – in the row of the building.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:3)


**בָּנָה עָלָיו וְלֹא קְבָעוֹ.** כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁהָאֻמָּנִים עוֹשִׂים שֶׁבּוֹנִים כִּפָּה עַל גַּבֵּי נְסָרִים וְאַחַר כָּךְ מְסִירִים אוֹתָם:


בנה עליו ולא קבעו (built upon it but did not fix it) – in the manner that the artisans do when building an arch/doorway over the boards and afterwards sawing them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:4)


**טָמֵא.** אִם יָשַׁב הַזָּב עַל הַבִּנְיָן שֶׁעָלָיו, נִטְמָא הַכֹּפֶת שֶׁתַּחַת הַבִּנְיָן, שֶׁהַזָּב מְטַמֵּא אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּב וְאֶת הַמּוֹשָׁב שֶׁתַּחַת אֶבֶן מְסָמָא. וְכֵן כְּשֶׁקְּבָעוֹ וְלֹא בָנָה עָלָיו וְיָשַׁב הַזָּב עָלָיו כְּשֶׁהוּא קָבוּעַ, טָמֵא, דְּלֹא נִתְבַּטֵּל בְּהָכִי. אֲבָל כְּשֶׁקְּבָעוֹ וּבָנָה עָלָיו, בָּטֵל לְגַבֵּי כֹתֶל וּכְכֹתֶל דָּמֵי:


טמא – if he person with gonorrhea sat on the building that he is upon, the stool/block with a concave top to sit on that is under the building is defiled. For the person with gonorrhea defiles that which he sits upon and that which he lies upon that is under the stone used for closing a pit (which may be over a corpse). And similarly, they fixed it but did not build upon it and the person with gonorrhea sat upon it when it is fixed, it is ritually impure, but it is not nullified in this. But when he fixed it and built upon it, it is nullified in regard to the wall, and it is like a wall.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:5)


**מַפָּץ.** כְּמִין מַחְצֶלֶת עֲשׂוּיָה מִקָּנִים אוֹ מִגֶּמִי:


מפץ (a mat of reeds, bark, the poor man’s mattress) – like the species of matting made from reeds or from bulrushes/reed-grass.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:5:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:6)


**עַל גַּבֵּי הַקּוֹרוֹת.** שֶׁל עֲלִיָּה:


על גבי הקורות – of the attic.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:5:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:7)


**מַעֲזִיבָה.** טִיט וּצְרוֹרוֹת שֶׁל אֲבָנִים שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים עַל גַּבֵּי הַתִּקְרָה. וְכָל כַּמָּה שֶׁלֹּא קָבַע הַמַּפָּץ בַּקּוֹרוֹת וְיָשַׁב הַזָּב עַל הַמַּעֲזִיבָה, נִטְמָא הַמַּפָּץ שֶׁתַּחְתֶּיהָ וְלֹא בָטֵל מִתּוֹרַת כְּלִי, דְּאִי בָעֵי שָׁקֵיל לֵיהּ. וְכֵן אִם קְבָעוֹ וְלֹא נָתַן עָלָיו מַעֲזִיבָה וְיָשַׁב הַזָּב עָלָיו, טָמֵא מוֹשָׁב. וְלֹא בָטֵיל עַד שֶׁיִּקְבַּע וְיִתֵּן עָלָיו הַמַּעֲזִיבָה:


מעזיבה (a concrete of stone chippings, clay) – plaster and pebbles of stones that one places on the room. And all the while that one did not fix the mat of reeds in the walls and the person with gonorrhea sat on the concrete of stone chippings, the mat is defiled that is below it, but it is not annulled from the laws of a vessels, for if he wanted, he could take it. And similarly, if he fixed it but did not place upon it the concrete of stones and the person with gonorrhea sat upon it, it is impure from sitting. But it is not annulled until he fixes it and places the concrete of stone chippings upon it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:5:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:8)


**כְּדֶרֶךְ קַבָּלָתָהּ.** שׁוּלֶיהָ לְמַטָּה:


כדרך קבלתה – its rims below.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:5:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:5:9)


**שֶׁלֹּא כְדֶרֶךְ קַבָּלָתָהּ.** שׁוּלֶיהָ לְמַעְלָה:


כדרך שלא קבלתה – its rims above.



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:6:1)


**סָדִין שֶׁהוּא טְמֵא מִדְרָס.** שֶׁרָאוּי לִטַּמֵּא מִדְרָס קָאָמַר, וְלֹא שֶׁנִּטְמָא מִדְרָס מַמָּשׁ. דְּאִם כֵּן אַדְּתָנֵי סֵיפָא אֲבָל טָמֵא טְמֵא מֵת, לִתְנֵי אֲבָל טָמֵא מַגַּע מִדְרָס, כִּדְתָנֵי בְהַקּוֹמֵץ רַבָּה:


סדין שהוא טמא מדרס – and it is appropriate to be defiled through treading, as it states, but it is not actually defiled through treading. For if so, as it is taught in the concluding section ‘of the Mishnah] “that is susceptible to uncleanness from corpse uncleanness,” let it be taught “but it is impure through contact with treading, as it is taught in the third chapter of Tractate Menahot (הקומץ רבה) [see also Tosefta Tractate Kelim Bava Metzia, Chapter 11, Halakha 9].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:6:2)


**וַעֲשָׂאוֹ וִילוֹן.** מָסָךְ לַפֶּתַח, אוֹ וִילוֹן לַסְּפִינָה. וְדַוְקָא שֶׁעָשָׂה בוֹ שִׁנּוּי מַעֲשֶׂה, אֲבָל מַחֲשָׁבָה אֵינָהּ מוֹצִיאַתּוּ מִידֵי טֻמְאָה שֶׁהָיוּ רְאוּיִין לָהּ:


ועשאו וילון – a curtain for the opening, or a curtain for a ship. And specifically, when he made it through a change in action, but thought [alone] does not remove it from defilement that it was appropriate for it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:6:3)


**אֲבָל טָמֵא טְמֵא מֵת.** מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהַשַּׁמָּשׁ מִתְחַמֵּם כְּנֶגְדּוֹ וּמִתְעַטֵּף בְּשׁוּלָיו לִפְעָמִים, הִלְכָּךְ לֹא בָטֵיל מִתּוֹרַת כְּלִי:


אבל טמא טמא מת – because the sun warms it (see Talmud Betzah 14a) it (i.e., the sheet) is wrapped in its rims periodically, therefore, it is not annulled from the laws of a vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:6:4)


**מֵאֵימָתַי טָהֳרָתוֹ.** שֶׁבָּטַל תּוֹרַת מִדְרָס מִמֶּנּוּ:


מאימתי טהרתו – that the law of treading is annulled from it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:6:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:6:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:6:5)


**מִשֶּׁיִּתָּפֵר.** בַּתּוֹסֶפְתָּא מוּכָח דְּבֵית שַׁמַּאי בָּעוּ שֶׁיִּקְרָעֶנּוּ וִיתַקְּנֶנּוּ לְמִדַּת הַפֶּתַח, וְיִתְפֹּר בּוֹ לוּלָאוֹת לִתְלוֹתוֹ בְמָסָךְ אוֹ בִסְפִינָה. וּבֵית הִלֵּל דְּאָמְרֵי מִשֶּׁיִּקָּשֵׁר, לֹא בָעוּ קְרִיעָה, אֶלָּא מִשֶּׁיִּקְשֹׁר בּוֹ הַלּוּלָאוֹת כְּדֵי לִתְלוֹתוֹ בָהֶם. וְאִית סְפָרִים דְּגָרְסֵי, בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים מִשֶּׁיִּתָּבֵר. וְהִיא הִיא. כְּלוֹמַר מִשֶּׁיִּשְׁבְּרוּהוּ וְיִקְרָעוּהוּ כְדֵי לְתָפְרוֹ לְמִדַּת הַפֶּתַח:


משיתפר – In the Tosefta it is proven that the School of Shammai (see above, Tractate Kelim Bava Metzia 11:6) requires when it is torn and one fixes it to the measure of the opening, and one sews on it loops/couplings to hang it on a curtain or on a ship. But the School of Hillel states: “when he ties it up” and it doesn’t require tearing. But rather, one he ties on it the loops/couplings in order to suspend them upon them. And there are books that have the reading: “The School of Shammai states from when it is broken,” and that this is the reading, meaning to say, that when he breaks it and tears it in order to sew it to the measure of the opening.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:6:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:6:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:6:6)


**רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא אוֹמֵר מִשֶּׁיִּקָּבֵעַ.** מֵעֵת שֶׁיִּתְלֶה אוֹתוֹ עַל הַפֶּתַח אוֹ עַל הַסְּפִינָה. וַהֲלָכָה כְּבֵית הִלֵּל:


ר' עקיבא אומר משיקבע – from the time that he will hang it on the opening or on the ship. And the Halakha is according to the School of Hillel.



### Mishnah 7

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:1)


**לְאָרְכָּהּ טְהוֹרָה.** אֹרֶךְ הַקָּנֶה לְאֹרֶךְ הַמַּחְצֶלֶת, טְהוֹרָה. דְּלֹא חַזְיָא לִשְׁכִיבָה, שֶׁהַקָּנִים מַזִּיקִין לַשּׁוֹכֵב, וְלֹא חַזְיָא כִּי אִם לְסִכּוּךְ:


לארכה טהורה – the length of the reed corresponding to the length of the matting [of straw], is pure, but it is not appropriate for lying, for the reeds damage the person lying down, but they are not appropriate for anything other than interlacing.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:2)


**כְּמִין כִי.** יְוָנִית. שֶׁהִיא כְּמִין כ'‏ הֲפוּכָה שֶׁלָּנוּ. כְּלוֹמַר, לְעוֹלָם הִיא טְמֵאָה עַד שֶׁיִּמְשֹׁךְ הַקָּנִים מִשְּׁלֹשָׁה צְדָדִים. וַהֲלָכָה כַּחֲכָמִים:


כמין כי – the Greek [letter]. That is akin to the reverse of our [letter] "כ". Meaning to say, it is always impure util he pulss the reeds from three sides. And the Halakha is according to the Sages.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:3)


**עֲשָׂאָם לְרָחְבָּהּ.** אֹרֶךְ הַקָּנֶה לְרֹחַב הַמַּחְצֶלֶת:


עשאם לרחבה – the length of the reed to the width of the matting.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:4)


**אַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים.** כְּשֶׁיֶּשׁ בֵּין קָנֶה לְקָנֶה אַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים, חַזְיָא לִשְׁכַּב בֵּין שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים:


ד' טפחים – when there is between each reed four handbreadths, it is appropriate to lie upon between the two reeds.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:5)


**נֶחְלְקָה לְרָחְבָּהּ.** וְנִשְׁבְּרוּ הַקָּנִים שֶׁלָּהּ לְחֵצִי:


נחלקה לרחבה – and its reeds were broken in-half.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:7:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:6)


**רַבִּי יְהוּדָה מְטַהֵר.** דְּלֹא חַזְיָא לִשְׁכִיבָה. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


רבי יהודה מטהר – for it is not appropriate for lying. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehuda.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:7:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:7)


**הַמַּתִּיר רָאשֵׁי הַמַּעֲדַנִּים.** מִנְהַג עוֹשֵׂי מַחְצְלָאוֹת כְּשֶׁמַּשְׁלִימִין הַמַּחְצֶלֶת נִשְׁאַר כְּמִין מֶלֶל, וְגוֹדְלִים אוֹתוֹ בְכָל שְׁנֵי טְפָחִים גְּדִיל אֶחָד וְקוֹשְׁרוֹ שֶׁלֹּא יִסָּתֵר הָאָרִיג. וְאִם נִתַּר עוֹמֵד לִסְתִירָה וְנִתְבַּטֵּל מִתּוֹרַת כְּלִי וּטְהוֹרָה:


המתיר ראשי מעדנים (he who loosens the tops of reed matting) – it is custom of those who make matting that when they complete the mat, there remains a kind of border/hem. And they raise it in all two handbreadths a twisted thread and tie it so that the web will not be destroyed. For if it remains, it stands to be destroyed and would be annulled from the notion of being a vessel, and is pure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:7:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:8)


**מַעֲדַנִּים.** קְשָׁרִים. כְּמוֹ וַיֵּלֵךְ אֵלָיו אֲגָג מַעֲדַנּוֹת (שמואל א טו), כְּלוֹמַר, קָשׁוּר כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁקּוֹשְׁרִים הָאֲסוּרִים. וְכֵן הַתְקַשֵּׁר מַעֲדַנּוֹת כִּימָה (איוב לח):


Reed matting, ties, like (I Samuel 15:32): “Agag approached him (i.e., Samuel) with faltering steps,” meaning to say, it is tied in the manner that forbidden things are tied, and similarly (Job 38:31): “Cast you tie cords to Pleiades.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:7:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:9)


**שֶׁהֵם שֶׁל שִׁשָּׁה טְפָחִים.** שְׁנֵי טְפָחִים בֵּין מַעֲדָן לְמַעֲדָן וְטֶפַח מִכָּאן וְטֶפַח מִכָּאן:


שהם של ששה טפחים – two handbreadths between each reed matting, and a handbreadth from here and a handbreadth from there.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 20:7:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/20:7:10)


**מִשֶּׁתִּקָּנֵּב.** מִשֶּׁיַּחְתֹּךְ וְיִקְטֹם רָאשֵׁי קְרוּמִים הַבּוֹלְטִים. וְזוֹ הִיא קְנִיבָה:


משתקנב (when it will have been trimmed) – that he will sever/cut and lop off the heads of the protruding membrane, and this is cutting/trimming.



## Chapter 21


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:1)


**הַנּוֹגֵעַ בַּכֹּבֶד הָעֶלְיוֹן.** שְׁנֵי עֵצִים עֲגֻלִּים יֵשׁ לָאוֹרֵג, הָאֶחָד שֶׁחוּט הַשְּׁתִי כָּרוּךְ בּוֹ, וְהַשֵּׁנִי שֶׁלְּפָנָיו שֶׁכָּל זְמַן שֶׁאוֹרֵג וְהוֹלֵךְ כּוֹרֵךְ בּוֹ הַיְרִיעָה הַנֶּאֱרֶגֶת. וּלְפִי שֶׁהֵם כְּבֵדִים, נִקְרָאִים כֹּבֶד. וְכֹבֶד הָעֶלְיוֹן הוּא שֶׁלְּפָנָיו, וְכֹבֶד הַתַּחְתּוֹן הוּא הָרָחוֹק מִמֶּנּוּ, שֶׁכָּל הַשְּׁתִי כָּרוּךְ בּוֹ:


הנוגע בכובד העליון (he who touches the upper beam from which the warp depends) –the weaver has two round pieces of wood, the first that the warp (i.e., longitudinal) thread is wrapped around, and the second that is in front of it that all the while that he continues to weave, he wraps the woven curtain. And because they are heavy, they are called כובד. And the upper beam from which the warp depends is what is in front of him, and the lower beam (כובד התחתון – the roller on which the web is wound as it advances) is distant one from him for all the warp (longitudinal thread) is wrapped on it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:2)


**בַּנִּירִים.** הֵן חוּטִים הָאֲרוּגִין עַל הַקָּנֶה, וּבַעֲבוּרָן מַגְבִּיהִין קְצָת הַחוּטִים וְעוֹשִׂין דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁיֵּלֵךְ בּוֹ הָאֶרֶג בַּחוּט:


הנירין (the cross-beam of the loom – the leashes or thrums to which the threads of the warp are attached) – they are the woven threads on the reed, and for them, they raise slightly the threads and make a path that the weaving of the thread goes.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:3)


**וְקֵירוֹס.** מַסְרֵק שֶׁבּוֹ מַכִּים עַל הָאֲרִיגָה וּמְחַבְּרִים הַחוּטִים:


קירום (the row of slips or thrums in the loom to which the threads of the warp are attached) – comb/strigil that one strikes on the weaving and fastens the threads


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:4)


**בְּחוּט שֶׁהֶעֱבִירוֹ עַל גַּבֵּי אַרְגָּמָן.** לְאַחַר שֶׁנַּעֲשֵׂית הָרִקְמָה מְשִׂימִין חוּטִין עָלֶיהָ שֶׁלֹּא תִּתְלַכְלֵךְ, וְאוֹתָן חוּטִין לֹא הָווּ חִבּוּר לַבֶּגֶד:


בחוט שהעבירו על גבי ארגמן – after the embroidered garment is made, they place threads on it that it should not become soiled, and those threads were not attached to the cloth.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:5)


**וּבְעִירָה.** הוּא אִירָא הָאָמוּר בְּפֶרֶק קַמָּא דְשַׁבָּת (דף יא) וְלֹא גָרְדִי בְאִירָא שֶׁבְּאָזְנוֹ. וְהִיא חֲתִיכָה קְטַנָּה מִצֶּמֶר אוֹ מִפִּשְׁתָּן אוֹ מִצֶּמֶר גֶּפֶן שֶׁאוֹרְגִים בְּתוֹךְ הַמִּטְפָּחוֹת לְנוֹי, וְזוֹרֵק אוֹתוֹ בְתוֹךְ הַשְּׁתִי וְחוּט שֶׁל עֵרֶב כָּרוּךְ בְּתוֹכָהּ, וְיֵשׁ מֵהֶן שְׁחוֹרִים וַאֲדֻמִּים. וְאִם אֵינוֹ עָתִיד לְהַחֲזִירָהּ, כְּגוֹן שֶׁהִיא אֲדֻמָּה וְעַתָּה רוֹצֶה לְהַכְנִיס אִירָא שְׁחוֹרָה, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁלֹּא פְסָקָהּ מִן הַבֶּגֶד לֹא הַוְיָא חִבּוּר:


ובעירא (white substance, undyed wool or cotton – this is the "אירא" /undyed wool or cotton that is mentioned in the first chapter of [Tractate] Shabbat [11b]: "ולא גדרי באירא שבאזנו"/nor a common weaver with undyed wool in his ear. And this is a small piece, from wool or flax or from wool of the vine that they weave within the wraps for beauty, and he throws it into the warp/longitudinal direction of the latitudinal direction/woof that is wrapped within it, and there are some of them that are black and red, and if it will not be eventually restored, such as for example that it is red and now he wants to bring in undyed black wool, and even those it has not split the cloth, there was no attachment/combination.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:6)


**בְּנֶפֶשׁ הַמַּסֶּכֶת.** חוּטֵי הָעֵרֶב שֶׁהוֹלְכִים בְּתוֹךְ הַמַּסֶּכֶת כְּנֶפֶשׁ בְּתוֹךְ הַגּוּף, וְכָל דָּבָר שֶׁהָאוֹרֵג נוֹתֵן בְּתוֹךְ הַמַּסֶּכֶת לְתַקֵּן אֲרִיגָתוֹ, קָרוּי נֶפֶשׁ. וְהַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּהֶן כְּנוֹגֵעַ בַּבֶּגֶד, דַּהֲווּ חִבּוּר:


בנפש המסכת (the woof) – the threads of the woof/latitudinal direction that go within the warp/longitudinal direction within the body [of the garment], and every thing that the weaver places within the woof to repair his weaving is called "נפש" /the soul of the woof, and when he comes in contact with them it is coming into contact with the clothes – which is attachment.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:7)


**שְׁתִי הָעוֹמֵד.** שֶׁצָּרִיךְ עֲדַיִן לַבֶּגֶד וְעוֹמֵד לֵאָרֵג:


שתי העומד (the warp of the standing loom) – that he needs still for the clothing and stands to be woven.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:8)


**וּבְכָפוּל שֶׁהֶעֱבִירוֹ עַל גַּבֵּי הָאַרְגָּמָן.** חֲתִיכַת בֶּגֶד שֶׁתּוֹפְרִים עַל הָאַרְגָּמָן שֶׁלֹּא יִתְלַכְלֵךְ, הָוֵי חִבּוּר לַבֶּגֶד:


וככפול שהעבירו על גבי ארגמן (the double/folded over thread which one passed over fine purple) – a piece of the cloth that they sew on the purple so that it doesn’t become soiled, it is like it is attached to the cloth.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:9)


**עִירָה שֶׁעָתִיד לְהַחֲזִירָהּ.** כִּדְפָרֵישְׁנָא לְעֵיל:


עירא שעתיד להחזירה (the spool which is going to be returned [to the web]) – as I have explained above.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:10)


**בַּצֶּמֶר שֶׁעַל הָאִימָּה.** וְיֵשׁ שֶׁגּוֹרְסִים הָעִימָה בְעַיִ"ן, וְהַכֹּל אֶחָד. וְהוּא מַקֵּל אָרֹךְ אוֹ קָנֶה שֶׁהַנָּשִׁים כּוֹרְכוֹת בּוֹ אֶת הַצֶּמֶר וְטֹווֹת:


בצמר שעל האימה (with the wool that is on the distaff) – there are those who have the reading [of the word אימה as] עימה with an "ע" and it is all the same. And it is a long staff or a reed that the women tie up the wool and spin.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:11)


**בָּאַשְׁוָיָא.** בַּצֶּמֶר שֶׁעַל הָאַשְׁוָיָא. וְאִימָּא וְאַשְׁוָיָא שְׁתֵּיהֶן לִטְווֹת עֲשׂוּיוֹת, אֶלָּא שֶׁמְּשֻׁנּוֹת זוֹ מִזּוֹ בְּצוּרָתָן:


באשוויא (the staff around the which the wool is put, spool) – the wool that is on the spool, and the distaff and/or the spool both of them are made for spilling, but each is different from the other in their shape/form.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:12)


**טָהוֹר.** דְּאֵינוֹ חִבּוּר:


טהור – for it is not attached.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:13)


**פִּיקָה.** כְּמִין עִגּוּל קָטָן שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת וְיֵשׁ בּוֹ נֶקֶב, וְהַנָּשִׁים נוֹתְנוֹת אוֹתוֹ בְּרֹאשׁ הַפֶּלֶךְ לְהַכְבִּידוֹ. וְקוֹרִים לוֹ בְלַעַ"ז פוסרול"ו:


פיקה (whorl, spinner) – a kind of small round piece of metal that has an incision, that the women put into the top of the spindle/distaff to make it heavy, and they call it a POSROLAV in the foreign language.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:14)


**עַד שֶׁלֹּא פֵרְעָהּ.** קֹדֶם שֶׁיַּתִּירֶנָּה:


עד שלא פירעה (until they didn’t lay it bare) – before releasing it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:1:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:1:15)


**מִשֶּׁפֵּרְעָהּ.** לְאַחַר שֶׁהִתִּירָהּ:


משפירעה – once he released it.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:1)


**קַטְרָב.** מְפֹרָשׁ לְמַעְלָה פֶּרֶק כְּלֵי מַתָּכוֹת, שֶׁהֵן שְׁנֵי עֵצִים מִשְּׁנֵי צִדֵּי הָעֹל וְהֵן נְקוּבִים, וּמַכְנִיסִים בְּתוֹךְ אוֹתוֹ נֶקֶב עֵץ וּשְׁמוֹ קַטְרָב, וְקוֹשְׁרִים אוֹתוֹ שֶׁלֹּא יִשָׁמְטוּ הַבָּקָר:


קטרב (cross-piece in front of yoked animals; the pin fastening the ropes of the yoke to the pole) – it is explained above in Chapter “Metal Vessels” (Tractate Kelim, Chapter 14, Mishnah 4) which are two pieces of wood from two sides of the yoke in which incisions have been made , and they bring into this incision a piece of wood called a קטרג /cross-piece in front of yoked animals/the pin fastening the ropes of the yoke to the pole, and tie it so that the cattle will not become detached/slip away.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:2)


**בָּעַיִן.** בֶּגֶד שֶׁל צֶמֶר אוֹ עוֹר אוֹ שַׂק שֶׁכּוֹרְכִים עַל צַוַּאר הַבְּהֵמָה, וְהָעֹל עָלָיו:


בעין (ring-shaped pad around the animal’s neck – a halter of soft material) – a woolen or leather pad or sack that they tie on the neck of the animal and the yoke is upon it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:3)


**עֲבוֹת.** עֵץ אָרֹךְ וְעָב שֶׁבַּמַּחְרֵשָׁה, שֶׁנִּכְנָס בְּתוֹךְ הָעֹל:


עבות (chain or rope for fastening the yoke of the animal to the plough – the pole tied to the yoke by means of a knotted rope) – a long and thick piece of wood tha tis in the plough, that enters into the yoke.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:4)


**וְהָחֶרֶב.** עֵץ עָשׂוּי כִּדְמוּת חֶרֶב שֶׁתּוֹפֵס בּוֹ הַחוֹרֵשׁ:


החרב (the sword-shaped handle of a plough) – a piece of wood made in the shape of a sword that catches in the wild-growing bushes.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:5)


**וְהַכֹּרֵךְ.** עֵץ עָקֹם דּוֹמֶה לְמֶרְכָּב, וְהוּא הַנָּטוּשׁ עַל הַקַּרְקַע בְּעֵת הַחֲרִישָׁה:


והכורך (part of a plough containing a receptacle out of which the seed falls during the ploughing) – a curved piece of wood similar to a saddle/handle of a saddle and it is sunk in the ground at the time of the ploughing.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:6)


**בַּיָּצוּל.** עֵץ שֶׁתּוֹפֵס אוֹתוֹ הַחוֹרֵשׁ בְּיָדוֹ, וּבוֹ מַטֶּה הַמַּחְרֵשָׁה לְכָל צַד שֶׁיִּרְצֶה. וּפֵרוּשׁ יָצוּל, מַטֶּה. לֹא תַטֶּה מִשְׁפָּט (דברים טז), מְתַרְגְּמִינַן לֹא תַצְלֵי דִין:


ביצול (in the cross-piece or handle of the plough) – a piece of wood that the person who ploughs holds in his hand, and he strikes the plough on each side when he wants. The explanation of – [the word] "יצול" – is a staff [as in] (Deuteronomy 16:19): “you shall not judge unfairly,” which we translate into Aramaic, “you shall not pervert the law.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:7)


**עַיִן שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת.** טַבַּעַת שֶׁל מַתֶּכֶת:


עין של מתכת – the metal ring.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:2:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:8)


**לְחָיַיִם.** שְׁנֵי עֵצִים שֶׁבְּנִקְבֵי הָעֹל:


לחיים (cheek pieces/plough guides) – two pieces of wood that are in the incisions of the yoke.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:2:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:2:9)


**עֲרָיִין.** עָשׂוּי כְּמִין כְּלִי שֶׁל מְסַתֵּת אֲבָנִים וּבוֹ מְשַׁבֵּר גּוּשִׁים שֶׁל עָפָר. וְקָרוּי עֲרָיִין מִלְּשׁוֹן עַרְעֵר תִּתְעַרְעַר (ירמיה נא), עָרוּ עָרוּ עַד הַיְסוֹד בָּהּ (תהלים קלז) וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה שֶׁמְּטַהֵר בַּלְּחָיַיִם:


עריים (iron-tipped ploughshare) – made like a kind of vessel of chiseling stones and with it breaks up clods of dirt. And it is called עריים from the language of (Jeremiah 51:58): “[Babylon’s broad wall] shall be knocked down,” (Psalms 137:7): “Strip her, Strip her to her very foundations!” But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehuda who declares the cheek pieces/plough guides to be pure [used to increase the soil].



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:1)


**מְגֵרָה.** בַּרְזֶל מָלֵא פְּגִימוֹת שֶׁמְּנַסְּרִים בּוֹ הַלּוּחוֹת וְהַנְּסָרִים. וּבְלַעַ"ז סיג"א. וְיֵשׁ לַמְּגֵרָה שְׁנֵי עֵצִים, אֶחָד מִצַּד זֶה וְאֶחָד מִצַּד זֶה, שֶׁבָּהֶם תּוֹפֵס חָרָשׁ עֵצִים בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁמְּנַסֵּר הַלּוּחוֹת, וְהָעֵצִים הַלָּלוּ הֵן בֵּית יָד לַמְּגֵרָה. וְאִם נִטְמֵאת הַמְּגֵרָה, הַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּהֶן טָמֵא, דַּהֲווּ לַהּ יָדוֹת:


מגרה (saw) – iron filled with notches that we saw with it the tablets and boards. And in the foreign language it is SIGA. And the saw has two pieces of wood, one from this side and another from the other side, and through them the carpenter/artisan captures wood and at the time that he saws the tablets, and these pieces of wood are a handle for the saw. But if the saw became defiled, a person who comes in contact with/touches them is impure, for they are handles to it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:2)


**בַּחוּט וּבַמְּשִׁיחָה.** בְּרֹאשׁ הָעֵצִים הַלָּלוּ שֶׁהֵן בֵּית יָד, קוֹשְׁרִין חוּט וּמְשִׁיחָה וְחֶבֶל שֶׁהוֹלֵךְ עַל אֹרֶךְ הַמְּגֵרָה וּמְחַבֵּר בֵּין שְׁנֵיהֶן וּמַעֲמִידוֹ:


בחוט ובמשיחה (the string and the rope of the saw) – at the top of these pieces of wood which are handles, they tie a string or a rope or a rope’s length that goes over the length of the saw and attaches between its teeth and preserves it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:3)


**בָּאַמָּה.** עֵץ אָרֹךְ שֶׁבְּאֶמְצַע אֵלּוּ הַשְּׁנֵי עֵצִים וְהוֹלֵךְ עַל אֹרֶךְ הַמְּגֵרָה, קָרוּי אַמָּה:


באמה (crosspiece) – a long piece of wood that is the middle of these two pieces of wood and goes throughout the length of the saw is called an אמה".”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:4)


**וּבַסְּנִיפִין.** עֵץ קָטָן נָתוּן מִן הַחוּט וְהַמְּשִׁיחָה עַד הָאַמָּה, וּבוֹ פוֹתְלִין וְגוֹדְלִין הַחוּט וְהַמְּשִׁיחָה, וְרֹאשׁוֹ אֶחָד בְּתוֹךְ הַחוּט וְרֹאשׁוֹ אֶחָד בָּאַמָּה. וּפְעָמִים יָשִׂים שְׁנַיִם:


בסניפין (the side-pieces of the saw which hold the blade, and the wedge with which the cord is twisted) – a small piece of wood that is placed from the string and the rope of the saw until the crosspiece, and upon it, it twists and makes a fringe of the string and the rope of the saw, and one head is within the thread and the other is within the crosspiece, and sometimes he would put two there.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:5)


**מַכְבֵּשׁ.** מָקוֹם יֵשׁ לוֹ לֶחָרָשׁ עֵצִים שֶׁכּוֹבֵשׁ וְעוֹצֵר שָׁם הָעֵצִים הָעֲקוּמִים וְהַלּוּחוֹת הָעֲקֻמּוֹת וְהָעֲקֻשּׁוֹת כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּתְיַשְּׁרוּ, וְכֵן עוֹצֵר שָׁם הָעֵצִים וְהַנְּסָרִים שֶׁלֹּא יִתְנוֹעֲעוּ לְכָאן וּלְכָאן עַד שֶׁיְּתַקְּנֵם לִמְלַאכְתּוֹ:


מכבש (carpenter’s vise for straightening wood) – it is a place that the carpenter has for wood that he presses and detains the curved pieces of wood and the curved tablets/boards and the crooked pieces in order to straighten them, and similarly, he detains there the wood and the boards that they should not move this way or that until he repairs them for his work.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:6)


**קַשְׁטָנִית.** כְּמִין קֶשֶׁת קָטָן שֶׁל עֵץ שֶׁתּוֹחֲבִים בּוֹ בַרְזֶל שֶׁל מַקְדֵּחַ כְּשֶׁרוֹצֶה לִקְדֹּחַ בּוֹ, וְהָאָדָם אוֹחֵז בַּקֶּשֶׁת וּמְגַלְגֵּל בּוֹ אֶת הַבַּרְזֶל. וְאִם הַבַּרְזֶל טָמֵא לֹא נִטְמָא הַקֶּשֶׁת, דְּלֹא הָוֵי חִבּוּר, שֶׁדַּרְכָּם הָיָה שֶׁלֹּא לְחַבֵּר הַקֶּשֶׁת בַּבַּרְזֶל:


קשטנית (bow=shaped handle of a borer, “bow-drill”) – like a kind of small bow of wood that they insert in it the iron of a borer when he wants to bore/penetrate into it, but when a person holds the bow and rolls the iron in it, but if the iron is impure, the bow is not defiled, for it is not considered an attachment, for it was their practice to not attach the bow to the iron.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:3:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:7)


**מַסָּר הַגָּדוֹל.** מְגֵרָה גְדוֹלָה שֶׁעֲשׂוּיָה לְנַסֵּר קוֹרוֹת, וְעוֹשִׂים לָהּ כְּמִין מְרֻבָּע מֵעֵצִים דַּקִּים, וְהַמְּגֵרָה בָאֶמְצַע, וְאוֹתוֹ הַמְרֻבָּע קָרוּי מַלְבֵּן:


מסר הגדול – large saw that is made to saw beams, and they make it like a kind of square from thin pieces of wood and the saw is in the middle and that square is called a frame.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:3:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:8)


**טָהוֹר.** שֶׁאֵין טָמֵא אֶלָּא מְקוֹם אֲחִיזַת בֵּית יָד בִּלְבַד. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


טהור – the part that is impure is only that of the place of the holding of the handle alone. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehuda.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:3:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:9)


**בַּיֶּתֶר.** חֶבֶל הַקֶּשֶׁת. לְשׁוֹן כּוֹנְנוּ חִצָּם עַל יֶתֶר (תהלים יא):


יתר (bow-string) – the cord of the bow. It is the language of (Psalms 11:2): “they set their arrow on the string.”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:3:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:10)


**אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהִיא מְתוּחָה.** אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהַחֵץ בַּיֶּתֶר וּבַקֶּשֶׁת וּמְתוּחָה לִירוֹת בָּהּ וְנִטְמָא הַחֵץ, לֹא נִטְמָא הַקֶּשֶׁת וְהַיֶּתֶר, שֶׁאֵין הַחֵץ חִבּוּר לְקֶשֶׁת וְיֶתֶר:


אע"פ שהיא מתחוה (even though it is stretched out) – even though the arrow in the bow-string and in the bow is stretched to shoot it, and the arrow is is defiled, the bow and the bow-string are not defiled, for the arrow is not connected/attached to the bow and the bow-string.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:3:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:11)


**אֵישׁוּת.** בְּרִיָּה שֶׁאֵין לָהּ עֵינַיִם. הַתִּנְשֶׁמֶת מְתַרְגְּמִינַן אֵישׁוּתָא. וְצָדִין אוֹתָהּ לְפִי שֶׁמַּפְסֶדֶת אֶת הַשָּׂדוֹת:


אישות (mole) – it is a creature that has no eyes. And the owl, we translate into Aramaic as moles, and we hunt it because it destroys the fields.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:3:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:12)


**טְהוֹרָה.** שֶׁאֵינָהּ חֲשׁוּבָה כְלִי:


טהורה – that it is not considered a vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 21:3:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/21:3:13)


**כָּל זְמַן שֶׁהִיא מְתוּחָה.** וְהַחֵץ שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל בָּהּ, אִם נִטְמָא הַחֵץ נִטְמֵאת הַמְּצוֹדָה. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


כל זמן שהיא מתוחה – and an iron arrow is in it. If the arrow is defiled, the [mole] trap is defiled. Ut the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yehuda.



## Chapter 22


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:1:1)


**הַשֻּׁלְחָן וְהַדְּלֻפְקִי.** כְּלִי עֵץ שֶׁמְּשִׂימִין בּוֹ צְלוֹחִיּוֹת וַאֲשִׁישׁוֹת וְאֳכָלִין וּמַשְׁקִין, וּמִמֶּנּוּ נוֹטְלִין וּמְשִׂימִין עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן:


השלחן והדלפק (the table and the delphica/a three-legged table used as a toilet table or a waiter) – a wooden vessel that they place upon it flasks and jugs and food and liquids, and from it, they take and place it on the table.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:1:2)


**וְשִׁיֵּר בָּהֶן מְקוֹם הַנָּחַת הַכּוֹסוֹת.** שֶׁלֹּא נִפְחַת אוֹ שֶׁלֹּא חִפָּן. דְּאִי הֲוָה כֻּלּוֹ מְחֻפֶּה שַׁיִשׁ, הָיָה טָהוֹר כִּכְלֵי אֲבָנִים, דְּבָתַר חִפּוּי אָזְלִינַן:


ושייר בהן מקום הנחת כוסות – which was not damaged or that was not covered [with marble], for if all it were covered with marble, it would be pure like a stone vessel, for we follow after its covering.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:1:3)


**מְקוֹם הַנָּחַת חֲתִיכוֹת.** שֶׁל לֶחֶם וְשֶׁל בָּשָׂר. דְּאִם אֵין בַּשֻּׁלְחָן מְקוֹם הַנָּחַת חֲתִיכוֹת, לָאו שֻׁלְחָן הוּא וְלָאו דְּלֻפְקִי הוּא. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה:


מקום הנחת חתיכות – of [pieces of] bread and meat. For if there was no place on the table for the placing of pieces [of bread and meat], it is not a table and it is not a delphica/three-legged table used as a waiter. But the Halakha Is not according to Rabbi Yehuda.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:2:1)


**נִטְּלָה אַחַת מֵרַגְלָיו טָהוֹר.** דְּלֹא חֲזִי לְשֻׁלְחָן, שֶׁהֲרֵי אֵינוֹ רָאוּי לֶאֱכֹל עָלָיו:


שניטלה אחת מרגליו טהור – for it is not fit as a table, for it is not appropriate to eat upon it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:2:2)


**נִטְּלָה שְׁלִישִׁית טָמֵא.** שֶׁרָאוּי לֶאֱכֹל עָלָיו כְּמוֹ עַל גַּבֵּי טַבְלָא. וְהוּא שֶׁיַּחְשֹׁב לֶאֱכֹל עָלָיו:


ניטלה שלישית טמא – for it is appropriate to eat upon it like on top of a board. And it is something that he would consider to eat upon.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:2:3)


**אֵינוֹ צָרִיךְ מַחְשָׁבָה.** דְּכֵיוָן שֶׁרָאוּי לֶאֱכֹל עָלָיו הֲרֵי הוּא מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה:


אינו צריך מחשבה – for since it is appropriate to eat upon it, it is susceptible to receive defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:2:4)


**וְכֵן הַדְּלֻפְקִי.** דִּינוֹ כְּדִין הַשֻּׁלְחָן, וּכְשֵׁם שֶׁנֶּחְלְקוּ בַּשֻּׁלְחָן כָּךְ נֶחְלְקוּ בַּדְּלֻפְקִי. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי:


וכן הדולפקי (and similarly the delphica) – its law is like that of the table. And just as there was disagreement regarding a table, so there was disagreement regarding the delphica. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yossi.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:3:1)


**סַפְסָל.** דַּף רָחָב וְאָרֹךְ, בְּרֹאשׁוֹ אֶחָד תָּקוּעַ מִתַּחְתָּיו דַּף גָּבֹהַּ וְכֵן בְּרֹאשׁוֹ הַשֵּׁנִי, כְּדֵי לְהַגְבִּיהּוֹ מִן הַקַּרְקַע שֶׁיִּהְיֶה רָאוּי לֵישֵׁב עָלָיו:


ספסל – a wide and long board/plank, its one end/head/ is fastened with a a high board/plank and similarly its second head/end, in order to left it up from the group that it would be appropriate to sit upon.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:3:2)


**נִטַּל הַשֵּׁנִי טָהוֹר.** וְלֹא דָמֵי לְשֻׁלְחָן דִּכְשֶׁנִּטְּלוּ שָׁלֹשׁ רַגְלָיו טָמֵא, דְּסַפְסָל שֶׁנִּשְׁבְּרוּ שְׁנֵי רָאשָׁיו לֹא חֲזִי לִישִׁיבָה, שֶׁהַיּוֹשֵׁב עָלָיו כְּיוֹשֵׁב עַל גַּבֵּי קַרְקַע:


ניטל השני טהור – for it is not similar to a table that if the removed three legs it is impure, for a bench whose two ends/heads were broken is not appropriate for sitting, for a person who sits upon it is like sitting on the ground.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:3:3)


**אִם יֶשׁ בּוֹ גֹבַהּ טֶפַח טָמֵא.** שֶׁהַדַּף הָעָב טֶפַח חֲזִי לִישִׁיבָה:


אם יש בו גובה טפח אמא – that the board/plank is a handbreadth thick it is appropriate for sitting.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:3:4)


**שְׁרַפְרַף.** סַפְסָל לַהֲדוֹם רַגְלָיו שֶׁל אָדָם:


שרפרף (a sort of camp stool/footstool) – a bench for the footstool of a person.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:3:5)


**הַכִּסֵּא שֶׁלִּפְנֵי קַתֶּדְרָא.** דִּינוֹ כִשְׁרַפְרַף:


הכסא שלפני קתדרא (stool that is before the throne/chair with a back) – its law is like that of a footstool.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:4:1)


**שֶׁנִּטְּלוּ חִפּוּיָו.** לְשׁוֹן חָפֵי פוֹתַחַת, כְּמִין שִׁנַּיִם יוֹצְאִים מִכָּל צַד בְּכִסֵּא שֶׁל כַּלָּה, וַעֲשׂוּיִין כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּסְמְכוּ עֲלֵיהֶן:


שניטלו חפויט (that its seat boards/coverings were removed) – it is the language of covering that opens, like a kind of teeth that extend outward from all sides of the chair of the bride, and are made in order to support them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:4:2)


**בֵּית שַׁמַּאי מְטַמְּאִין.** דְּאַכַּתִּי חֲזִי לִישִׁיבָה:


בית שמאי מטמאין – for they are still fit for sitting.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/22:4:3)


**וּבֵית הִלֵּל מְטַהֲרִין.** דְּלֹא חֲזִי לְכַלָּה, וְהָוֵי כְנִשְׁבָּר:


ובית הלל מטהרין – for they are not fit for the bride, for it is like it is broken.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 22:4:4
