[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:6:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:6:5)


**וְכִיס שֶׁל פֻּנְדָּא.** אֵזוֹר חָלוּל, וְהוּא כְעֵין כִּיס הֶעָשׂוּי לְקַבֵּל:


וכיס של פונדא (money belt) – a region that is hollow, and it is similar to a pocket that is made for receiving.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:6:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:6:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:6:6)


**מַטְלִית.** טְלַאי:


מטלית – patch.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:6:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:6:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:6:7)


**שֶׁטְּלָיָהּ עַל הַשָּׂפָה.** שֶׁתְּפָרָהּ עַל הַשָּׂפָה סָבִיב לַצַּוָּאר:


שטלייה על השפה – that one sewed on the hem around the neck.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:6:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:6:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:6:8)


**אִם פְּשׁוּטָה.** שֶׁאֵינָהּ תְּפוּרָה מִשְּׁנֵי צְדָדִים אֶלָּא אוֹ מִלְּפָנָיו אוֹ מֵאַחֲרָיו. וְלַפֵּרוּשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי, שֶׁלֹּא נִכְפַּל מִן הַחוּט סְבִיב הַתְּפִירָה:


אם פשוטה (if it is flat) – that it is not sewn from both sides but rather either from in front or from behind. And for the second explanation, that it is not doubled from the thread surrounding the seam.



### Mishnah 7

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:7:1)


**הַבֶּגֶד שֶׁאָרַג בּוֹ שְׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים.** מְצֻמְצָמוֹת, שֶׁהוּא שִׁעוּר לִטַּמֵּא מִדְרָס. וְאַחַר שֶׁנִּטְמְאוּ בְמִדְרָס כְּשֶׁהֵן מְצֻמְצָמוֹת הִשְׁלִים עָלָיו אֲרִיגַת כָּל הַבֶּגֶד, וְהַשְׁתָּא כָל הַבֶּגֶד טָמֵא מִדְרָס דַּהֲוֵי חִבּוּר לִשְׁלֹשָׁה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה שֶׁנִּטְמְאוּ קֹדֶם אֲרִיגַת כָּל הַבֶּגֶד:


הבגד שארג בו שלשה טפחים על שלשה טפחים (the cloth on which one wove three by three square handbreadths) – in close confinement, which is the measurement to be susceptible to uncleanness through treading. But after they were defiled through treading when they are closely confined, he competed upon it the weaving of all of the cloth, and now all of the cloth is impure through treading which is an attachment of three [handbreadths] by three [handbreadths] square that were defiled prior to the weaving of all the cloth.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:7:2)


**נָטַל חוּט אֶחָד מִתְּחִלָּתוֹ.** מִשְּׁלֹשָׁה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה רִאשׁוֹנִים שֶׁנִּטְמְאוּ מִדְרָס:


נטל חוט אחד מתחלתו – from the first three [handbreadths] by three [handbreadths] square that were defiled by treading.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:7:3)


**טָהוֹר.** כָּל הַבֶּגֶד מִן הַמִּדְרָס:


טהור – the entire cloth [is pure] from uncleanness of treading.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:7:4)


**אֲבָל טָמֵא מַגַּע מִדְרָס.** לְפִי שֶׁנָּגַע בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה רִאשׁוֹנִים קֹדֶם שֶׁנִּתְמַעֵט שִׁעוּרוֹ:


אבל טמא מגע מדרס – because it came in contact with the first three [handbreadths] by three [handbreadths] square prior to its measure being reduced/diminished.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:7:5)


**נָטַל חוּט אֶחָד מִתְּחִלָּתוֹ וְאַחַר כָּךְ הִשְׁלִים עָלָיו אֶת כָּל הַבֶּגֶד טָמֵא מַגַּע מִדְרָס.** וְאַף עַל גַּב דְּנִתְמַעֵט שִׁעוּרוֹ קֹדֶם שֶׁהִשְׁלִים עָלָיו אֶת כָּל הַבֶּגֶד, אַף עַל פִּי כֵן טָמֵא כָל הַבֶּגֶד מַגַּע מִדְרָס. דְּהַאי תַּנָּא סְבִירָא לֵיהּ בֶּגֶד שְׁלֹשָׁה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה שֶׁנֶּחְלַק אַחַר שֶׁנִּטְמָא בְמִדְרָס, טָמֵא מַגַּע מִדְרָס, כְּדִלְקַמָּן בְּפִרְקִין. הִלְכָּךְ כְּשֶׁנִּתְמַעֵט שִׁעוּרוֹ דִּשְׁלֹשָׁה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה, נִשְׁאַר טָמֵא מַגַּע מִדְרָס, וּכְשֶׁהִשְׁלִים עָלָיו אֶת כָּל הַבֶּגֶד הָוֵי הַבֶּגֶד מְחֻבָּר לְטָמֵא מַגַּע מִדְרָס, וְכָל הַמְחֻבָּר לַטָּמֵא, טָמֵא כְמוֹתוֹ:


נטל חוט אחד מתחילתו ואח"כ השלים עליו את כל הבגד טמא מגע מדרס – and even though it reduced/diminished its measure prior to completing the entire cloth, nevertheless, the entire cloth is impure through contact with Midrash/treading uncleanness. For this Tanna/teacher holds that a cloth of three [handbreadths] by three [handbreadths] square that was divided after it was defiled through treading, is impure through contact with treading, as is found later on in our chapter (see Mishnah 10 of this chapter). Therefore, when it reduced/diminished its measurement of three [handbreadths] by three [handbreadths] square, it remained impure through contact with treading uncleanness, and when he completed the entire cloth, the cloth is attached to impurity through contact of treading, and all that is attached/connected to something impure, is impure like it.



### Mishnah 8

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:8:1)


**וְכֵן בֶּגֶד שֶׁאָרַג בּוֹ שָׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת עַל שָׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת.** מְצֻמְצָמוֹת, שֶׁזֶּה שִׁעוּרוֹ לִטַּמֵּא בְכָל הַטֻּמְאוֹת כֻּלָּן חוּץ מִמִּדְרָס, וּבִבְצִיר מֵהָכִי לֹא מִטַּמֵּא בְשׁוּם טֻמְאָה שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם:


וכן בגד שארג בו שלש אצבעות – in close confinement, that this is its measure to be defilement in all of the defilements together except for that of leaning, but with this, it is not defiled in any defilement that is in the world.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:8:2)


**שָׁלֹשׁ עַל שָׁלֹשׁ שֶׁנִּתְמַעֵט טָהוֹר.** לְגַמְרֵי. דְּלֹא חֲזִי לְמִידִי לֹא לַעֲנִיִּים וְלֹא לַעֲשִׁירִים, הִלְכָּךְ טָהוֹר מִכָּל הַטֻּמְאוֹת:


שלש על שלש שנתמעט טהור – it is completely [pure], and is not appropriate for anything, neither for the poor nor the rich, therefore, it is pure from all defilements.



### Mishnah 9

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:9:1)


**וַעֲשָׂאוֹ וִילוֹן.** מָסָךְ לִפְנֵי הַפֶּתַח. כְּגוֹן שֶׁעָשָׂה בוֹ מַעֲשֶׂה שֶׁעַל יְדֵי כֵן טָהוֹר מִן הַמִּדְרָס, לְבֵית שַׁמַּאי מִשֶּׁיִּתְחַבֵּר, וּלְבֵית הִלֵּל מִשֶּׁיִּקָּשֵׁר, וּלְרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא מִשֶּׁיִּקָּבֵעַ, כְּדִתְנַן לְעֵיל בְּפֶרֶק הַכָּרִים וְהַכְּסָתוֹת [מִשְׁנָה ו]:


ועשאו וילון – a curtain that is front of the opening, as for example, that he made something that by means of it is pure from uncleanness through treading, according to the School of Shammai from when it is sewn, but according to the School of Hillel, from when it is tied up. But according to Rabbi Akiba, from when one fixed it, as is taught in the Mishnah above in [Tractate Kelim] the Chapter, “The Mattresses and the Pillows”/"הכרים והכסתות" (Chapter 20) [Mishnah 6[.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:9:2)


**טָהוֹר מִן הַמִּדְרָס.** דְּבָטַל מִתּוֹרַת מִשְׁכָּב וּמוֹשָׁב. אֲבָל לְטֻמְאַת מַגָּע חֲזִי, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהַשַּׁמָּשׁ מִתְחַמֵּם בּוֹ וּמִתְעַטֵּף בְּשׁוּלָיו:


טהור מן המדרס – that it is annulled from the law of lying and sitting, but it is appropriate to the defilement of contact, because the attendant warms himself in it and wraps himself in his rims.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:9:3)


**וְכִי בְאֵיזֶה מִדְרָס נָגַע זֶה.** כְּלוֹמַר, הוֹאִיל וְטָהוֹר מִטֻּמְאַת מִדְרָס כְּשֶׁעֲשָׂאָהוּ וִילוֹן, הֲרֵי טָהוֹר לְגַמְרֵי וְלֹא נִשְׁאַר בּוֹ טֻמְאָה כְלָל, מִידִי דַהֲוָה אַשִּׁבְרֵי כֵלִים שֶׁהֵם טְהוֹרִים מִטֻּמְאָתָן לְגַמְרֵי:


וכי באיזה מדרס נגע זה – meaning to say, since it is ritually pure from the defilement of treading when he made it into a curtain, it is completely pure and there doesn’t remain in it any defilement. For anything that were shards of vessels are pure from their defilement completely.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:9:4)


**אֶלָּא אִם כֵּן נָגַע בּוֹ הַזָּב.** אִם נָגַע הַזָּב בְּוִילוֹן זֶה, מְטַמְּאוֹ טֻמְאַת מַגַּע הַזָּב. אֲבָל מִכֹּחַ טֻמְאַת מִדְרָס שֶׁהָיְתָה בוֹ תְחִלָּה, אֵין כָּאן טֻמְאָה כְלָל. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי:


אלא אם כן נגע בו הזב – if the person with gonorrhea/flux came in contact with this curtain, he defiles it with the defilement of the contact of a person with gonorrhea. But from the power of defilement of treading that was in it initially, there is no defilement here at all. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yossi.



### Mishnah 10

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:10:1)


**שְׁלֹשָׁה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה שֶׁנֶּחֱלַק.** בֶּגֶד שֶׁיֶּשׁ בּוֹ שְׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים שֶׁנִּטְמָא בְמִדְרַס הַזָּב, וְאַחַר כָּךְ נֶחְלַק וְאֵין בְּאֶחָד מֵהֶן כְּדֵי שִׁעוּר טֻמְאַת מִדְרָס, בְּהָא פְלִיגֵי תַנָּא קַמָּא וְרַבִּי יוֹסֵי, דְּתַנָּא קַמָּא סָבַר טָמֵא מַגַּע מִדְרָס, וְרַבִּי יוֹסֵי סָבַר טָהוֹר לְגַמְרֵי. אֲבָל בֶּגֶד שֶׁל שָׁלֹשׁ עַל שָׁלֹשׁ שֶׁפֵּרַשׁ מִבֶּגֶד גָּדוֹל שֶׁהָיָה מִדְרָס, הַכֹּל מוֹדִים שֶׁבִּשְׁעַת פְּרִישָׁתָן מֵאֲבִיהֶן מְקַבְּלוֹת טֻמְאָה מֵאֲבִיהֶן. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי:


שלשה על שלשה שנחלק – a cloth which has in it three handbreadths by three handbreadths which had been defiled by treading uncleanness of a person with gonorrhea, and afterwards, it was divided, and there isn’t in any one of them by the way of the measurement of defilement by treading, in this, there is a dispute between the first Tanna/teacher and Rabbi Yossi, that the first Tanna/teacher holds that he is impure through contact with treading, but Rabbi Yossi holds that he is pure completely. But the cloth of three [handbreadths] by three [handbreadths] that that was separated from a large cloth that was [defiled] through treading, everyone admits that at the time of their separation from their “father”, it received the defilement from their “father.” And the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yossi.



### Mishnah 11

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:11:1)


**בָּרִיא וְצוֹרֵר מֶלַח.** גָּרְסִינַן. בֶּגֶד הַמֻּטָּל בָּאַשְׁפּוֹת בָּטַל לֵיהּ מִתּוֹרַת בֶּגֶד, אֶלָּא אִם כֵּן אִית בֵּיהּ תַּרְתֵּי, שֶׁיְּהֵא בָּרִיא וְחָזָק, וְרָאוּי לִצְרֹר בּוֹ רֹבַע קַב מֶלַח. אֲבָל הַנִּמְצָא בַבַּיִת, הוֹאִיל וְאֵינָהּ מֻשְׁלֶכֶת בָּאַשְׁפָּה עֲדַיִן חָשׁוּב הוּא וּבְחַד גְּרֵידָא סַגִּי, אוֹ בָּרִיא אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵינוֹ צוֹרֵר מֶלַח, אוֹ צוֹרֵר מֶלַח אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵינוֹ בָּרִיא:


בריא וצורר מלח (sound and capable of wrapping up salt) – this is our reading. A cloth that is placed in the trash is voided from the designation/nature of a cloth, unless it has two things: that it is sound and strong and appropriate to wrap in it a quarter Kab of salt. But if it is found in the house, since it wasn’t thrown in the garbage, it is still valuable/regarded but one qualification is enough, either it is sound/firm even though it is not capable of wrapping up salt or it wraps up salt even though it is not sound/firm.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:11:2)


**רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר בְּדַקָּה.** לְעוֹלָם אֵינוֹ מִטַּמֵּא עַד שֶׁיְּהֵא צוֹרֵר רֹבַע מֶלַח דַּקָּה:


ר' יהודה אומר בדקה – always it does not become defiled until it wraps up a quarter [of a Kab] of fine salt.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:11:3)


**וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים.** אֵינוֹ מִטַּמֵּא עַד שֶׁיְּהֵא צוֹרֵר בְּגַסָּה:


וחכמים אומרים – it does not become susceptible to impurity until it wraps up coarse salt.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:11:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:11:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:11:4)


**אֵלּוּ וָאֵלּוּ מִתְכַּוְּנִים לְהָקֵל.** רַבִּי יְהוּדָה סָבַר דַּקָּה צְרִיכָה לִצְרֹר בְּבֶגֶד בָּרִיא וְחָזָק טְפֵי, מִפְּנֵי כָבְדָהּ, שֶׁהִיא כְבֵדָה יוֹתֵר מִן הַגַּסָּה, הִלְכָּךְ מְשַׁעֵר עַד שֶׁתְּהֵא מַחֲזֶקֶת בַּדַּקָּה, לְהָקֵל עָלֶיהָ שֶׁלֹּא תִטַּמֵּא. וְרַבָּנָן סָבְרֵי גַסָּה צְרִיכָה בֶּגֶד יוֹתֵר בָּרִיא, מִפְּנֵי חִדּוּדָהּ וְקַרְנוֹתֶיהָ בּוֹלְטִים, הִלְכָּךְ מְשַׁעֲרִים בְּגַסָּה לִטַּמֵּא, כְּדֵי לְהָקֵל עַל הַבֶּגֶד הַמַּחֲזִיק מֶלַח דַּקָּה שֶׁלֹּא יִטַּמֵּא:


אלו ואלו מתכוונים להקל – Rabbi Yehuda holds that fine [salt] must be wrapped in a sound and very strong cloth, because of its heaviness, that it is heavier than the coarse salt. Therefore, he estimates until it holds the fine salt, to be lenient regarding it so that it does not become defiled. But the Rabbis hold that coarse salt requires a cloth that is even more sound, because of its pointed projections and horns that protrude. Therefore, they estimate with the coarse salt to be susceptible to be defiled, in order to be lenient on the cloth that holds the thin salt that it should not become defiled.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:11:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:11:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:11:5)


**שָׁוִין שְׁלֹשָׁה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה בָאַשְׁפָּה לְשָׁלֹשׁ עַל שָׁלֹשׁ בַּבָּיִת.** כְּשֵׁם שֶׁשָּׁלֹשׁ עַל שָׁלֹשׁ בַּבַּיִת מִטַּמְּאוֹת טְמֵא מֵת וְאֵין מִטַּמְּאוֹת מִדְרָס, כָּךְ שְׁלֹשָׁה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה בָאַשְׁפָּה מִטַּמְּאוֹת טְמֵא מֵת וְאֵין מִטַּמְּאוֹת מִדְרָס, דְּבָטְלָה חֲשִׁיבוּתָן מֵאַחַר שֶׁהִשְׁלִיכָהּ לָאַשְׁפָּה. וַהֲלָכָה כַּחֲכָמִים בִּלְבַד:


שוין שלשה על שלשה באשפה לשלש על שלש בבית – just the three [handbreadth] by three [handbreadth cloth] in the house is defiled through corpse uncleanness and are not defiled through treading/Midras uncleanness, so the three [handbreadth] by three [handbreadth cloth] that is in the garbage become defiled through corpse uncleanness and are not defiled through treading. For their importance has been invalidated after he threw it into the trash. And the Halakha is according to the Sages alone.



### Mishnah 12

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:1)


**שְׁלֹשָׁה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה שֶׁנִּקְרַע.** וְלֹא נֶחְלְקוּ הַקְּרָעִים זוֹ מִזּוֹ:


שלשה על שלשה שנקרע – and the tears were not divided from each other (i.e., they were attached).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:2)


**וּבְשָׂרוֹ נוֹגֵעַ בַּכִּסֵּא.** אִם הַקֶּרַע כָּל כָּךְ גָּדוֹל עַד שֶׁכְּשֶׁמְּשִׂימִים הַבֶּגֶד עַל הַכִּסֵּא וְיֵשֵׁב עָלָיו בְּשָׂרוֹ נוֹגֵעַ בַּכִּסֵּא:


ובשרו נוגע בכסא – if the tear is so large under that when they place the cloth upon the chair and he sat upon it, his flesh would come in contact/touch the chair.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:12:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:3)


**טָהוֹר.** דְּבָטַל לֵיהּ מִתּוֹרַת בֶּגֶד:


טהור – that he nullified it from the category of a piece of cloth.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:12:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:4)


**וְאִם לָאו.** שֶׁאֵין הַקֶּרַע כָּל כָּךְ שֶׁיִּגַּע בְּשָׂרוֹ בַכִּסֵּא, לֹא בָטַל מִתּוֹרַת בֶּגֶד, וְטָמֵא:


ואם לאו – that the tear is not so great that his skin would come in contact with/touch the chair, it did not void it from the category of a piece of cloth, and he is ritually impure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:12:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:5)


**שֶׁנִּמְהָה מִמֶּנּוּ.** שֶׁבָּלָה מִמֶּנּוּ. וְדֻגְמָתוֹ מְהוּהָה שֶׁטְּלָיָהּ עַל גַּבֵּי בְרִיאָה דִּתְנַן לְעֵיל בְּסוֹף פֶּרֶק שְׁלֹשָׁה תְרִיסִין. וּכְשֶׁבָּלָה חוּט אֶחָד מִבֶּגֶד שָׁלֹשׁ עַל שָׁלֹשׁ מְצֻמְצָמוֹת, נִתְמַעֵט שִׁעוּרוֹ וְטָהוֹר:


שנמהה ממנו (to be tattered/to fall to pieces from it) – that [one thread] wore out from it, and its example of something tattered that was hanging over a healthy piece, as is taught in the Mishnah above at the end of chapter twenty-four (Mishnah 17) "שלשה תריסין הן"/There are three kinds of shields”: “A worn out basket in which one patched to a sound one – they follow the status of the sound one.” And when one thread wore out from a piece of cloth of three [handbreadths] by three-handbreadths squeezed in, the measurement was lessened and it is ritually pure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:12:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:6)


**אוֹ שְׁנֵי חוּטִין מַתְאִימִין.** פֵּרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתַי, דְּמַתְאִימִין קָאֵי נַמִּי אַקֶּשֶׁר. וְהָכִי קָתָנֵי, נִמְצְאוּ בָהּ שְׁנֵי קְשָׁרִים מַתְאִימִין אוֹ שְׁנֵי חוּטִים מַתְאִימִין. מִשּׁוּם דְּאִם שְׁנֵי חוּטִים קְשׁוּרִים זֶה אֵצֶל זֶה בְּבֶגֶד אֵין דֶּרֶךְ לְהַנִּיחָם, וְהָכִי אָמְרִינַן בַּגְּמָרָא פֶּרֶק כְּלָל גָּדוֹל [שַׁבָּת דַּף עד] אִי מִתְרְמֵי תְרֵי קִטְרֵי בַהֲדֵי הֲדָדֵי שָׁרֵי חַד וְקָטַר חַד. וּשְׁנֵי חוּטִים הַמַּתְאִימִין, שֶׁדֶּרֶךְ הָאֲרִיגָה שֶׁהָעֵרֶב נִכְנָס לְתוֹךְ הַשְּׁתִי אֵין שְׁנֵי חוּטִים נִכְנָסִים בְּסֵדֶר אֶחָד אֶלָּא בְמָקוֹם שֶׁזֶּה נִכְנָס זֶה יוֹצֵא, וּכְשֶׁשְּׁנֵיהֶם שָׁוִין נֶחְשָׁב הָאֶחָד כְּמִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ:


או שני חוטין מתאימין (or two threads running alongside) – My teachers/Rabbis explained, that [the word] מתאימין/running alongside/adjoining refers to the knot. And such it is taught, that if there found in it two knots that are adjoining each other or two threads adjoining each other. Because if two threads that are tied one to the other in the cloth, there is no way to leave them, and this what we said in the Gemara in [Tractate Shabbat 74b) in the chapter, “The Great Principle”/כלל גדול, if it happens that there are two knots next to one another, one is loosened and the other is knotted. Two threads that run along one another, for it is the manner of the weaving that the woof enters into the warp, two threads do not enter at the same time, but rather in a place where this one enters and that one leaves, and when both of them are equivalent, the one is thought to be like the one that doesn’t exist.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:12:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:7)


**הֶחֱזִירָהּ.** לַבַּיִת:


החזירה – to the house.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:12:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:8)


**טְמֵאָה.** דְּהָא הָדַר אַחְשְׁבַהּ:


טמאה – for he retracted in his intention/thought.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:12:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:9)


**לְעוֹלָם הַשְׁלָכָתָהּ מְטַהֲרַתָּהּ.** כְּלוֹמַר כִּי הַאי גַּוְנָא מִטַּמְאָה וּמִטַּהֶרֶת אֲפִלּוּ עֶשֶׂר פְּעָמִים בַּיּוֹם:


לעולם השלכתה מטהרתה וחזרתה מטמאתה (always does throwing it out purify it and recovering it renders it unclean) – meaning to say in that manner/way, it becomes susceptible for being defiled and becomes purified ten times a day.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:12:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:10)


**אַרְגָּמָן וּזְהוֹרִית טוֹבָה.** חֲשִׁיבֵי וְלֹא מְבַטְּלָה לְהוּ [מִתּוֹרַת בֶּגֶד]. וּזְהוֹרִית טוֹבָה הוּא הַמֶּשִׁי הַצָּבוּעַ כרמיז"י בְּלַעַ"ז:


ארגמן וזהורית טובה (purple and fine crimson silk) – it is considered but it is not nullified [from the category of cloth]. And the good crimson is colored silk CRAMIZI in the foreign language.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:12:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:11)


**אַף מַטְלִית חֲדָשָׁה כַּיּוֹצֵא בָהֶן.** דִּינָהּ כְדִין אַרְגָּמָן וּזְהוֹרִית טוֹבָה, וְלֹא מְבַטְּלָה לַהּ אַשְׁפָּה מִתּוֹרַת בֶּגֶד:


אף מטלית חדשה כיוצא בהן (even a new patch of that stuff) – its law is like the law of purple and fine crimson [silk], and the trash does not invalidate it from the category of a cloth.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:12:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:12)


**כֻּלָּן טְהוֹרִין.** אִם הֻשְׁלְכוּ לָאַשְׁפָּה, אֲפִלּוּ אַרְגָּמָן וּזְהוֹרִית טוֹבָה:


כולן טהורין – if it was thrown into the trash, even the purple and the fine crimson [silk].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:12:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:13)


**לֹא הֻזְכְּרוּ.** אַרְגָּמָן וּזְהוֹרִית טוֹבָה לֵחָלֵק מִשְּׁאָר בְּגָדִים:


לא הוזכרו – purple and good crimson [silk] to be separated/divided from the rest of the clothing.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 27:12:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/27:12:14)


**אֶלָּא מִפְּנֵי הֲשָׁבַת אֲבֵדָה.** דְּאִם מְצָאָם בָּאַשְׁפָּה לֹא אָמְרִינַן מִדַּעַת הִשְׁלִיכָם, וּבָעוּ הַכְרָזָה, דְּמִפְּנֵי חֲשִׁיבוּתַיְהוּ לֹא מִיַּאֲשֵׁי הַבְּעָלִים. וּשְׁאָר בְּגָדִים דְּלָא חֲשִׁיבֵי, אִם מְצָאָם בָּאַשְׁפָּה לֹא בָעוּ הַכְרָזָה. וַהֲלָכָה כְּתַנָּא קַמָּא:


אלא מפני השבת אבידה – that if he found them in the trash, we don’t say that he threw them there knowingly, and they require public announcement for because of their importance, the owner do not despair [of recovering it]. But the rest of the clothing is not important, that if he found them in the garbage/trash, they don’t require public announcement. And the Halakah is according to the first Tanna/teacher.



## Chapter 28


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:1:1)


**שָׁלֹשׁ עַל שָׁלֹשׁ שֶׁנְּתָנָהּ בְּכַדּוּר.** בֶּגֶד שֶׁל שָׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת עַל שָׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת שֶׁנְּתָנָהּ בְּתוֹךְ כַּדּוּר, פלוט"א בְּלַעַ"ז:


שלש על שלש שנתנה בכדור – a cloth of three fingerbreadths by three-fingerbreadths that was placed within a ball, PLOTA in the foreign language.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:1:2)


**אוֹ שֶׁעֲשָׂאָהּ כַּדּוּר.** שֶׁלָּקַח הַבֶּגֶד וּכְרָכוֹ עָגֹל כְּמִין כַּדּוּר, כְּמוֹ שֶׁעוֹשִׂים לְתִינוֹקוֹת, וּתְפָרוֹ:


או שעשאה כדור – that he took a cloth and wrapped it up round like a kind of ball, like the young children do, and sewed it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:1:3)


**טְהוֹרָה.** שֶׁנִּתְבַּטְּלָה כְשֶׁנְּתָנָהּ בַּכַּדּוּר, וְכָל שֶׁכֵּן כְּשֶׁעֲשָׂאָהּ כַּדּוּר בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ שֶׁנִּתְבַּטְּלָה בַתְּפִירָה:


טהורה – that it became voided when it it was placed in a ball, and all the more so, when he made a ball of it by itself that it became voided through sewing.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:1:4)


**אֲבָל שְׁלֹשָׁה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה.** לֹא מִבַּטְּלָה בִנְתִינָתָהּ לְתוֹךְ הַכַּדּוּר, לְפִי שֶׁהִיא שְׁמוּרָה שָׁם. אֲבָל אִם עֲשָׂאָהּ כַּדּוּר בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ, טְהוֹרָה, לְפִי שֶׁהַתְּפִירָה מְמַעֲטָהּ, וּטְהוֹרָה מִמִּדְרָס, אֲבָל טְמֵאָה בְכָל שְׁאָר טֻמְאוֹת כְּדִין כָּל שְׁלֹשָׁה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה שֶׁנִּתְמַעֵט:


אבל שלשה על שלשה (but three – handbreadths—by three – handbreadths) – it was not voiced through its being placed within the ball, because it is preserved there. But if he made of it a ball by itself, it is ritually pure, because the sewing diminishes it, and it is pure from treading/Midras uncleanness. But it is impure in all of the other defilements according to the law of all three-handbreadths by three-handbreadth objects that were diminished.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:2:1)


**לָפוֹק.** לִסְתֹּם נְקָבִין שֶׁבַּמֶּרְחָץ שֶׁלֹּא יֵצֵא הַחֹם:


לפוק\ (to fill up a gap) – to stop up holes that are in the bath house so that the heat doesn’t leave.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:2:2)


**וּלְנַעֵר בּוֹ אֶת הַקְּדֵרָה.** לֶאֱחֹז בּוֹ אֶת הַקְּדֵרָה כְּדֵי לְעָרוֹת מִמֶּנָּה לְתוֹךְ הַקְּעָרָה אוֹ לְתוֹךְ הַתַּמְחוּי:


ולנער בו את הקדרה (to empty out the contents of the pot/dish) – to hold on to the pot in order to pour from it into a dish or into a tray.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:2:3)


**בֵּין מִן הַמּוּכָן בֵּין שֶׁאֵינוֹ מִן הַמּוּכָן.** בְּפֶרֶק בַּמֶּה מַדְלִיקִין מוֹכִיחַ, דִּבְהִנִּיחוֹ בְקֻפְסָא כֻלֵּי עָלְמָא לֹא פְלִיגֵי דְטָמֵא, דְּהָא אַחְשְׁבֵיהּ. וּבִזְרָקוֹ לָאַשְׁפָּה כֻלֵּי עָלְמָא לֹא פְלִיגֵי דְטָהוֹר, דְּהָא בַטְּלֵיהּ. כִּי פְלִיגֵי הֵיכָא דְתָלָה אוֹתוֹ בְמַגּוֹד, קויליי"א בְּלַעַ"ז, אוֹ הִנִּיחוֹ אֲחוֹרֵי הַדֶּלֶת. רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר סָבַר בֵּין הִנִּיחוֹ בְמַגּוֹד שֶׁנִּרְאֶה כְמוּכָן לְגַבֵּי זְרָקוֹ בָאַשְׁפָּה, בֵּין הִנִּיחוֹ אֲחוֹרֵי הַדֶּלֶת שֶׁנִּרְאֶה כְאֵינוֹ מוּכָן לְגַבֵּי הִנִּיחוֹ בְקֻפְסָא, לְעוֹלָם טָמֵא כָּל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא זְרָקוֹ בָאַשְׁפָּה. וְרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ סָבַר, לְעוֹלָם טָהוֹר כָּל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא הִנִּיחוֹ בְקֻפְסָא. וְרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא סָבַר, דִּתְלָאוֹ בְמַגּוֹד מוּכָן הוּא וְהָוֵי כְאִלּוּ הִנִּיחוֹ בְקֻפְסָא וְטָמֵא, וְהִנִּיחוֹ אֲחוֹרֵי הַדֶּלֶת דַּהֲוֵי שֶׁלֹּא מִן הַמּוּכָן, הֲרֵי הוּא כְאִלּוּ זְרָקוֹ בָאַשְׁפָּה וְטָהוֹר. וְהָתָם מַסִּיק דְּהָדַר בֵּיהּ רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא לְגַבֵּי רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ:


בין מוכן בין שאינו מוכן (whether kept in readiness or not) – in the Chapter, “With what [wicks] do we kindle [Sabbath lights]” {Tractate Shabbat folio 29a--b, chapter 2) it proves that when he places it in a box, everyone doesn’t argue about it that it is ritually impure, for it is his intention. But when he throws it into the trash, everyone doesn’t argue about it that it is ritually pure, for he has voided it. Where they argue is where he suspended it upon a frame to spread clothes on, KOYLIYA in the foreign language, or left it behind the door. Rabbi Eliezer holds that whether he left it upon a frame to spread clothes on, that it appears as ready to throw it in the garbage, or whether he left it behind the door, that it appears that is not ready concerning leaving it in a box, it is always impure as long as he didn’t throw it into the garbage. But Rabbi Yehoshua holds that it is always pure all the time that he did not put it in a box. But Rabbi Akiba holds that suspending it upon a fame to spread clothes on, it is [considered] ready and it is as if he placed it in a box and it is impure, but if he left it behind the door, it is [considered] that it is not ready, for it is as if he threw it into the garbage and it is ritually pure. But there (in Tractate Shabbat 29a-b), it concludes that Rabbi Akiba retracted in favor of the opinion of Rabbi Yehoshua. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Yehoshua.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:3:1)


**אִסְפְּלָנִית.** תַּחְבֹּשֶׁת שֶׁעוֹשִׂים מֵחֵלֶב וְשַׁעֲוָה וְחֶמְאָה וְשֶׁמֶן וְכַיּוֹצֵא בָזֶה, וּמְמָרְחִים אוֹתָהּ עַל הַבֶּגֶד אוֹ עַל הָעוֹר וְנוֹתְנִים עַל הַמַּכָּה, וְהִיא נִמְאֶסֶת, וְאֵין הַבֶּגֶד וְהָעוֹר רְאוּיִין עוֹד לִישִׁיבָה וְלֹא לְתַשְׁמִישׁ אַחֵר:


אספלנית (plaster) – a bandage/dressing that they make from milk, and wax and butter and [olive] oil and similar things. And they strike a plaster/rub a salve on the cloth or on the [leather] hide or they place it on the wound and it is repulsive, for the cloth nor the hide are appropriate any longer for sitting or for any other use.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:3:2)


**מְלוּגְמָא.** תַּחְבֹּשֶׁת עֲשׂוּיָה מִקֶּמַח וּתְאֵנִים וְכַיּוֹצֵא בָהֶן, שֶׁאָדָם לוֹעֵס וְנוֹתֵן עַל גַּב הַמַּכָּה. וּפֵרוּשׁ מְלוּגְמָא, מְלֹא לוּגְמָא:


מלוגמא (poultice/plaster) – a bandage/dressing that is made from flour and figs and similar things, that a person chews and places upon the wound. And an explanation [of the word] מלוגמא is a mouthful/quantity of liquid filling one cheek.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:3:3)


**בְּבֶגֶד טְהוֹרָה.** לְפִי שֶׁהַבֶּגֶד נִמְאַס וּמִתְבַּטֵּל וְתוּ לֹא חֲזִי לְתַשְׁמִישׁ:


בבגד טהור – because the cloth is repulsive and is voided and is further not appropriate for use.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:3:4)


**וּבְעוֹר טָמֵאָה.** שֶׁאֵין הַמְּלוּגְמָא מִתְדַּבֶּקֶת עַל הָעוֹר כְּמוֹ עַל הַבֶּגֶד, וְאֵין הָעוֹר מִתְבַּטֵּל בְּכָךְ:


ובעור טמא – because the poultice does not cling on the hide like on the cloth, and the hide is not voided through this.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:3:5)


**מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהִיא נִנְעָרֶת.** לְאַחַר שֶׁנִּתְיַבְּשָׁה מֵעַל הַבֶּגֶד הִיא נִנְעֶרֶת וְנִשְׁמֶטֶת מֵאֵלֶיהָ מֵעַל הַבֶּגֶד וְהוֹלֵךְ כָּל הַלִּכְלוּךְ. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל:


מפני שהיא ננערת (because it is shaken off) – after it dried up from upon the cloth, it is shaken off and is detached on its own from upon the cloth and all the soiling departs. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Shimon ben Gamaliel.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:4:1)


**מְצֻיָּרוֹת טְהוֹרוֹת.** דְּצוּרָתָן מוֹכַחַת עֲלֵיהֶן שֶׁהֵן מְיֻחָדִים לִסְפָרִים בִּלְבַד וְאֵינָן מְשַׁמְּשֵׁי אָדָם, וְכָל שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְשַׁמְּשֵׁי אָדָם, טָהוֹר:


מצויירות טהורות – for their form proves upon them that they are designated for Scrolls alone, and not for the use of a person, and all that is not for usage of a person, is ritually pure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:4:2)


**וְשֶׁאֵינָן מְצֻיָּרוֹת.** מְיֻחָדִים נַמִּי לִשְׁאָר תַּשְׁמִישִׁין, הִלְכָּךְ טְמֵאוֹת. וּבֵית שַׁמַּאי דִּמְטַמְּאִין בֵּין מְצֻיָּרוֹת בֵּין שֶׁאֵינָן מְצֻיָּרוֹת, מִשּׁוּם דְּמִחְשְׁבֵי מִטְפְּחוֹת סְפָרִים מְשַׁמְּשֵׁי אָדָם, שֶׁעֲשׂוּיִין לְמַשְׁמֵשׁ בָּהֶם תָּמִיד:


ואינן מצוירות – designated also for the rest of the usages, therefore they are ritually impure. But the School of Shammai who [states] that they defile, whether they are painted [with figures] or not, because coverings for [Torah] Scrolls are considered for the usage of humans, that they are made to be used by them always.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:4:3)


**אֵלּוּ וָאֵלּוּ טְהוֹרוֹת.** דְּכֵיוָן שֶׁיִּחֲדָן לִסְפָרִים תּוּ לֹא הָווּ מְשַׁמְּשֵׁי אָדָם. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל:


אלו ואלו טהורות – for since they were designated for [Torah] scrolls, it is further not for human usage. But the Halakha is not according to Rabban Gamaliel.



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:5:1)


**כִּפָּה.** מִטְפַּחַת שֶׁבְּרֹאשׁ הָאִשָּׁה. וְיֵשׁ לָהּ טֻמְאַת מִדְרָס, שֶׁפְּעָמִים שֶׁהִיא יוֹשֶׁבֶת עָלֶיהָ:


כיפה – a wrap that is on the head of a woman. And it has defilement through treading, for sometimes she sits upon it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:5:2)


**וּנְתָנוֹ עַל הַסֵּפֶר.** אִם יִחֵד אוֹתוֹ לְסֵפֶר וְכָרַךְ אוֹתוֹ עָלָיו:


ונתנו על הספר – if he designated it for a Scroll and wrapped it upon it (i.e., the Scroll).


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:5:3)


**טָהוֹר מִן הַמִּדְרָס.** אֲבָל טָמֵא שְׁאָר טֻמְאוֹת:


טהור מן המדרס – but it is impure regarding other defilements.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:5:4)


**חֵמֶת.** נֹאד שֶׁל עוֹר:


חמת (waterskin) – a bottle made of [leather] hide.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:5:5)


**שֶׁעֲשָׂאוֹ שָׁטִיחַ.** עוֹר שָׁטוּחַ עַל הָאָרֶץ לֵישֵׁב עָלָיו. וְחֵמֶת וְשָׁטִיחַ תַּרְוַיְהוּ טְמֵאִין מִדְרָס, וַאֲפִלּוּ הָכִי כֵיוָן דְּשִׁנָּה מִזֶּה לָזֶה וַאֲפִלּוּ בְלֹא שִׁנּוּי מַעֲשֶׂה הָוֵי לֵיהּ כִּכְלִי שֶׁנִּשְׁבַּר וְטָהוֹר, אֲבָל מְקַבֵּל טֻמְאָה מִכָּאן וּלְהַבָּא:


שעשאו שטיח – a hide stretched on the ground to sit upon it. And a waterskin and a rug are both impure through treading/Midras, and even so, since they are different one from the other, and even without the change of action, it is like a vessel that is broken and is pure, but it is susceptible to receive defilement from here onwards.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:5:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:5:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:5:6)


**תּוּרְמֵל.** כְּלִי עוֹר שֶׁהָרוֹעֶה מַנִּיחַ כֵּלָיו לְתוֹכוֹ:


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:5:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:5:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:5:7)


**הָכִי גָרְסִינַן, כֶּסֶת שֶׁעֲשָׂאוֹ מִטְפַּחַת וּמִטְפַּחַת שֶׁעֲשָׂאָהּ כֶּסֶת טָהוֹר.** וְלֹא גָרְסִינַן טָמֵא. וְכָךְ הִיא גִרְסַת רַבּוֹתַי. וְכֵן מָצָאתִי בְמִשְׁנָה דַוְּקָנִית. וְהָכִי מוּכָח מִן הַתּוֹסֶפְתָּא. וְטַעֲמָא דִּבְכֻלְּהוּ טָהוֹר, כְּדִתְנַן בְּסָמוּךְ זֶה הַכְּלָל לִשְׁמוֹ טָמֵא לְשֵׁם אַחֵר טָהוֹר, וּמְפָרֵשׁ בַּתּוֹסֶפְתָּא, לִשְׁמוֹ מִכְּלִי פָשׁוּט לִכְלִי פָשׁוּט, כְּגוֹן מִשָּׁטִיחַ לְמִטְפַּחַת אוֹ מִמִּטְפַּחַת לְשָׁטִיחַ, וְשֶׁלֹּא לִשְׁמוֹ מִכְּלִי פָשׁוּט לִכְלִי קִבּוּל וּמִכְּלִי קִבּוּל לִכְלִי פָשׁוּט, וּמִכְּלִי קִבּוּל לִכְלִי קִבּוּל נַמִּי, הַכֹּל שִׁנּוּי שֶׁלֹּא לִשְׁמוֹ וְטָהוֹר. וְאִם כֵּן חֵמֶת שֶׁעֲשָׂאָהּ תּוּרְמֵל דְּשִׁנָּהוּ מִקִּבּוּל לְקִבּוּל נַמִּי טָהוֹר, וְכַר שֶׁעֲשָׂאוֹ סָדִין וְסָדִין שֶׁעֲשָׂאוֹ כַר דַּהֲוֵי שִׁנּוּי מִקִּבּוּל לְפָשׁוּט וּמִפָּשׁוּט לְקִבּוּל נַמִּי טָהוֹר. וְאִי קַשְׁיָא, אַמַּאי לֹא עַרְבִינְהוּ וּתְנִינְהוּ חֵמֶת שֶׁעֲשָׂאָהּ שָׁטִיחַ וְשָׁטִיחַ שֶׁעֲשָׂאוֹ חֵמֶת בַּהֲדֵי הָנָךְ, כֵּיוָן דְּכֻלְּהוּ טָהוֹר הוּא. הָא לֹא קַשְׁיָא, מִשּׁוּם דְּקָא בָעֵי לְמִהְדַּר וּלְמִתְנֵי [חֵמֶת] זִימְנָא אַחֲרִיתִי כִדְתָנֵי חֵמֶת שֶׁעֲשָׂאָהּ תּוּרְמֵל וַהֲוָה צָרִיךְ לְמִתְנֵי חֵמֶת שֶׁעֲשָׂאָהּ שָׁטִיחַ אוֹ תוּרְמֵל, וְאֵינוֹ רוֹצֶה לְשַׁנּוֹת מִסֵּדֶר הָאֲחֵרִים. וְרֹב סְפָרִים גּוֹרְסִים טָמֵא, וְאֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ לְיַשֵּׁב גִּרְסָא זוֹ מְכֻוֶּנֶת:


כסת שעשאו מטפחת ומטפחת שעשאו כסת טהור (a bolster/cushion that one made into a wrap and a wrap that one made into a bolster/cushion is pure) – And we don’t have the reading of טמא/impure [as does the Mishnah]. And this is the reading of my Rabbis/teachers. And similarly, I found in an accurate Mishnah. And this is proved from the Tosefta (see Tosefta Kelim Bava Batra, Chapter 6, Halakha 1), and the reason that in all of them, it is pure, as is taught in the Mishnah close by (our Mishnah): “This is the general principle: Anything which one changed for [something] in its own category is impure, and for [something in] another category is pure./"זה הכלל: כל ששנהו לשמו – טמא, לשם אחר – טהור"’, and it explains in the Tosefta: for something in its own category – from a flat vessel to a flat vessel, as for example, from a rug to a wrap or from a wrap to a rug, and in another category, from a simple vessel to a receptacle or from a receptacle to a simply vessel, and also from one receptacle to another receptacle, everything that is a change that is not in its own category is ritually pure. And if so, the waterskin that was made into a bag that he changed it from one [kind of] receptacle to another kind of receptacle is also ritually pure. But if you raise the question, why didn’t they combine them and teach them [together] a waterskin that was made into a rug and a rug that was made into a waterskin at the same time, since all of them are ritually pure. But it is not difficult, because he needed to go back and teach [waterskin] another time, as it taught the waterskin that was made into a bag, and he would have had to teach a waterskin that was made into a rug or a bag, and he didn’t want to change fro the order of the other things. But most of the books have the reading of "טמא"/impure, and I don’t know how to resolve this “reading” correspondingly.



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:1)


**מַטְלִית.** שֶׁהִיא טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס, וּטְלָאָהּ בַקֻּפָּה. וְקֻפָּה לָאו בַּת מִדְרָס הִיא, וּמִיהוּ כְשֶׁטְּלָאָהּ בַקֻּפָּה נִטְמֵאת הַקֻּפָּה, לְפִי שֶׁנָּגְעָה בַמַּטְלִית הַטְּמֵאָה מִדְרָס, וַהֲרֵי הִיא מַגַּע מִדְרָס. וְהַמַּטְלִית כְּשֶׁנִּגְמְרָה טְלִיָּתָהּ פָּרַח מִנַּהּ טֻמְאַת מִדְרָס, מִשּׁוּם דְּבָטְלָה לְגַבֵּי קֻפָּה וְקֻפָּה לֹא חַזְיָא לְמִדְרָס:


מטלית (a patch) – which is impure through treading, and one batched it onto a basket. But the basket is not something that can become impure by treading, but when he placed the patch on the basket, the basket was defiled, because it came in contact with the patch that is impure through treading, and this is contact of treading. But the patch, when the patching had been completed, the defilement of treading flew off from it, because it was voided concerning the basket and a basket is not suitable for treading uncleanness.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:2)


**מְטַמְּאָה אֶחָד וּפוֹסֶלֶת אֶחָד.** כְּדִין כֵּלִים שֶׁנָּגְעוּ בַמִּדְרָס וּפָרְשׁוּ, דִּתְנַן בְּסוֹף זָבִים הַנּוֹגֵעַ בְּמִשְׁכָּב מְטַמֵּא שְׁנַיִם וּפוֹסֵל אֶחָד, פֵּרַשׁ מְטַמֵּא אֶחָד וּפוֹסֵל אֶחָד, דְּכָל זְמַן שֶׁהַכְּלִי נוֹגֵעַ בַּמִּדְרָס חָשְׁבִינַן לֵיהּ כְּאַב הַטֻּמְאָה לְעִנְיַן אֳכָלִים לַעֲשׂוֹת רִאשׁוֹן וְשֵׁנִי בַחֻלִּין וּשְׁלִישִׁי בַתְּרוּמָה, אֲבָל כְּשֶׁפֵּרַשׁ הָוֵי לֵיהּ כִּוְלַד הַטֻּמְאָה וְעוֹשֶׂה שֵׁנִי בַחֻלִּין וּשְׁלִישִׁי בַתְּרוּמָה בִלְבַד, דְּהַיְנוּ מְטַמֵּא אֶחָד וּפוֹסֵל אֶחָד:


מטמאה אחד ופוסלת אחד (renders unclean at first remove and renders unfit at one) – like the law of vessels that came in contact with treading uncleanness, and they explained, that it is taught in the Mishnah at the end of [Tractate] Zabim (Chapter 5, Mishnah 6): "הנוגע במשכב מטמא שנים ופוסל אחד"/If a person touched a bed (i.e., the uncleanness caused by an unclean person lying on a object) imparts uncleanness at two removes (at one step and this in turn at another)and renders [heave-offering] unfit at one further remove,” he explained imparting uncleanness at two removes and rendering [heave-offering] unit at one remove, that all the while that the vessel touches the [object] that is unclean through treading, we consider it as a primary source of ritual uncleanness regarding foods to make them first and second degree uncleanness for profane things and third-level of uncleanness for heave offering. But when he separated himself, it is like the offspring of uncleanness (i.e., acquired through contact with any primary source of uncleanness or derivative uncleanness of such) which makes it second-degree of ritual uncleanness for profane things and third-level uncleanness for heave offering alone, which is that it defiles by one degree and invalidates by one degree.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:3)


**הִפְרִישָׁהּ.** לַמַּטְלִית מִן הַקֻּפָּה, הָוֵי לַהּ הַקֻּפָּה וְלַד הַטֻּמְאָה כְמוֹ שֶׁהָיְתָה קֹדֶם שֶׁהִפְרִישָׁהּ, אֲבָל הַמַּטְלִית טְהוֹרָה, דְּמִכֵּיוָן שֶׁטְּלָאָהּ בַּקֻּפָּה נַעֲשֵׂית כַּקֻּפָּה וְהַוְיָא לַהּ כַּחֲתִיכַת דֹּפֶן שֶׁנִּטְּלָה מִן הַקֻּפָּה דִּטְהוֹרָה הַחֲתִיכָה. וּמִיהוּ אִם אַחַר פְּרִישָׁתָהּ מִן הַקֻּפָּה חִשֵּׁב עָלֶיהָ לִישִׁיבָה, מְקַבֶּלֶת טֻמְאָה מִכָּאן וּלְהַבָּא אִם יֵשׁ בָּהּ כְּשִׁעוּר:


הפרישה (if he removed/separated it) – the patch from the basket, the asked is an offspring of uncleanness, like it was prior to his removing it, but the patch is pure, for since he patched it on the basked, it became like the basket, and it is like a piece of the wall that he took from the basket that the piece is ritually pure. But however, if after its removal from the basket he considered it for sitting, it receives impurity from he onwards if had in it like the measure [for impurity].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:4)


**טְלָאָהּ עַל הַבֶּגֶד.** לֹא נִתְבַּטְּלָה מִטֻּמְאַת מִדְרָס, וּמְטַמֵּא הַבֶּגֶד שְׁנַיִם וּפוֹסֵל אֶחָד כְּדִין כֵּלִים הַנּוֹגְעִים בַּמִּדְרָס כָּל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא פָרְשׁוּ:


טלאה על הבגד (if he patched it on to the cloth) – not that it had been voided from the uncleanness of treading, for he defiles the cloth in two counts and invalidates it in one like the law of vessels that touch uncleanness through treading all the while that he did not remove it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:6:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:5)


**הִפְרִישָׁהּ מִן הַבֶּגֶד.** דִּין הַבֶּגֶד כְּכֵלִים שֶׁנָּגְעוּ וּפָרְשׁוּ, מְטַמֵּא אֶחָד וּפוֹסֵל אֶחָד, וְהַמַּטְלִית הֲרֵי הִיא כְמוֹ שֶׁהָיְתָה, דִּלְעוֹלָם לֹא נִתְבַּטְּלָה, וּמְטַמְּאָה שְׁנַיִם וּפוֹסֶלֶת אֶחָד:


הפרישה מן הבגד – the law of cloth is like that of vessels that came in contact with [defilement] and then separated/removed it. It defiles at one remove and invalidates at one remove, for the patch, it is like it was, that it had never been voided, and defiles at two removes and invalidates at one.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:6:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:6)


**וְכֵן הַטּוֹלֶה.** מַטְלִית:


וכן הטולה (and similarly one who patches) – a patch.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:6:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:7)


**עַל הַשַּׂק אוֹ עַל הָעוֹר.** כְּטוֹלֶה עַל הַבֶּגֶד וְאֵינָהּ מִתְבַּטֶּלֶת:


על השק או על העור – like patching on the cloth and it is not voided [and remains unclean].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:6:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:6:8)


**וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן מְטַהֵר.** קָסָבַר בַּשַּׂק וּבָעוֹר מִתְבַּטֶּלֶת, הוֹאִיל וְלָאו מִינָהּ. וְרַבִּי יוֹסֵי סָבַר, דִּבְשַׂק דְּאָרִיג כְּמוֹתָהּ, אֵינָהּ מִתְבַּטֶּלֶת. אֲבָל בְּעוֹר, דְּלָאו אָרִיג הוּא, מִתְבַּטֶּלֶת. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי:


ר' שמעון מטהר – for he holds that the sack and the hide it is voided, for it is not of its kind. But Rabbi Yossi holds, that with a sack that is woven like it is not voided, but on a hide, since it is not woven, is voided. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Yossi.



### Mishnah 7

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:1)


**שָׁלֹשׁ עַל שָׁלֹשׁ שֶׁאָמְרוּ.** דְּמִטַּמֵּא לְעִנְיַן טֻמְאַת מֵת וְשֶׁרֶץ וּנְבֵלָה:


שלש על שלש שאמרו (three-fingerbreadths by three-fingerbreadths – that they spoke of) – that it is susceptible to corpse defilement and reptile and carrion.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:2)


**חוּץ מִן הַמְּלָל.** מַה שֶּׁמְּשַׁיֵּר הָאוֹרֵג בְּרֹאשׁ הַבֶּגֶד כְּשִׁעוּר שְׁתֵּי אֶצְבָּעוֹת, וְהוּא עָנָף שֶׁל בֶּגֶד, קָרוּי מְלָל. וְכֵיוָן שֶׁשְּׁתִי לְבַדּוֹ הוּא וְאֵין בּוֹ עֵרֶב, אֵין מִצְטָרֵף לָאָרִיג. וְרַבּוֹתַי מְפָרְשִׁים מְלָל, מַה שֶּׁמּוֹלֵל וְכוֹפֵל הַתּוֹפֵר מְקוֹם הַחֲתָךְ, מִפְּנֵי הַחוּטִים שֶׁדַּרְכָּן לָצֵאת שֶׁלֹּא יֵצְאוּ וְתִתְקַלְקֵל הַתְּפִירָה:


חוץ מן המלל – what the weaver leaves over at the top of he cloth, like the measure of two fingerbreadths, and it is branch/locks of the cloth, which is called מלל/hem. And since it is the warp/longitudinal direction alone and there is no woof/latitudinal direction, it does not combine for weaving. But my Teachers/Rabbis explain [the word] מלל, just as he hems and doubles the stitch in the place of he incision, because it is the manner of the threads to extend where they shouldn’t extend and the sewing is ruined.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:3)


**מְכֻוָּנֶת.** וְהַמְּלָל בִּכְלָל:


מכוונות (exactly)– and the hem is included in all of this.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:4)


**טְלָיָהּ עַל הַבֶּגֶד מֵרוּחַ אַחַת.** מַטְלִית שֶׁהִיא טְמֵאָה מִדְרָס וְתָפַר אוֹתָהּ עַל הַבֶּגֶד בְּאֶמְצָעוֹ מֵרוּחַ אַחַת, וּמִשָּׁלֹשׁ רוּחוֹת תְּלוּיָה וְאֵינָהּ מְחֻבֶּרֶת בַּבֶּגֶד:


טלייה על הבגד מרוח אחת – the path is impure through treading and he sewed it on the the cloth in the middle from one direction [only], but from three directions, it is suspending and not attached to the cloth.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:5)


**אֵינוֹ חִבּוּר.** וְאֵין הַבֶּגֶד טָמֵא מִדְרָס:


אינו חיבור- and the cloth is not impure through treading uncleanness.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:7:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:6)


**מִשְּׁתֵּי רוּחוֹת זוֹ כְנֶגֶד זוֹ.** כְּגוֹן שֶׁהִיא תְפוּרָה מִזְרָח וּמַעֲרָב, וְדָרוֹם וְצָפוֹן אֵינָהּ תְּפוּרָה. אוֹ אִפְּכָא. הֲרֵי זֶה חִבּוּר וְהַבֶּגֶד טָמֵא מִדְרָס:


משתי רוחות זו כנגד זו (from two directions – one opposite the other) – as for example, that it is sewn from the east and the west, but it is not sewn from the north and south. Or its reverse. This is a connection and the cloth is impure through treading uncleanness.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:7:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:7)


**כְּמִין גַּאם.** שֶׁתְּפוּרָה מִזְרָח וְדָרוֹם, אוֹ מַעֲרָב וְצָפוֹן:


כמין גאם – that it is sewn east and south, or west and north.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:7:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:8)


**בַּמֶּה דְבָרִים אֲמוּרִים.** דְּלֹא הָוֵי חִבּוּר אֶלָּא בִשְׁתֵּי רוּחוֹת זוֹ כְנֶגֶד זוֹ:


במה דברים אמורים – that it is not a connector other than from two directions/sides, one opposite the other.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:7:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:9)


**בְּטַלִּית.** שֶׁאֵינָהּ דֶּרֶךְ מַלְבּוּשׁ אֶלָּא שֶׁכּוֹרְכָהּ עָלָיו בִּלְבַד:


בטלית – for it is not the manner of dress/clothing other than that wrapping upon it alone.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:7:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:7:10)


**אֲבָל בֶּחָלוּק.** שֶׁלּוֹבְשִׁים אוֹתוֹ, לְעוֹלָם הָוֵי חִבּוּר, אֶלָּא אִם כֵּן תְּפוּרָה הַשָּׂפָה הָעֶלְיוֹנָה. וַהֲלָכָה כַּחֲכָמִים:


אבל בחלוק (but a shirt) – that we wear, is always a connector, unless the upper rim/hem is sewn. And the Halakha is according to the Sages.



### Mishnah 8

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:8:1)


**בִּגְדֵי עֲנִיִּים.** שֶׁהֵם עֲשׂוּיִים מֵחֲתִיכוֹת חֲתִיכוֹת קְטַנּוֹת וְאֵין בְּכֻלָּן חֲתִיכָה אַחַת שֶׁיִּהְיֶה בָהּ שָׁלֹשׁ עַל שָׁלֹשׁ:


בגדי עניים – which are made from small individual pieces, and there isn’t in all of them one whole piece that has three [fingerbreadths] by three [fingerbreadths].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:8:2)


**הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ טְמֵאִים מִדְרָס.** הוֹאִיל וְיֵשׁ בְּכָל הַבֶּגֶד בִּכְלָלוֹ שְׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים אוֹ יוֹתֵר, הֲרֵי הַבֶּגֶד כֻּלּוֹ טָמֵא מִדְרָס:


הרי אלו טמאים מדרס – for since there is in all of the cloth as a whole three handbreadths by three handbreadths or more, the entire cloth is impure with treading uncleanness.;


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:8:3)


**כֵּיוָן שֶׁנִּקְרַע רֻבָּהּ אֵינוֹ חִבּוּר.** וְאִם נִטְמָא הַקָּצֶה הָאֶחָד לֹא נִטְמָא הַקָּצֶה הָאַחֵר:


כיון שנקרע רובה אינו חיבור – but if the one end is defiled, the other end is not defiled.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:8:4)


**הֶעָבִים וְהָרַכִּים.** הַבְּגָדִים הֶעָבִים וְהַגַּסִּים בְּיוֹתֵר, כְּגוֹן הַלְּבָדִין וְהַמַּגּוֹסִין. וְהָרַכִּים וְדַקִּין בְּיוֹתֵר, כְּגוֹן הַשִּׁירָאִין וְהַסְּרִיקִין:


העבים והרכים – the most thick and huge clothing, such as the thick, full or felted stuff and the large ones. And the most soft and thin, such as that of silk and that which is hatchelled.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:8:5)


**אֵין בָּהֶן מִשּׁוּם שָׁלֹשׁ עַל שָׁלֹשׁ.** וְאֵין טְמֵאִין טְמֵא מֵת וְלֹא שְׁאָר טֻמְאוֹת עַד שֶׁיִּהְיֶה בָהֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה טְפָחִים אוֹ יוֹתֵר, מִשּׁוּם דְּשָׁלֹשׁ עַל שָׁלֹשׁ מֵהֶן לֹא חֲזִי לְמִידִי:


אין בהן משום שלש על שלש – and they are not defiled through corpse defilement nor the rest of the defilements until there they will have three-handbreadths or more, because [less than] three [fingerbreadths] by three [fingerbreadths] is not worth anything.



### Mishnah 9

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:1)


**כֶּסֶת הַסַּבָּלִין.** הַנּוֹשְׂאִים מַשָּׂאוֹת עַל כְּתֵפָן אוֹ עַל רֹאשָׁן יֵשׁ לָהֶן כֶּסֶת קָטָן בְּרֹאשָׁן אוֹ בִכְתֵפָן שֶׁלֹּא יַזִּיק לָהֶן הַמַּשְּׂאוֹי, וּפְעָמִים יוֹשְׁבִים עָלָיו:


כסת הסבלין (the cushion which load-carriers wear on their heads) – that carry loads on their shoulders or on their heads, there is small cushion on their heads or upon their shoulders so that the load doesn’t damage them, and sometimes they sit upon it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:2)


**מְשַׁמֶּרֶת שֶׁל יַיִן אֵין בָּהּ מִשּׁוּם מוֹשָׁב.** שֶׁאֵין יוֹשְׁבִים עָלֶיהָ מִפְּנֵי הַשְּׁמָרִים:


משמרת של יין אין בה משום מושב (the strainer for wine is not susceptible to sitting uncleanness) – for we don’t sit on it because of the sediment.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:3)


**סְבָכָה שֶׁל זְקֵנָה טְמֵאָה מוֹשָׁב.** לְפִי מַאי דִּתְנַן לְעֵיל בְּפֶרֶק שְׁלֹשָׁה תְרִיסִין דִּסְבָכָה שֶׁל זְקֵנָה טְמֵאָה טְמֵא מֵת דְּמַשְׁמַע אֲבָל לֹא מִשּׁוּם מוֹשָׁב, צָרִיךְ לְפָרֵשׁ דִּשְׁנֵי מִינֵי סְבָכוֹת יֵשׁ לִזְקֵנָה, אַחַת שֶׁאֵינָהּ רְאוּיָה לֵישֵׁב עָלֶיהָ וְהִיא טְמֵאָה טְמֵא מֵת, וּסְבָכָה אַחֶרֶת שֶׁפְּעָמִים יוֹשֶׁבֶת עָלֶיהָ, וּבָהּ תְּנַן הָכָא שֶׁהִיא מִטַּמְּאָה מִשּׁוּם מוֹשָׁב:


סבכה של זקנה טמאה מושב (the head-dress/net of an old woman is not susceptible to sitting uncleanness) – because of what is taught in the chapter “Three Shields”/שלשה תריסין (Tractate Kelim, Chapter 24, Mishnah 16), that the head-dress/net of an elderly woman is defiled through corpse uncleanness, that is implies, but not because of seating, it is necessary to explain that there are two kinds of head-dress/nets for elderly women, one that is not appropriate for sitting up and it is defiled through corpse uncleanness, and the other head-dress/net, sometimes she sits upon it, and the Mishnah here comes t to teach that it is susceptible to sitting.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:4)


**חָלוּק שֶׁל יוֹצֵאת הַחוּץ.** תַּרְגּוּם זוֹנָה נַפְקַת בָּרָא:


חלוק של יוצאת החוץ – it is the Aramaic translation of a whore – a creature that goes out.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:9:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:5)


**עָשׂוּי כִּסְבָכָה.** שֶׁיֶּשׁ בָּהּ חַלּוֹנוֹת חַלּוֹנוֹת מַעֲשֵׂה רֶשֶׁת וּבְשָׂרָהּ נִרְאֶה לַחוּץ:


עשוי כדבכה – it has many windows like the making of a net and her skin can be seen outside.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:9:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:6)


**מִן הַחֵרֶם.** מִן הָרֶשֶׁת. וּבְשָׂרוֹ נִרְאֶה, לְפִיכָךְ טָהוֹר:


מן החרם (from the net) – from the net-work. And his skin is seen, therefore it is pure.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:9:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:7)


**מִזּוּטוֹ.** יֵשׁ בְּתַחְתִּית הָרֶשֶׁת מְעַט אָרִיג עָשׂוּי כְּבֶגֶד, וְקָרוּי זוּטוֹ שֶׁל רֶשֶׁת:


מן זוטו (from the fishing net/solid web of network) – there is at the bottom of the netting a bit that is woven made in the cloth. And it is called זוטו של רשת /webbing of the net.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:9:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:8)


**וּכְפָלוֹ.** שֶׁכָּפַל אֶת הָרֶשֶׁת וּתְפָרָהּ וְאֵין בְּשָׂרוֹ נִרְאֶה מִתּוֹכָהּ:


וכפלו (and doubled it up) – and he doubled up the netting and sewed it, and his skin is not seen from within it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:9:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:9:9)


**טָמֵא.** דַּחֲשִׁיב בֶּגֶד. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר בֶּן יַעֲקֹב:


טמא – for it is considered a cloth. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov.



### Mishnah 10

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:10:1)


**קוּרְקוּרְתָּהּ.** שׁוּלַיִם וְתַחְתִּית, כְּמוֹ קַרְקְרוֹת הַכֵּלִים:


קורקורקתה (lower border of a web) – the hem and the bottom, like the rimmed bottom of the vessels.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:10:2)


**עַד שֶׁיִּגְמֹר אֶת פִּיהָ.** שְׂפָתָהּ הָעֶלְיוֹנָה. שֶׁאֵינָהּ יוֹרֶדֶת לְטֻמְאָה עַד שֶׁיִּגְמֹר אֶת כָּל מְלַאכְתָּהּ:


עד שיגמור את פיה (until he completes its hem) – its upper rim/hem, that does not descend into defilement until he completes all of its work.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:10:3)


**שָׁבִיס שֶׁלָּהּ.** מִלְּשׁוֹן הַשְּׁבִיסִים וְהַשַּׂהֲרוֹנִים. צִיּוּר שֶׁעוֹשִׂים עַל הַסְּבָכָה לְנוֹי, עוֹמֵד עַל מִצְחָהּ וּמַקִּיף מֵאֹזֶן לְאֹזֶן. וּבִפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ נַמִּי חָשִׁיב, שֶׁהוּא עָשׂוּי לַהֲסִירוֹ מִשָּׁם וְלָתֵת אוֹתוֹ בִּסְבָכָה אַחֶרֶת:


שביס שלה (the band of the net) – from the language of “the bands and the enclosed places.” It is a painting that one makes on the hairnet for beauty. It stands on her forehead and surrounds it from eat to ear. And it is also considered on its own, that it is made to remove it from there, and to place it in another hairnet.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:10:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:10:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:10:4)


**הַחוּטִין שֶׁלָּהּ.** שֶׁבָּהֶן קוֹשְׁרִים הַסְּבָכָה עַל הָרֹאשׁ:


טמאים משום חיבור – that if the hairnet is defiled, all the stings are defiled with it. For it were strings/threads without the hairnet, it would not be susceptible to receive ritual defilement.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 28:10:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:10:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/28:10:5)


**טְמֵאִים מִשּׁוּם חִבּוּר.** שֶׁאִם נִטְמֵאת הַסְּבָכָה נִטְמְאוּ הַחוּטִים עִמָּהּ דְּאִלּוּ הַחוּטִים בְּלֹא סְבָכָה לֹא הָיוּ מְקַבְּלִים טֻמְאָה: **אִם אֵינָהּ מְקַבֶּלֶת אֶת רֹב הַשֵּׂעָר.** שֶׁל הָרֹאשׁ, טְהוֹרָה:


אם אינה מקבלת את רוב השער – of the head, it is pure/clean.



## Chapter 29


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:1)


**נוֹמֵי הַסָּדִין.** נִימִין הַיּוֹצְאִים מִן הַסָּדִין, וְהֵן חוּטִים שֶׁרְגִילִים לָצֵאת מִן הָאָרִיג בֵּין מִן הַצְּדָדִים בֵּין מִלְּמַעְלָה בֵּין מִלְּמַטָּה. אִם נָגַע שֶׁרֶץ בַּנִּימִין, נִטְמָא הַסָּדִין. וְהוּא שֶׁיִּגַּע בְּתוֹךְ הַשִּׁעוּר הַמְפֹרָשׁ בְּמַתְנִיתִין. וְכֵן אִם נָגַע שֶׁרֶץ בַּסָּדִין, נִטְמְאוּ הַנִּימִין עַד מְקוֹם הַשִּׁעוּר הַמְפֹרָשׁ. וּמִשָּׁם וְלַחוּץ טְהוֹרִים, שֶׁאֵין הַנִּימִין חִבּוּר לְכָל בֶּגֶד אֶלָּא עַד מְקוֹם הַשִּׁעוּר הַמְפֹרָשׁ בָּהֶן:


נומי הסדין (threads/fringes of the sheet) –fringes that extend from the sheet. And they are threads that regularly extend from something woven, whether from the sides, whether from above or whether from below. If a reptile touched the fringes, the sheet is defiled. And it should touch within the measurement that is explained in our Mishnah (i.e., six fingerbreadths). And similarly, if a reptile touched a sheet, all of the fringes are defiled up to the point of the explained measurement. But from there and outward, they are pure, for the fringes are not a connector to the entire cloth but rather only up to the point of the measurement that is explained about them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:2)


**טַרְטִין.** כְּמִין כּוֹבָעִים:


טרטין – like kinds of hats.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:3)


**פִּלְיוֹן.** סָדִין שֶׁמִּתְעַטֵּף בּוֹ כֻלּוֹ:


פליון – a sheet that one wraps oneself in entirely.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:4)


**אַפְקַרְסִין.** כְּמוֹ אַפְקַרְסוּתוֹ אֵינָהּ מְעַכֶּבֶת דְּפֶרֶק וְאֵלּוּ מְגַלְּחִים [מוֹעֵד קָטָן כב:], וְהוּא לְבוּשׁ הַתַּחְתּוֹן וּפָתוּחַ מִכְּתֵפָיו וּכְשֶׁלּוֹבְשׁוֹ קוֹשְׁרוֹ:


אפקרסין (underwear) – like his undershirt forms no check (but must likewise be rent) that is the third chapter of [Tractate] Moed Katan אלו מגלחין/Which are those who may shave? [Moed Katan 22b] and it is the underclothing and it is open from its shoulders, and when he wears it, he ties it up.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:5)


**סָגוֹס.** בֶּגֶד שֶׁל צֶמֶר עָב וְכֻלּוֹ צִיצִיּוֹת, וְקוֹרִים לוֹ בַעֲרָבִי אלבורנו"ס:


סגוס (a coarse woolen blanket – often mentioned a s a mattress to sleep on) – a thick cloth of wool and all it is fringes, and they call it ALBORNUS in Aramic.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:6)


**רְדִיד.** צָעִיף דַּק שֶׁהָאִשָּׁה מְכַסָּה בוֹ רֹאשָׁהּ. וַתְּכַס בַּצָּעִיף, תַּרְגּוּם יְרוּשַׁלְמִי רְדִידָא:


רדיד (female’s wrap of fine texture, veil) – a thin that woman covers here head. The Aramaic Jerusalem translation of "ותכס בצעיף"/”And she (Tamar) covered her face with a veil” (Genesis 38:14) is רדידא.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:7)


**גּוּמְדִין.** בֶּגֶד שֶׁהוּא אַמָּה עַל אַמָּה, וּמְכַסִּין הָעַרְבִים חָטְמָן וּפִיהֶם בִּזְמַן הַקֹּר. וּפֵרוּשׁ גֹּמֶד אַמָּה, כְּדִכְתִיב (שופטים ג) וְלָהּ שְׁנֵי פֵיוֹת גֹּמֶד אָרְכָּהּ:


גומדין (a veil of a square gomed/a cubit less the hand’s length, the arm) – a cloth that is a cubit by a cubit, and the Arabs cover heir noses and their mouths in the cold weather. And the explanation of a גומד is a cubit, as it is written (Judges 3:16): “[So Ehud made for himself] a two-edged dagger, a GOMED in length, [which he girded on his right side under his cloak].”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:8)


**קֻלְקִין.** אָרִיג שֶׁל שֵׂעָר וְיֵשׁ לוֹ נִימִין:


קלקין (Cicilian goat hair cloth) – woven of hair and it has fringes.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:1:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:9)


**פֻּנְדָּא.** יֵשׁ מְפָרְשִׁים אֵזוֹר חָלוּל וְרָחָב. וְיֵשׁ מְפָרְשִׁים הַבֶּגֶד הַתַּחְתּוֹן שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים עַל הַבָּשָׂר לִשְׁמֹר שְׁאָר הַבְּגָדִים שֶׁלֹּא יִטַּנְּפוּ בַזֵּעָה:


פונדא (money bag, hollow belt) – there are those who explain it as a hollow and wide girdle/belt. And there are those who explain it as the underwear that one places on one’s flesh to preserve the rest of the clothing so that they will not be soiled through sweat.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:1:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:10)


**מַעֲפֹרֶת.** תַּרְגּוּם וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ בַּאֲפֵר (מלכים א כ) וְאֶשְׁתַּנֵי בְּמַעֲפָרָא. סוּדָר שֶׁמְּעַטְּפִים בּוֹ הָרֹאשׁ:


מעפורת (apron, any garment for the protection of clothes) – It is the Aramaic translation of (I Kings 20:38): “[Then the prophet,] disguised by a cloth over his eyes, [went and waited for the king by the road],” and it is taught regarding a מעפרא/a cloak with a hood. A kerchief that one wraps one’s head in.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:1:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:11)


**פַּרְגּוֹד.** מָסָךְ שֶׁתּוֹלִין עַל פִּתְחֵי הַמְּלָכִים:


פרגוד – a curtain that one hangs over the entrances of the kings.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:1:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:1:12)


**כָּל שֶׁהֵן.** בֵּין רַב בֵּין מְעַט הָוֵי חִבּוּר. וְכֻלְּהוּ אַחֲרִינֵי שֶׁשִּׁעוּרָן מְפֹרָשׁ, כְּשִׁעוּר הָוֵי חִבּוּר, מַה שֶּׁיָּתֵר מִכְּשִׁעוּר לֹא הָוֵי חִבּוּר, לֹא לַטֻּמְאָה וְלֹא לַהַזָּאָה:


כל שהן (any length) – whether great or a little, it is connector. And all of them, the last ones that the measures are explained, like the measurement that is a connection – whatever that remains from that of the measure, is not a connector, neither for defilement nor for sprinkling.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:2:1)


**שָׁלֹשׁ כְּסָתוֹת שֶׁל צֶמֶר.** תְּפוּרוֹת זוֹ עִם זוֹ כְּשָׁלָל שֶׁל כּוֹבְסִין. אִי נַמִּי, אֲרוּגוֹת יַחַד, כְּעֵין הָאוֹרְגִים מַפּוֹת שֶׁדַּרְכָּן לְהָנִיחַ הֶפְרֵשׁ בֵּין מַפָּה לְמַפָּה וּמְחֻבָּרוֹת בְּחוּטֵי הַשְּׁתִי וְאֵין בּוֹ עֵרֶב. וְכָל הָנֵי דִתְנַן הָכָא, כָּל אֶחָד בְּמִנְיָנוֹ אוֹ פָּחוֹת הָוֵי חִבּוּר, וְאִם נָגְעָה טֻמְאָה בְאֶחָד מֵהֶן נִטְמְאוּ כֻלָּן, וְאִם הָיוּ טְמֵאִין וְהוּזָה מֵאֵפֶר הַפָּרָה בְאֶחָד מֵהֶן נִטְהֲרוּ כֻלָּן. וְיוֹתֵר עַל מִנְיָן זֶה לֹא הָוֵי חִבּוּר לֹא לַטֻּמְאָה וְלֹא לַהַזָּאָה:


שלש כסתות של צמר (three woolen cushions) – that are sewn this one with that one like washers’ materials loosely stitched together (see also Tractate Shabbat 48b). Alternatively, woven together, similar to those who weave napkins whose manner is to leave a separation between each napkin and they are connected with threads of the warp/in the longitudinal direction and it has no woof/latitudinal direction. And all of these are taught in the Mishnah, here each one according to its number or less is a connection, but if defilement came in contact with one of them, all of them are defiled. But if they were impure, and dust was sprinkled from the [Red] Heifer on one of them, all of them are purified. But more than this number, there is no connection, not for defilement nor for sprinkling.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:2:2)


**סוּבְרִיקִין.** אִית דְּתָנֵי סַפְרִיקִין. אִית דִּמְפָרְשֵׁי מִכְנָסַיִם, וְאִית דִּמְפָרְשֵׁי כְּמִין בָּתֵּי יָדַיִם מִצֶּמֶר שֶׁמַּלְבִּישִׁים בָּהֶם אֶת הַיָּדַיִם וּמְכַסִּים בָּהֶם הַזְּרוֹעוֹת עַד הָאֲצִילִים:


סבריקין (a sort of trousers) – there are those who teach [the word as] ספריקין. There are those who explain it as trousers/undergarments, drawers. And there are those who explain as a kind of gloves made from wool that we dress the hands in them and cover the arms until the joint which touches the rib/elbow.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:2:3)


**גְּלֻפְקָרִין.** כְּסוּת עָבָה שֶׁל צֶמֶר שֶׁלּוֹבְשִׁים בְּעֵת הַקְּרִירוּת:


גלופקרין (woolly bed-covers, blankets) – thick covering of wood that they wear at the time of the cold [weather].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:2:4)


**חִבּוּר לַטֻּמְאָה וְאֵינוֹ חִבּוּר לַהַזָּאָה.** לְחֻמְרָא. אִם נָגְעָה טֻמְאָה בְּאֶחָד מֵהֶן הָוֵי חִבּוּר וְנִטְמְאוּ כֻלָּן, וְאִם הוּזָה אֶחָד מֵהֶן לֹא הָוֵי חִבּוּר, וְלֹא טָהַר אֶלָּא אוֹתוֹ שֶׁהוּזָה עָלָיו בִּלְבַד:


חיבור לטומאה ואינו חיבור להזאה – for a stringency. If defilement came in contact with one them, it is a connection and all of them were defiled. But if one of them was sprinkled, it is not a connection, and he didn’t purify anything other than that one that was sprinkled upon alone.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:2:5)


**רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר אַף לֹא לַטֻּמְאָה.** וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי:


ר' יוסי אומר אף לא לטומאה – but the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yossi.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:3:1)


**חוּט הַמִּשְׁקֹלֶת.** הַבַּנָּאִים מַחֲזִיקִים בְּיָדָם חוּט וּבְרֹאשׁוֹ עוֹפֶרֶת וּמוֹרִידִים אוֹתוֹ כְנֶגֶד הַכֹּתֶל לִרְאוֹת שֶׁלֹּא יְהֵא עָקוּם:


חוט המשקולת (plumb-line) – The builders take hold of a thread/cord In their hands, and at its top is lead and they lower it opposite the wall to see that it should not be curved.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:3:2)


**חָרָשִׁין.** נַגָּרִין שֶׁל עֵץ:


חרשין – carpenters of wood.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:3:3)


**וְשֶׁל בַּנָּאִים.** הַבּוֹנִים הַחוֹמוֹת הַגְּבוֹהוֹת וְהַגְּדוֹלוֹת. וְחוּט הַמִּשְׁקֹלֶת דְּרֵישָׁא דְּלֹא הָוֵי אֶלָּא שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר, מַיְרֵי בִמְיֻחָד לְבִנְיָנִים קְטַנִּים:


ושל בנאים – those who build high and large walls, and a plumb-line [mentioned] in the first clause [of the Mishnah] is aught other than twelve [handbreadths], we are speaking of something designated for small buildings.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:3:4)


**יָתֵר מִכֵּן.** יוֹתֵר מִמִּדּוֹת אֵלּוּ שֶׁמָּנוּ חֲכָמִים בְּכָל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהוּא רוֹצֶה בְקִיּוּמָן, טָהוֹר אוֹתוֹ הָעוֹדֵף עַל הַמִּדָּה וְלֹא הָוֵי חִבּוּר לִכְלִי:


יתר מכאן – more than these measurements that the Sages counted for each and every one, even though that he desires their existence, the excess over the measurement is ritually pure and it is not a connector to the vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:3:5)


**וְשֶׁל סַיָּדִים.** הַטָּחִים פְּנֵי הַכֹּתֶל בְּסִיד וְגַם הֵם צְרִיכִים לְמִשְׁקֹלֶת, וְכֵן הַצַּיָּרִים שֶׁמְּצַיְּרִים צוּרָה בַכְּתָלִים:


ושל סיידים (that of plasterers) – who plaster the face of the walls with lime/plaster, and they also require [the use of] a plumb-line, and similarly the painters who paint images on the walls.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:3:6)


**כָּל שֶׁהֵן.** בֵּין רַב בֵּין מְעַט הָוֵי חִבּוּר:


כל שהן – whether a lot or a little, it is a connector.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:4:1)


**חוּט מֹאזְנַיִם.** חוּט שֶׁאוֹחֲזִים בּוֹ הַמֹּאזְנַיִם בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁשּׁוֹקְלִים בָּהֶן:


חוט המאזנים (cord of the balance) – the chord that holds in it the balance at the time that they weigh them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:4:2)


**רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר טֶפַח טָהוֹר.** אִם יַד הַקֻּרְדֹּם גָּדוֹל כָּל כָּךְ שֶׁיּוֹצֵא טֶפַח לְאַחַר יָדוֹ, לָא חֲשִׁיב יָד, לְפִי שֶׁמַּזִּיק לוֹ לִמְלַאכְתּוֹ, וְכָל הַיָּד כֻּלּוֹ טָהוֹר. כָּךְ פֵּרֵשׁ מוֹרִי. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי:


ר' יוסי אומר טפח טהור – if the handle of the ax is so large that it extends a handbreadth from the back of his hand, it is not considered a handle, because it damages him while he is working, and every handle is completely pure. This is what my teacher explained. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yossi.



### Mishnah 5

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:5:1)


**יַד הַקֻּרְדֹּם מִלְּפָנָיו.** דֶּרֶךְ הָאוֹחֵז בְּיַד הַקֻּרְדֹּם כְּשֶׁרוֹצֶה לַחְתֹּךְ בּוֹ אֵינוֹ אוֹחֵז מַמָּשׁ בְּרֹאשׁ הַקַּתָּא שֶׁמָּא יַחְלִיק וְיִפֹּל מִיָּדוֹ אֶלָּא מַנִּיחַ מְעַט לְאַחַר יָדוֹ, וְהַשִּׁעוּר שֶׁיֶּשׁ בֵּין יַד הָאָדָם לַבַּרְזֶל קוֹרֵא מִלְּפָנָיו, וְהַיּוֹצֵא לְאַחַר יָדוֹ קוֹרֵא מֵאַחֲרָיו בְּאִידָךְ בָּבָא. וְהָא דְלָא מְפָרֵשׁ בְּבָבָא זוֹ דִין שֶׁלְּפָנָיו וְשֶׁל אַחֲרָיו, מִשּׁוּם דְּהָכָא חֲשִׁיב הָנָךְ דְּשִׁעוּרָן טֶפַח, וּבְאִידָךְ בָּבָא חֲשִׁיב הַנְהוּ דְשִׁעוּרָן שָׁלֹשׁ אֶצְבָּעוֹת:


יד הקרדום מלפניו (the handle of the ax at its front) – the manner that a person grasps hold on the handle of the ax when he wants to sever/cut with it, he doesn’t hold it actually at the top of the handle/helve lest it slip and fall from his hand, but rather he leaves a it of in back of his hand, and the measurement that there is between the hand of a person and the iron he calls from in front of him. But the person who goes out from the back of his hand he calls from in back of him in the other clause [of the Mishnah]. But that it doesn’t explain in this clause , the law of what is in front of him and what is behind him, because here, it considers theses those that their measurement is a handbreadth, but in the other clause [of the Mishnah], those whose measurement is three fingerbreadths.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:5:2)


**פַּרְגּוֹל.** מְחוֹגָה. קומפש"ו בְּלַעַ"ז. וְהֶחָרָשִׁים צְרִיכִים לַעֲשׂוֹת בּוֹ צוּרוֹת עֲגֻלּוֹת:


פרגל (a pair of compasses) – drawing figures in he air/gesturing. CUMPASU in the foreign language. And the artisans need to make round forms with it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:5:3)


**מַקֶּבֶת.** פַּטִּישׁ שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל שֶׁרֹאשׁוֹ אֶחָד חַד וּבוֹ נוֹקְבִים וּפוֹסְלִים אֶת הָאֲבָנִים, וְעַל שֵׁם כָּךְ נִקְרָא מַקֶּבֶת. וּלְשׁוֹן מִקְרָא הוּא, וּמַקָּבוֹת וְהַגַּרְזֶן כָּל כְּלִי בַרְזֶל (מלכים א ו):


מקבת (stone-cutter’s mallet) – an iron hammer that its one end is sharp and with it they bore/perforate and with it they cut/hew the stones. And on account of this it is called מקבת.
