And stone-cutter’s mallets and the ax/hatchel are all vessels of iron (First Kings, Chapter 6, Verse 7): “When the House (i.e., the First Temple) was built, only finished stones cut at the quarry were used,] so that no hammer or ax or any iron tool was heard in the House [while it was being built].”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:5:4)


**מְפַתְּחֵי אֲבָנִים.** לְשׁוֹן פִּתּוּחֵי חוֹתָם:


מפתחי אבנים (the shaft of a stonemason’s chisel) – "פתוחי חותם" /”[On the two stones you shall make] seal engravings – [the work of a lapidary”] (Exodus 28:11).



### Mishnah 6

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:6:1)


**שֶׁל צַמָּרִים.** מוֹכְרֵי צֶמֶר. וְטַעֲמָא דְהָנָךְ שִׁעוּרָן בִּטְפָחַיִם, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁתּוֹפֵס בָּהֶן בִּשְׁתֵּי יָדָיו. וְהַיְנוּ נַמִּי טַעֲמָא דְכָל הָנָךְ יָדוֹת דִּלְקַמָּן שֶׁשִּׁעוּרָן בְּטִפְחָיִם. וְכָל אוֹתָן שֶׁשִּׁעוּרָן טֶפַח, לְפִי שֶׁדַּרְכּוֹ לֶאֱחֹז בָּהֶן בְּיָדוֹ אַחַת:


של צמרים – those who sell wool, and he reason for these is there measurements of two handbreadths, because he grabs hold of them with two hands, and that is also the reason that all of these handles that are coming up, their measurement is with two handbreadths. And all of those whose measurement was a handbreadth, is because it was his manner to grab hold of them with [only] one hand.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:6:2)


**מַקּוֹר.** קֻרְנָס חַד שֶׁמְּנַקְּרִים בּוֹ הָרֵחַיִם. וְעַל שֵׁם שֶׁמְּנַקְּרִים בּוֹ קָרוּי מַקּוֹר:


מקור (beak, a tool for whetting millstones) – a sharp mallet/smith’s hammer that they bore/chisel the millstone. And on account of the fact that they bore/chisel with it, it is called a מקור.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:6:3)


**יַד הַמַּעֲצָד שֶׁל לִגְיוֹנוֹת.** גָּרְסִינַן. וְהוּא כְלִי מִכְּלֵי הָרוֹצְחִים, רֹאשׁוֹ עָגֹל, וְנוֹשְׂאִים אוֹתוֹ אַנְשֵׁי הַחַיִל בַּמִּלְחָמָה. וּבְעַרְבִי קוֹרִים לוֹ טבריזי"ן:


יד המעצד של לגיונות (the handle of the adze of the legions) – we have the reading. And it is a vessel from the vessels of the murderers, its head is round and warriors carry them in war. And in Arabic, we call it TAVRIZIN.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:6:4)


**שֶׁל זֶהָבִים.** הַמַּכִּים עַל זָהָב לַעֲשׂוֹת טַסִּין דַּקִּין:


של זהבים – they strike on gold to make thin plated objects (i.e., the goldsmith’s hammer)


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:6:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:6:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:6:5)


**וְשֶׁל חָרָשִׁים.** שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל:


ושל חרשים – of iron.



### Mishnah 7

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:7:1)


**שְׁיָרֵי הַדָּרְבָן מִלְמַעְלָן.** הַמַּרְדֵּעַ רֹאשׁוֹ אֶחָד יֵשׁ בּוֹ בַרְזֶל כְּעֵין מַרְצֵעַ שֶׁבּוֹ מְלַמֵּד הַפָּרָה לִתְלָמֶיהָ וְהוּא קָרוּי דָּרְבָן, וּבְרֹאשׁוֹ הַשֵּׁנִי בַּרְזֶל רָחָב מְחֻדָּד לַחְתֹּךְ בּוֹ שָׁרָשִׁים וּשְׁמוֹ חַרְחוּר. וְשִׁעוּר יַד הַמַּרְדֵּעַ, לְמַעְלָה לְצַד הַדָּרְבָן אַרְבָּעָה טְפָחִים חֲשׁוּבִים חִבּוּר, וּלְמַטָּה לְצַד הַחַרְחוּר שִׁבְעָה טְפָחִים הַסְּמוּכִים לוֹ הָווּ חִבּוּר, כְּדִלְקַמָּן. וּמַה שֶּׁהוּא יוֹתֵר מֵאַרְבָּעָה לְצַד הַדָּרְבָן וְשִׁבְעָה לְצַד הַחַרְחוּר אֵינוֹ חִבּוּר, וְאִם נָגַע שָׁם טֻמְאָה לֹא נִטְמָא לֹא הַחַרְחוּר וְלֹא הַדָּרְבָן:


שיירי הדרבן מלמעלן (the remnants [of the shaft] about the point of the ox goad) – the handle of the plough (called in the Bible a דרבן and/or a מלמד) at one end it has iron similar to an awl/borer that with it leads/teaches the heifer to its furrow, and it called a דרבן/ox goad, and on its second end is a wide piece of sharpened iron to sever the roots, and its name is חרחור/coulter [inserted into the horizontal pole/מרדע in front of the ploughshare/דרבן). And the measurement of the handle of the horizontal pole/מרדע is higher on the side of the דרבן/ox goad four handbreadths and it is considered as a connector, but below, to the side of the coulter/חרחור is seven handbreadths which are adjacent to it is a connector, as we see further on. And what is more than the four [handbreadths] to the side of the ploughshare and seven [handbreadths] to the side of the coulter is not a connector and if impurity/defilement came in contact there, it is not defiled, neither the coulter nor the ox goad.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:7:2)


**בָּדִיד.** כְּלִי בַרְזֶל שֶׁבּוֹ חוֹפְרִים גֻּמּוֹת סְבִיב הָאִילָן כְּדֵי שֶׁיַּחֲזִיקוּ מֵימֵיהֶן. וְעַל שֵׁם הַגֻּמּוֹת שֶׁקְּרוּיִין בְּדִידִין נִקְרָא הַכְּלִי הַחוֹפֵר בָּהֶן בָּדִיד:


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:7:3)


**שֶׁל נִכּוּשׁ.** פַּטִּישׁ שֶׁמַּקִּישִׁים בּוֹ עַל הָאֲבָנִים וּמְשַׁבְּרִים אוֹתָן:


של נכוש (the ax used for lopping trees) – a hammer that they strike with it on the stones and break them.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:7:4)


**בֶּן פַּטִּישׁ.** הַפַּטִּישׁ הַקָּטָן קָרוּי בֶּן פַּטִּישׁ, וְהַגָּדוֹל שְׁמוֹ פַּטִּישׁ:


בן פטיש (small hammer) – the small hammer is called בן פטיש and the large is called a פטיש/hammer.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:7:5)


**שֶׁל בִּקּוּעַ.** קֻרְדֹּם שֶׁמְּבַקְּעִים בּוֹ עֵצִים:


של בקוע (that part of the spade used for chopping) – a spade/hatchet that they chop trees with.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:7:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:7:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:7:6)


**שֶׁל עָדִיר.** שֶׁחוֹפְרִים בּוֹ הַקַּרְקַע לִזְרִיעָה. כְּמוֹ אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּעְדֵּר יֵעָדֵרוּן (ישעיה ז):


ושל עדור (hoeing) – that they dig/hollow out the ground for seeding, like (Isaiah 7:25): “[But the perils of thornbush and thistle shall not spread to any of the hills] that could only be tilled with a hoe; [and here cattle shall be let loose, and sheep and goats shall tramp about].”


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:7:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:7:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:7:7)


**שֶׁל סַתָּתִים.** חוֹצְבֵי אֲבָנִים וְהַמְקַצְּעִים וּמַשְׁוִין אוֹתָן:


של סתתין (stone-cutter’s ax) – hewing stones and those who trim them level them off.



### Mishnah 8

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:8:1)


**מַגְרֵפָה.** שֶׁגּוֹרְפִים בָּהּ תַּנּוּר וְכִירַיִם אוֹ הַטִּיט. תַּרְגּוּם יָעִים, מַגְרוֹפְיָתָא:


מגריפה (ladle – of the household) – that they remove/sweep ashes/coals from the oven and double stove, or the plaster/clay. The Aramaic translation of (Numbers 4:14): “[Upon I they shall place all the vessels that are used in its service: the fire pans, the flesh hooks,] the scrapers/יעים [and the basins – all the vessels of the altar – and over it they shall spread a covering of dolphin skin;]”is מגרופייתא /from ladles.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:8:2)


**וְשֶׁל סַיָּדִים.** שֶׁגּוֹרְפִים בָּהּ אֶת הַסִּיד:


ושל סיידים (of plasterers) – that they remove the plaster/lime.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:8:3)


**יָתֵר מִכָּאן.** יוֹתֵר מִמִּדּוֹת אֵלּוּ שֶׁמָּנוּ חֲכָמִים בְּיַד הַמַּגְרֵפָה, אִם רוֹצֶה בְקִיּוּם זֶה הָאֹרֶךְ הַיָּתֵר:


יתר מכן – more than these measures that the Sages counted in the hand of the ladle, if he wants this preservation of the extra length.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:8:4)


**טָמֵא.** אִם נִטְמָא הַכְּלִי. וְכֵן אִם נָגְעָה טֻמְאָה בְּכָל זֶה הָאֹרֶךְ שֶׁל יָד, נִטְמָא הַכְּלִי עִמּוֹ, דַּהֲוֵי חִבּוּר לַכְּלִי:


טמא – if the vessel is defiled, and similarly, if the defilement came in contact with all of this length of the handle, the vessel is defiled with it, for it is a connector to the vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 29:8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/29:8:5)


**יַד מְשַׁמְּשֵׁי הָאוּר.** כְּגוֹן יָד שֶׁל שַׁפּוּד וְאַסְכָּלָה וּמַרְחֶשֶׁת וּשְׁאָר כֵּלִים שֶׁתַּשְׁמִישָׁן עַל יְדֵי הָאוּר:


יד משמשי אור (shaft of fire implements) – such as the handle of the spit and the lattice-work of a fire place and the deep and covered plan, and other vessels and their utensils/implements through the fire.



## Chapter 30


### Mishnah 1

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:1:1)


**כְּלֵי זְכוּכִית.** הַךְ מַתְנִיתִין תְּנִינַן לְעֵיל בְּפֶרֶק ב'‏ וּבְפֶרֶק ט"ו. וְאַיְדֵי דְבָעֵי לְמִתְנֵי דִין הָנָךְ כֵּלִים שֶׁל זְכוּכִית הֲדַר תָּנָא לַהּ הָכָא:


כלי זכוכית – This Mishnah is taught above in Chapter 2 [Mishnah 1] and Chapter 15 [Mishnah 1] and since it was necessary to teach the law of these vessels of glass, he returns and teaches them once again here.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:1:2)


**טַבְלָא.** שֻׁלְחָן:


טבלא – table.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:1:3)


**אִסְקוּטְלָא.** בִּלְשׁוֹן לע"ז קוֹרִים לִקְעָרָה שקוטיל"א. וְהָכָא מַיְרֵי בִקְעָרָה פְשׁוּטָה שֶׁאֵין לָהּ בֵּית קִבּוּל, אֶלָּא שֶׁמִּתַּחְתֶּיהָ מְחֻבָּר לָהּ בֵּית קִבּוּל קָטָן הַמְשַׁמֵּשׁ כְּשֶׁכּוֹפִין הַכְּלִי עַל פָּנָיו, כְּעֵין שֶׁיֶּשׁ לְכוֹסוֹת שֶׁל כֶּסֶף וְשֶׁל זְכוּכִית שֶׁלָּנוּ:


אסקוטלא (a salver or a waiter of nearly square form) – in the foreign language, we call a dish SHEKOTILA. But here we are speaking of a flat dish, which does not have a receptacle, but rather that from underneath it, a small receptacle is connected to it that serves when we turn it upside down on its face, similar to what our silver and glass cups have.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:1:4)


**יֶשׁ לָהֶן לְבִזְבֵּז.** שָׂפָה סָבִיב, הַלְּבִזְבֵּז עוֹשֵׂהוּ כְלִי שֶׁיֶּשׁ בּוֹ בֵית קִבּוּל:


יש להן לבזבז (they have a vertical rim/edge – by which a flat vessel is made into a vessel—like receptacle) – a rim all around, the vertical rim makes it a vessel that has a receptacle.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:1:5)


**שׁוּלֵי קְעָרָה וְשׁוּלֵי אִסְקוּטְלָא.** כְּשֶׁנִּשְׁבָּר מְקוֹם תַּשְׁמִישָׁן נִשְׁאָר הַבֵּית קִבּוּל קָטָן וְהוֹפְכוֹ וּמִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בּוֹ, וַאֲפִלּוּ הָכִי טְהוֹרִים, דְּלָא חֲשִׁיבֵי הַשּׁוּלַיִם כְּלִי, מִפְּנֵי מְקוֹם הַשֶּׁבֶר שֶׁמַּזִּיק לַיָּדַיִם כְּשֶׁאוֹחֲזִים בּוֹ:


שולי קערה ושולי אסקוטלא (bottoms of a flat dish) – when the place of their usage is broken, there remains a small receptacle and he turns it over and uses it, but nevertheless they are ritually pure, for the rims are not considered a vessel, because the place of the break that injuries the hands when they hold it.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:1:6)


**קִרְטְסָן אוֹ שָׁפָן.** תִּקְּנָם וַעֲשָׂאָן חֲלָקִים עַד שֶׁרְאוּיִין לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בְּאוֹתוֹ בֵית קִבּוּל, טְמֵאִים, דְּלֹא הָווּ תוּ שֶׁבֶר כְּלִי:


קרטסן או שפן (if he scraped them or filed them) – he repaired them and made them smooth until their were appropriate to be used in the same receptacle, they are impure, for they are no longer the shards of a vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:1:7)


**בְּשׁוּפִין.** כְּלִי שֶׁצּוֹרְפִין וְחָרָשֵׁי בַרְזֶל מְסִירִים בּוֹ הַחֲלֻדָּה וּמַחְלִיקִים בּוֹ הַכֵּלִים. תַּרְגּוּם הַצְּרִיפִים, שׁוּפִינָא. לימ"א בְּלַעַ"ז:


בשופין (with files) – a vessel that that refines and iron artisans remove the rust/mold and smooth/level the vessels. The Aramaic translation of הצריפים/those who smelt, refine is שופינא/file. LIMA in the foreign language.



### Mishnah 2

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:2:1)


**אַסְפַּקְלַרְיָא.** מַרְאָה שֶׁל זְכוּכִית שֶׁהָאִשָּׁה רוֹאָה בָהּ אֶת פָּנֶיהָ. וּבְלַעַ"ז אספקל"ו. וַאֲפִלּוּ יֵשׁ לָהּ בֵּית קִבּוּל טְהוֹרָה, לְפִי שֶׁאֵינָהּ עֲשׂוּיָה לְקַבֵּל אֶלָּא לִרְאוֹת צוּרַת הַפָּנִים:


אספקלריא (window-glass) – a glass mirror that a woman sees her face in. And in the foreign language ISPAKLAV. But even if it has a receptacle, it is ritually pure, for it is not used to receive anything, but only to look at the shape/form of the face.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:2:2)


**תַּמְחוּי.** כְּמִין קְעָרָה גְדוֹלָה שֶׁל זְכוּכִית:


תמחוי – like a kind of large glass tray.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:2:3)


**תַּרְוָד.** כַּף שֶׁל זְכוּכִית:


תרוד (spoon – pointed on top and curved at the end) – a glass spoon.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:2:4)


**וְאִם לָאו.** אִם כְּשֶׁנּוֹתְנוֹ עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן אוֹ עַל דָּבָר פָּשׁוּט הוּא מִתְגַּלְגֵּל לְכָאן וּלְכָאן וְנִשְׁפָּךְ מַה שֶּׁבְּתוֹכוֹ, לְפִי שֶׁתַּחְתָּיו חַד וְאֵינוֹ עוֹמֵד:


ואם לאו – if when he places it on the table or on a flat surface it rolls to here and there and what is in it spills, because it is sharp underneath and does not stand.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:2:5)


**רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא מְטַמֵּא.** הוֹאִיל וְיֵשׁ לוֹ בֵית קִבּוּל. וַהֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא:


ר' עקיבא מטמא – for since it has a receptacle. And the Halakha is according to Rabbi Akiba.



### Mishnah 3

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:3:1)


**כּוֹס.** שֶׁל זְכוּכִית:


כוס – of glass.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:3:2)


**שֶׁנִּפְגַּם רֻבּוֹ טָהוֹר.** דַּחֲשִׁיב שֶׁבֶר כְּלִי:


שנפגם רובו טהור (that the majority of which is cracked/broken off) – that it is considered a broken vessel/fragment of a vessel.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:3:3)


**נִפְגַּם בּוֹ שָׁלֹשׁ בְּרֻבּוֹ.** שֶׁהַשָּׁלֹשׁ פְּגִימוֹת עוֹמְדוֹת בְּרֻבּוֹ שֶׁל כּוֹס וְלֹא בְמִעוּטוֹ:


מפגם בו שלש ברובו – that the three notches/cracks stand in the majority of the cup but not in its minority.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:3:4)


**טָהוֹר.** אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְפַזֵּר אֶת רֹב הַמַּיִם:


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:3:5)


**אִם מְפַזֵּר הוּא אֶת רֹב הַמַּיִם טָהוֹר.** אֲבָל בְּמִעוּט, טָמֵא. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן:


אם מפזר הוא את רוב המים טהור (if it scatters/disperses the majority of the water – it is pure) – but with a minority, it is ritually impure. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Shimon.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:3:6)


**בְּבַעַץ.** בִּבְדִיל:


בבעץ – with tin.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:3:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:3:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:3:7)


**רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר בְּבַעַץ טָמֵא.** דְּהַכֹּל הוֹלֵךְ אַחַר הַמַּעֲמִיד, וַחֲשִׁיב כִּכְלֵי מַתָּכוֹת. וְאֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי:


רבי יוסי אומר בבעץ טמא – for everything follows after what restores it/preserves it, and it is considered like a metal vessel. But the Halakha is not according to Rabbi Yossi.



### Mishnah 4

###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:1)


**צְלוֹחִית.** כְּעֵין צְלוֹחִיּוֹת שֶׁל זְכוּכִית שֶׁלָּנוּ שֶׁיֶּשׁ לָהֶן צַוָּאר אָרֹךְ:


צלוחית – that is similar to our glass flash that has a long neck.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:2)


**שֶׁנִּטַּל פִּיהָ.** שֶׁנִּטַּל צַוָּארָהּ:


שניטל פיה – whose neck was removed.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:3)


**וּבִגְדוֹלָה.** שֶׁאֵינָהּ יְכוֹלָה לִנָּטֵל בְּיָדוֹ אַחַת אֶלָּא בִשְׁתֵּי יָדָיו קְרוּיָה גְדוֹלָה, וְשֶׁיְּכוֹלָה לִנָּטֵל בְּיָדוֹ אַחַת קְרוּיָה קְטַנָּה:


ובגדולה – that is not able to be carried with one hand, but only with two hands is called a large [flask], but that which can be carried with one hand is called a small [flask].


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:4)


**שֶׁל פַּלְיָטוֹן.** שֶׁל שֶׁמֶן אֲפַרְסְמוֹן:


של פלייטון (an ointment or oil prepared from leaves of spikenard) – of balsam oil.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:4:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:5)


**טְהוֹרָה.** דְּתוּ לֹא חַזְיָא לִמְלַאכְתָּהּ:


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:4:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:6)


**מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהִיא סוֹרַחַת אֶת הַיָּד.** הַבָּא לָתֵת יָדוֹ לְתוֹכָהּ לָקַחַת מִן הַפַּלְיָטוֹן לְהָרִיחַ בּוֹ, יָדוֹ נִסְרֶכֶת וְנִשְׂרֶטֶת וְנִקְרַעַת, סוֹרַחַת, כְּמוֹ סוֹרֶכֶת בְּכָ"ף, לְשׁוֹן סִרְכָא:


מפני שהיא סורחת את היד (because it lacerates/catches the hand – when you attempt to get the aromatic unguent out) – one who goes to place his hand inside to take from the ointment of spikenard to smell it, his hand is lacerated and scratched and torn, [The word] סורחת like [the word] סורכת with [the letter] "כ" is the language of an adhesion/סרכא.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:4:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:7)


**לְגִינִין גְּדוֹלִים.** כְּמוֹ כַדִּין גְּדוֹלִים:


לגינין (bottle, flask/flagon – smaller than a pitcher but larger than a cup) – like large pitchers.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:4:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:8)


**מְתַקְּנָן לִכְבָשִׁים.** שֶׁכּוֹבְשִׁים בָּהֶן יָרָק בְּמֶלַח וּבְחֹמֶץ וּמַנִּיחִין אוֹתָן שָׁם לְהִתְקַיֵּם:


מתקנין לכבשים (repairs them for use for pickled/preserved things) – when they pickle in them a vegetable in salt and in vinegar and leave the there to be established.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:4:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:9)


**אֲפַרְכֵּס.** כְּלִי עָשׂוּי לָרֵחַיִם, שֶׁרָחָב מִלְּמַעְלָה וְקָצָר מִלְּמַטָּה בְשׁוּלָיו, וְנוֹתְנִים בּוֹ חִטִּין הַרְבֵּה בְּפַעַם אַחַת וְהֵן יוֹרְדִים מְעַט מְעַט לְתוֹךְ הָרֵחַיִם וְנִטְחָנִים שָׁם. וְדֻגְמָתוֹ מָצִינוּ בְּרֵישׁ חֲגִיגָה (דף ג) עֲשֵׂה אָזְנְךָ כַּאֲפַרְכֶּסֶת, שֶׁמַּכְנִיס הַרְבֵּה וּמוֹצִיא קִמְעָה:


אפרכס (the hopper, grain-receiver on top of the millstone) – a vessel that is made for the millstone, wide from the top and narrow from the bottom at its rims, and they place in it a lot of wheat at one time and they (i.e., the wheat kernels) go down gradually into the millstone and they are ground there. And an example of this we found at the beginning of [Tractate] Hagigah [3a]: “Make your ear like the hopper to receive the teaching,” for one brings in a lot and it produces a little.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:4:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:10)


**אַשְׁרַיִךְ כֵּלִים.** מַסֶּכֶת כֵּלִים:


אשריך כלים – Tractate Kelim.


###### Bartenura on Mishnah Kelim 30:4:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Bartenura%20on%20Mishnah%20Kelim/r/30:4:11)


**שֶׁנִּכְנַסְתְּ בְּטֻמְאָה וְיָצָאת בְּטָהֳרָה.** מַתְחֶלֶת בַּאֲבוֹת הַטֻּמְאוֹת וּמְסַיֶּמֶת הָאֲפַרְכֵּס שֶׁל זְכוּכִית טְהוֹרָה:


שנכנסת בטומאה ויצאת בטהרה – it begins with the primary sources of uncleanness and the glass hopper/grain-receive on top of the receiver concludes in purity.
